```js
(function(){
  'use strict';

  var API = window.__API_BASE__ || '/api';

  /* هشدار: اگر hostname فرق داره، کوکی SameSite=Lax ممکنه ارسال نشه */
  try{
    var apiUrl = new URL(API, location.href);
    if(apiUrl.hostname !== location.hostname){
      console.warn("[login] hostname mismatch: page=" + location.hostname + " api=" + apiUrl.hostname + " — کوکی SameSite=Lax ممکنه ارسال نشه. از همون hostname استفاده کن.");
    }
  }catch(e){}

  var $ = function(s,r){ return (r||document).querySelector(s); };
  var $$ = function(s,r){ return Array.prototype.slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(s)); };

  var card = $('.auth-card');
  var form = $('#loginForm');
  var alertBox = $('#authAlert');
  var submitBtn = $('#authSubmit');

  function setAlert(msg, ok){
    if(!msg){ alertBox.hidden = true; return; }
    alertBox.hidden = false;
    alertBox.textContent = msg;
    alertBox.className = 'auth-alert' + (ok ? ' ok' : '');
  }

  function normPhone(v){
    return String(v || '')
      .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, function(d){ return '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d); })
      .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
  }

  function switchMode(mode){
    card.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    form.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    $$('.auth-tab').forEach(function(t){
      t.classList.toggle('is-active', t.dataset.tab === mode);
    });
    var label = $('.auth-submit-label');
    if(label) label.textContent = mode === 'signup' ? 'ساخت حساب' : 'ورود به حساب';
    var pw = $('#auPassword');
    if(pw) pw.setAttribute('autocomplete', mode === 'signup' ? 'new-password' : 'current-password');
    var pwS = $('#pwStrength');
    if(pwS) pwS.hidden = mode !== 'signup';
    setAlert('');
  }

  $$('.auth-tab').forEach(function(t){
    t.addEventListener('click', function(){ switchMode(t.dataset.tab); });
  });
  $$('[data-switch-to]').forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      switchMode(a.dataset.switchTo);
    });
  });

  $$('.auth-eye').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var inp = document.getElementById(b.dataset.eye);
      if(!inp) return;
      var on = inp.type === 'text';
      inp.type = on ? 'password' : 'text';
      b.classList.toggle('is-on', !on);
    });
  });

  var pwInput = $('#auPassword');
  if(pwInput){
    pwInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
      var v = pwInput.value;
      var bar = $('#pwStrength .auth-pw-bar i');
      var lbl = $('#pwStrength .auth-pw-lbl');
      if(!bar) return;
      var s = 0;
      if(v.length >= 8) s++;
      if(v.length >= 12) s++;
      if(/[A-Z]/.test(v) || /[آ-ی]/.test(v)) s++;
      if(/\d/.test(v)) s++;
      if(/[^A-Za-z0-9آ-ی]/.test(v)) s++;
      var pct = Math.min(100, (s/5)*100);
      bar.style.width = pct + '%';
      bar.style.background = s <= 1 ? '#b91c4a' : (s <= 3 ? '#d97706' : '#0e7c5f');
      lbl.textContent = s <= 1 ? 'ضعیف' : (s <= 3 ? 'متوسط' : (s >= 5 ? 'بسیار قوی' : 'قوی'));
    });
  }

  var otpBtn = $('#otpBtn');
  if(otpBtn){
    otpBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      setAlert('ورود با کد یکبار مصرف به زودی فعال می‌شود. لطفاً از رمز عبور استفاده کنید.');
    });
  }

  var forgotLink = $('#forgotLink');
  if(forgotLink){
    forgotLink.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      setAlert('برای بازیابی رمز، با پشتیبانی تماس بگیرید.');
    });
  }

  var phoneInput = $('#auPhone');
  if(phoneInput){
    phoneInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
      var v = normPhone(phoneInput.value);
      if(v.length > 11) v = v.slice(0, 11);
      phoneInput.value = v;
    });
  }

  form.addEventListener('submit', async function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    setAlert('');
    var mode = form.getAttribute('data-mode') || 'login';
    var phone = normPhone($('#auPhone').value);
    var password = $('#auPassword').value;

    if(!/^09\d{9}$/.test(phone)){
      setAlert('شمارهٔ موبایل باید با ۰۹ شروع شود و ۱۱ رقم باشد.');
      $('#auPhone').focus();
      return;
    }

    if(mode === 'signup'){
      var name = $('#auName').value.trim();
      var confirm = $('#auConfirm').value;
      var terms = $('#auTerms').checked;

      if(name.length < 3){ setAlert('نام حداقل ۳ کاراکتر.'); $('#auName').focus(); return; }
      if(password.length < 8){ setAlert('رمز حداقل ۸ کاراکتر.'); $('#auPassword').focus(); return; }
      if(password !== confirm){ setAlert('رمز و تکرار یکسان نیست.'); $('#auConfirm').focus(); return; }
      if(!terms){ setAlert('پذیرش قوانین الزامی است.'); return; }

      submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.classList.add('is-loading');
      try{
        var r1 = await fetch(API + '/auth/register', {
          method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include',
          body: JSON.stringify({ name: name, phone: phone, password: password })
        });
        var d1 = await r1.json();
        if(!r1.ok) throw new Error(d1.message || 'ثبت‌نام ناموفق');
        setAlert('حساب ساخته شد! در حال انتقال...', true);
        setTimeout(function(){ var u=d.user||d.data&&d.data.user; var target=(u&&u.role==="admin")?"admin.html":"index.html"; window.location.href=target; }, 700);
      }catch(err){
        setAlert(err.message || 'خطا در ثبت‌نام');
      }finally{
        submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.classList.remove('is-loading');
      }
      return;
    }

    if(!password){ setAlert('رمز عبور الزامی است.'); $('#auPassword').focus(); return; }

    submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.classList.add('is-loading');
    try{
      var r = await fetch(API + '/auth/login', {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include',
        body: JSON.stringify({ phone: phone, password: password })
      });
      var d = await r.json();
      if(!r.ok) throw new Error(d.message || 'ورود ناموفق');
      setAlert('خوش آمدید! در حال انتقال...', true);
      setTimeout(function(){ var u=d.user||d.data&&d.data.user; var target=(u&&u.role==="admin")?"admin.html":"index.html"; window.location.href=target; }, 700);
    }catch(err){
      setAlert(err.message || 'شماره یا رمز اشتباه است.');
    }finally{
      submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.classList.remove('is-loading');
    }
  });

  var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  if(params.get('signup') === '1') switchMode('signup');
})();
```

```js
(function(){
  'use strict';

  /* ============== helpers ============== */
  function $(s, r){ return (r || document).querySelector(s); }
  function $$(s, r){ return Array.prototype.slice.call((r || document).querySelectorAll(s)); }
  function fa(n){ try{ return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('fa-IR'); } catch(e){ return String(n || 0); } }
  function faT(n){ return fa(Math.round((Number(n)||0)/10)); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c){ return { '&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;' }[c]; }); }

  /* حذف هر کاراکتر غیر عددی */
  function toNum(s){ return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''); }
  /* فرمت سه رقمی با جداکننده فارسی */
  function fmt(n){
    var num = Number(n) || 0;
    if(num === 0) return '';
    return num.toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
  }

  /* تبدیل عدد به حروف فارسی */
  function numToWordsFa(n){
    n = Math.floor(Number(n) || 0);
    if(n === 0) return 'صفر';
    if(n < 0) return 'منفی ' + numToWordsFa(-n);

    var yekan = ['', 'یک', 'دو', 'سه', 'چهار', 'پنج', 'شش', 'هفت', 'هشت', 'نه'];
    var dahgan = ['', '', 'بیست', 'سی', 'چهل', 'پنجاه', 'شصت', 'هفتاد', 'هشتاد', 'نود'];
    var dah = ['ده', 'یازده', 'دوازده', 'سیزده', 'چهارده', 'پانزده', 'شانزده', 'هفده', 'هجده', 'نوزده'];
    var sadgan = ['', 'صد', 'دویست', 'سیصد', 'چهارصد', 'پانصد', 'ششصد', 'هفتصد', 'هشتصد', 'نهصد'];
    var scales = ['', ' هزار', ' میلیون', ' میلیارد', ' بیلیون'];

    function threeDigit(x){
      if(x === 0) return '';
      var out = [];
      var s = Math.floor(x / 100);
      var r = x % 100;
      if(s) out.push(sadgan[s]);
      if(r >= 10 && r < 20){
        out.push(dah[r - 10]);
      } else {
        var d = Math.floor(r / 10);
        var y = r % 10;
        if(d) out.push(dahgan[d]);
        if(y) out.push(yekan[y]);
      }
      return out.join(' و ');
    }

    var groups = [];
    var rem = n;
    var i = 0;
    while(rem > 0){
      var g = rem % 1000;
      if(g > 0){
        var txt = threeDigit(g);
        if(scales[i]) txt = txt + scales[i];
        groups.unshift(txt);
      }
      rem = Math.floor(rem / 1000);
      i++;
      if(i >= scales.length) break;
    }
    return groups.join(' و ');
  }

  async function apiGet(p){ return fetchAPI(p, 'GET'); }
  async function fetchAPI(p, method, body){
    method = method || 'GET';
    var opts = { method: method, credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } };
    if(body) opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    var res = await fetch(API + p, opts);
    var data = null;
    try{ data = await res.json(); }catch(e){ data = { success:false, message:'invalid' }; }
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || ('HTTP ' + res.status));
    return data;
  }

  }

  function getModal(){
    var m = $('#modal');
    if(!m){
      m = document.createElement('div');
      m.id = 'modal';
      m.className = 'adm-modal';
      m.hidden = true;
      m.innerHTML = '<div class="adm-modal-scrim" data-close></div><div class="adm-modal-box" id="modalBox"></div>';
      document.body.appendChild(m);
    }
    return m;
  }
  function getModalBox(){
    var b = $('#modalBox');
    if(!b){ getModal(); b = $('#modalBox'); }
    return b;
  }

  var lastFocus = null;
  function openModal(html){
    var m = getModal();
    var box = getModalBox();
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    box.innerHTML = html;
    m.hidden = false;
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    var fe = box.querySelector('[data-autofocus]');
    if(fe) setTimeout(function(){ fe.focus(); }, 40);
  }
  function closeModal(){
    var m = $('#modal');
    var box = $('#modalBox');
    if(m) m.hidden = true;
    if(box) box.innerHTML = '';
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = '';
    if(lastFocus && lastFocus.focus) lastFocus.focus();
  }

        +     '<div class="sl-final-label">قیمت نهایی پس از تخفیف</div>'
        +     '<div class="sl-final-value">'
        +       '<b id="slFinalNum">' + fa(fp) + '</b> <small>ریال</small>'
        +     '</div>'
        +     '<div class="sl-final-words" id="slFinalWords">' + (fpWords ? fpWords + ' ریال' : '') + '</div>'
        +   '</div>'
        + '</div>'
        + '<div class="aps-section">'
        +   '<div class="aps-section-head"><span class="aps-section-ic">' + ic('box', 16) + '</span><h4>انبار</h4></div>'
        +   '<div class="aps-grid">'
        +     '<div class="aps-field"><label>موجودی <span class="req">*</span></label><input class="adm-input" data-f="stock" inputmode="numeric" value="' + F.stock + '"></div>'
        +     '<div class="aps-field"><label>حداقل موجودی</label><input class="adm-input" data-f="minStock" inputmode="numeric" value="' + F.minStock + '"></div>'
        +     '<div class="aps-field"><label>وزن (گرم)</label><input class="adm-input" data-f="weight" inputmode="numeric" value="' + F.weight + '"></div>'
        +     '<div class="aps-field"><label>ابعاد</label><input class="adm-input" data-f="dimensions" dir="ltr" value="' + esc(F.dimensions) + '"></div>'
        +     '<div class="aps-field aps-field-wide"><label>گارانتی</label><input class="adm-input" data-f="warranty" value="' + esc(F.warranty) + '"></div>'
        +   '</div>'
        + '</div>';
    }

    function tabMedia(){
      return ''
        + '<div class="aps-section">'
        +   '<div class="aps-section-head"><span class="aps-section-ic">' + ic('image', 16) + '</span><h4>تصاویر</h4><span class="aps-counter" id="slImgCount">' + fa(F.images.length) + '</span></div>'
        +   '<div id="slImgList" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(100px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px"></div>'
        +   '<div class="aps-upload-row">'
        +     '<label class="aps-upload-btn" for="slFile" style="cursor:pointer">' + ic('upload', 16) + '<span>آپلود از دستگاه</span></label>'
        +     '<input type="file" id="slFile" accept="image/*" multiple style="display:none">'
        +     '<div class="aps-url-add"><input class="adm-input" id="slNewUrl" dir="ltr" placeholder="https://..."><button class="adm-btn outline" id="slAddUrl" type="button">افزودن با URL</button></div>'
        +   '</div>'
        + '</div>'
        + '<div class="aps-section">'
        +   '<div class="aps-section-head"><span class="aps-section-ic">' + ic('image', 16) + '</span><h4>ویدئو</h4></div>'
        +   '<div class="aps-field aps-field-wide"><input class="adm-input" data-f="videoUrl" dir="ltr" value="' + esc(F.videoUrl) + '" placeholder="https://..."></div>'
        + '</div>';
    }

    function tabVariants(){
      var colorRows = F.colors.map(function(c, i){
        return '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr 36px;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px">'
          + '<input type="color" value="' + esc(c.hex || '#94a3b8') + '" data-ch="' + i + '" style="width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--adm-border);cursor:pointer">'
          + '<input class="adm-input" value="' + esc(c.name || '') + '" data-cn="' + i + '" placeholder="نام رنگ">'
          + '<button type="button" data-cd="' + i + '" class="aps-row-del">×</button>'
          + '</div>';
      }).join('');
      var sizeChips = F.sizes.map(function(s, i){
        return '<span class="aps-size-chip"><input value="' + esc(s) + '" data-sz="' + i + '"><button type="button" data-szd="' + i + '">×</button></span>';
      }).join('');
      return ''
        + '<div class="aps-section">'
        +   '<div class="aps-section-head"><span class="aps-section-ic">' + ic('layers', 16) + '</span><h4>رنگ‌ها</h4></div>'
        +   '<div>' + colorRows + '</div>'
        +   '<button class="aps-add-btn" id="slAddColor" type="button" style="margin-top:8px">+ افزودن رنگ</button>'
        + '</div>'
        + '<div class="aps-section">'
        +   '<div class="aps-section-head"><span class="aps-section-ic">' + ic('layers', 16) + '</span><h4>سایزها</h4></div>'
        +   '<div class="aps-size-list">' + sizeChips + '</div>'
        +   '<div class="aps-inline-add" style="margin-top:12px"><input class="adm-input" id="slNewSize" placeholder="مثلاً XL"><button class="adm-btn outline" id="slAddSize" type="button">افزودن</button></div>'
        + '</div>';
    }

    function tabSpecs(){
      var specRows = F.specs.map(function(s, i){
        return '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 36px;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px">'
          + '<input class="adm-input" value="' + esc(s.key || '') + '" data-sk="' + i + '" placeholder="کلید">'
          + '<input class="adm-input" value="' + esc(s.value || '') + '" data-sv="' + i + '" placeholder="مقدار">'
          + '<button type="button" data-sd="' + i + '" class="aps-row-del">×</button>'
          + '</div>';
      }).join('');
      var featRows = F.features.map(function(f, i){
        return '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr 36px;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px">'
          + '<span style="color:var(--adm-ok)">✓</span>'
          + '<input class="adm-input" value="' + esc(f) + '" data-ft="' + i + '">'
          + '<button type="button" data-ftd="' + i + '" class="aps-row-del">×</button>'
          + '</div>';
      }).join('');
      return ''
        + '<div class="aps-section">'
        +   '<div class="aps-section-head"><span class="aps-section-ic">' + ic('grid', 16) + '</span><h4>مشخصات فنی</h4></div>'
        +   '<div>' + specRows + '</div>'
        +   '<button class="aps-add-btn" id="slAddSpec" type="button" style="margin-top:8px">+ افزودن مشخصه</button>'
        + '</div>'
        + '<div class="aps-section">'
        +   '<div class="aps-section-head"><span class="aps-section-ic">' + ic('check', 16) + '</span><h4>ویژگی‌ها</h4></div>'
        +   '<div>' + featRows + '</div>'
        +   '<div class="aps-inline-add" style="margin-top:12px"><input class="adm-input" id="slNewFeat" placeholder="ویژگی جدید"><button class="adm-btn outline" id="slAddFeat" type="button">افزودن</button></div>'
        + '</div>';
    }

    function bindInputs(){
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-f]').forEach(function(el){
        var k = el.dataset.f;
        if(el.type === 'checkbox'){
          el.onchange = function(){
            F[k] = el.checked;
            if(k === 'isActive'){
              var lbl = el.closest('.adm-pub-toggle');
              if(lbl){ var sp = lbl.querySelector('.adm-pub-label'); if(sp) sp.textContent = el.checked ? 'منتشر شده' : 'پیش‌نویس'; }
            }
          };
        } else if(el.classList.contains('sl-num')){
          /* فیلد عددی با جداکننده سه‌رقمی */
          el.oninput = function(){
            var raw = toNum(el.value);
            F[k] = raw;
            var pos = el.selectionStart;
            var prevLen = el.value.length;
            el.value = raw ? fmt(Number(raw)) : '';
            var newLen = el.value.length;
            var newPos = pos + (newLen - prevLen);
            if(newPos < 0) newPos = 0;
            if(newPos > newLen) newPos = newLen;
            try{ el.setSelectionRange(newPos, newPos); }catch(e){}
            /* آپدیت باکس قیمت */
            updateFinalBox();
          };
        } else {
          el.oninput = function(){ F[k] = el.value; };
        }
      });
    }

    function updateFinalBox(){
      var priceEl = body.querySelector('[data-f="price"]');
      var offEl = body.querySelector('[data-f="off"]');
      var price = Number(toNum(priceEl ? priceEl.value : '')) || 0;
      var off = Math.min(90, Math.max(0, Number(toNum(offEl ? offEl.value : '')) || 0));
      var fp = Math.round(price * (1 - off / 100) / 1000) * 1000;

      var numEl = body.querySelector('#slFinalNum');
      var wordsEl = body.querySelector('#slFinalWords');
      var priceWordsEl = body.querySelector('#slPriceWords');

      if(numEl) numEl.textContent = fa(fp);
      if(wordsEl) wordsEl.textContent = fp > 0 ? numToWordsFa(fp) + ' ریال' : '';
      if(priceWordsEl) priceWordsEl.textContent = price > 0 ? numToWordsFa(price) + ' ریال' : '';
    }

    function paintTab(name){
      sheet.querySelectorAll('.aps-tab').forEach(function(t){ t.classList.toggle('is-active', t.dataset.ptab === name); });

      if(name === 'general'){
        body.innerHTML = tabGeneral();
        bindInputs();
      } else if(name === 'pricing'){
        body.innerHTML = tabPricing();
        bindInputs();
        /* event listener روی off */
        var offEl = body.querySelector('[data-f="off"]');
        if(offEl){
          offEl.addEventListener('input', updateFinalBox);
        }
        updateFinalBox();
      } else if(name === 'media'){
        body.innerHTML = tabMedia();
        bindInputs();
        renderImages();

        var fileInput = body.querySelector('#slFile');
        if(fileInput){
          fileInput.onchange = function(){
            var files = Array.prototype.slice.call(fileInput.files || []);
            fileInput.value = '';
            if(!files.length) return;
            files.forEach(function(f){
              var fd = new FormData();
              fd.append('image', f);
              var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
              xhr.open('POST', (window.__API_BASE__ || '/api') + '/upload/product-single', true);
              xhr.withCredentials = true;
              xhr.onload = function(){
                try{
                  var r = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText || '{}');
                  if(r.success){ F.images.push(r.url); renderImages(); }
                  else toast('خطا: ' + (r.message || 'آپلود ناموفق'), 'err');
                }catch(e){ toast('خطا در آپلود', 'err'); }
              };
              xhr.send(fd);
            });
          };
        }

        body.querySelector('#slAddUrl').onclick = function(){
          var i = body.querySelector('#slNewUrl');
          var u = (i.value || '').trim();
          if(!u){ toast('URL را وارد کنید.', 'warn'); return; }
          F.images.push(u); i.value = ''; renderImages();
        };
      } else if(name === 'variants'){
        body.innerHTML = tabVariants();
        bindInputs();
        bindVariants();
      } else if(name === 'specs'){
        body.innerHTML = tabSpecs();
        bindInputs();
        bindSpecs();
      }
    }

    function renderImages(){
      var list = body.querySelector('#slImgList');
      var cnt = body.querySelector('#slImgCount');
      if(!list) return;
      if(cnt) cnt.textContent = fa(F.images.length);
      if(!F.images.length){
        list.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:20px;grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;color:var(--adm-muted);font-size:13px">هنوز تصویری اضافه نشده</div>';
        return;
      }
      list.innerHTML = F.images.map(function(u, i){
        var abs = window.__ASSET__ ? window.__ASSET__(u) : u;
        return '<div style="position:relative;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--adm-border);background-image:url(' + JSON.stringify(abs) + ');background-size:cover;background-position:center">'
          + '<button type="button" data-di="' + i + '" style="position:absolute;top:6px;inset-inline-end:6px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);color:#fff;border:0;cursor:pointer">×</button>'
          + '</div>';
      }).join('');
      list.querySelectorAll('[data-di]').forEach(function(b){
        b.onclick = function(){ F.images.splice(+b.dataset.di, 1); renderImages(); };
      });
    }

    function bindVariants(){
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-ch]').forEach(function(el){ el.oninput = function(){ F.colors[+el.dataset.ch].hex = el.value; }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-cn]').forEach(function(el){ el.oninput = function(){ F.colors[+el.dataset.cn].name = el.value; }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-cd]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick = function(){ F.colors.splice(+b.dataset.cd, 1); paintTab('variants'); }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-sz]').forEach(function(el){ el.oninput = function(){ F.sizes[+el.dataset.sz] = el.value; }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-szd]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick = function(){ F.sizes.splice(+b.dataset.szd, 1); paintTab('variants'); }; });
      var ac = body.querySelector('#slAddColor');
      if(ac) ac.onclick = function(){ F.colors.push({ name:'', hex:'#94a3b8' }); paintTab('variants'); };
      var as = body.querySelector('#slAddSize');
      if(as) as.onclick = function(){ var v = body.querySelector('#slNewSize').value.trim(); if(!v) return; F.sizes.push(v); paintTab('variants'); };
    }

    function bindSpecs(){
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-sk]').forEach(function(el){ el.oninput = function(){ F.specs[+el.dataset.sk].key = el.value; }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-sv]').forEach(function(el){ el.oninput = function(){ F.specs[+el.dataset.sv].value = el.value; }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-sd]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick = function(){ F.specs.splice(+b.dataset.sd, 1); paintTab('specs'); }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-ft]').forEach(function(el){ el.oninput = function(){ F.features[+el.dataset.ft] = el.value; }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-ftd]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick = function(){ F.features.splice(+b.dataset.ftd, 1); paintTab('specs'); }; });
      var as = body.querySelector('#slAddSpec');
      if(as) as.onclick = function(){ F.specs.push({ key:'', value:'' }); paintTab('specs'); };
      var af = body.querySelector('#slAddFeat');
      if(af) af.onclick = function(){ var v = body.querySelector('#slNewFeat').value.trim(); if(!v) return; F.features.push(v); paintTab('specs'); };
    }

    sheet.querySelectorAll('[data-ptab]').forEach(function(t){
      t.onclick = function(){ paintTab(t.dataset.ptab); };
    });

    sheet.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick = closeModal; });

    /* delete */
    var delBtn = sheet.querySelector('#slDelBtn');
    if(delBtn && id){
      delBtn.onclick = async function(){
        var yes = await confirmDialog({ title:'حذف محصول', message:'این محصول حذف می‌شود. مطمئنید؟', confirmText:'حذف' });
        if(!yes) return;
        delBtn.disabled = true;
        try{
          await fetchAPI('/seller/products/' + id, 'DELETE');
          toast('محصول حذف شد.', 'ok');
          closeModal();
          if(window.__sellerProductsRefresh) window.__sellerProductsRefresh();
        }catch(e){ toast('خطا: ' + e.message, 'err'); delBtn.disabled = false; }
      };
    }

    /* save */
    var saveBtn = sheet.querySelector('#slSaveBtn');
    saveBtn.onclick = async function(){
      if(saveBtn.disabled) return;
      saveBtn.disabled = true;
      var old = saveBtn.textContent;
      saveBtn.textContent = 'در حال ذخیره...';
      try{
        sheet.querySelectorAll('[data-f]').forEach(function(el){
          var k = el.dataset.f;
          if(el.classList.contains('sl-num')){
            F[k] = toNum(el.value);
          } else {
            F[k] = el.type === 'checkbox' ? el.checked : el.value;
          }
        });
        var payload = {
          name: String(F.name || '').trim(),
          sku: String(F.sku || '').trim() || null,
          brand: String(F.brand || '').trim(),
          category: F.category,
          price: Number(toNum(F.price)) || 0,
          purchasePrice: 0,
          off: Math.min(90, Math.max(0, Number(toNum(F.off)) || 0)),
          stock: Number(toNum(F.stock)) || 0,
          minStock: Number(toNum(F.minStock)) || 0,
          weight: Number(toNum(F.weight)) || 0,
          dimensions: F.dimensions || '',
          art: F.art || 'book',
          description: F.description || '',
          shortDescription: F.shortDescription || '',
          videoUrl: F.videoUrl || '',
          warranty: F.warranty || '',
          metaTitle: F.metaTitle || '',
          metaDescription: F.metaDescription || '',
          images: (F.images || []).filter(function(u){ return u && String(u).trim(); }),
          features: (F.features || []).filter(function(x){ return x && String(x).trim(); }),
          sizes: (F.sizes || []).filter(function(x){ return x && String(x).trim(); }),
          colors: (F.colors || []).filter(function(c){ return c && c.name; }),
          specs: (F.specs || []).filter(function(s){ return s && s.key && s.value; }),
          isActive: !!F.isActive
        };
        if(payload.name.length < 2){ toast('نام محصول را وارد کنید.', 'warn'); throw new Error('v'); }
        if(!payload.brand){ toast('برند را وارد کنید.', 'warn'); throw new Error('v'); }
        if(!payload.category){ toast('دسته را انتخاب کنید.', 'warn'); throw new Error('v'); }
        if(!payload.price){ toast('قیمت را وارد کنید.', 'warn'); throw new Error('v'); }

        if(id){ await fetchAPI('/seller/products/' + id, 'PUT', payload); }
        else   { await fetchAPI('/seller/products', 'POST', payload); }
        toast(id ? 'محصول ذخیره شد.' : 'محصول اضافه شد.', 'ok');
        closeModal();
        if(window.__sellerProductsRefresh) window.__sellerProductsRefresh();
      }catch(e){
        if(e.message !== 'v'){
          console.error('[seller-save]', e);
          toast('خطا: ' + (e.message || 'نامشخص'), 'err');
        }
        saveBtn.disabled = false;
        saveBtn.textContent = old;
      }
    };

    paintTab('general');
  }

  /* ============== inject actions to table ============== */
  function injectActions(){
    var body = document.getElementById('prBody');
    if(!body) return;
    var table = body.closest('table');
    if(!table) return;
    var thead = table.querySelector('thead tr');
    if(!thead) return;

    if(!thead.querySelector('[data-seller-actions]')){
      var th = document.createElement('th');
      th.className = 'col-actions';
      th.setAttribute('data-seller-actions', '1');
      th.textContent = 'عملیات';
      thead.appendChild(th);
    }

    var rows = body.querySelectorAll('tr[data-id]');
    rows.forEach(function(tr){
      if(tr.querySelector('[data-seller-actions-cell]')) return;
      var id = tr.getAttribute('data-id');
      if(!id) return;
      var td = document.createElement('td');
      td.className = 'col-actions';
      td.setAttribute('data-seller-actions-cell', '1');
      td.innerHTML = '<div class="adm-tbl-actions">'
        + '<button class="adm-iconbtn-sm" data-sl-edit="' + id + '" title="ویرایش">✎</button>'
        + '<button class="adm-iconbtn-sm danger" data-sl-del="' + id + '" title="حذف">🗑</button>'
        + '</div>';
      tr.appendChild(td);
      td.querySelector('[data-sl-edit]').onclick = function(){ openProductForm(+id); };
      td.querySelector('[data-sl-del]').onclick = async function(){
        var yes = await confirmDialog({ title:'حذف محصول', message:'مطمئنید؟', confirmText:'حذف' });
        if(!yes) return;
        try{ var r = await fetchAPI('/seller/products/' + id, 'DELETE'); toast(r.message || 'حذف شد.', 'ok'); if(window.__sellerProductsRefresh) window.__sellerProductsRefresh(); }
        catch(e){ toast(e.message, 'err'); }
      };
    });
  }

  function injectAddButton(){
    var addBtn = document.getElementById('sl-add-product-btn');
    if(addBtn) return;
    var secHead = document.querySelector('.adm-content .adm-sec-head');
    if(!secHead) return;
    var h2 = secHead.querySelector('h2');
    if(!h2 || h2.textContent.indexOf('محصولات من') === -1) return;
    var actions = secHead.querySelector('.adm-sec-actions');
    if(!actions){ actions = document.createElement('div'); actions.className = 'adm-sec-actions'; secHead.appendChild(actions); }
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.id = 'sl-add-product-btn';
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.className = 'adm-btn primary';
    btn.innerHTML = '+ افزودن محصول';
    btn.onclick = function(){ openProductForm(null); };
    actions.appendChild(btn);
  }

  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    setTimeout(function(){ injectAddButton(); injectActions(); }, 100);
    setTimeout(function(){ injectAddButton(); injectActions(); }, 400);
  });
  function start(){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    setTimeout(function(){ injectAddButton(); injectActions(); }, 500);
    setTimeout(function(){ injectAddButton(); injectActions(); }, 1500);
    setTimeout(function(){ injectAddButton(); injectActions(); }, 3000);
  }
  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  } else {
    start();
  }

  console.log('[seller-products-ui-v2] ready');
})();
```

```js
/* ============== helpers ============== */
var $  = function(s,r){ return (r||document).querySelector(s); };
var $$ = function(s,r){ return Array.prototype.slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(s)); };
var fa = function(n){ try{ return Number(n||0).toLocaleString('fa-IR'); }catch(e){ return String(n||0); } };
var esc = function(s){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){ return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]; }); };
var store = {
  get: function(k,d){ try{ var v=localStorage.getItem(k); return v?JSON.parse(v):d; }catch(e){ return d; } },
  set: function(k,v){ try{ localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v)); }catch(e){} },
  del: function(k){ try{ localStorage.removeItem(k); }catch(e){} }
};

/* ============== api ============== */
async function api(path, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  var res = await fetch(API + path, Object.assign({
    credentials: 'include',
    headers: Object.assign({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, opts.headers || {})
  }, opts));
  var data = null;
  try{ data = await res.json(); }catch(e){ data = { success:false, message:'پاسخ نامعتبر' }; }
  if(res.status === 401){
    showBoot('نشست منقضی شد، در حال انتقال...');
    setTimeout(function(){ location.href = 'login.html'; }, 1200);
    throw new Error('unauth');
  }
  if(res.status === 403){
    toast('دسترسی ندارید.', 'err');
    throw new Error(data.message || 'forbidden');
  }
  if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || ('HTTP ' + res.status));
  return data;
}
var apiGet = function(p){ return api(p); };

/* ============== toast ============== */
function toast(msg, type, dur){
  type = type || 'info'; dur = dur || 3200;
  var box = $('#toasts');
  var el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'adm-toast ' + (type==='ok'?'ok':type==='err'?'err':type==='warn'?'warn':'');
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="adm-toast-ic">' + ic(type==='ok'?'check':'x', 18) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="adm-toast-msg"></div>' +
    '<button class="adm-toast-x" type="button">×</button>';
  el.querySelector('.adm-toast-msg').textContent = String(msg);
  var remove = function(){ el.classList.add('out'); setTimeout(function(){ el.remove(); }, 200); };
  el.querySelector('.adm-toast-x').onclick = remove;
  box.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(remove, dur);
}

/* ============== boot ============== */
function showBoot(msg){ $('#bootLoader').hidden = false; $('#app').hidden = true; if(msg) $('#bootMsg').textContent = msg; }

var PAGES = [

function renderNav(){
  var nav = $('#nav');
  nav.innerHTML = PAGES.map(function(p){
    return '<a class="adm-nav-it' + (state.page === p.id ? ' active' : '') + '" data-page="' + p.id + '" tabindex="0">' +
      '<span class="adm-nav-ic" data-ic="' + p.icon + '"></span><span>' + p.label + '</span></a>';
  }).join('');
  hydrateIcons(nav);
  nav.querySelectorAll('.adm-nav-it').forEach(function(el){
    el.onclick = function(){ go(el.dataset.page); };
  });
}

function hydrateIcons(root){
  (root || document).querySelectorAll('[data-ic]').forEach(function(e){ e.innerHTML = ic(e.dataset.ic, e.dataset.s || 20); });
}

function go(page){
  state.page = page;
  document.querySelectorAll('.adm-nav-it').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.toggle('active', el.dataset.page === page); });
  closeSidebar();
  var P = PAGES.filter(function(p){ return p.id === page; })[0];
  $('#pageTitle').textContent = P ? P.label : '';
  $('#pageSub').textContent = '';
  var c = $('#content');
  c.innerHTML = '';
  if(page === 'dashboard') renderDashboard(c);
  else if(page === 'products') renderProducts(c);
  else if(page === 'orders') renderOrders(c);
}

/* ============== products ============== */
async function renderProducts(root){
  root.innerHTML = '<div class="adm-sec-head"><h2>محصولات من</h2><span class="adm-sec-sub" id="prCount"></span></div>' +
    '<div class="adm-card">' +
    '<div class="adm-toolbar"><div class="adm-search"><span class="adm-search-ic">' + ic('search',18) + '</span><input id="prQ" placeholder="جستجو..." autocomplete="off"></div>' +
    '<select class="adm-select" id="prStatus" style="max-width:180px"><option value="">همه وضعیت‌ها</option><option value="true">فعال</option><option value="false">غیرفعال</option></select>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="adm-tbl-wrap"><table class="adm-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
    '<th>محصول</th><th>دسته</th><th>قیمت</th><th>موجودی</th><th>فروش</th><th>وضعیت</th>' +
    '</tr></thead><tbody id="prBody"></tbody></table></div></div>';
  var body = $('#prBody');
  var cntEl = $('#prCount');
  var timer;
  async function load(){
    body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:32px;text-align:center;color:var(--adm-muted)">در حال بارگذاری...</td></tr>';
    var params = new URLSearchParams();
    var qv = $('#prQ').value.trim();
    var st = $('#prStatus').value;
    if(qv) params.set('q', qv);
    if(st) params.set('active', st);
    params.set('limit', '100');
    try{
      var r = await apiGet('/seller/products?' + params.toString());
      var items = r.items || [];
      cntEl.textContent = fa(r.pagination && r.pagination.total || items.length) + ' محصول';
      if(!items.length){
        body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="adm-empty" style="padding:52px 16px"><h3>محصولی نیست</h3></div></td></tr>';
        return;
      }
      body.innerHTML = items.map(function(p){
        var img = p.images && p.images.length ? window.__ASSET__(p.images[0]) : null;
        var stockBadge = p.stock <= 0 ? '<span class="adm-bdg danger">ناموجود</span>' : (p.stock <= 5 ? '<span class="adm-bdg warn">' + fa(p.stock) + ' (کم)</span>' : '<span class="adm-bdg ok">' + fa(p.stock) + ' عدد</span>');
        return '<tr data-id="' + p.id + '">' +
          '<td><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px">' +
            '<div class="adm-prod-thumb" style="position:relative;overflow:hidden">' +
            (img ? '<img src="' + esc(img) + '" alt="" style="position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover" onerror="this.style.display=&quot;none&quot;">' : '') +
            '<span style="position:relative;z-index:0;display:grid;place-items:center;width:100%;height:100%">' + ic(p.art || 'box', 22) + '</span></div>' +
            '<div><b>' + esc(p.name) + '</b><div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--adm-muted)">' + esc(p.brand || '') + '</div></div>' +
          '</div></td>' +
          '<td><span class="adm-bdg">' + esc(p.category ? p.category.name : '—') + '</span></td>' +
          '<td><b>' + fa(p.finalPrice) + '</b>' + (p.off ? ' <small style="color:var(--adm-danger)">-' + fa(p.off) + '%</small>' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + stockBadge + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + fa(p.sales) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + (p.isActive ? '<span class="adm-bdg ok">منتشرشده</span>' : '<span class="adm-bdg">پیش‌نویس</span>') + '</td>' +
        '</tr>';
      }).join('');
    }catch(e){
      body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:32px;text-align:center;color:var(--adm-danger)">' + esc(e.message) + '</td></tr>';
    }
  }
  $('#prQ').addEventListener('input', function(){ clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(load, 300); });
  $('#prStatus').addEventListener('change', load);
  load();
}

async function renderOrders(root){

    '</tr></thead><tbody id="orBody"></tbody></table></div></div>';

        '<td>' + (o.createdAt ? new Date(o.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('fa-IR') : '—') + '</td>' +
      '</tr>';
    }).join('');
  }catch(e){
    body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:32px;text-align:center;color:var(--adm-danger)">' + esc(e.message) + '</td></tr>';
  }
}

/* ============== init ============== */
async function init(){
  hydrateIcons();
  renderNav();
  try{
    var r = await apiGet('/auth/me');
    if(!r.user || (r.user.role !== 'seller' && r.user.role !== 'admin')){
      showBoot('دسترسی فروشنده لازم است. در حال انتقال...');
      setTimeout(function(){ location.href = 'index.html'; }, 1200);
      return;
    }
    state.user = r.user;
    $('#userAvatar').textContent = (r.user.name || 'ف').trim().charAt(0);
    $('#userName').textContent = r.user.name || 'فروشنده';
    $('#userEmail').textContent = r.user.phone || r.user.email || '';
  }catch(e){
    if(e.message !== 'unauth'){
      showBoot('برای دسترسی وارد شوید...');
      setTimeout(function(){ location.href = 'login.html'; }, 1200);
    }
    return;
  }
  $('#bootLoader').hidden = true;
  $('#app').hidden = false;
  go('dashboard');

  $('#menuBtn').onclick = openSidebar;
  $('#sideScrim').onclick = closeSidebar;
  $('#refreshBtn').onclick = function(){ if(state.page === 'dashboard') renderDashboard($('#content')); else if(state.page === 'products') renderProducts($('#content')); else renderOrders($('#content')); };
  $('#themeBtn').onclick = function(){
    state.theme = state.theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    document.documentElement.dataset.admTheme = state.theme;
    store.set('bz.sl.theme', state.theme);
  };

  /* user chip */
  var chip = $('#userChip');
  chip.onclick = function(e){
    if(e.target.closest('[data-user-menu]')) return;
    var m = $('#userMenu');
    m.hidden = !m.hidden;
    chip.classList.toggle('open', !m.hidden);
  };
  $('#userMenu').onclick = function(e){
    var btn = e.target.closest('[data-user-menu]');
    if(!btn) return;
    var a = btn.dataset.userMenu;
    $('#userMenu').hidden = true; chip.classList.remove('open');
    if(a === 'site') window.open('index.html','_blank');
    else if(a === 'logout'){
      fetch(API + '/auth/logout', { method:'POST', credentials:'include' }).then(function(){ location.href = 'index.html'; });
    }
  };
}

init();
})();
```

FILE: backend\routes\auth.js
================================================================================
```js
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const { body } = require('express-validator');
const validate = require('../middleware/validate');
const { protect } = require('../middleware/auth');
const rateLimit = require('express-rate-limit');
const ctrl = require('../controllers/authController');

/* محدودکننده تلاش ورود */
const loginLimiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  max: 15,
  message: { success:false, message:'تعداد تلاش‌های ورود زیاد است. ۱۵ دقیقه صبر کنید.' }
});

/* ============ ثبت‌نام — فقط شماره ============ */
router.post('/register',
  loginLimiter,
  [
    body('name').trim().isLength({ min:3, max:60 }).withMessage('نام باید بین ۳ تا ۶۰ کاراکتر باشد.'),
    body('phone').trim().matches(/^09\d{9}$/).withMessage('شمارهٔ موبایل باید با ۰۹ شروع شود و ۱۱ رقم باشد.'),
    body('password').isLength({ min:8 }).withMessage('رمز عبور حداقل ۸ کاراکتر باشد.')
  ],
  validate, ctrl.register
);

/* ============ ورود — فقط شماره ============ */
router.post('/login',
  loginLimiter,
  [
    body('phone').trim().matches(/^09\d{9}$/).withMessage('شمارهٔ موبایل باید با ۰۹ شروع شود و ۱۱ رقم باشد.'),
    body('password').notEmpty().withMessage('رمز عبور الزامی است.')
  ],
  validate, ctrl.login
);

/* ============ OTP — به زودی ============ */
router.post('/otp/send', ctrl.sendOtp);
router.post('/otp/verify', ctrl.verifyOtp);

/* ============ بقیه ============ */
router.post('/logout', ctrl.logout);
router.post('/refresh', ctrl.refresh);
router.get('/me', protect, ctrl.me);
router.put('/me', protect, ctrl.updateMe);
router.put('/change-password', protect, ctrl.changePassword);

/* ============ Google (غیرفعال اگه کلید نباشه) ============ */
if(process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID){
  const passport = require('passport');
  require('../config/passport');
  router.get('/google', ctrl.googleStart);
  router.get('/google/callback',
    ctrl.googleVerifyState,
    function(req, res, next){
      const base = (process.env.CLIENT_URL || '').split(',')[0].trim() || 'http://localhost:8080';
      passport.authenticate('google', { session: false, failureRedirect: base + '/login.html?error=oauth' })(req, res, next);
    },
    ctrl.googleCallback
  );
}

module.exports = router;
```

FILE: backend\routes\categories.js
================================================================================
```js
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();

/* __cache_buster__ */
const { del: _cDel } = require('../utils/cache');
router.use(function(req, res, next){
  if(req.method === 'GET') return next();
  res.on('finish', function(){
    if(res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300){
      try{ _cDel('http:/api/categories'); }catch(e){}
    }
  });
  next();
});

const { body } = require('express-validator');
const validate = require('../middleware/validate');
const { protect, adminOnly } = require('../middleware/auth');
const ctrl = require('../controllers/categoryController');

router.get('/', ctrl.list);

router.post('/',
  protect, adminOnly,
  [body('name').trim().notEmpty().withMessage('نام دسته‌بندی الزامی است.')],
  validate, ctrl.create
);
router.put('/:id',    protect, adminOnly, ctrl.update);
router.delete('/:id', protect, adminOnly, ctrl.remove);

module.exports = router;
```

```js
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();

/* __cache_buster__ */
const { del: _cDel } = require('../utils/cache');
router.use(function(req, res, next){
  if(req.method === 'GET') return next();
  res.on('finish', function(){
    if(res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300){
      try{ _cDel('http:/api/cms'); }catch(e){}
    }
  });
  next();
});

const { protect, adminOnly, optionalAuth } = require('../middleware/auth');
const ctrl = require('../controllers/cmsController');

/* Pages — public reads, admin writes */
router.get('/pages', optionalAuth, ctrl.pagesList);
router.get('/pages/:slug', optionalAuth, ctrl.pagesGet);
router.post('/pages', protect, adminOnly, ctrl.pagesCreate);
router.put('/pages/:id', protect, adminOnly, ctrl.pagesUpdate);
router.delete('/pages/:id', protect, adminOnly, ctrl.pagesDelete);

/* Banners */
router.get('/banners', optionalAuth, ctrl.bannersList);
router.post('/banners', protect, adminOnly, ctrl.bannersCreate);
router.put('/banners/:id', protect, adminOnly, ctrl.bannersUpdate);
router.delete('/banners/:id', protect, adminOnly, ctrl.bannersDelete);

/* Sliders */
router.get('/sliders', optionalAuth, ctrl.slidersList);
router.post('/sliders', protect, adminOnly, ctrl.slidersCreate);
router.put('/sliders/:id', protect, adminOnly, ctrl.slidersUpdate);
router.delete('/sliders/:id', protect, adminOnly, ctrl.slidersDelete);

module.exports = router;
```

FILE: backend\routes\upload.js
================================================================================
```js
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const multer = require('multer');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { protect, adminOnly } = require('../middleware/auth');

const UPLOAD_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'uploads');
if(!fs.existsSync(UPLOAD_DIR)) fs.mkdirSync(UPLOAD_DIR, { recursive:true });

const ALLOWED = ['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp','image/gif','image/avif'];
const MAX_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024; /* 5MB */

const storage = multer.diskStorage({
  destination: (req, file, cb) => cb(null, UPLOAD_DIR),
  filename: (req, file, cb) => {
    const ext = (path.extname(file.originalname) || '.jpg').toLowerCase().slice(0, 6);
    const id = crypto.randomBytes(12).toString('hex');
    cb(null, 'prod-' + Date.now() + '-' + id + ext);
  }
});

const upload = multer({
  storage,
  limits: { fileSize: MAX_SIZE },
  fileFilter: (req, file, cb) => {
    if(ALLOWED.includes(file.mimetype)) return cb(null, true);
    cb(new Error('فرمت تصویر پشتیبانی نمی‌شود.'));
  }
});

/* POST /api/upload/product  — multiple images */
router.post('/product',
  protect, adminOnly,
  (req, res, next) => {
    upload.array('images', 10)(req, res, (err) => {
      if(err instanceof multer.MulterError){
        const msg = err.code === 'LIMIT_FILE_SIZE'
          ? 'حجم تصویر بیشتر از ۵ مگابایت است.'
          : err.message;
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message: msg });
      }
      if(err) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message: err.message });
      next();
    });
  },
  (req, res) => {
    if(!req.files || !req.files.length){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'هیچ فایلی ارسال نشد.' });
    }
    const urls = req.files.map(f => '/uploads/' + f.filename);
    res.json({ success:true, urls, files: req.files.map(f => ({ name:f.filename, size:f.size })) });
  }
);

/* POST /api/upload/product-single — one image */
router.post('/product-single',
  protect, adminOnly,
  (req, res, next) => {
    upload.single('image')(req, res, (err) => {
      if(err instanceof multer.MulterError){
        const msg = err.code === 'LIMIT_FILE_SIZE'
          ? 'حجم تصویر بیشتر از ۵ مگابایت است.'
          : err.message;
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message: msg });
      }
      if(err) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message: err.message });
      next();
    });
  },
  (req, res) => {
    if(!req.file){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'فایلی ارسال نشد.' });
    }
    res.json({ success:true, url:'/uploads/' + req.file.filename });
  }
);

/* DELETE /api/upload/delete — remove an uploaded file */
router.delete('/delete',
  protect, adminOnly,
  (req, res) => {
    try{
      const { url } = req.body || {};
      if(!url || !url.startsWith('/uploads/')) return res.status(400).json({ success:false });
      const filename = path.basename(url);
      const full = path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, filename);
      if(!full.startsWith(UPLOAD_DIR)) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'مسیر نامعتبر' });
      if(fs.existsSync(full)) fs.unlinkSync(full);
      res.json({ success:true });
    }catch(e){
      res.status(500).json({ success:false, message:e.message });
    }
  }
);

module.exports = router;
```

```js
require('dotenv').config();
const { pool } = require('../db/init');

async function hasIdx(t, n){
  const [r] = await pool.query(
    'SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=? AND TABLE_NAME=? AND INDEX_NAME=?',
    [process.env.DB_NAME, t, n]
  );
  return r[0].c > 0;
}
async function add(t, n, c){
  if(await hasIdx(t, n)){ console.log('[skip] ' + n); return; }
  try{
    await pool.query('CREATE INDEX ' + n + ' ON ' + t + ' (' + c + ')');
    console.log('[add]  ' + n);
  }catch(e){ console.log('[fail] ' + n + ' — ' + e.message); }
}
(async ()=>{
  try{
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_created', 'created_at');
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_price', 'price');
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_off', 'off');
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_stock', 'stock');
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_rating', 'rating');
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_sales', 'sales');
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_cat_active', 'category_id, is_active');
    await add('orders', 'idx_ord_created', 'created_at');
    await add('orders', 'idx_ord_status', 'status');
    await add('orders', 'idx_ord_user', 'user_id');
    await add('order_items', 'idx_oi_prod', 'product_id');
    await add('users', 'idx_usr_role', 'role');
    await add('users', 'idx_usr_created', 'created_at');
    await add('reviews', 'idx_rev_created', 'created_at');
    await add('cms_pages', 'idx_cms_menu', 'show_in_menu');
    console.log('Indexes done.');
    await pool.end();
    process.exit(0);
  }catch(e){ console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); }
})();
```

FILE: backend\utils\cache.js
================================================================================
```js
const store = new Map();
const MAX_ENTRIES = 500;

function get(k){
  const it = store.get(k);
  if(!it) return null;
  if(Date.now() > it.expires){ store.delete(k); return null; }
  return it.value;
}
function set(k, v, ttl){
  if(store.size >= MAX_ENTRIES){
    const first = store.keys().next().value;
    if(first) store.delete(first);
  }
  store.set(k, { value: v, expires: Date.now() + (ttl || 60000) });
}
function del(prefix){
  if(!prefix){ store.clear(); return; }
  for(const k of store.keys()){
    if(k.indexOf(prefix) === 0) store.delete(k);
  }
}
function cacheMiddleware(ttl){
  return function(req, res, next){
    if(req.method !== 'GET') return next();

    /* اگه کوکی یا هدر Authorization هست، کش نکن (ادمین/کاربر لاگین‌شده) */
    if(req.headers && (req.headers.authorization || req.headers.cookie)){
      res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'SKIP-AUTH');
      return next();
    }

    /* کلید کش: مسیر کامل شامل path و query */
    var key = 'http:' + req.originalUrl;

    var hit = get(key);
    if(hit){
      res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'HIT');
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=' + Math.floor(ttl/1000));
      return res.json(hit);
    }

    var orig = res.json.bind(res);
    res.json = function(body){
      if(res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300){
        set(key, body, ttl);
      }
      res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'MISS');
      return orig(body);
    };
    next();
  };
}
setInterval(function(){
  const now = Date.now();
  for(const [k,v] of store.entries()){
    if(now > v.expires) store.delete(k);
  }
}, 300000);
module.exports = { get, set, del, cacheMiddleware };
```

```js
const nodemailer = require('nodemailer');

let transporter = null;
if(process.env.SMTP_HOST && process.env.SMTP_USER){
  transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
    host: process.env.SMTP_HOST,
    port: Number(process.env.SMTP_PORT || 587),
    secure: Number(process.env.SMTP_PORT) === 465,
    auth: { user: process.env.SMTP_USER, pass: process.env.SMTP_PASS }
  });
}

async function sendMail({ to, subject, text, html }){
  if(!transporter){
    console.log('\n========== [MAIL - DEV MODE] ==========');
    console.log('To:', to);
    console.log('Subject:', subject);
    console.log('Body:', text || html);
    console.log('=======================================\n');
    return { dev:true };
  }
  return transporter.sendMail({
    from: process.env.SMTP_FROM || 'Bazaarche <noreply@bazaarche.local>',
    to, subject, text, html
  });
}
module.exports = { sendMail };
```

```js
require('dotenv').config();
const { pool } = require('../db/init');

async function hasColumn(t, c){
  const [r] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=? AND TABLE_NAME=? AND COLUMN_NAME=?', [process.env.DB_NAME, t, c]);
  return r[0].c > 0;
}
async function hasTable(t){
  const [r] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=? AND TABLE_NAME=?', [process.env.DB_NAME, t]);
  return r[0].c > 0;
}
async function addCol(t, c, def){
  if(await hasColumn(t, c)){ console.log('[skip] ' + t + '.' + c); return; }
  try{ await pool.query('ALTER TABLE ' + t + ' ADD COLUMN ' + c + ' ' + def); console.log('[add]  ' + t + '.' + c); }
  catch(e){ console.log('[fail] ' + t + '.' + c + ' — ' + e.message); }
}

(async ()=>{
  try{
    // products columns
    await addCol('products', 'sku', 'VARCHAR(64)');
    await addCol('products', 'purchase_price', 'INT DEFAULT 0');
    await addCol('products', 'short_description', 'VARCHAR(320)');
    await addCol('products', 'images', 'JSON');
    await addCol('products', 'video_url', 'VARCHAR(500)');
    await addCol('products', 'min_stock', 'INT DEFAULT 3');
    await addCol('products', 'weight', 'INT DEFAULT 0');
    await addCol('products', 'dimensions', 'VARCHAR(60)');
    await addCol('products', 'features', 'JSON');
    await addCol('products', 'sizes', 'JSON');
    await addCol('products', 'warranty', 'VARCHAR(120)');
    await addCol('products', 'meta_title', 'VARCHAR(200)');
    await addCol('products', 'meta_description', 'VARCHAR(320)');

    // orders columns
    await addCol('orders', 'tax', 'INT DEFAULT 0');
    await addCol('orders', 'shipment_tracking', 'VARCHAR(80)');
    await addCol('orders', 'shipment_carrier', 'VARCHAR(60)');
    await addCol('orders', 'internal_note', 'TEXT');
    await addCol('orders', 'refunded_amount', 'INT DEFAULT 0');
    await addCol('orders', 'returned_at', 'TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL');
    await addCol('orders', 'return_reason', 'TEXT');
    await addCol('orders', 'refunded_at', 'TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL');
    await addCol('orders', 'refund_note', 'TEXT');
    await addCol('orders', 'stock_restored', 'TINYINT DEFAULT 0');
    await addCol('orders', 'payment_simulated', 'TINYINT DEFAULT 0');

    // users columns
    await addCol('users', 'token_version', 'INT DEFAULT 0');

    // cms tables
    if(!await hasTable('cms_pages')){
      await pool.query('CREATE TABLE cms_pages (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, slug VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, content LONGTEXT, meta_title VARCHAR(200), meta_description VARCHAR(320), is_published TINYINT DEFAULT 1, show_in_menu TINYINT DEFAULT 0, sort_order INT DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_cms_pages_slug (slug)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci');
      console.log('[add]  cms_pages');
    } else console.log('[skip] cms_pages');
    if(!await hasTable('cms_banners')){
      await pool.query('CREATE TABLE cms_banners (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(200), image_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, link VARCHAR(500), position VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT \'top\', is_active TINYINT DEFAULT 1, sort_order INT DEFAULT 0, start_at TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL, end_at TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_cms_banners_pos (position, is_active)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci');
      console.log('[add]  cms_banners');
    } else console.log('[skip] cms_banners');
    if(!await hasTable('cms_sliders')){
      await pool.query('CREATE TABLE cms_sliders (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(200), subtitle VARCHAR(300), image_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, link VARCHAR(500), button_text VARCHAR(80), bg_color VARCHAR(20), is_active TINYINT DEFAULT 1, sort_order INT DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_cms_sliders_active (is_active, sort_order)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci');
      console.log('[add]  cms_sliders');
    } else console.log('[skip] cms_sliders');

    // indexes
    const indexes = [
      ['products', 'idx_prod_created', 'created_at'],
      ['products', 'idx_prod_active', 'is_active'],
      ['products', 'idx_prod_cat_active', 'category_id, is_active'],
      ['orders', 'idx_ord_created', 'created_at'],
      ['orders', 'idx_ord_status', 'status'],
      ['orders', 'idx_ord_user', 'user_id'],
      ['order_items', 'idx_oi_prod', 'product_id'],
      ['users', 'idx_usr_role', 'role'],
      ['users', 'idx_usr_created', 'created_at']
    ];
    for(const [t, n, c] of indexes){
      try{
        const [r] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=? AND TABLE_NAME=? AND INDEX_NAME=?', [process.env.DB_NAME, t, n]);
        if(r[0].c > 0){ console.log('[skip] ' + n); continue; }
        await pool.query('CREATE INDEX ' + n + ' ON ' + t + ' (' + c + ')');
        console.log('[add]  ' + n);
      }catch(e){ console.log('[fail] ' + n); }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('Migration done.');
    await pool.end();
    process.exit(0);
  }catch(e){ console.error('FATAL:', e.message); process.exit(1); }
})();
```

```js
require('dotenv').config();
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const { pool, q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');

(async ()=>{
  try{
    const NAME  = process.argv[2];
    const PHONE = process.argv[3];
    const PASS  = process.argv[4];

    if(!NAME || !PHONE || !PASS){
      console.error('missing args');
      process.exit(1);
    }

    /* چک اگه از قبل هست */
    let user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE phone = ? LIMIT 1', [PHONE]);
    const hash = await bcrypt.hash(PASS, 12);

    if(user){
      /* آپدیت به ادمین + رمز جدید */
      await q('UPDATE users SET name = ?, password = ?, role = ?, is_active = 1, token_version = COALESCE(token_version,0) + 1 WHERE id = ?', [NAME, hash, 'admin', user.id]);
      console.log('UPDATED');
    } else {
      /* ایجاد */
      const email = 'admin' + PHONE + '.' + Date.now().toString(36) + '@admin.local';
      const id = await insert(
        'INSERT INTO users (name, email, phone, password, role, is_active) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)',
        [NAME, email, PHONE, hash, 'admin', 1]
      );
      console.log('CREATED id=' + id);
    }

    /* لیست ادمین‌ها */
    const [admins] = await pool.query("SELECT id, name, phone, is_active FROM users WHERE role = 'admin' ORDER BY id");
    console.log('ADMINS_TOTAL=' + admins.length);
    for(const a of admins){
      console.log('  #' + a.id + '  ' + a.name + '  |  ' + a.phone + '  |  ' + (a.is_active ? 'فعال' : 'غیرفعال'));
    }

    await pool.end();
    process.exit(0);
  }catch(e){
    console.error('ERR: ' + e.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();
```

```js
require('dotenv').config();
const { pool } = require('../db/init');
async function hasCol(t, c){
  const [r] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=? AND TABLE_NAME=? AND COLUMN_NAME=?', [process.env.DB_NAME, t, c]);
  return r[0].c > 0;
}
async function add(t, c, def){
  if(await hasCol(t, c)){ console.log('[skip] ' + t + '.' + c); return; }
  try{ await pool.query('ALTER TABLE ' + t + ' ADD COLUMN ' + c + ' ' + def); console.log('[add]  ' + t + '.' + c); }
  catch(e){ console.log('[fail] ' + t + '.' + c); }
}
(async ()=>{
  try{
    await add('categories', 'image_url', 'VARCHAR(500)');
    await add('site_features', 'image_url', 'VARCHAR(500)');
    console.log('done');
    await pool.end();
    process.exit(0);
  }catch(e){ console.error('ERR:', e.message); process.exit(1); }
})();
```

```js
require('dotenv').config();
const { pool } = require('../db/init');

const COLUMNS = [
  ['tax',               'INT DEFAULT 0'],
  ['shipment_tracking', 'VARCHAR(80)'],
  ['shipment_carrier',  'VARCHAR(60)'],
  ['internal_note',     'TEXT'],
  ['refunded_amount',   'INT DEFAULT 0'],
  ['returned_at',       'TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL'],
  ['return_reason',     'TEXT'],
  ['refunded_at',       'TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL'],
  ['refund_note',       'TEXT']
];

async function columnExists(table, col){
  const [rows] = await pool.query(
    'SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=? AND TABLE_NAME=? AND COLUMN_NAME=?',
    [process.env.DB_NAME, table, col]
  );
  return rows[0].c > 0;
}

(async ()=>{
  for(const [name, def] of COLUMNS){
    if(await columnExists('orders', name)){
      console.log('[SKIP] orders.' + name);
      continue;
    }
    await pool.query('ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN ' + name + ' ' + def);
    console.log('[ADD]  orders.' + name);
  }
  console.log('Done.');
  await pool.end();
  process.exit(0);
})().catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });
```

```js
async function hasColumn(table, col){
  const [r] = await pool.query(
    'SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=? AND TABLE_NAME=? AND COLUMN_NAME=?',
    [process.env.DB_NAME, table, col]
  );
  return r[0].c > 0;
}

(async ()=>{
  for(const [name, def] of COLS){
    if(await hasColumn('products', name)){ console.log('[SKIP] products.' + name); continue; }
    await pool.query('ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN ' + name + ' ' + def);
    console.log('[ADD]  products.' + name);
  }
  console.log('Migration done.');
  await pool.end();
```

```js
require('dotenv').config();
const { pool } = require('../db/init');
async function hasTable(t){
  const [r] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=? AND TABLE_NAME=?', [process.env.DB_NAME, t]);
  return r[0].c > 0;
}
(async ()=>{
  try{
    /* site_features — آیتم‌های فروشگاه */
    if(!await hasTable('site_features')){
      await pool.query('CREATE TABLE site_features (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, subtitle VARCHAR(150), icon VARCHAR(40) DEFAULT "shield", color VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT "#c81e3a", sort_order INT DEFAULT 0, is_active TINYINT DEFAULT 1, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci');
      console.log('[ADD]  site_features');
    } else console.log('[SKIP] site_features');

    /* site_festivals — جشنواره‌ها */
    if(!await hasTable('site_festivals')){
      await pool.query('CREATE TABLE site_festivals (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, subtitle VARCHAR(200), link VARCHAR(300), ends_at DATETIME NULL, bg_color VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT "#d92a3f", sort_order INT DEFAULT 0, is_active TINYINT DEFAULT 1, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci');
      console.log('[ADD]  site_festivals');
    } else console.log('[SKIP] site_festivals');

    /* seed features اگه خالی بود */
    const [cnt] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM site_features');
    if(cnt[0].c === 0){
      const F = [
        ['ارسال سریع','تحویل ۱ تا ۳ روز کاری','truck','#0ea5e9',1],
        ['ضمانت اصالت کالا','همهٔ کالاها با گارانتی معتبر','shield','#c9a961',2],
        ['بازگشت ۷ روزه','برای کالاهای سالم','ret','#0e7c5f',3],
        ['پرداخت امن','درگاه بانکی یا در محل','card','#7b1e3a',4]
      ];
      for(const x of F){
        await pool.query('INSERT INTO site_features (title,subtitle,icon,color,sort_order) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)', x);
      }
      console.log('[SEED] 4 features');
    }

    /* seed festival اگه خالی بود */
    const [fCnt] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM site_festivals');
    if(fCnt[0].c === 0){
      await pool.query('INSERT INTO site_festivals (title,subtitle,link,ends_at,bg_color,sort_order) VALUES (?,?,?,DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY),?,?)',
        ['شگفت‌انگیزها','تخفیف‌های ویژهٔ امروز','#offers','#7b1e3a',1]);
      console.log('[SEED] 1 festival');
    }

    /* seed categories اگه خالی بود */
    const [cCnt] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM categories');
    if(cCnt[0].c === 0){
      const C = [
        ['موبایل','phone','#3b82f6',1],
        ['لپ‌تاپ','laptop','#64748b',2],
        ['صوتی و تصویری','headphones','#8b5cf6',3],
        ['ساعت هوشمند','watch','#14b8a6',4],
        ['مد و پوشاک','sneaker','#f97316',5],
        ['خانه و آشپزخانه','kettle','#0ea5e9',6],
        ['کتاب','book','#eab308',7]
      ];
      for(const x of C){
        var slug = x[0].trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-').replace(/[^\w\u0600-\u06FF-]/g, '');
        await pool.query('INSERT INTO categories (name,slug,icon,color,order_num) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)', [x[0], slug, x[1], x[2], x[3]]);
      }
      console.log('[SEED] 7 categories');
    }

    console.log('done');
    await pool.end();
    process.exit(0);
  }catch(e){ console.error('ERR: ' + e.message); process.exit(1); }
})();
```

```js
  { name:'کتاب «برنامه‌نویسی با جاوااسکریپت» از مبتدی تا حرفه‌ای', brand:'نشر نمونه', cat:'کتاب', price:410000, off:15, rating:4.8, numReviews:980, stock:60, sales:3300, art:'book', colors:[{name:'زرد',hex:'#eab308'}], description:'آموزش گام‌به‌گام با پروژه‌های واقعی.' }
];

function slugify(s){
  return String(s).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-').replace(/[^\w\u0600-\u06FF-]/g,'');
}

(async function run(){
  try{
    await initSchema();
    console.log('\n--- SEED START ---');

    const adminEmail = (process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL || 'admin@bazaarche.local').toLowerCase();
    const crypto = require('crypto');
const adminPass = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || ('Adm-' + crypto.randomBytes(6).toString('base64').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g,'').slice(0,10) + '!');
    const adminName  = process.env.ADMIN_NAME || 'مدیر کل';

    let admin = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?', [adminEmail]);
    if(!admin){
      const hash = await bcrypt.hash(adminPass, 10);
      const id = await insert(
        'INSERT INTO users (name, email, phone, password, role) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',
        [adminName, adminEmail, '09000000000', hash, 'admin']
      );
      admin = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [id]);
      console.log('[User] Admin created:', adminEmail, '/', adminPass);
    }else{
      await q('UPDATE users SET role = ? WHERE id = ?', ['admin', admin.id]);
      console.log('[User] Admin exists:', adminEmail);
    }

    const catMap = {};
    for(const c of CATS){
      let cat = await qOne('SELECT * FROM categories WHERE name = ?', [c.name]);
      if(!cat){
        const id = await insert(
          'INSERT INTO categories (name, slug, icon, color, order_num) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',
          [c.name, slugify(c.name), c.icon, c.color, c.order]
        );
        cat = await qOne('SELECT * FROM categories WHERE id = ?', [id]);
      }
      catMap[c.name] = cat.id;
    }
    console.log('[Category] ' + Object.keys(catMap).length + ' categories ready');

    let created = 0, skipped = 0;
    for(const p of PRODUCTS){
      const exists = await qOne('SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = ?', [p.name]);
      if(exists){ skipped++; continue; }

      const catId = catMap[p.cat];
      if(!catId) continue;

      const slug = slugify(p.name) + '-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);
      const prodId = await insert(
        'INSERT INTO products (name, slug, brand, category_id, price, off, rating, num_reviews, stock, sales, art, description, created_by) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
        [p.name, slug, p.brand, catId, p.price, p.off, p.rating, p.numReviews,
         p.stock, p.sales, p.art, p.description, admin.id]
      );

      for(const c of p.colors){
        await insert('INSERT INTO product_colors (product_id, name, hex) VALUES (?,?,?)',
          [prodId, c.name, c.hex]);
      }
      created++;
    }
    console.log('[Product] created: ' + created + ', skipped: ' + skipped);

    console.log('\n--- SEED DONE ---');
    console.log('Admin login:');
    console.log('  email:    ' + adminEmail);
    console.log('  password: ' + adminPass);
    console.log('');
    console.log('  ⚠️  این رمز را الان کپی کنید — دیگر نمایش داده نمی‌شود.');
    console.log('');

    await pool.end();
    process.exit(0);
  }catch(err){
    console.error('[Seed error]', err);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();
```

```js
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');

function signAccess(id, tv){
  return jwt.sign({ id: id, tv: tv || 0 }, process.env.JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: process.env.JWT_EXPIRE || '7d' });
}
function signRefresh(id, tv){
  return jwt.sign({ id: id, tv: tv || 0 }, process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET, { expiresIn: process.env.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRE || '30d' });
}
function verifyAccess(t){ return jwt.verify(t, process.env.JWT_SECRET); }
function verifyRefresh(t){ return jwt.verify(t, process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET); }

function setCookies(res, access, refresh){
  const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
  res.cookie('accessToken', access, {
    httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'lax', secure: isProd,
    maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
  });
  res.cookie('refreshToken', refresh, {
    httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'lax', secure: isProd,
    maxAge: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
  });
}
function clearCookies(res){
  res.clearCookie('accessToken');
  res.clearCookie('refreshToken');
}
module.exports = { signAccess, signRefresh, verifyAccess, verifyRefresh, setCookies, clearCookies };
```

```md
# راهنمای عکس دسته‌بندی

## چطور عکس بذارم؟

۱) عکس‌ها رو توی همین پوشه بریز
۲) اسم فایل = اسم دقیق دسته

مثال:
- موبایل.jpg
- همبرگر.png
- پوشاک.jpeg

## نکات مهم
- اسم فایل باید **دقیقاً** با اسم دسته توی دیتابیس یکی باشه
- پسوندهای مجاز: jpg, jpeg, png, webp, gif
- بهترین اندازه: مربع (مثلاً 500×500)
- حداقل 200×200، حداکثر 2000×2000

## اجرا
بعد از ریختن عکس‌ها، این دستور رو بزن:
\`\`\`
node setup-category-images.js
\`\`\`

اسکریپت عکس‌ها رو پیدا می‌کنه، به uploads منتقل می‌کنه و توی DB ذخیره می‌کنه.
```
