```js
async function loadSiteSettings(){
  try{
    var r = await apiGet('/site/settings');
    var s = (r && r.settings) || {};

    var el1 = document.getElementById('catSecTitle');
    if(el1 && s.cat_section_title) el1.textContent = s.cat_section_title;

    var el2 = document.getElementById('catSecDesc');
    if(el2){
      if(s.cat_section_desc){ el2.textContent = s.cat_section_desc; el2.style.display = ''; }
      else { el2.style.display = 'none'; }
    }

    /* مخفی کردن کل بخش trust اگه لازم بود */
    var trustEl = document.getElementById('trust');
    if(trustEl && s.trust_section_visible === '0'){
      trustEl.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }catch(e){
    console.warn('[settings] load failed:', e.message);
  }
}

async function init(){
  hydrateIcons();
  renderHero();renderTrust();
  loadSiteSettings();
  const ok=await loadAll();
  await resolveCartProducts();
  if(!ok){toast('اتصال به سرور برقرار نشد. مطمئن شو بک‌اند روی ۵۰۰۰ اجراست.');}
  renderCatbar();renderCatTiles();renderOffers();
  buildFilters();renderList();updateCartUI();paintUser();
  /* سال کپی‌رایت */
  try{
    var el = document.getElementById("copyrightYear");
    if(el){
      var jy;
      try{ jy = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("fa-IR-u-ca-persian",{year:"numeric"}).format(new Date()).replace(/\D/g,""); }catch(e){}
      if(jy) el.textContent = jy;
    }
  }catch(e){}
  tick();setInterval(tick,1000);heroAuto();
 try{
    const r = await apiGet('/auth/me');
    if(r.user){
      state.user = r.user;
      store.set('bz.user', r.user);
      paintUser();
    }
  }catch(e){
    /* کوکی منقضی شده - کاربر رو لاگ‌اوت کن */
    if(state.user){
      state.user = null;
      store.set('bz.user', null);
      paintUser();
    }
  }

  /* scrolled header */
  const header=$('header.site');
  addEventListener('scroll',()=>{header.classList.toggle('scrolled',scrollY>10)},{passive:true});

  /* theme toggle */
  const sunIc='<svg class="ic sun" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.5"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.2 4.2l1.4 1.4M18.4 18.4l1.4 1.4M2 12h2M20 12h2M4.2 19.8l1.4-1.4M18.4 5.6l1.4-1.4"/></svg>';
  const moonIc='<svg class="ic moon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 12.8A9 9 0 1 1 11.2 3a7 7 0 0 0 9.8 9.8z"/></svg>';
  const actions=document.querySelector('.actions');
  if(actions && !$('.theme-toggle')){
    const tb=document.createElement('button');
    tb.className='icon-btn theme-toggle';
    tb.setAttribute('aria-label','تغییر تم');
    tb.innerHTML=sunIc+moonIc;
    actions.insertBefore(tb,actions.querySelector('#loginBtn'));
    tb.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const cur=document.documentElement.dataset.theme;
      const isDark=cur?cur==='dark':matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
      theme.set(isDark?'light':'dark');
    });
  }

  /* view toggle */
  if(!$('.view-toggle')){
    const sorts=$('#sorts');
    if(sorts){
      const vt=document.createElement('div');
      vt.className='view-toggle';
      vt.innerHTML=`<button data-action="view" data-v="grid" aria-pressed="${viewMode.get()==='grid'}" aria-label="نمای شبکه‌ای">${ic('grid',16)}</button>
        <button data-action="view" data-v="list" aria-pressed="${viewMode.get()==='list'}" aria-label="نمای لیستی">${ic('list',16)}</button>`;
      sorts.parentElement.insertBefore(vt,sorts.nextSibling);
    }
  }

  /* ripple */
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    const b=e.target.closest('.btn.primary,.btn.outline');
    if(b)ripple(e);
  });

  /* infinite scroll */
  const moreBtn=$('#more');
  if(moreBtn){
    const io=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
      entries.forEach(en=>{
        if(en.isIntersecting && !moreBtn.hidden){loadMore()}
      });
    },{rootMargin:'300px'});
    io.observe(moreBtn);
  }

  /* بارگذاری محتوای داینامیک بعد از رندر اولیه */
  setTimeout(async function(){
    try{ await loadCmsContent(); }catch(e){ console.warn("cms:", e.message); }
    try{ await loadSiteFeatures(); }catch(e){ console.warn("features:", e.message); }
    try{ await loadSiteFestivals(); }catch(e){ console.warn("festivals:", e.message); }
  }, 100);
}


/* ================================================================
   CMS — Banners, Sliders, Pages
   ================================================================ */
/* ================================================================
   Site Features / Festivals — from admin panel
   ================================================================ */




async function loadCmsContent(){
  try{
    const results = await Promise.all([
      apiGet('/cms/banners').catch(function(){ return { banners: [] }; }),
      apiGet('/cms/sliders').catch(function(){ return { sliders: [] }; }),
      apiGet('/cms/pages').catch(function(){ return { pages: [] }; })
    ]);
    var banners = (results[0] && results[0].banners) || [];
    var sliders = (results[1] && results[1].sliders) || [];
    var pages   = (results[2] && results[2].pages) || [];
    if(banners.length) renderCmsBanners(banners);
    if(sliders.length) renderCmsSliders(sliders);
    if(pages.length)   renderCmsFooterPages(pages);
  }catch(e){
    console.warn('[cms] load failed:', e.message);
  }
}

function renderCmsBanners(banners){
  var top = banners.filter(function(b){ return b.position === 'top'; });
  var mid = banners.filter(function(b){ return b.position === 'middle' || b.position === 'sidebar'; });
  paintBannersInto('#cmsTopBanners', top);
  paintBannersInto('#cmsMidBanners', mid);
}

function paintBannersInto(sel, list){
  var el = document.querySelector(sel);
  if(!el) return;
  if(!list.length){ el.hidden = true; return; }
  el.hidden = false;
  el.innerHTML = list.map(function(b){
    var url = window.__ASSET__ ? window.__ASSET__(b.image_url) : b.image_url;
    var inner = '<img src="' + esc(url) + '" alt="' + esc(b.title || '') + '" loading="lazy">';
    var safeLink = window.__safeLink ? window.__safeLink(b.link) : '';
    if(safeLink){
      var tgt = safeLink.indexOf('http') === 0 ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"' : '';
      return '<a class="cms-banner" href="' + esc(safeLink) + '"' + tgt + '>' + inner + '</a>';
    }
    return '<div class="cms-banner">' + inner + '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function renderCmsSliders(sliders){
  var hero = document.querySelector('#hero');
  if(!hero || !sliders.length) return;

  var html = '';
  for(var i = 0; i < sliders.length; i++){
    var s = sliders[i];
    var imgUrl = window.__ASSET__ ? window.__ASSET__(s.image_url) : s.image_url;
    var bg = s.bg_color || '#0f172a';
    var btn = s.button_text || 'مشاهده';
    var link = s.link || '#';
    var onCls = i === 0 ? ' on' : '';
    var hidden = i === 0 ? 'false' : 'true';
    var tabIdx = i === 0 ? '' : ' tabindex="-1"';
    link = window.__safeLink ? window.__safeLink(link) : '';
    var tgt = link.indexOf('http') === 0 ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"' : '';
    html += '<div class="slide' + onCls + '" style="background:' + esc(bg) + ';color:#fff" aria-label="' + fa(i+1) + ' از ' + fa(sliders.length) + '" aria-hidden="' + hidden + '">';
    html += '<div><h2>' + esc(s.title || '') + '</h2>';
    if(s.subtitle) html += '<p>' + esc(s.subtitle) + '</p>';
    html += '<a class="btn light" href="' + esc(link) + '"' + tgt + tabIdx + '>' + esc(btn) + '</a></div>';
    html += '<div class="art"><img src="' + esc(imgUrl) + '" alt="" style="position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:inherit"></div>';
    html += '</div>';
  }
  html += '<button class="hnav prev" data-action="hero-prev" aria-label="قبلی"><svg class="ic" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>';
  html += '<button class="hnav next" data-action="hero-next" aria-label="بعدی"><svg class="ic" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15 6l-6 6 6 6"/></svg></button>';
  html += '<div class="dots">';
  for(var j = 0; j < sliders.length; j++){
    html += '<button data-action="hero-go" data-i="' + j + '" aria-label="اسلاید ' + fa(j+1) + '" aria-current="' + (j === 0) + '"></button>';
  }
  html += '</div>';

  hero.innerHTML = html;
  try{ if(typeof heroGo === 'function') heroGo(0); }catch(e){}
  try{ if(typeof heroAuto === 'function') heroAuto(); }catch(e){}
}

function renderCmsFooterPages(pages){
  var el = document.querySelector('#cmsFooterLinks');
  if(!el) return;
  var menu = pages.filter(function(p){ return p.show_in_menu; });
  if(!menu.length){ el.hidden = true; return; }
  el.hidden = false;
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="cms-page-links-inner">' +
    menu.map(function(p){
      return '<a href="#/page/' + esc(p.slug) + '" data-page-slug="' + esc(p.slug) + '">' + esc(p.title) + '</a>';
    }).join('') +
    '</div>';

  var links = el.querySelectorAll('[data-page-slug]');
  for(var i = 0; i < links.length; i++){
    (function(a){
      a.onclick = function(e){
        e.preventDefault();
        openCmsPage(a.getAttribute('data-page-slug'));
      };
    })(links[i]);
  }
}

async function openCmsPage(slug){
  try{
    var r = await apiGet('/cms/pages/' + encodeURIComponent(slug));
    var p = r.page;
    if(!p){ toast('صفحه پیدا نشد.'); return; }
    var sheet = document.querySelector('#pmSheet');
    if(!sheet){ toast('خطا در باز کردن صفحه'); return; }
    var xBtn = '<button class="x icon-btn" data-action="close" aria-label="بستن"><svg class="ic" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button>';
    sheet.innerHTML = xBtn + '<div class="cms-page-view">' +
      '<h2 class="cms-page-title">' + esc(p.title) + '</h2>' +
      '<div class="cms-page-content">' + window.__sanitize(p.content || '') + '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    openLayer(document.querySelector('#pm'));
    document.querySelector('#pmSheet').scrollTop = 0;
  }catch(e){ toast('خطا: ' + e.message); }
}



/* sanitize HTML برای CMS */
/* __sanitize__ — با DOMPurify و fallback whitelist */
window.__sanitize = window.__sanitize || function(html){
  if(html === null || html === undefined) return '';
  html = String(html);

  /* اگه DOMPurify لود شده، ازش استفاده کن */
  if(typeof window.DOMPurify !== 'undefined' && window.DOMPurify.sanitize){
    return window.DOMPurify.sanitize(html, {
      ALLOWED_TAGS: ['p','br','hr','strong','b','em','i','u','s','del','ins','mark','sub','sup',
                     'h1','h2','h3','h4','h5','h6',
                     'ul','ol','li','blockquote','pre','code',
                     'a','img',
                     'table','thead','tbody','tfoot','tr','th','td',
                     'div','span','section','article','aside','header','footer','nav'],
      ALLOWED_ATTR: ['href','title','target','rel','src','alt','width','height','class','id','style',
                     'colspan','rowspan','align','dir'],
      ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP: /^(?:(?:https?|mailto|tel|ftp):|[^a-z]|[a-z+.\-]+(?:[^a-z+.\-:]|$))/i,
      FORBID_TAGS: ['script','style','iframe','frame','frameset','object','embed','applet','form',
                    'input','button','select','option','textarea','base','link','meta','svg','math'],
      FORBID_ATTR: ['onerror','onload','onclick','onmouseover','onmouseout','onfocus','onblur',
                    'onchange','onsubmit','onkeydown','onkeyup','onkeypress','oninput',
                    'formaction','action','srcdoc','xlink:href'],
      ADD_ATTR: ['target'],
      KEEP_CONTENT: true,
    });
  }

  /* fallback: whitelist regex (اگه DOMPurify لود نشد) */
  return html
    .replace(/<script[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<script[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<style[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<style[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<iframe[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/iframe\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<iframe[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<object[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/object\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<object[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<embed[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<form[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/form\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<form[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<input[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<button[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/button\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<button[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<svg[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/svg\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<svg[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<meta[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<link[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<base[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<math[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/math\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+on[a-z]+\s*=\s*"[^"]*"/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+on[a-z]+\s*=\s*'[^']*'/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+on[a-z]+\s*=\s*[^\s>]+/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+(?:href|src|action|formaction|xlink:href)\s*=\s*"\s*javascript:[^"]*"/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+(?:href|src|action|formaction|xlink:href)\s*=\s*'\s*javascript:[^']*'/gi, '')
    .replace(/javascript\s*:/gi, '');
};

/* __safeLink__ — فقط http(s) و مسیرهای نسبی مجاز */
window.__safeLink = function(url){
  if(!url) return '';
  url = String(url).trim();
  if(!url) return '';
  /* مسیر نسبی */
  if(url.charAt(0) === '/' || url.charAt(0) === '#' || url.charAt(0) === '?') return url;
  /* http(s) */
  if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) return url;
  /* mailto, tel */
  if(/^(mailto|tel):/i.test(url)) return url;
  /* هر چیز دیگه (javascript:, data:, vbscript:, ...) → خالی */
  return '';
};

async function loadSiteFeatures(){
  try{
    var r = await apiGet('/site/features');
    var list = (r && r.features) || [];
    if(!list.length) return;
    var el = document.querySelector('#trust');
    if(!el) return;
    el.innerHTML = list.map(function(f){
      var color = f.color || '#c81e3a';
      var inner = f.image_url
        ? '<span class="ti has-img"><img src="' + (window.__ASSET__ ? window.__ASSET__(f.image_url) : f.image_url) + '" alt=""></span>'
        : '<span class="ti" style="background:color-mix(in srgb,' + color + ' 14%, transparent);color:' + color + ';border-color:color-mix(in srgb,' + color + ' 22%, transparent)">' + ic(f.icon || 'shield', 20) + '</span>';
      return '<div>' + inner +
        '<p style="margin:0"><b>' + esc(f.title) + '</b><span>' + esc(f.subtitle || '') + '</span></p>' +
        '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }catch(e){ console.warn('[site] features:', e.message); }
}




/* ================================================================
   Site Festivals — بارگذاری از API
   ================================================================ */
async function loadSiteFestivals(){
  var el = document.querySelector('#offers');
  if(!el){ console.warn('[festival] #offers پیدا نشد'); return; }

  /* پاک‌سازی استایل و محتوای قبلی */
  el.removeAttribute('style');
  el.innerHTML = '';

  var r, list;
  try{
    r = await apiGet('/site/festivals');
    list = (r && r.festivals) || [];
    console.log('[festival] API برگرداند:', list.length, 'مورد');
  }catch(e){
    console.error('[festival] خطای API:', e);
    showNoFestival(el);
    return;
  }

  /* دنبال اولین جشنواره‌ی فعال و منقضی‌نشده */
  var now = Date.now();
  var chosen = null;
  for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){
    var f = list[i];
    if(f.is_active === 0 || f.is_active === false) continue;
    if(!f.ends_at){ chosen = f; break; }
    var s = String(f.ends_at).replace(' ', 'T').replace(/Z$/, '').replace(/\.\d+$/, '');
    s = s.replace(/[+-]\d{2}:\d{2}$/, '');
    var d = new Date(s);
    if(isNaN(d.getTime())) continue;
    if(d.getTime() > now){ chosen = f; break; }
  }

  /* هیچ جشنواره فعالی نیست */
  if(!chosen){
    console.log('[festival] هیچ جشنواره فعالی وجود ندارد');
    window.__festivalActive = false;
    window.__festivalEnds = 0;
    showNoFestival(el);
    return;
  }

  /* جشنواره فعال پیدا شد */
  var ff = chosen;
  var endsMs = 0;
  if(ff.ends_at){
    var ss = String(ff.ends_at).replace(' ', 'T').replace(/Z$/, '').replace(/\.\d+$/, '');
    ss = ss.replace(/[+-]\d{2}:\d{2}$/, '');
    var dd = new Date(ss);
    endsMs = isNaN(dd.getTime()) ? 0 : dd.getTime();
  }
  window.__festivalEnds = endsMs;
  window.__festivalActive = true;
  el.classList.remove('is-empty');
  el.classList.add('has-active');
  console.log('[festival] ✅ فعال:', ff.title, '| پایان:', new Date(endsMs).toLocaleString('fa-IR'));

  /* محصولات تخفیف‌دار */
  var L = ALL_PRODUCTS.filter(function(p){ return p.off >= 15 && p.st; })
    .sort(function(a, b){ return b.off - a.off; })
    .slice(0, 8);
  if(!L.length) L = ALL_PRODUCTS.filter(function(p){ return p.st; }).slice(0, 8);

  /* رندر جشنواره */
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="o-head">' +
      '<div><h2>' + esc(ff.title) + '</h2><p>' + esc(ff.subtitle || '') + '</p></div>' +
      '<div class="cd" aria-label="زمان باقی‌مانده" role="timer">' +
        '<span id="cdH">۰۰</span><span id="cdM">۰۰</span><span id="cdS">۰۰</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<button class="btn light" data-action="deals">' + esc(ff.button_text || 'دیدن همه') + '</button>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="rail" tabindex="0">' + L.map(cardHTML).join('') + '</div>';

  if(ff.image_url){
    var imgUrl = window.__ASSET__ ? window.__ASSET__(ff.image_url) : ff.image_url;
    el.style.background = ff.bg_color || '#7b1e3a';
    el.style.backgroundImage = 'linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, ' + (ff.bg_color || '#7b1e3a') + ' 60%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, ' + (ff.bg_color || '#7b1e3a') + ' 80%, transparent)), url(' + JSON.stringify(imgUrl) + ')';
    el.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
    el.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
    el.style.color = '#fff';
  } else if(ff.bg_color){
    el.style.background = ff.bg_color;
    el.style.backgroundImage = 'linear-gradient(135deg, ' + ff.bg_color + ' 0%, color-mix(in srgb, ' + ff.bg_color + ' 70%, #000) 100%)';
  }

  if(typeof tick === 'function') tick();
}

/* نمایش پیام «جشنواره فعالی وجود ندارد» */
function showNoFestival(el){
  if(!el) el = document.querySelector('#offers');

  el.classList.remove('has-active');

  el.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto">' +

    '</div>';
}

/* ================================================================

let userMenuEl = null;
let userMenuOutsideBound = false;

function handleLoginClick(btn){
  /* چک مستقیم از localStorage برای اطمینان */
  var savedUser = null;
  try{ savedUser = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bz.user') || 'null'); }catch(e){}
  var isLoggedIn = !!(state.user || savedUser);
  if(isLoggedIn){
    if(typeof toggleUserMenu === 'function') toggleUserMenu(btn);
    else if(typeof openUserMenu === 'function') openUserMenu(btn);
    else { window.location.href = 'index.html'; }
  } else {
    window.location.href = 'login.html';
  }
}

function toggleUserMenu(btn){
  if(userMenuEl){ closeUserMenu(); return; }
  openUserMenu(btn);
}

function closeUserMenu(){
  if(!userMenuEl) return;
  const el = userMenuEl;
  el.classList.remove('on');
  userMenuEl = null;
  setTimeout(function(){ el.remove(); }, 220);
  if(userMenuOutsideBound){
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', userMenuOutsideHandler);
    userMenuOutsideBound = false;
  }
  window.removeEventListener('resize', closeUserMenu);
  window.removeEventListener('scroll', closeUserMenu, true);
}

function userMenuOutsideHandler(e){
  if(userMenuEl && !userMenuEl.contains(e.target)){
    closeUserMenu();
  }
}

function openUserMenu(btn){
  const u = state.user || {};
  const initial = (u.name || 'ک').trim().charAt(0);

  el.className = 'user-menu';

  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="user-menu-head">

    </div>

    <div class="user-menu-list">
      <button type="button" class="user-menu-item" data-um="orders" role="menuitem">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">

          '<rect x="14" y="12" width="7" height="9" rx="1.5"/>' +

        '</svg>' +
        '<span>رفتن به پنل ادمین</span>' +
        '</button>' : ""}
 + ${state.user && state.user.role === "seller" ? '<button type="button" class="user-menu-item admin-panel-item" data-um="seller-panel" role="menuitem">' +
        '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">' +
          '<path d="M3 9l9-7 9 7v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z"/>' +
          '<path d="M9 22V12h6v10"/>' +
        '</svg>' +
        '<span>پنل فروشنده</span>' +
        '</button>' : ""}
      <button type="button" class="user-menu-item" data-um="reviews" role="menuitem">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/>
          <path d="M8 9h8M8 13h5"/>
        </svg>

        </svg>
        <span>خروج از حساب کاربری</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  `;

  document.body.appendChild(el);
  userMenuEl = el;

  /* Position under the button */
  const r = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mw = el.offsetWidth;
  const mh = el.offsetHeight;

  let left = r.left + (r.width / 2) - (mw / 2);
  left = Math.max(12, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - mw - 12));

  let top = r.bottom + 10;
  if(top + mh > window.innerHeight - 12){
    top = Math.max(12, r.top - mh - 10);
  }

  el.style.top = top + 'px';
  el.style.left = left + 'px';

  requestAnimationFrame(function(){ if(userMenuEl) userMenuEl.classList.add('on'); });

  /* Handle item clicks */
  el.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-um]');
    if(!b) return;
    const um = b.dataset.um;
    closeUserMenu();
    if(um === 'admin-panel'){ window.location.href = 'admin.html'; return; }
    if(um === 'seller-panel'){ window.location.href = 'seller.html'; return; }
    if(um === 'orders'){
      if(typeof openMyOrders === 'function') openMyOrders();
    }else if(um === 'wishlist'){
      gotoWishlist();
    }else if(um === 'reviews'){
      openMyReviews();
    }else if(um === 'logout'){
      doUserLogout();
    }
  });

  /* Close on outside click */
  setTimeout(function(){
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', userMenuOutsideHandler);
    userMenuOutsideBound = true;
  }, 0);

  window.addEventListener('resize', closeUserMenu);
  window.addEventListener('scroll', closeUserMenu, true);
}

function gotoWishlist(){
  if(!state.wish.size){
    toast('هنوز کالایی به علاقه‌مندی‌ها اضافه نکرده‌اید.');
    return;
  }
  closeLayer(true);
  state.wishOnly = true;
  state.shown = 12;
  renderList();
  scrollToShop();
}

async function openMyReviews(){
  const sh = $('#lgSheet');
  const x = '<button class="x icon-btn" data-action="close" aria-label="بستن">' + ic('x',22) + '</button>';
  sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2>دیدگاه و پرسش و پاسخ</h2>'
    + '<p class="muted">در حال بارگذاری...</p></div>';
  openLayer($('#lg'));

  try{
    const res = await apiGet('/orders/my');
    const orders = res.orders || [];
    const items = [];
    orders.forEach(function(o){
      (o.items || []).forEach(function(it){
        if(!items.find(function(x){ return x.product === it.product; })){
          items.push({ product: it.product, name: it.name, art: it.art });
        }
      });
    });

    if(!items.length){
      sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2>دیدگاه و پرسش و پاسخ</h2>'
        + '<p class="muted">هنوز خریدی ثبت نکرده‌اید. بعد از خرید، می‌توانید نظر و پرسش خود را ثبت کنید.</p>'
        + '<button class="btn primary block" data-action="close" style="margin-top:16px" data-autofocus>بستن</button>'
        + '</div>';
      return;
    }

    sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2>دیدگاه و پرسش و پاسخ</h2>'
      + '<p class="muted" style="margin:0 0 12px;font-size:13.5px">کالاهایی که خریده‌اید، می‌توانید برایشان نظر ثبت کنید.</p>'
      + '<div class="my-rev-list">'
      + items.slice(0,20).map(function(it){
          return '<button type="button" class="my-rev-item" data-action="open" data-id="' + it.product + '">'
            + '<span class="my-rev-thumb">' + art(it.art || 'book', '#94a3b8') + '</span>'
            + '<span class="my-rev-name">' + esc(it.name) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="my-rev-arrow">›</span>'
            + '</button>';
        }).join('')
      + '</div>'
      + '<button class="btn outline block" data-action="close" style="margin-top:14px">بستن</button>'
      + '</div>';

    sh.querySelectorAll('[data-action="open"]').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click', function(){
        closeLayer(true);
        openProduct(Number(b.dataset.id));
      });
    });
  }catch(e){
    sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2>دیدگاه و پرسش و پاسخ</h2>'
      + '<p class="err">' + esc(e.message) + '</p>'
      + '<button class="btn outline block" data-action="close" style="margin-top:12px">بستن</button>'
      + '</div>';
  }
}

async function doUserLogout(){
  try{ await apiPost('/auth/logout'); }catch(_){}
  state.user = null;
  try{ localStorage.removeItem('bz.user'); }catch(e){}
  try{ store.set('bz.user', null); }catch(e){}
  closeLayer();
  closeUserMenu();
  /* رفرش صفحه برای پاک کردن همه چیز */
  window.location.href = 'index.html';
}

function attachUserMenuHover(){
  /* Auto-close on page navigation */
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', closeUserMenu);
}
```

```js
/* ================================================================
   config.js — تنظیمات مرکزی پروژه
   ================================================================
   این فایل باید *قبل از* همه اسکریپت‌های دیگر بارگذاری شود.
   ================================================================ */
(function(){
  'use strict';

  var DEV_BACKEND_PORT = 5000;
  var DEV_PORTS = [3000, 4200, 5173, 5500, 5501, 8000, 8080];

  var loc = window.location;
  var isFile = loc.protocol === 'file:';
  var isLocalhost = loc.hostname === 'localhost'
                 || loc.hostname === '127.0.0.1'
                 || loc.hostname === '0.0.0.0'
                 || loc.hostname === '::1';
  var port = parseInt(loc.port, 10) || 0;
  var isDevPort = DEV_PORTS.indexOf(port) !== -1;

  var BACKEND_ORIGIN, MODE;

  if (isFile) {
    BACKEND_ORIGIN = 'http://127.0.0.1:' + DEV_BACKEND_PORT;
    MODE = 'file';
  } else if (isLocalhost && isDevPort) {
    BACKEND_ORIGIN = loc.protocol + '//' + loc.hostname + ':' + DEV_BACKEND_PORT;
    MODE = [REDACTED]
  } else {
    BACKEND_ORIGIN = [REDACTED]
    MODE = [REDACTED]
  }

  var API_BASE = BACKEND_ORIGIN + '/api';

  window.__API_BASE__       = API_BASE;
  window.__API_BASE         = API_BASE;
  window.__BACKEND_ORIGIN__ = BACKEND_ORIGIN;
  window.__BACKEND__        = BACKEND_ORIGIN;
  window.__API_ORIGIN__     = BACKEND_ORIGIN;
  window.__CONFIG_MODE__    = MODE;

  /* ثابت‌های ارسال — از سرور هم بیاد بهتر، ولی اینجا هاردکد برای هماهنگی */
  window.__SHIPPING__ = {
    FREE_THRESHOLD: 10000000,
    COST: 600000
  };

  window.__ASSET__ = function(u){
    if (!u) return '';
    u = String(u);
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(u)) return u;
    if (/^data:/i.test(u))         return u;
    if (/^blob:/i.test(u))         return u;
    if (u.charAt(0) === '/')       return BACKEND_ORIGIN + u;
    return BACKEND_ORIGIN + '/' + u;
  };

  window.__resolveCardImg = function(p){
    if (!p) return null;
    var imgs = p.imgs || p.images || p.image || null;
    var u = null;
    if (Array.isArray(imgs) && imgs.length) u = imgs[0];
    else if (typeof imgs === 'string') u = imgs;
    if (!u) return null;
    return window.__ASSET__(u);
  };

  console.log('[config] mode=' + MODE + '  API=' + API_BASE);


/* ============================================================
   Rial → Toman helper
   ورودی‌ها به ریال، نمایش به تومان
   ============================================================ */
window.__rial2toman = function(rial){
  return Math.round((Number(rial) || 0) / 10);
};
window.__tomanLabel = function(rial){
  try{ return window.__rial2toman(rial).toLocaleString('fa-IR'); }
  catch(e){ return String(window.__rial2toman(rial)); }
};
})();
```

```js
/* ============================================================
   fa-words.js — Persian number utilities
   - تبدیل عدد به حروف فارسی
   - جداکنندهٔ سه‌رقمی
   - تقویت خودکار فیلدهای قیمت (بدون نیاز به تغییر HTML)
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.__FA_WORDS__) return;
  window.__FA_WORDS__ = true;

  var YEKAN  = ['','یک','دو','سه','چهار','پنج','شش','هفت','هشت','نه'];
  var DAHGAN = ['','','بیست','سی','چهل','پنجاه','شصت','هفتاد','هشتاد','نود'];
  var DAH    = ['ده','یازده','دوازده','سیزده','چهارده','پانزده','شانزده','هفده','هجده','نوزده'];
  var SADGAN = ['','صد','دویست','سیصد','چهارصد','پانصد','ششصد','هفتصد','هشتصد','نهصد'];
  var SCALES = ['','هزار','میلیون','میلیارد','تریلیون','کوادریلیون'];

  function threeDigit(n){
    var parts = [];
    var s = Math.floor(n / 100);
    var remain = n % 100;
    if(s > 0) parts.push(SADGAN[s]);
    if(remain >= 10 && remain < 20){
      parts.push(DAH[remain - 10]);
    } else {
      var d = Math.floor(remain / 10);
      var y = remain % 10;
      if(d > 0) parts.push(DAHGAN[d]);
      if(y > 0) parts.push(YEKAN[y]);
    }
    return parts.join(' و ');
  }

  function numberToPersianWords(num){
    num = Math.floor(Math.abs(Number(num) || 0));
    if(num === 0) return 'صفر';
    var groups = [];
    var n = num;
    var scaleIdx = 0;
    while(n > 0){
      var chunk = n % 1000;
      if(chunk > 0){
        if(chunk === 1 && scaleIdx > 0){
          groups.unshift(SCALES[scaleIdx]);
        } else {
          var cw = threeDigit(chunk);
          groups.unshift(cw + (SCALES[scaleIdx] ? ' ' + SCALES[scaleIdx] : ''));
        }
      }
      n = Math.floor(n / 1000);
      scaleIdx++;
    }
    return groups.join(' و ');
  }

  function formatNum(n){
    var s = String(Math.floor(Math.abs(Number(n) || 0)));
    return s.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
  }

  function parseNum(s){
    return Number(String(s || '').replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || 0;
  }

  window.__faWords = numberToPersianWords;
  window.__faNum   = formatNum;
  window.__faParse = parseNum;

  /* ---------- تقویت خودکار فیلدهای قیمت ---------- */
  var SELECTORS = [
    'input[data-f="price"]',
    'input[data-f="purchasePrice"]',
    'input#refAmount',
    'input#ordShip',
    'input#ordTax',
    'input#ordDisc'
  ];

  function enhanceInput(input){
    if(!input || input.__priceEnhanced) return;
    var t = (input.type || '').toLowerCase();
    if(t === 'checkbox' || t === 'radio' || t === 'file' || t === 'range') return;
    input.__priceEnhanced = true;

    /* عنصر حروف */
    var words = document.createElement('div');
    words.className = '__price-words';
    words.style.cssText = 'margin-top:6px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:#64748b;line-height:1.6;direction:rtl;text-align:right;';

    input.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', words);

    function updateWords(){
      var n = parseNum(input.value);
      words.textContent = n > 0 ? numberToPersianWords(n) + ' ریال' : '';
    }

    function onInput(){
      var raw = input.value.replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
      var formatted = raw ? formatNum(raw) : '';
      if(input.value !== formatted){
        var pos = input.selectionStart || 0;
        var oldLen = input.value.length;
        input.value = formatted;
        var delta = formatted.length - oldLen;
        var newPos = Math.max(0, Math.min(formatted.length, pos + delta));
        try { input.setSelectionRange(newPos, newPos); } catch(e){}
      }
      updateWords();
    }

    input.addEventListener('input', onInput);
    input.addEventListener('blur', updateWords);
    updateWords();
  }

  function enhanceAll(){
    for(var i = 0; i < SELECTORS.length; i++){
      var nodes = document.querySelectorAll(SELECTORS[i]);
      for(var j = 0; j < nodes.length; j++){
        try { enhanceInput(nodes[j]); } catch(e){ /* ignore */ }
      }
    }
  }

  /* run on load */
  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', enhanceAll);
  } else {
    enhanceAll();
  }

  /* observer برای فیلدهای پویا (مودالها) */
  function startObserver(){
    if(!document.body) return;
    var observer = new MutationObserver(function(){
      setTimeout(enhanceAll, 30);
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }
  if(document.body){
    startObserver();
  } else {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', startObserver);
  }

  window.__enhancePriceInputs = enhanceAll;
})();
```

```js
/* ==============================================================
   gallery.js — multi-image gallery for product modals
   Works for #pmThumb (site) and .adm-pv-thumb (admin)
   ============================================================== */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.__GALLERY_LOADED__) return;
  window.__GALLERY_LOADED__ = true;

  function resolve(u){
    if(!u) return '';
    u = String(u);
    if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(u) || /^data:/i.test(u)) return u;
    return window.__ASSET__(u);
  }

  function getImages(product){
    if(!product) return [];
    var arr = product.images || product.imgs || [];
    if(!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];
    return arr.filter(function(x){ return x && typeof x === 'string'; });
  }

  /* ---- build gallery HTML ---- */
  function buildGallery(images, opts){
    opts = opts || {};
    if(!images.length) return null;

    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'gal-wrap';

    var stage = document.createElement('div');
    stage.className = 'gal-stage';

    var img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'gal-main';
    img.src = resolve(images[0]);
    img.alt = opts.alt || '';
    img.setAttribute('data-index', '0');
    stage.appendChild(img);

    /* prev / next */
    if(images.length > 1){
      var prev = document.createElement('button');
      prev.type = 'button';
      prev.className = 'gal-nav gal-prev';
      prev.setAttribute('aria-label', 'قبلی');
      prev.innerHTML = '<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15 6l-6 6 6 6"/></svg>';
      stage.appendChild(prev);

      var next = document.createElement('button');
      next.type = 'button';
      next.className = 'gal-nav gal-next';
      next.setAttribute('aria-label', 'بعدی');
      next.innerHTML = '<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>';
      stage.appendChild(next);

      var counter = document.createElement('span');
      counter.className = 'gal-counter';
      counter.textContent = '۱ / ' + images.length.toLocaleString('fa-IR');
      stage.appendChild(counter);

      var ci = 0;
      function go(i){
        ci = (i + images.length) % images.length;
        img.src = resolve(images[ci]);
        counter.textContent = (ci + 1).toLocaleString('fa-IR') + ' / ' + images.length.toLocaleString('fa-IR');
        var thumbs = wrap.querySelectorAll('.gal-thumb');
        for(var k = 0; k < thumbs.length; k++){
          thumbs[k].classList.toggle('is-active', k === ci);
        }
      }

      prev.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go(ci - 1); });
      next.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go(ci + 1); });

      /* keyboard */
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
        if(!document.body.contains(wrap)) return;
        if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  go(ci + 1);
        if(e.key === 'ArrowRight') go(ci - 1);
      });

      /* swipe for mobile */
      var sx = 0, dx = 0;
      stage.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
        sx = e.touches[0].clientX;
      }, { passive: true });
      stage.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
        dx = e.touches[0].clientX - sx;
      }, { passive: true });
      stage.addEventListener('touchend', function(){
        if(Math.abs(dx) > 40){ go(dx > 0 ? ci + 1 : ci - 1); }
        dx = 0;
      });

      /* thumbnails */
      var thumbs = document.createElement('div');
      thumbs.className = 'gal-thumbs';
      images.forEach(function(u, i){
        var t = document.createElement('button');
        t.type = 'button';
        t.className = 'gal-thumb' + (i === 0 ? ' is-active' : '');
        t.setAttribute('aria-label', 'تصویر ' + (i + 1));
        var ti = document.createElement('img');
        ti.src = resolve(u);
        ti.alt = '';
        ti.loading = 'lazy';
        t.appendChild(ti);
        t.addEventListener('click', function(e){
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          go(i);
        });
        thumbs.appendChild(t);
      });

      wrap.appendChild(stage);
      wrap.appendChild(thumbs);
    } else {
      wrap.appendChild(stage);
    }

    return wrap;
  }

  /* ================================================================
     SITE — inject into #pmThumb when modal opens
     ================================================================ */
  function injectSite(){
    var thumb = document.getElementById('pmThumb');
    if(!thumb) return;
    if(thumb.querySelector('.gal-wrap')) return;

    var p = window.__curPmProduct;
    if(!p){
      /* try to read from any [data-id] in the modal */
      var idAttr = thumb.closest('[data-id]');
      if(idAttr && window.byId) p = window.byId[idAttr.getAttribute('data-id')];
    }
    if(!p) return;

    var imgs = getImages(p);
    if(!imgs.length) return;

    /* clear existing image/svg */
    var existing = thumb.querySelector('.thumb-img');
    if(existing) existing.style.display = 'none';
    var svg = thumb.querySelector('svg');
    if(svg) svg.style.display = 'none';

    /* make thumb a plain container */
    thumb.style.padding = '0';
    thumb.style.background = 'transparent';
    thumb.style.aspectRatio = '1';

    var gal = buildGallery(imgs, { alt: p.n || '' });
    if(gal){
      gal.style.borderRadius = 'inherit';
      thumb.appendChild(gal);
    }
  }

  /* ================================================================
     ADMIN — inject into .adm-pv-thumb in product view modal
     ================================================================ */
  function injectAdmin(){
    var thumb = document.querySelector('.adm-pv-thumb');
    if(!thumb) return;
    if(thumb.querySelector('.gal-wrap')) return;

    var p = window.__curPmAdminProduct;
    if(!p) return;

    var imgs = getImages(p);
    if(!imgs.length) return;

    /* hide any existing img/svg */
    var existing = thumb.querySelector('img');
    if(existing) existing.style.display = 'none';
    var svg = thumb.querySelector('svg');
    if(svg) svg.style.display = 'none';

    thumb.style.padding = '0';
    thumb.style.background = 'transparent';

    var gal = buildGallery(imgs, { alt: p.name || '' });
    if(gal){
      gal.style.borderRadius = 'inherit';
      thumb.appendChild(gal);
    }
  }

  /* ================================================================
     Observer — auto-detect modal open
     ================================================================ */
  function runAll(){
    injectSite();
    injectAdmin();
  }

  var observer = new MutationObserver(function(muts){
    var shouldRun = false;
    for(var i = 0; i < muts.length; i++){
      var m = muts[i];
      if(m.type === 'attributes' && m.target && m.target.id === 'pm'){
        shouldRun = true;
      }
      if(m.type === 'childList'){
        shouldRun = true;
      }
    }
    if(shouldRun){
      setTimeout(runAll, 60);
      setTimeout(runAll, 200);
      setTimeout(runAll, 500);
    }
  });

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
      setTimeout(runAll, 500);
    });
  } else {
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    setTimeout(runAll, 500);
  }

  window.__GALLERY_RUN__ = runAll;
  console.log('[gallery] ready');
})();
```

FILE: frontend\lazy.js
================================================================================
```js
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;

  var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(!e.isIntersecting) return;
      var img = e.target;
      if(img.dataset && img.dataset.src){
        img.src = img.dataset.src;
        delete img.dataset.src;
      }
      obs.unobserve(img);
    });
  }, { rootMargin: '200px' });

  function bind(){
    var list = document.querySelectorAll('img[data-src]');
    for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) obs.observe(list[i]);
  }

  window.__lazyBind = bind;

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bind);
  } else {
    bind();
  }

  /* MutationObserver فقط روی #grid و #offers با debounce */
  var debounceTimer = null;
  function scheduleBind(){
    if(debounceTimer) return;
    debounceTimer = setTimeout(function(){
      debounceTimer = null;
      bind();
    }, 300);
  }

  var mo = new MutationObserver(scheduleBind);
  var observed = new WeakSet();

  function observeTargets(){
    ['grid', 'offers', 'pmPanel', 'catTiles'].forEach(function(id){
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if(el && !observed.has(el)){
        observed.add(el);
        mo.observe(el, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      }
    });
  }

  /* تلاش اولیه + یک بار بعد از تأخیر کوتاه (برای زمانی که JS محتوا رو می‌سازه) */
  setTimeout(observeTargets, 500);
  setTimeout(observeTargets, 3000);
})();
```

```js
(function(){
  'use strict';

  var API = window.__API_BASE__ || '/api';

  /* هشدار: اگر hostname فرق داره، کوکی SameSite=Lax ممکنه ارسال نشه */
  try{
    var apiUrl = new URL(API, location.href);
    if(apiUrl.hostname !== location.hostname){
      console.warn("[login] hostname mismatch: page=" + location.hostname + " api=" + apiUrl.hostname + " — کوکی SameSite=Lax ممکنه ارسال نشه. از همون hostname استفاده کن.");
    }
  }catch(e){}

  var $ = function(s,r){ return (r||document).querySelector(s); };
  var $$ = function(s,r){ return Array.prototype.slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(s)); };

  var card = $('.auth-card');
  var form = $('#loginForm');
  var alertBox = $('#authAlert');
  var submitBtn = $('#authSubmit');

  function setAlert(msg, ok){
    if(!msg){ alertBox.hidden = true; return; }
    alertBox.hidden = false;
    alertBox.textContent = msg;
    alertBox.className = 'auth-alert' + (ok ? ' ok' : '');
  }

  function normPhone(v){
    return String(v || '')
      .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, function(d){ return '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d); })
      .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
  }

  function switchMode(mode){
    card.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    form.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    $$('.auth-tab').forEach(function(t){
      t.classList.toggle('is-active', t.dataset.tab === mode);
    });
    var label = $('.auth-submit-label');
    if(label) label.textContent = mode === 'signup' ? 'ساخت حساب' : 'ورود به حساب';
    var pw = $('#auPassword');
    if(pw) pw.setAttribute('autocomplete', mode === 'signup' ? 'new-password' : 'current-password');
    var pwS = $('#pwStrength');
    if(pwS) pwS.hidden = mode !== 'signup';
    setAlert('');
  }

  $$('.auth-tab').forEach(function(t){
    t.addEventListener('click', function(){ switchMode(t.dataset.tab); });
  });
  $$('[data-switch-to]').forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      switchMode(a.dataset.switchTo);
    });
  });

  $$('.auth-eye').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var inp = document.getElementById(b.dataset.eye);
      if(!inp) return;
      var on = inp.type === 'text';
      inp.type = on ? 'password' : 'text';
      b.classList.toggle('is-on', !on);
    });
  });

  var pwInput = $('#auPassword');
  if(pwInput){
    pwInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
      var v = pwInput.value;
      var bar = $('#pwStrength .auth-pw-bar i');
      var lbl = $('#pwStrength .auth-pw-lbl');
      if(!bar) return;
      var s = 0;
      if(v.length >= 8) s++;
      if(v.length >= 12) s++;
      if(/[A-Z]/.test(v) || /[آ-ی]/.test(v)) s++;
      if(/\d/.test(v)) s++;
      if(/[^A-Za-z0-9آ-ی]/.test(v)) s++;
      var pct = Math.min(100, (s/5)*100);
      bar.style.width = pct + '%';
      bar.style.background = s <= 1 ? '#b91c4a' : (s <= 3 ? '#d97706' : '#0e7c5f');
      lbl.textContent = s <= 1 ? 'ضعیف' : (s <= 3 ? 'متوسط' : (s >= 5 ? 'بسیار قوی' : 'قوی'));
    });
  }

  var otpBtn = $('#otpBtn');
  if(otpBtn){
    otpBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      setAlert('ورود با کد یکبار مصرف به زودی فعال می‌شود. لطفاً از رمز عبور استفاده کنید.');
    });
  }

  var forgotLink = $('#forgotLink');
  if(forgotLink){
    forgotLink.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      setAlert('برای بازیابی رمز، با پشتیبانی تماس بگیرید.');
    });
  }

  var phoneInput = $('#auPhone');
  if(phoneInput){
    phoneInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
      var v = normPhone(phoneInput.value);
      if(v.length > 11) v = v.slice(0, 11);
      phoneInput.value = v;
    });
  }

  form.addEventListener('submit', async function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    setAlert('');
    var mode = form.getAttribute('data-mode') || 'login';
    var phone = normPhone($('#auPhone').value);
    var password = $('#auPassword').value;

    if(!/^09\d{9}$/.test(phone)){
      setAlert('شمارهٔ موبایل باید با ۰۹ شروع شود و ۱۱ رقم باشد.');
      $('#auPhone').focus();
      return;
    }

    if(mode === 'signup'){
      var name = $('#auName').value.trim();
      var confirm = $('#auConfirm').value;
      var terms = $('#auTerms').checked;

      if(name.length < 3){ setAlert('نام حداقل ۳ کاراکتر.'); $('#auName').focus(); return; }
      if(password.length < 8){ setAlert('رمز حداقل ۸ کاراکتر.'); $('#auPassword').focus(); return; }
      if(password !== confirm){ setAlert('رمز و تکرار یکسان نیست.'); $('#auConfirm').focus(); return; }
      if(!terms){ setAlert('پذیرش قوانین الزامی است.'); return; }

      submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.classList.add('is-loading');
      try{
        var r1 = await fetch(API + '/auth/register', {
          method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include',
          body: JSON.stringify({ name: name, phone: phone, password: password })
        });
        var d1 = await r1.json();
        if(!r1.ok) throw new Error(d1.message || 'ثبت‌نام ناموفق');
        setAlert('حساب ساخته شد! در حال انتقال...', true);
        setTimeout(function(){ var u=d.user||d.data&&d.data.user; var target=(u&&u.role==="admin")?"admin.html":"index.html"; window.location.href=target; }, 700);
      }catch(err){
        setAlert(err.message || 'خطا در ثبت‌نام');
      }finally{
        submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.classList.remove('is-loading');
      }
      return;
    }

    if(!password){ setAlert('رمز عبور الزامی است.'); $('#auPassword').focus(); return; }

    submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.classList.add('is-loading');
    try{
      var r = await fetch(API + '/auth/login', {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include',
        body: JSON.stringify({ phone: phone, password: password })
      });
      var d = await r.json();
      if(!r.ok) throw new Error(d.message || 'ورود ناموفق');
      setAlert('خوش آمدید! در حال انتقال...', true);
      setTimeout(function(){ var u=d.user||d.data&&d.data.user; var target=(u&&u.role==="admin")?"admin.html":"index.html"; window.location.href=target; }, 700);
    }catch(err){
      setAlert(err.message || 'شماره یا رمز اشتباه است.');
    }finally{
      submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.classList.remove('is-loading');
    }
  });

  var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  if(params.get('signup') === '1') switchMode('signup');
})();
```

```js
(function(){

  /* ============== helpers ============== */
  function $(s, r){ return (r || document).querySelector(s); }
  function $$(s, r){ return Array.prototype.slice.call((r || document).querySelectorAll(s)); }
  function fa(n){ try{ return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('fa-IR'); } catch(e){ return String(n || 0); } }
  function faT(n){ return fa(Math.round((Number(n)||0)/10)); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c){ return { '&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;' }[c]; }); }

  /* حذف هر کاراکتر غیر عددی */
  function toNum(s){ return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''); }
  /* فرمت سه رقمی با جداکننده فارسی */
  function fmt(n){
    var num = Number(n) || 0;
    if(num === 0) return '';
    return num.toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
  }

  /* تبدیل عدد به حروف فارسی */
  function numToWordsFa(n){
    n = Math.floor(Number(n) || 0);
    if(n === 0) return 'صفر';
    if(n < 0) return 'منفی ' + numToWordsFa(-n);

    var yekan = ['', 'یک', 'دو', 'سه', 'چهار', 'پنج', 'شش', 'هفت', 'هشت', 'نه'];
    var dahgan = ['', '', 'بیست', 'سی', 'چهل', 'پنجاه', 'شصت', 'هفتاد', 'هشتاد', 'نود'];
    var dah = ['ده', 'یازده', 'دوازده', 'سیزده', 'چهارده', 'پانزده', 'شانزده', 'هفده', 'هجده', 'نوزده'];
    var sadgan = ['', 'صد', 'دویست', 'سیصد', 'چهارصد', 'پانصد', 'ششصد', 'هفتصد', 'هشتصد', 'نهصد'];
    var scales = ['', ' هزار', ' میلیون', ' میلیارد', ' بیلیون'];

    function threeDigit(x){
      if(x === 0) return '';
      var out = [];
      var s = Math.floor(x / 100);
      var r = x % 100;
      if(s) out.push(sadgan[s]);
      if(r >= 10 && r < 20){
        out.push(dah[r - 10]);
      } else {
        var d = Math.floor(r / 10);
        var y = r % 10;
        if(d) out.push(dahgan[d]);
        if(y) out.push(yekan[y]);
      }
      return out.join(' و ');
    }

    var groups = [];
    var rem = n;
    var i = 0;
    while(rem > 0){
      var g = rem % 1000;
      if(g > 0){
        var txt = threeDigit(g);
        if(scales[i]) txt = txt + scales[i];
        groups.unshift(txt);
      }
      rem = Math.floor(rem / 1000);
      i++;
      if(i >= scales.length) break;
    }
    return groups.join(' و ');
  }

  async function apiGet(p){ return fetchAPI(p, 'GET'); }
  async function fetchAPI(p, method, body){
    method = method || 'GET';
    var opts = { method: method, credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } };
    if(body) opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    var res = await fetch(API + p, opts);
    var data = null;
    try{ data = await res.json(); }catch(e){ data = { success:false, message:'invalid' }; }
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || ('HTTP ' + res.status));
    return data;
  }

    var sheet = getModalBox();
    var body = sheet.querySelector('#slProdBody');

    function catOptions(sel){
      var out = '<option value="">— انتخاب کنید —</option>';
      cats.forEach(function(c){
        var val = c.slug || String(c.id);
        var s = val === sel ? ' selected' : '';
        out += '<option value="' + esc(val) + '"' + s + '>' + esc(c.name) + '</option>';
      });
      return out;
    }

        + '<div class="aps-section">'

    function tabPricing(){
      var priceVal = F.price ? fmt(F.price) : '';
      var offVal = F.off || 0;
      var fp = Math.round((Number(F.price) || 0) * (1 - offVal / 100) / 1000) * 1000;
      var fpWords = fp > 0 ? numToWordsFa(fp) : '';
      var fpFormatted = fp > 0 ? fmt(fp) : '0';

      return ''
        + '<div class="aps-section">'
        +   '<div class="aps-section-head"><span class="aps-section-ic">' + ic('wallet', 16) + '</span><h4>قیمت</h4></div>'
        +   '<div class="aps-grid">'
        +     '<div class="aps-field"><label>قیمت فروش (ریال) <span class="req">*</span></label>'
        +       '<input class="adm-input sl-num" data-f="price" inputmode="numeric" value="' + priceVal + '" placeholder="0" data-autofocus>'
        +       '<div class="sl-price-words" id="slPriceWords">' + (F.price ? numToWordsFa(F.price) + ' ریال' : '') + '</div>'
        +     '</div>'
        +     '<div class="aps-field"><label>درصد تخفیف (٪)</label>'
        +       '<input class="adm-input" data-f="off" inputmode="numeric" value="' + offVal + '" placeholder="0" max="90">'
        +       '<div class="aps-hint">۰ تا ۹۰</div>'
        +     '</div>'
        +   '</div>'
        +   '<div class="sl-final-box">'
        +     '<div class="sl-final-label">قیمت نهایی پس از تخفیف</div>'
        +     '<div class="sl-final-value">'
        +       '<b id="slFinalNum">' + fa(fp) + '</b> <small>ریال</small>'
        +     '</div>'
        +     '<div class="sl-final-words" id="slFinalWords">' + (fpWords ? fpWords + ' ریال' : '') + '</div>'
        +   '</div>'
        + '</div>'
        + '<div class="aps-section">'
        +   '<div class="aps-section-head"><span class="aps-section-ic">' + ic('box', 16) + '</span><h4>انبار</h4></div>'
        +   '<div class="aps-grid">'
        +     '<div class="aps-field"><label>موجودی <span class="req">*</span></label><input class="adm-input" data-f="stock" inputmode="numeric" value="' + F.stock + '"></div>'
        +     '<div class="aps-field"><label>حداقل موجودی</label><input class="adm-input" data-f="minStock" inputmode="numeric" value="' + F.minStock + '"></div>'
        +     '<div class="aps-field"><label>وزن (گرم)</label><input class="adm-input" data-f="weight" inputmode="numeric" value="' + F.weight + '"></div>'
        +     '<div class="aps-field"><label>ابعاد</label><input class="adm-input" data-f="dimensions" dir="ltr" value="' + esc(F.dimensions) + '"></div>'
        +     '<div class="aps-field aps-field-wide"><label>گارانتی</label><input class="adm-input" data-f="warranty" value="' + esc(F.warranty) + '"></div>'
        +   '</div>'
        + '</div>';
    }

    function tabMedia(){

        +   '<div id="slImgList" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(100px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px"></div>'

        +     '<input type="file" id="slFile" accept="image/*" multiple style="display:none">'
        +     '<div class="aps-url-add"><input class="adm-input" id="slNewUrl" dir="ltr" placeholder="https://..."><button class="adm-btn outline" id="slAddUrl" type="button">افزودن با URL</button></div>'
        +   '</div>'
        + '</div>'
        + '<div class="aps-section">'
        +   '<div class="aps-section-head"><span class="aps-section-ic">' + ic('image', 16) + '</span><h4>ویدئو</h4></div>'
        +   '<div class="aps-field aps-field-wide"><input class="adm-input" data-f="videoUrl" dir="ltr" value="' + esc(F.videoUrl) + '" placeholder="https://..."></div>'
        + '</div>';
    }

    function tabVariants(){
      var colorRows = F.colors.map(function(c, i){
        return '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr 36px;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px">'
          + '<input type="color" value="' + esc(c.hex || '#94a3b8') + '" data-ch="' + i + '" style="width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--adm-border);cursor:pointer">'

          + '<button type="button" data-cd="' + i + '" class="aps-row-del">×</button>'

      }).join('');
      var sizeChips = F.sizes.map(function(s, i){
        return '<span class="aps-size-chip"><input value="' + esc(s) + '" data-sz="' + i + '"><button type="button" data-szd="' + i + '">×</button></span>';
      }).join('');
      return ''
        + '<div class="aps-section">'

        +   '<div>' + colorRows + '</div>'
        +   '<button class="aps-add-btn" id="slAddColor" type="button" style="margin-top:8px">+ افزودن رنگ</button>'
        + '</div>'
        + '<div class="aps-section">'
        +   '<div class="aps-section-head"><span class="aps-section-ic">' + ic('layers', 16) + '</span><h4>سایزها</h4></div>'
        +   '<div class="aps-size-list">' + sizeChips + '</div>'
        +   '<div class="aps-inline-add" style="margin-top:12px"><input class="adm-input" id="slNewSize" placeholder="مثلاً XL"><button class="adm-btn outline" id="slAddSize" type="button">افزودن</button></div>'
        + '</div>';
    }

    function tabSpecs(){
      var specRows = F.specs.map(function(s, i){
        return '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 36px;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px">'
          + '<input class="adm-input" value="' + esc(s.key || '') + '" data-sk="' + i + '" placeholder="کلید">'
          + '<input class="adm-input" value="' + esc(s.value || '') + '" data-sv="' + i + '" placeholder="مقدار">'
          + '<button type="button" data-sd="' + i + '" class="aps-row-del">×</button>'
          + '</div>';
      }).join('');
      var featRows = F.features.map(function(f, i){
        return '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr 36px;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px">'
          + '<span style="color:var(--adm-ok)">✓</span>'
          + '<input class="adm-input" value="' + esc(f) + '" data-ft="' + i + '">'
          + '<button type="button" data-ftd="' + i + '" class="aps-row-del">×</button>'

        +   '<button class="aps-add-btn" id="slAddSpec" type="button" style="margin-top:8px">+ افزودن مشخصه</button>'
        + '</div>'
        + '<div class="aps-section">'
        +   '<div class="aps-section-head"><span class="aps-section-ic">' + ic('check', 16) + '</span><h4>ویژگی‌ها</h4></div>'
        +   '<div>' + featRows + '</div>'
        +   '<div class="aps-inline-add" style="margin-top:12px"><input class="adm-input" id="slNewFeat" placeholder="ویژگی جدید"><button class="adm-btn outline" id="slAddFeat" type="button">افزودن</button></div>'
        + '</div>';
    }

    function bindInputs(){
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-f]').forEach(function(el){
        var k = el.dataset.f;
        if(el.type === 'checkbox'){
          el.onchange = function(){
            F[k] = el.checked;
            if(k === 'isActive'){
              var lbl = el.closest('.adm-pub-toggle');
              if(lbl){ var sp = lbl.querySelector('.adm-pub-label'); if(sp) sp.textContent = el.checked ? 'منتشر شده' : 'پیش‌نویس'; }
            }
          };
        } else if(el.classList.contains('sl-num')){
          /* فیلد عددی با جداکننده سه‌رقمی */
          el.oninput = function(){
            var raw = toNum(el.value);
            F[k] = raw;
            var pos = el.selectionStart;
            var prevLen = el.value.length;
            el.value = raw ? fmt(Number(raw)) : '';
            var newLen = el.value.length;
            var newPos = pos + (newLen - prevLen);
            if(newPos < 0) newPos = 0;
            if(newPos > newLen) newPos = newLen;
            try{ el.setSelectionRange(newPos, newPos); }catch(e){}
            /* آپدیت باکس قیمت */
            updateFinalBox();
          };
        } else {
          el.oninput = function(){ F[k] = el.value; };
        }
      });
    }

    function updateFinalBox(){
      var priceEl = body.querySelector('[data-f="price"]');
      var offEl = body.querySelector('[data-f="off"]');
      var price = Number(toNum(priceEl ? priceEl.value : '')) || 0;
      var off = Math.min(90, Math.max(0, Number(toNum(offEl ? offEl.value : '')) || 0));
      var fp = Math.round(price * (1 - off / 100) / 1000) * 1000;

      var numEl = body.querySelector('#slFinalNum');
      var wordsEl = body.querySelector('#slFinalWords');
      var priceWordsEl = body.querySelector('#slPriceWords');

      if(numEl) numEl.textContent = fa(fp);
      if(wordsEl) wordsEl.textContent = fp > 0 ? numToWordsFa(fp) + ' ریال' : '';
      if(priceWordsEl) priceWordsEl.textContent = price > 0 ? numToWordsFa(price) + ' ریال' : '';
    }

    function paintTab(name){
      sheet.querySelectorAll('.aps-tab').forEach(function(t){ t.classList.toggle('is-active', t.dataset.ptab === name); });

      if(name === 'general'){
        body.innerHTML = tabGeneral();
        bindInputs();
      } else if(name === 'pricing'){
        body.innerHTML = tabPricing();
        bindInputs();
        /* event listener روی off */
        var offEl = body.querySelector('[data-f="off"]');
        if(offEl){
          offEl.addEventListener('input', updateFinalBox);
        }
        updateFinalBox();
      } else if(name === 'media'){
        body.innerHTML = tabMedia();
        bindInputs();
        renderImages();

        var fileInput = body.querySelector('#slFile');
        if(fileInput){
          fileInput.onchange = function(){
            var files = Array.prototype.slice.call(fileInput.files || []);
            fileInput.value = '';
            if(!files.length) return;
            files.forEach(function(f){
              var fd = new FormData();
              fd.append('image', f);
              var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
              xhr.open('POST', (window.__API_BASE__ || '/api') + '/upload/product-single', true);
              xhr.withCredentials = true;
              xhr.onload = function(){
                try{
                  var r = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText || '{}');
                  if(r.success){ F.images.push(r.url); renderImages(); }
                  else toast('خطا: ' + (r.message || 'آپلود ناموفق'), 'err');
                }catch(e){ toast('خطا در آپلود', 'err'); }
              };
              xhr.send(fd);
            });
          };
        }

        body.querySelector('#slAddUrl').onclick = function(){
          var i = body.querySelector('#slNewUrl');
          var u = (i.value || '').trim();
          if(!u){ toast('URL را وارد کنید.', 'warn'); return; }
          F.images.push(u); i.value = ''; renderImages();
        };
      } else if(name === 'variants'){
        body.innerHTML = tabVariants();
        bindInputs();
        bindVariants();
      } else if(name === 'specs'){
        body.innerHTML = tabSpecs();
        bindInputs();
        bindSpecs();
      }
    }

    function renderImages(){
      var list = body.querySelector('#slImgList');
      var cnt = body.querySelector('#slImgCount');
      if(!list) return;
      if(cnt) cnt.textContent = fa(F.images.length);
      if(!F.images.length){
        list.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:20px;grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;color:var(--adm-muted);font-size:13px">هنوز تصویری اضافه نشده</div>';
        return;
      }
      list.innerHTML = F.images.map(function(u, i){
        var abs = window.__ASSET__ ? window.__ASSET__(u) : u;
        return '<div style="position:relative;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--adm-border);background-image:url(' + JSON.stringify(abs) + ');background-size:cover;background-position:center">'
          + '<button type="button" data-di="' + i + '" style="position:absolute;top:6px;inset-inline-end:6px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);color:#fff;border:0;cursor:pointer">×</button>'
          + '</div>';
      }).join('');
      list.querySelectorAll('[data-di]').forEach(function(b){
        b.onclick = function(){ F.images.splice(+b.dataset.di, 1); renderImages(); };
      });
    }

    function bindVariants(){
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-ch]').forEach(function(el){ el.oninput = function(){ F.colors[+el.dataset.ch].hex = el.value; }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-cn]').forEach(function(el){ el.oninput = function(){ F.colors[+el.dataset.cn].name = el.value; }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-cd]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick = function(){ F.colors.splice(+b.dataset.cd, 1); paintTab('variants'); }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-sz]').forEach(function(el){ el.oninput = function(){ F.sizes[+el.dataset.sz] = el.value; }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-szd]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick = function(){ F.sizes.splice(+b.dataset.szd, 1); paintTab('variants'); }; });
      var ac = body.querySelector('#slAddColor');
      if(ac) ac.onclick = function(){ F.colors.push({ name:'', hex:'#94a3b8' }); paintTab('variants'); };
      var as = body.querySelector('#slAddSize');
      if(as) as.onclick = function(){ var v = body.querySelector('#slNewSize').value.trim(); if(!v) return; F.sizes.push(v); paintTab('variants'); };
    }

    function bindSpecs(){
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-sk]').forEach(function(el){ el.oninput = function(){ F.specs[+el.dataset.sk].key = el.value; }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-sv]').forEach(function(el){ el.oninput = function(){ F.specs[+el.dataset.sv].value = el.value; }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-sd]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick = function(){ F.specs.splice(+b.dataset.sd, 1); paintTab('specs'); }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-ft]').forEach(function(el){ el.oninput = function(){ F.features[+el.dataset.ft] = el.value; }; });
      body.querySelectorAll('[data-ftd]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick = function(){ F.features.splice(+b.dataset.ftd, 1); paintTab('specs'); }; });
      var as = body.querySelector('#slAddSpec');
      if(as) as.onclick = function(){ F.specs.push({ key:'', value:'' }); paintTab('specs'); };
      var af = body.querySelector('#slAddFeat');
      if(af) af.onclick = function(){ var v = body.querySelector('#slNewFeat').value.trim(); if(!v) return; F.features.push(v); paintTab('specs'); };
    }

    sheet.querySelectorAll('[data-ptab]').forEach(function(t){
      t.onclick = function(){ paintTab(t.dataset.ptab); };
    });

    sheet.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick = closeModal; });

    /* delete */
    var delBtn = sheet.querySelector('#slDelBtn');
    if(delBtn && id){
      delBtn.onclick = async function(){
        var yes = await confirmDialog({ title:'حذف محصول', message:'این محصول حذف می‌شود. مطمئنید؟', confirmText:'حذف' });
        if(!yes) return;
        delBtn.disabled = true;
        try{
          await fetchAPI('/seller/products/' + id, 'DELETE');
          toast('محصول حذف شد.', 'ok');
          closeModal();
          if(window.__sellerProductsRefresh) window.__sellerProductsRefresh();
        }catch(e){ toast('خطا: ' + e.message, 'err'); delBtn.disabled = false; }
      };
    }

    /* save */
    var saveBtn = sheet.querySelector('#slSaveBtn');
    saveBtn.onclick = async function(){
      if(saveBtn.disabled) return;
      saveBtn.disabled = true;
      var old = saveBtn.textContent;
      saveBtn.textContent = 'در حال ذخیره...';
      try{
        sheet.querySelectorAll('[data-f]').forEach(function(el){
          var k = el.dataset.f;
          if(el.classList.contains('sl-num')){
            F[k] = toNum(el.value);
          } else {
            F[k] = el.type === 'checkbox' ? el.checked : el.value;
          }
        });
        var payload = {
          name: String(F.name || '').trim(),
          sku: String(F.sku || '').trim() || null,
          brand: String(F.brand || '').trim(),
          category: F.category,
          price: Number(toNum(F.price)) || 0,
          purchasePrice: 0,
          off: Math.min(90, Math.max(0, Number(toNum(F.off)) || 0)),
          stock: Number(toNum(F.stock)) || 0,
          minStock: Number(toNum(F.minStock)) || 0,
          weight: Number(toNum(F.weight)) || 0,
          dimensions: F.dimensions || '',
          art: F.art || 'book',
          description: F.description || '',
          shortDescription: F.shortDescription || '',
          videoUrl: F.videoUrl || '',
          warranty: F.warranty || '',
          metaTitle: F.metaTitle || '',
          metaDescription: F.metaDescription || '',
          images: (F.images || []).filter(function(u){ return u && String(u).trim(); }),
          features: (F.features || []).filter(function(x){ return x && String(x).trim(); }),
          sizes: (F.sizes || []).filter(function(x){ return x && String(x).trim(); }),
          colors: (F.colors || []).filter(function(c){ return c && c.name; }),
          specs: (F.specs || []).filter(function(s){ return s && s.key && s.value; }),
          isActive: !!F.isActive
        };
        if(payload.name.length < 2){ toast('نام محصول را وارد کنید.', 'warn'); throw new Error('v'); }
        if(!payload.brand){ toast('برند را وارد کنید.', 'warn'); throw new Error('v'); }
        if(!payload.category){ toast('دسته را انتخاب کنید.', 'warn'); throw new Error('v'); }
        if(!payload.price){ toast('قیمت را وارد کنید.', 'warn'); throw new Error('v'); }

        if(id){ await fetchAPI('/seller/products/' + id, 'PUT', payload); }
        else   { await fetchAPI('/seller/products', 'POST', payload); }
        toast(id ? 'محصول ذخیره شد.' : 'محصول اضافه شد.', 'ok');
        closeModal();
        if(window.__sellerProductsRefresh) window.__sellerProductsRefresh();
      }catch(e){
        if(e.message !== 'v'){
          console.error('[seller-save]', e);
          toast('خطا: ' + (e.message || 'نامشخص'), 'err');
        }
        saveBtn.disabled = false;
        saveBtn.textContent = old;
      }
    };

    paintTab('general');
  }

  /* ============== inject actions to table ============== */
  function injectActions(){
    var body = document.getElementById('prBody');
    if(!body) return;
    var table = body.closest('table');
    if(!table) return;
    var thead = table.querySelector('thead tr');
    if(!thead) return;

    if(!thead.querySelector('[data-seller-actions]')){
      var th = document.createElement('th');
      th.className = 'col-actions';
      th.setAttribute('data-seller-actions', '1');
      th.textContent = 'عملیات';
      thead.appendChild(th);
    }

    var rows = body.querySelectorAll('tr[data-id]');
    rows.forEach(function(tr){
      if(tr.querySelector('[data-seller-actions-cell]')) return;
      var id = tr.getAttribute('data-id');
      if(!id) return;
      var td = document.createElement('td');
      td.className = 'col-actions';
      td.setAttribute('data-seller-actions-cell', '1');
      td.innerHTML = '<div class="adm-tbl-actions">'
        + '<button class="adm-iconbtn-sm" data-sl-edit="' + id + '" title="ویرایش">✎</button>'
        + '<button class="adm-iconbtn-sm danger" data-sl-del="' + id + '" title="حذف">🗑</button>'
        + '</div>';
      tr.appendChild(td);
      td.querySelector('[data-sl-edit]').onclick = function(){ openProductForm(+id); };
      td.querySelector('[data-sl-del]').onclick = async function(){
        var yes = await confirmDialog({ title:'حذف محصول', message:'مطمئنید؟', confirmText:'حذف' });
        if(!yes) return;
        try{ var r = await fetchAPI('/seller/products/' + id, 'DELETE'); toast(r.message || 'حذف شد.', 'ok'); if(window.__sellerProductsRefresh) window.__sellerProductsRefresh(); }
        catch(e){ toast(e.message, 'err'); }
      };
    });
  }

  function injectAddButton(){
    var addBtn = document.getElementById('sl-add-product-btn');
    if(addBtn) return;
    var secHead = document.querySelector('.adm-content .adm-sec-head');
    if(!secHead) return;
    var h2 = secHead.querySelector('h2');
    if(!h2 || h2.textContent.indexOf('محصولات من') === -1) return;
    var actions = secHead.querySelector('.adm-sec-actions');
    if(!actions){ actions = document.createElement('div'); actions.className = 'adm-sec-actions'; secHead.appendChild(actions); }
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.id = 'sl-add-product-btn';
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.className = 'adm-btn primary';
    btn.innerHTML = '+ افزودن محصول';
    btn.onclick = function(){ openProductForm(null); };
    actions.appendChild(btn);
  }

  var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
    setTimeout(function(){ injectAddButton(); injectActions(); }, 100);
    setTimeout(function(){ injectAddButton(); injectActions(); }, 400);
  });
  function start(){
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    setTimeout(function(){ injectAddButton(); injectActions(); }, 500);
    setTimeout(function(){ injectAddButton(); injectActions(); }, 1500);
    setTimeout(function(){ injectAddButton(); injectActions(); }, 3000);
  }
  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  } else {
    start();
  }

  console.log('[seller-products-ui-v2] ready');
})();
```

```js
(function(){
'use strict';

window.__SELLER_LOADED__ = true;

var API = (window.__API_BASE__ || '/api');

/* ============== helpers ============== */
var $  = function(s,r){ return (r||document).querySelector(s); };
var $$ = function(s,r){ return Array.prototype.slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(s)); };
var fa = function(n){ try{ return Number(n||0).toLocaleString('fa-IR'); }catch(e){ return String(n||0); } };
var esc = function(s){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){ return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]; }); };
var store = {
  get: function(k,d){ try{ var v=localStorage.getItem(k); return v?JSON.parse(v):d; }catch(e){ return d; } },
  set: function(k,v){ try{ localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v)); }catch(e){} },
  del: function(k){ try{ localStorage.removeItem(k); }catch(e){} }
};

/* ============== api ============== */
async function api(path, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  var res = await fetch(API + path, Object.assign({
    credentials: 'include',
    headers: Object.assign({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, opts.headers || {})
  }, opts));
  var data = null;
  try{ data = await res.json(); }catch(e){ data = { success:false, message:'پاسخ نامعتبر' }; }
  if(res.status === 401){
    showBoot('نشست منقضی شد، در حال انتقال...');
    setTimeout(function(){ location.href = 'login.html'; }, 1200);
    throw new Error('unauth');
  }
  if(res.status === 403){
    toast('دسترسی ندارید.', 'err');
    throw new Error(data.message || 'forbidden');
  }
  if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || ('HTTP ' + res.status));
  return data;
}
var apiGet = function(p){ return api(p); };

/* ============== icons ============== */

/* ============== toast ============== */
function toast(msg, type, dur){
  type = type || 'info'; dur = dur || 3200;
  var box = $('#toasts');
  var el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'adm-toast ' + (type==='ok'?'ok':type==='err'?'err':type==='warn'?'warn':'');
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="adm-toast-ic">' + ic(type==='ok'?'check':'x', 18) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="adm-toast-msg"></div>' +
    '<button class="adm-toast-x" type="button">×</button>';
  el.querySelector('.adm-toast-msg').textContent = String(msg);
  var remove = function(){ el.classList.add('out'); setTimeout(function(){ el.remove(); }, 200); };
  el.querySelector('.adm-toast-x').onclick = remove;
  box.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(remove, dur);
}

/* ============== boot ============== */
function showBoot(msg){ $('#bootLoader').hidden = false; $('#app').hidden = true; if(msg) $('#bootMsg').textContent = msg; }

/* ============== sidebar ============== */
function openSidebar(){ $('#sidebar').classList.add('open'); $('#sideScrim').hidden = false; }

/* ============== nav ============== */
var PAGES = [
  { id: 'dashboard', label: 'داشبورد', icon: 'dashboard' },
  { id: 'products',  label: 'محصولات من', icon: 'box' },
  { id: 'orders',    label: 'سفارش‌ها', icon: 'cart' }
];

function renderNav(){
  var nav = $('#nav');
  nav.innerHTML = PAGES.map(function(p){
    return '<a class="adm-nav-it' + (state.page === p.id ? ' active' : '') + '" data-page="' + p.id + '" tabindex="0">' +
      '<span class="adm-nav-ic" data-ic="' + p.icon + '"></span><span>' + p.label + '</span></a>';
  }).join('');
  hydrateIcons(nav);
  nav.querySelectorAll('.adm-nav-it').forEach(function(el){
    el.onclick = function(){ go(el.dataset.page); };
  });
}

function hydrateIcons(root){
  (root || document).querySelectorAll('[data-ic]').forEach(function(e){ e.innerHTML = ic(e.dataset.ic, e.dataset.s || 20); });
}

function go(page){
  state.page = page;
  document.querySelectorAll('.adm-nav-it').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.toggle('active', el.dataset.page === page); });
  closeSidebar();
  var P = PAGES.filter(function(p){ return p.id === page; })[0];
  $('#pageTitle').textContent = P ? P.label : '';
  $('#pageSub').textContent = '';
  var c = $('#content');
  c.innerHTML = '';
  if(page === 'dashboard') renderDashboard(c);
  else if(page === 'products') renderProducts(c);
  else if(page === 'orders') renderOrders(c);
}
```
