```js
/* ============== products ============== */
async function renderProducts(root){
  root.innerHTML = '<div class="adm-sec-head"><h2>محصولات من</h2><span class="adm-sec-sub" id="prCount"></span></div>' +
    '<div class="adm-card">' +
    '<div class="adm-toolbar"><div class="adm-search"><span class="adm-search-ic">' + ic('search',18) + '</span><input id="prQ" placeholder="جستجو..." autocomplete="off"></div>' +
    '<select class="adm-select" id="prStatus" style="max-width:180px"><option value="">همه وضعیت‌ها</option><option value="true">فعال</option><option value="false">غیرفعال</option></select>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="adm-tbl-wrap"><table class="adm-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
    '<th>محصول</th><th>دسته</th><th>قیمت</th><th>موجودی</th><th>فروش</th><th>وضعیت</th>' +
    '</tr></thead><tbody id="prBody"></tbody></table></div></div>';
  var body = $('#prBody');
  var cntEl = $('#prCount');
  var timer;
  async function load(){
    body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:32px;text-align:center;color:var(--adm-muted)">در حال بارگذاری...</td></tr>';
    var params = new URLSearchParams();
    var qv = $('#prQ').value.trim();
    var st = $('#prStatus').value;
    if(qv) params.set('q', qv);
    if(st) params.set('active', st);
    params.set('limit', '100');
    try{
      var r = await apiGet('/seller/products?' + params.toString());
      var items = r.items || [];
      cntEl.textContent = fa(r.pagination && r.pagination.total || items.length) + ' محصول';
      if(!items.length){
        body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="adm-empty" style="padding:52px 16px"><h3>محصولی نیست</h3></div></td></tr>';
        return;
      }
      body.innerHTML = items.map(function(p){
        var img = p.images && p.images.length ? window.__ASSET__(p.images[0]) : null;
        var stockBadge = p.stock <= 0 ? '<span class="adm-bdg danger">ناموجود</span>' : (p.stock <= 5 ? '<span class="adm-bdg warn">' + fa(p.stock) + ' (کم)</span>' : '<span class="adm-bdg ok">' + fa(p.stock) + ' عدد</span>');
        return '<tr data-id="' + p.id + '">' +
          '<td><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px">' +
            '<div class="adm-prod-thumb" style="position:relative;overflow:hidden">' +
            (img ? '<img src="' + esc(img) + '" alt="" style="position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover" onerror="this.style.display=&quot;none&quot;">' : '') +
            '<span style="position:relative;z-index:0;display:grid;place-items:center;width:100%;height:100%">' + ic(p.art || 'box', 22) + '</span></div>' +
            '<div><b>' + esc(p.name) + '</b><div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--adm-muted)">' + esc(p.brand || '') + '</div></div>' +
          '</div></td>' +
          '<td><span class="adm-bdg">' + esc(p.category ? p.category.name : '—') + '</span></td>' +
          '<td><b>' + fa(p.finalPrice) + '</b>' + (p.off ? ' <small style="color:var(--adm-danger)">-' + fa(p.off) + '%</small>' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + stockBadge + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + fa(p.sales) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + (p.isActive ? '<span class="adm-bdg ok">منتشرشده</span>' : '<span class="adm-bdg">پیش‌نویس</span>') + '</td>' +
        '</tr>';
      }).join('');
    }catch(e){
      body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:32px;text-align:center;color:var(--adm-danger)">' + esc(e.message) + '</td></tr>';
    }
  }
  $('#prQ').addEventListener('input', function(){ clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(load, 300); });
  $('#prStatus').addEventListener('change', load);
  load();
}

/* ============== orders ============== */
async function renderOrders(root){
  root.innerHTML = '<div class="adm-sec-head"><h2>سفارش‌ها</h2><span class="adm-sec-sub" id="orCount"></span></div>' +
    '<div class="adm-card"><div class="adm-tbl-wrap"><table class="adm-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
    '<th>کد</th><th>مشتری</th><th>اقلام من</th><th>مبلغ من</th><th>وضعیت</th><th>تاریخ</th>' +
    '</tr></thead><tbody id="orBody"></tbody></table></div></div>';
  var body = $('#orBody');
  var cntEl = $('#orCount');
  var STATUS = { pending:'در انتظار پرداخت', paid:'پرداخت‌شده', processing:'در حال پردازش', shipped:'ارسال‌شده', delivered:'تحویل‌شده', cancelled:'لغو‌شده', refunded:'مرجوعی' };
  var CLS = { pending:'warn', paid:'info', processing:'info', shipped:'brand', delivered:'ok', cancelled:'danger', refunded:'danger' };
  body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:32px;text-align:center;color:var(--adm-muted)">در حال بارگذاری...</td></tr>';
  try{
    var r = await apiGet('/seller/orders?limit=100');
    var items = r.orders || [];
    cntEl.textContent = fa(r.pagination && r.pagination.total || items.length) + ' سفارش';
    if(!items.length){
      body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="adm-empty" style="padding:52px 16px"><h3>سفارشی شامل محصولات شما نیست</h3></div></td></tr>';
      return;
    }
    body.innerHTML = items.map(function(o){
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td><b dir="ltr">' + esc(o.trackingCode) + '</b></td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(o.customer || '—') + '<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--adm-muted)" dir="ltr">' + esc(o.customerPhone || '') + '</div></td>' +
        '<td><span class="adm-bdg">' + fa(o.itemsCount) + ' قلم</span></td>' +
        '<td><b>' + fa(Math.round(o.sellerTotal)) + '</b> <small style="color:var(--adm-muted)">ریال</small></td>' +
        '<td><span class="adm-bdg ' + (CLS[o.status]||'') + '">' + esc(STATUS[o.status] || o.status) + '</span></td>' +
        '<td>' + (o.createdAt ? new Date(o.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('fa-IR') : '—') + '</td>' +
      '</tr>';
    }).join('');
  }catch(e){
    body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:32px;text-align:center;color:var(--adm-danger)">' + esc(e.message) + '</td></tr>';
  }
}

/* ============== init ============== */
async function init(){
  hydrateIcons();
  renderNav();
  try{
    var r = await apiGet('/auth/me');
    if(!r.user || (r.user.role !== 'seller' && r.user.role !== 'admin')){
      showBoot('دسترسی فروشنده لازم است. در حال انتقال...');
      setTimeout(function(){ location.href = 'index.html'; }, 1200);
      return;
    }
    state.user = r.user;
    $('#userAvatar').textContent = (r.user.name || 'ف').trim().charAt(0);
    $('#userName').textContent = r.user.name || 'فروشنده';
    $('#userEmail').textContent = r.user.phone || r.user.email || '';
  }catch(e){
    if(e.message !== 'unauth'){
      showBoot('برای دسترسی وارد شوید...');
      setTimeout(function(){ location.href = 'login.html'; }, 1200);
    }
    return;
  }
  $('#bootLoader').hidden = true;
  $('#app').hidden = false;
  go('dashboard');

  $('#menuBtn').onclick = openSidebar;
  $('#sideScrim').onclick = closeSidebar;
  $('#refreshBtn').onclick = function(){ if(state.page === 'dashboard') renderDashboard($('#content')); else if(state.page === 'products') renderProducts($('#content')); else renderOrders($('#content')); };
  $('#themeBtn').onclick = function(){
    state.theme = state.theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    document.documentElement.dataset.admTheme = state.theme;
    store.set('bz.sl.theme', state.theme);
  };

  /* user chip */
  var chip = $('#userChip');
  chip.onclick = function(e){
    if(e.target.closest('[data-user-menu]')) return;
    var m = $('#userMenu');
    m.hidden = !m.hidden;
    chip.classList.toggle('open', !m.hidden);
  };
  $('#userMenu').onclick = function(e){
    var btn = e.target.closest('[data-user-menu]');
    if(!btn) return;
    var a = btn.dataset.userMenu;
    $('#userMenu').hidden = true; chip.classList.remove('open');
    if(a === 'site') window.open('index.html','_blank');
    else if(a === 'logout'){
      fetch(API + '/auth/logout', { method:'POST', credentials:'include' }).then(function(){ location.href = 'index.html'; });
    }
  };
}

init();
})();
```

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
/* ================================================================
   backup-and-analyze.js
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   فاز ۱: بکاپ کامل + تحلیل
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   ۱) بکاپ کامل از تمام فایل‌های پروژه (بدون node_modules و uploads)
   ۲) تحلیل رنگ‌های hardcoded در فایل‌ها
   ۳) گزارش دقیق — بدون تغییر
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   اجرا: node backup-and-analyze.js
   ================================================================ */
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { spawnSync } = require('child_process');

const ROOT = process.cwd();
const TIMESTAMP = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-').slice(0, 19);
const BACKUP_DIR = path.join(ROOT, 'full-backup-' + TIMESTAMP);
const REPORT_FILE = path.join(ROOT, 'theme-analysis-report.txt');

const C = { reset:'\x1b[0m', green:'\x1b[32m', red:'\x1b[31m', yellow:'\x1b[33m', cyan:'\x1b[36m', dim:'\x1b[2m', bold:'\x1b[1m', mag:'\x1b[35m' };
const ok = (s) => C.green + s + C.reset;
const err = (s) => C.red + s + C.reset;
const warn = (s) => C.yellow + s + C.reset;
const info = (s) => C.cyan + s + C.reset;
const dim = (s) => C.dim + s + C.reset;
const bold = (s) => C.bold + s + C.reset;
const mag = (s) => C.mag + s + C.reset;

/* ================================================================
   پوشه‌هایی که کپی نمیشن
   ================================================================ */
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set([
  'node_modules',
  '.git',
  '.vscode',
  '.idea',
  'uploads',
  'dist',
  'build',
  'coverage',
  '.next',
  '.nuxt',
]);

/* پوشه‌های backup قدیمی */
function isBackupDir(name) {
  return name.startsWith('.') && (
    name.indexOf('backup') !== -1 ||
    name.indexOf('-fix-') !== -1 ||
    name.indexOf('patch') !== -1 ||
    name.indexOf('recover') !== -1
  );
}

/* پسوندهای مجاز */
const EXTS = new Set([
  '.js', '.json', '.html', '.css', '.md', '.txt', '.sql',
  '.env', '.example', '.yml', '.yaml', '.config', '.xml',
]);

/* فایل‌های خاص */
const SPECIAL_FILES = new Set([
  '.env', '.env.example', '.gitignore', 'package.json',
  'package-lock.json', 'README.md',
]);

function shouldCopy(src) {
  const stat = fs.statSync(src);
  if (stat.isDirectory()) return false;

  const ext = path.extname(src).toLowerCase();
  const name = path.basename(src);

  if (SPECIAL_FILES.has(name)) return true;
  return EXTS.has(ext);
}

/* ================================================================
   بکاپ
   ================================================================ */
function copyRecursive(src, dest, stats) {
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(src, { withFileTypes: true });

  for (const entry of entries) {
    const srcPath = path.join(src, entry.name);
    const destPath = path.join(dest, entry.name);

    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      if (SKIP_DIRS.has(entry.name)) continue;
      if (isBackupDir(entry.name)) continue;
      if (entry.name === 'node_modules') continue;

      fs.mkdirSync(destPath, { recursive: true });
      copyRecursive(srcPath, destPath, stats);
    } else if (entry.isFile()) {
      if (!shouldCopy(srcPath)) continue;

      fs.copyFileSync(srcPath, destPath);
      stats.files++;
      stats.bytes += fs.statSync(srcPath).size;
    }
  }
}

function takeBackup() {
  console.log('╔════════════════════════════════════════════╗');
  console.log('║   Full Backup                              ║');
  console.log('╚════════════════════════════════════════════╝');
  console.log('');

  fs.mkdirSync(BACKUP_DIR, { recursive: true });

  const stats = { files: 0, bytes: 0 };

  console.log(bold('── کپی فایل‌ها ──'));
  console.log(dim('  از: ' + ROOT));
  console.log(dim('  به: ' + path.relative(ROOT, BACKUP_DIR)));
  console.log('');

  /* پوشه‌های اصلی */
  const DIRS = ['backend', 'frontend'];

  DIRS.forEach(function(dir){
    const src = path.join(ROOT, dir);
    if (!fs.existsSync(src)) {
      console.log(dim('  [skip] ' + dir));
      return;
    }
    const dest = path.join(BACKUP_DIR, dir);
    fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true });
    copyRecursive(src, dest, stats);
    console.log(ok('  ✅ ' + dir));
  });

  /* فایل‌های ریشه */
  const rootFiles = fs.readdirSync(ROOT).filter(function(f){
    const p = path.join(ROOT, f);
    return fs.statSync(p).isFile();
  });

  rootFiles.forEach(function(f){
    if (!shouldCopy(path.join(ROOT, f))) return;
    fs.copyFileSync(path.join(ROOT, f), path.join(BACKUP_DIR, f));
    stats.files++;
    stats.bytes += fs.statSync(path.join(ROOT, f)).size;
  });

  /* گزارش backup */
  const mb = (stats.bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2);
  console.log('');
  console.log(ok('  ✅ بکاپ کامل شد'));
  console.log('     ' + mag(stats.files) + ' فایل');
  console.log('     ' + mag(mb + ' MB'));
  console.log('     ' + info(path.relative(ROOT, BACKUP_DIR)));

  return stats;
}

/* ================================================================
   تحلیل رنگ‌ها
   ================================================================ */

/* الگوی رنگ hex */
const HEX_RE = /#([0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})\b/g;

/* رنگ‌های معنی‌دار که باید بمونن (چون بخشی از برند یا semantic هستن) */
const KNOWN_COLORS = new Set([
  '#fff', '#ffffff', '#000', '#000000',
  '#d92a3f', '#b91c30',  /* برند قرمز */
  '#c9a961', '#a8833c',  /* طلایی برند */
  '#0e9f6e', '#059669',  /* سبز موفقیت */
  '#ef4444', '#dc2626',  /* قرمز خطا */
  '#fbbf24', '#d97706',  /* نارنجی هشدار */
  '#3b82f6', '#0284c7',  /* آبی اطلاع */
]);

/* الگوی inline style در JS/HTML */
const INLINE_STYLE_RE = /style\s*=\s*["'`]([^"'`]+)["'`]/g;

/* الگوی color-mix */
const COLORMIX_RE = /color-mix\s*\(\s*in\s+srgb\s*,\s*(#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6})/g;

function analyzeFile(filePath, relPath, report) {
  const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
  const name = path.basename(filePath);

  if (!EXTS.has(ext) && !SPECIAL_FILES.has(name)) return;

  let content;
  try {
    content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
  } catch (e) {
    return;
  }

  const lines = content.split('\n');

  /* آمار */
  const fileStats = {
    path: relPath,
    hexTotal: 0,
    hexUnique: new Set(),
    hexOutsideVars: 0,
    inlineStyles: 0,
    colorMix: 0,
    examples: [],
  };

  lines.forEach(function(line, idx){
    /* hex colors */
    var m;
    HEX_RE.lastIndex = 0;
    while ((m = HEX_RE.exec(line)) !== null) {
      var hex = m[0].toLowerCase();
      fileStats.hexTotal++;
      fileStats.hexUnique.add(hex);

      /* چک: آیا این خط بخشی از تعریف متغیر هست؟ */
      var isVariableDef = /^\s*--[a-z-]+\s*:/.test(line);
      var isVarUse = /var\(--/.test(line);

      if (!isVariableDef) {
        fileStats.hexOutsideVars++;
        if (fileStats.examples.length < 5) {
          fileStats.examples.push({
            line: idx + 1,
            text: line.trim().slice(0, 120),
            hex: hex,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    /* inline styles */
    var im;
    INLINE_STYLE_RE.lastIndex = 0;
    while ((im = INLINE_STYLE_RE.exec(line)) !== null) {
      fileStats.inlineStyles++;
    }

    /* color-mix */
    var cm;
    COLORMIX_RE.lastIndex = 0;
    while ((cm = COLORMIX_RE.exec(line)) !== null) {
      fileStats.colorMix++;
    }
  });

  if (fileStats.hexTotal > 0 || fileStats.inlineStyles > 0 || fileStats.colorMix > 0) {
    report.files.push(fileStats);
    report.totalHex += fileStats.hexTotal;
    report.totalInline += fileStats.inlineStyles;
    report.totalColorMix += fileStats.colorMix;
    fileStats.hexUnique.forEach(function(h){ report.allHex.add(h); });
  }
}

function analyzeProject() {
  console.log('');
  console.log('╔════════════════════════════════════════════╗');
  console.log('║   Theme Analysis                           ║');
  console.log('╚════════════════════════════════════════════╝');
  console.log('');

  const report = {
    files: [],
    totalHex: 0,
    totalInline: 0,
    totalColorMix: 0,
    allHex: new Set(),
  };

  const TARGET_DIRS = [
    path.join(ROOT, 'backend', 'public'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'frontend'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'backend', 'controllers'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'backend', 'routes'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'backend', 'middleware'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'backend', 'utils'),
  ];

  /* فایل‌های مهم backend */
  const BACKEND_FILES = [
    path.join(ROOT, 'backend', 'server.js'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'backend', 'db', 'init.js'),
  ];

  TARGET_DIRS.forEach(function(dir){
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return;
    walk(dir, function(filePath){
      var relPath = path.relative(ROOT, filePath);
      analyzeFile(filePath, relPath, report);
    });
  });

  BACKEND_FILES.forEach(function(fp){
    if (!fs.existsSync(fp)) return;
    analyzeFile(fp, path.relative(ROOT, fp), report);
  });

  return report;
}

function walk(dir, cb) {
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  entries.forEach(function(entry){
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      if (SKIP_DIRS.has(entry.name)) return;
      if (isBackupDir(entry.name)) return;
      walk(full, cb);
    } else if (entry.isFile()) {
      cb(full);
    }
  });
}

/* ================================================================
   نمایش گزارش
   ================================================================ */
function printReport(report) {
  console.log(bold('── خلاصه ──'));
  console.log('  ' + mag(report.files.length + ' فایل') + ' با رنگ hardcoded');
  console.log('  ' + mag(report.totalHex + ' کد hex') + ' در کل');
  console.log('  ' + mag(report.allHex.size + ' رنگ یکتا') + ' شناسایی شد');
  console.log('  ' + mag(report.totalInline + ' inline style') + ' در JS/HTML');
  console.log('  ' + mag(report.totalColorMix + ' color-mix') + ' بدون CSS variable');
  console.log('');

  /* مرتب‌سازی بر اساس تعداد */
  const sorted = report.files.slice().sort(function(a, b){
    return b.hexOutsideVars - a.hexOutsideVars;
  });

  console.log(bold('── فایل‌هایی که بیشترین مشکل رو دارن (top 15) ──'));
  console.log('');
  console.log('  ' + dim('تعداد') + '  ' + dim('فایل'));
  console.log('  ' + dim('─────') + '  ' + dim('────'));

  sorted.slice(0, 15).forEach(function(f){
    var count = f.hexOutsideVars;
    var bar = '█'.repeat(Math.min(30, Math.ceil(count / 5)));
    console.log(
      '  ' + String(count).padStart(5) + '  ' +
      C.cyan + f.path + C.reset + '  ' +
      C.yellow + bar + C.reset
    );
  });

  if (sorted.length > 15) {
    console.log(dim('  ... و ' + (sorted.length - 15) + ' فایل دیگه'));
  }

  /* رنگ‌های پرتکرار */
  const hexCount = {};
  report.files.forEach(function(f){
    f.examples.forEach(function(ex){
      hexCount[ex.hex] = (hexCount[ex.hex] || 0) + 1;
    });
  });

  const topHex = Object.keys(hexCount).sort(function(a, b){
    return hexCount[b] - hexCount[a];
  }).slice(0, 20);

  console.log('');
  console.log(bold('── ۲۰ رنگ پرتکرار ──'));
  console.log('');

  topHex.forEach(function(hex){
    var isKnown = KNOWN_COLORS.has(hex.toLowerCase());
    var tag = isKnown ? dim(' (برند)') : warn(' ← کاندید جایگزینی');
    console.log('  ' + mag(hex.padEnd(10)) + '  ' + dim('×' + hexCount[hex]) + tag);
  });

  /* ذخیره در فایل */
  var out = [];
  out.push('════════════════════════════════════════════');
  out.push('  Theme Analysis Report');
  out.push('  ' + new Date().toLocaleString('fa-IR'));
  out.push('════════════════════════════════════════════');
  out.push('');
  out.push('خلاصه:');
  out.push('  فایل‌ها: ' + report.files.length);
  out.push('  hex کل: ' + report.totalHex);
  out.push('  رنگ یکتا: ' + report.allHex.size);
  out.push('  inline styles: ' + report.totalInline);
  out.push('  color-mix: ' + report.totalColorMix);
  out.push('');
  out.push('════════════════════════════════════════════');
  out.push('  فایل‌ها:');
  out.push('════════════════════════════════════════════');
  out.push('');

  sorted.forEach(function(f){
    out.push('── ' + f.path);
    out.push('   hex خارج از var: ' + f.hexOutsideVars + ' / کل: ' + f.hexTotal);
    out.push('   inline styles: ' + f.inlineStyles);
    out.push('   color-mix: ' + f.colorMix);
    out.push('   نمونه:');
    f.examples.forEach(function(ex){
      out.push('     خط ' + ex.line + ': ' + ex.text);
    });
    out.push('');
  });

  fs.writeFileSync(REPORT_FILE, out.join('\n'), 'utf8');
  console.log('');
  console.log(ok('  ✅ گزارش کامل ذخیره شد: ' + path.relative(ROOT, REPORT_FILE)));
}

/* ================================================================
   اجرا
   ================================================================ */
function main() {
  console.log('');

  /* فاز ۱: بکاپ */
  var backupStats = takeBackup();

  /* فاز ۲: تحلیل */
  var report = analyzeProject();
  printReport(report);

  /* نتیجه نهایی */
  console.log('');
  console.log('╔════════════════════════════════════════════╗');
  console.log('║   ✅ فاز ۱ کامل شد                         ║');
  console.log('╚════════════════════════════════════════════╝');
  console.log('');
  console.log(bold('➜  بکاپ:'));
  console.log('     ' + info(path.relative(ROOT, BACKUP_DIR)));
  console.log('     ' + mag(backupStats.files + ' فایل') + ' | ' + mag((backupStats.bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2) + ' MB'));
  console.log('');
  console.log(bold('➜  گزارش:'));
  console.log('     ' + info(path.relative(ROOT, REPORT_FILE)));
  console.log('');
  console.log(bold('➜  مرحله بعد:'));
  console.log('     ۱) گزارش رو باز کن و یه نگاه بنداز');
  console.log('     ۲) اگه موافقی، اسکریپت فاز ۲ رو اجرا میکنیم');
  console.log('     که رنگ‌های مستقل رو با CSS variable جایگزین میکنه');
  console.log('');
  console.log(warn('  💡 نکته:'));
  console.log('     رنگ‌های برند (قرمز/طلایی) و رنگ‌های semantic');
  console.log('     (سبز/قرمز/نارنجی/آبی برای پیام‌ها) عمداً حفظ میشن');
  console.log('');
}
```

```js
require('dotenv').config();
const express = require('express');
const cors = require('cors');
const helmet = require('helmet');
const compression = require('compression');
const morgan = require('morgan');
const cookieParser = require('cookie-parser');
const rateLimit = require('express-rate-limit');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');

const { initSchema } = require('./db/init');
const errorHandler = require('./middleware/error');
const { cacheMiddleware } = require('./utils/cache');

const app = express();
app.set('trust proxy', 1);

app.use(helmet({ crossOriginResourcePolicy:false }));
/* CORS — فقط originهای مجاز */
const ALLOWED_ORIGINS = (() => {
  const raw = process.env.CLIENT_URL || '';
  const list = raw.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (!list.length) {
    return [
      'http://localhost:5000',
      'http://127.0.0.1:5000',
      'http://localhost:8080',
      'http://127.0.0.1:8080',
      'http://localhost:3000',
      'http://127.0.0.1:3000',
      'http://localhost:5500',
      'http://127.0.0.1:5500',
    ];
  }
  return list;
})();

console.log('[CORS] allowed origins:', ALLOWED_ORIGINS.join(', '));

app.use(cors({
  origin: function(origin, callback){
    /* درخواست بدون Origin (curl، same-origin) → مجاز */
    if (!origin) return callback(null, true);
    /* origin در لیست مجاز؟ */
    if (ALLOWED_ORIGINS.indexOf(origin) !== -1) return callback(null, true);
    /* در حالت dev، هر localhost/127.0.0.1 */
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
      try {
        const u = new URL(origin);
        if (u.hostname === 'localhost' || u.hostname === '127.0.0.1') {
          return callback(null, true);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    /* غیرمجاز → بدون هدر CORS (مرورگر بلاک می‌کنه) */
    console.warn('[CORS] blocked origin:', origin);
    return callback(null, false);
  },
  credentials: true,
  methods: ['GET','POST','PUT','PATCH','DELETE','OPTIONS'],
  allowedHeaders: ['Content-Type','Authorization','X-Requested-With'],
  exposedHeaders: ['X-Cache'],
  maxAge: 86400
}));
app.use(express.json({ limit:'10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended:true }));
app.use(cookieParser());

if(process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') app.use(morgan('dev'));
/* Serve uploaded files */
app.use('/uploads', express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'uploads'), {
  maxAge: '7d',
  setHeaders: (res) => { res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*'); }
}));

const limiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs:15*60*1000, max:300,
  message:{ success:false, message:'تعداد درخواست‌ها زیاد است.' }
});
app.use('/api', limiter);

const authLimiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs:15*60*1000, max:20,
  message:{ success:false, message:'تعداد تلاش‌های ورود زیاد است.' }
});

app.get('/', (req,res)=>res.json({ success:true, message:'Bazaarche API', version:'3.0.0' }));
app.get('/api/health', (req,res)=>res.json({ success:true, uptime:process.uptime() }));

app.use('/api/auth', require('./routes/auth'));
app.use('/api/products',   cacheMiddleware(30000), require('./routes/products'));
app.use('/api/upload',      require('./routes/upload'));
app.use('/api/categories', cacheMiddleware(60000), require('./routes/categories'));
app.use('/api/users',      require('./routes/users'));
app.use('/api/orders',     require('./routes/orders'));
app.use('/api/reviews',    require('./routes/reviews'));
app.use('/api/site',       require('./routes/site'));
app.use('/api/cms',        cacheMiddleware(60000), require('./routes/cms'));

const pub = path.join(__dirname, 'public');
if(fs.existsSync(pub)){
  app.use(express.static(pub));
  app.get(/^\/(?!api).*/, (req,res)=>res.sendFile(path.join(pub, 'index.html')));
}

app.use((req,res)=>res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'مسیر پیدا نشد.' }));
app.use(errorHandler);


/* ================================================================
   Process-level safety nets
   ================================================================ */
process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason, promise) => {
  console.error('[FATAL] Unhandled Rejection at:', promise);
  console.error('[FATAL] Reason:', reason && reason.stack ? reason.stack : reason);
  /* در production بعد از log کردن، پروسه رو با کد خطا ببند تا مدیر پروسه (pm2/systemd) دوباره بالا بیاره */
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    setTimeout(() => process.exit(1), 100);
  }
});

process.on('uncaughtException', (err) => {
  console.error('[FATAL] Uncaught Exception:', err && err.stack ? err.stack : err);
  /* در production باید پروسه بسته بشه — نمی‌تونیم مطمئن باشیم state سالم می‌مونه */
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    setTimeout(() => process.exit(1), 100);
  }
});

const PORT = process.env.PORT || 5000;

(async () => {
  try{
    await initSchema();
    app.listen(PORT, ()=>console.log('[Server] Running on port ' + PORT + ' (' + process.env.NODE_ENV + ')'));
  }catch(err){
    console.error('[FATAL] DB init failed:', err.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();
```

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
/* ================================================================
   check-db.js — چک وضعیت دیتابیس
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   اجرا: node check-db.js
   (از داخل پوشه backend اجرا کن)
   ================================================================ */
'use strict';

require('dotenv').config();
const { pool } = require('./db/init');

async function run() {
  console.log('==============================================');
  console.log('  Database Check');
  console.log('==============================================');
  console.log('  DB:', process.env.DB_NAME, '| Host:', process.env.DB_HOST + ':' + process.env.DB_PORT);
  console.log('');

  let ok = true;

  /* اتصال */
  try {
    const [c] = await pool.query('SELECT 1');
    console.log('✅ اتصال به MySQL');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('❌ اتصال:', e.message);
    console.log('\n  ➜ چک کن .env درست باشه و MySQL روشن باشه');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  /* جدول‌ها */
  const tables = ['users', 'categories', 'products', 'product_colors', 'product_specs', 'orders', 'order_items', 'reviews', 'cms_pages', 'cms_banners', 'cms_sliders', 'site_features', 'site_festivals'];
  console.log('\n--- جدول‌ها ---');
  for (const t of tables) {
    try {
      const [r] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM ' + t);
      console.log('  ✅ ' + t.padEnd(20) + ' → ' + r[0].c + ' ردیف');
    } catch (e) {
      console.log('  ❌ ' + t.padEnd(20) + ' → ' + e.message);
      ok = false;
    }
  }

  /* محصولات فعال */
  console.log('\n--- محصولات ---');
  try {
    const [all] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products');
    const [active] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE is_active = 1');
    const [inactive] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE is_active = 0');
    console.log('  کل محصولات:     ' + all[0].c);
    console.log('  فعال:           ' + active[0].c);
    console.log('  غیرفعال:        ' + inactive[0].c);

    if (all[0].c === 0) {
      console.log('\n  ⚠️  هیچ محصولی توی DB نیست.');
      console.log('  ➜ اجرا کن: node utils/seed.js');
    } else if (active[0].c === 0) {
      console.log('\n  ⚠️  همه محصولات غیرفعالن.');
      console.log('  ➜ فعالشون کن: UPDATE products SET is_active = 1;');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('  ❌', e.message);
  }

  /* دسته‌ها */
  console.log('\n--- دسته‌بندی‌ها ---');
  try {
    const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT id, name, is_active FROM categories ORDER BY id LIMIT 10');
    if (!rows.length) {
      console.log('  ⚠️  هیچ دسته‌ای نیست → node utils/seed.js');
    } else {
      rows.forEach(r => console.log('  #' + r.id + ' ' + r.name + ' | active=' + r.is_active));
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('  ❌', e.message);
  }

  /* ادمین‌ها */
  console.log('\n--- ادمین‌ها ---');
  try {
    const [rows] = await pool.query("SELECT id, name, phone, email, is_active FROM users WHERE role='admin'");
    if (!rows.length) {
      console.log('  ⚠️  هیچ ادمینی نیست');
      console.log('  ➜ اجرا کن: node utils/make-admin.js "نام" 09123456789 "پسورد-قوی"');
    } else {
      rows.forEach(r => console.log('  #' + r.id + ' ' + r.name + ' | ' + r.phone + ' | ' + r.email + ' | active=' + r.is_active));
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('  ❌', e.message);
  }

  console.log('\n==============================================');
  console.log(ok ? '  ✅ همه جدول‌ها موجودن' : '  ⚠️  بعضی جدول‌ها مشکل دارن');
  console.log('==============================================\n');

  await pool.end();
}

run().catch(e => { console.error('FATAL:', e); process.exit(1); });
```

```js
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');
const { signAccess, signRefresh, setCookies, clearCookies, verifyRefresh } = require('../utils/token');

function payload(u){
  return {
    _id: u.id, id: u.id,
    name: u.name, phone: u.phone,
    role: u.role, avatar: u.avatar
  };
}

function normalizePhone(p){
  if(!p) return '';
  return String(p)
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, function(d){ return '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d); })
    .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
}

function bumpTokenVersion(userId){
  return q('UPDATE users SET token_version = COALESCE(token_version,0) + 1 WHERE id = ?', [userId]);
}

/* ============ ثبت‌نام — فقط شماره ============ */
exports.register = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { name, phone, password } = req.body;
    const cleanPhone = normalizePhone(phone);

    if(!name || String(name).trim().length < 3){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نام باید حداقل ۳ کاراکتر باشد.' });
    }
    if(!/^09\d{9}$/.test(cleanPhone)){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'شمارهٔ موبایل باید با ۰۹ شروع شود و ۱۱ رقم باشد.' });
    }
    if(!password || String(password).length < 8){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'رمز عبور حداقل ۸ کاراکتر باشد.' });
    }

    const dup = await qOne('SELECT id FROM users WHERE phone = ? LIMIT 1', [cleanPhone]);
    if(dup){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این شمارهٔ موبایل قبلاً ثبت شده است.' });
    }

    /* ایمیل پلیس‌هولدر یکتا */
    const placeholderEmail = 'u' + cleanPhone + '.' + Date.now().toString(36) + '@phone.local';
    const hash = await bcrypt.hash(password, 10);
    const id = await insert(
      'INSERT INTO users (name, email, phone, password) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [String(name).trim(), placeholderEmail, cleanPhone, hash]
    );
    const user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    const tv = 0;
    setCookies(res, signAccess(user.id, tv), signRefresh(user.id, tv));
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, user: payload(user) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* ============ ورود — فقط شماره ============ */
exports.login = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { phone, password } = req.body;
    const cleanPhone = normalizePhone(phone);

    if(!cleanPhone || !password){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'شماره و رمز عبور الزامی است.' });
    }

    const user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE phone = ? LIMIT 1', [cleanPhone]);
    if(!user){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'شماره یا رمز عبور اشتباه است.' });
    }
    const okPw = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.password);
    if(!okPw){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'شماره یا رمز عبور اشتباه است.' });
    }
    if(!user.is_active){
      return res.status(403).json({ success:false, message:'حساب شما غیرفعال شده است.' });
    }

    await q('UPDATE users SET last_login = NOW() WHERE id = ?', [user.id]);
    const tv = user.token_version || 0;
    setCookies(res, signAccess(user.id, tv), signRefresh(user.id, tv));
    res.json({ success:true, user: payload(user) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* ============ OTP — آماده برای آینده ============ */
exports.sendOtp = async (req, res) => {
  return res.status(503).json({ success:false, message:'ورود با کد یکبار مصرف به زودی فعال می‌شود.' });
};
exports.verifyOtp = async (req, res) => {
  return res.status(503).json({ success:false, message:'ورود با کد یکبار مصرف به زودی فعال می‌شود.' });
};

/* ============ بقیه ============ */
exports.logout = function(req, res){
  clearCookies(res);
  res.json({ success:true, message:'از حساب خارج شدید.' });
};

exports.refresh = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const token = req.cookies && req.cookies.refreshToken;
    if(!token) return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'توکن موجود نیست.' });
    const decoded = verifyRefresh(token);
    const user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ? AND is_active = 1', [decoded.id]);
    if(!user) return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'کاربر معتبر نیست.' });
    if(typeof decoded.tv === 'number' && decoded.tv !== (user.token_version || 0)){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'نشست باطل شده.' });
    }
    const access = signAccess(user.id, user.token_version || 0);
    res.cookie('accessToken', access, {
      httpOnly:true, sameSite:'lax',
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
      maxAge: 7*24*60*60*1000
    });
    res.json({ success:true });
  }catch(err){
    res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'توکن نامعتبر.' });
  }
};

exports.me = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const addresses = await q('SELECT * FROM addresses WHERE user_id = ?', [req.user.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, user: { ...req.user, addresses } });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.updateMe = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const fields = [];
    const vals = [];
    if(req.body.name !== undefined){
      const n = String(req.body.name).trim();
      if(n.length < 3 || n.length > 60) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نام باید بین ۳ تا ۶۰ کاراکتر.' });
      fields.push('name = ?'); vals.push(n);
    }
    if(req.body.avatar !== undefined){
      fields.push('avatar = ?'); vals.push(String(req.body.avatar || '').trim().slice(0, 500));
    }
    if(fields.length){
      vals.push(req.user.id);
      await q('UPDATE users SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals);
    }
    const user = await qOne('SELECT id, name, phone, role, avatar, is_active FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.user.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, user });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.changePassword = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { currentPassword, newPassword } = req.body;
    if(!currentPassword || !newPassword || newPassword.length < 8){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'رمز فعلی و جدید (حداقل ۸ کاراکتر) الزامی است.' });
    }
    if(currentPassword === newPassword){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'رمز جدید باید متفاوت باشد.' });
    }
    const user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.user.id]);
    const okPw = await bcrypt.compare(currentPassword, user.password);
    if(!okPw) return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'رمز فعلی اشتباه است.' });
    const hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 10);
    await q('UPDATE users SET password = ? WHERE id = ?', [hash, user.id]);
    await bumpTokenVersion(user.id);
    clearCookies(res);
    res.json({ success:true, message:'رمز تغییر کرد. دوباره وارد شوید.' });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.forgotPassword = async (req, res) => {
  return res.status(503).json({ success:false, message:'بازیابی رمز به زودی از طریق پیامک فعال می‌شود.' });
};
exports.resetPassword = async (req, res) => {
  return res.status(503).json({ success:false, message:'بازیابی رمز به زودی فعال می‌شود.' });
};
```

```js
exports.list = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const where = req.query.all === 'true' ? '' : 'WHERE is_active = 1';
    const rows = await q('SELECT * FROM categories ' + where + ' ORDER BY order_num ASC, name ASC');
    const withCount = await Promise.all(rows.map(async c => {
      const cnt = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE category_id = ? AND is_active = 1', [c.id]);
      return {
        id: c.id, _id: c.id,
        name: c.name, slug: c.slug,
        icon: c.icon, color: c.color,
        image_url: c.image_url || null,
        order: c.order_num,
        isActive: !!c.is_active,
        productCount: cnt.c
      };
    }));
    res.json({ success:true, categories: withCount });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.create = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { name, icon, color, order, image_url } = req.body;
    if(!name) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نام الزامی است.' });
    const slug = slugify(name);
    const id = await insert(
      'INSERT INTO categories (name, slug, icon, color, order_num, image_url) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)',
      [name, slug, icon || 'book', color || '#3b82f6', Number(order) || 0, String(image_url || '').slice(0, 500)]
    );
    const cat = await qOne('SELECT * FROM categories WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, category: cat });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.update = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const b = req.body;
    const fields = [];
    const vals = [];
    if(b.name !== undefined){ fields.push('name = ?', 'slug = ?'); vals.push(b.name, slugify(b.name)); }
    if(b.icon !== undefined){ fields.push('icon = ?'); vals.push(b.icon); }
    if(b.color !== undefined){ fields.push('color = ?'); vals.push(b.color); }
    if(b.order !== undefined){ fields.push('order_num = ?'); vals.push(Number(b.order) || 0); }
    if(b.isActive !== undefined){ fields.push('is_active = ?'); vals.push(b.isActive ? 1 : 0); }
    if(b.image_url !== undefined){ fields.push('image_url = ?'); vals.push(String(b.image_url || '').slice(0, 500)); }
    if(fields.length){
      vals.push(req.params.id);
      await q('UPDATE categories SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals);
    }
    const cat = await qOne('SELECT * FROM categories WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!cat) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'دسته پیدا نشد.' });
    res.json({ success:true, category: cat });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.remove = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const cnt = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE category_id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(cnt.c > 0) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'ابتدا ' + cnt.c + ' محصول این دسته را منتقل یا حذف کنید.' });
    await q('DELETE FROM categories WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, message:'دسته حذف شد.' });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};
```

```js
const { pool, q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');

const { FREE_THRESHOLD: FREE_SHIPPING, SHIPPING_COST } = require('../utils/shippingConstants');

function finalPrice(p){
  return Math.round(p.price * (1 - p.off/100) / 1000) * 1000;
}

async function getOrderItems(conn, orderId){
  const [rows] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [orderId]);
  return rows;
}

function buildOrder(order, items, forAdmin){
  const out = {
    id: order.id, _id: order.id,
    items: items.map(i => ({
      _id: i.id, product: i.product_id, name: i.name, art: i.art,
      color: i.color_name ? { name: i.color_name, hex: i.color_hex } : null,
      price: i.price, qty: i.qty, lineTotal: i.line_total
    })),
    shippingAddress: {
      name: order.shipping_name, phone: order.shipping_phone,
      province: order.shipping_province, city: order.shipping_city,
      street: order.shipping_street, postalCode: order.shipping_postal
    },
    itemsPrice: order.items_price,
    shippingPrice: order.shipping_price,
    totalPrice: order.total_price,
    paymentMethod: order.payment_method,
    trackingCode: order.tracking_code,
    status: order.status,
    paymentSimulated: !!order.payment_simulated,
    customerNote: order.note || '',
    createdAt: order.created_at
  };
  if(forAdmin){
    out.discountAmount = Number(order.discount || 0);
    out.tax = Number(order.tax || 0);
    out.internalNote = order.internal_note || '';
    out.shipmentTracking = order.shipment_tracking || null;
    out.shipmentCarrier = order.shipment_carrier || null;
    out.refundedAmount = Number(order.refunded_amount || 0);
    out.returnedAt = order.returned_at;
    out.returnReason = order.return_reason;
    out.refundedAt = order.refunded_at;
    out.refundNote = order.refund_note;
    out.stockRestored = !!order.stock_restored;
  }
  return out;
}

async function hydrateOrder(row, forAdmin){
  const items = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [row.id]);
  return buildOrder(row, items, forAdmin);
}

function isAdmin(req){ return req && req.user && req.user.role === 'admin'; }

/* ============ Create — with transaction ============ */
exports.create = async (req, res, next) => {
  let conn = null;
  let __released = false;
  try{
    conn = await pool.getConnection();
    const { items, shippingAddress, paymentMethod, note } = req.body;
    if(!Array.isArray(items) || !items.length){
      if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'سبد خرید خالی است.' });
    }
    if(!shippingAddress || !shippingAddress.name || !shippingAddress.city || !shippingAddress.street){
      if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'اطلاعات نشانی ناقص است.' });
    }
    const pm = paymentMethod === 'cod' ? 'cod' : 'online';

    // merge duplicate products
    const merged = {};
    for(const raw of items){
      const pid = Number(raw.product);
      const qty = Number(raw.qty);
      if(!Number.isInteger(pid) || pid <= 0) continue;
      if(!Number.isInteger(qty) || qty <= 0 || qty > 10){
        if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'تعداد کالا نامعتبر است.' });
      }
      /* کلید = product + color تا دو رنگ مختلف با هم ادغام نشن */
      const cname = (raw.color && raw.color.name) ? String(raw.color.name).trim() : '';
      const chex  = (raw.color && raw.color.hex)  ? String(raw.color.hex).trim()  : '';
      const key = pid + '::' + cname;
      if(!merged[key]){
        merged[key] = { product: pid, qty: 0, color: cname ? { name: cname, hex: chex } : null };
      }
      merged[key].qty += qty;
    }
    const list = Object.values(merged);
    if(!list.length){
      if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'سبد خرید خالی است.' });
    }

    await conn.beginTransaction();

    let itemsPrice = 0;
    const prepared = [];

    for(const it of list){
      const [rows] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ? AND is_active = 1 FOR UPDATE', [it.product]);
      const p = rows[0];
      if(!p){
        await conn.rollback();
        if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'کالای انتخاب‌شده در دسترس نیست.' });
      }
      if(p.stock < it.qty){
        await conn.rollback();
        if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'موجودی «' + p.name + '» کافی نیست.' });
      }
      const fp = finalPrice(p);
      const lineTotal = fp * it.qty;
      itemsPrice += lineTotal;
      let color = it.color;
      if(!color || !color.name){
        const [cs] = await conn.query('SELECT name, hex FROM product_colors WHERE product_id = ? LIMIT 1', [p.id]);
        if(cs[0]) color = { name: cs[0].name, hex: cs[0].hex };
      }
      prepared.push({
        product_id: p.id, name: p.name, art: p.art,
        color_name: color ? color.name : null,
        color_hex: color ? color.hex : null,
        price: fp, qty: it.qty, line_total: lineTotal
      });
    }

    const shippingPrice = itemsPrice >= FREE_SHIPPING ? 0 : SHIPPING_COST;
    const totalPrice = itemsPrice + shippingPrice;
    const trackCode = 'BZ-' + Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase() + '-' + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000);

    // online: pending until confirmed. cod: pending too.
    const status = 'pending';
    const paymentSimulated = pm === 'online' ? 1 : 0;

    const [orderRes] = await conn.query(
      'INSERT INTO orders (user_id, payment_method, items_price, shipping_price, total_price, status, tracking_code, note, shipping_name, shipping_phone, shipping_province, shipping_city, shipping_street, shipping_postal, payment_simulated) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
      [req.user.id, pm, itemsPrice, shippingPrice, totalPrice, status, trackCode, note || '', shippingAddress.name, shippingAddress.phone, shippingAddress.province || null, shippingAddress.city, shippingAddress.street, shippingAddress.postalCode || null, paymentSimulated]
    );
    const orderId = orderRes.insertId;

    for(const it of prepared){
      await conn.query(
        'INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, name, art, color_name, color_hex, price, qty, line_total) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
        [orderId, it.product_id, it.name, it.art, it.color_name, it.color_hex, it.price, it.qty, it.line_total]
      );
      await conn.query('UPDATE products SET stock = stock - ?, sales = sales + ? WHERE id = ?', [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
    }

    await conn.commit();
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }

    const order = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [orderId]);
    const items2 = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [orderId]);
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(order, items2, true) });
  }catch(err){
    try{ if(conn) await conn.rollback(); }catch(e){}
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    next(err);
  }
};

/* ============ Confirm payment (simulated gateway) ============ */
exports.confirmPayment = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const order = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?', [req.params.id, req.user.id]);
    if(!order) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' });
    if(order.status !== 'pending'){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این سفارش در وضعیت قابل پرداخت نیست.' });
    }
    if(order.payment_method !== 'online'){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این سفارش پرداخت آنلاین نیست.' });
    }
    await q("UPDATE orders SET status = 'paid', paid_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?", [order.id]);
    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    const items = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(updated, items, true) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* ============ My Orders ============ */
exports.myOrders = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const rows = await q('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC', [req.user.id]);
    const orders = [];
    for(const r of rows){
      const items = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [r.id]);
      orders.push(buildOrder(r, items, false));
    }
    res.json({ success:true, orders });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.getOne = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const order = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!order) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' });
    const owner = order.user_id === req.user.id;
    if(!owner && req.user.role !== 'admin'){
      return res.status(403).json({ success:false, message:'دسترسی ندارید.' });
    }
    const items = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(order, items, isAdmin(req)) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* ============ Cancel — with transaction ============ */
exports.cancel = async (req, res, next) => {
  let conn = null;
  let __released = false;
  try{
    conn = await pool.getConnection();
    await conn.beginTransaction();
    const [oRows] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE', [req.params.id]);
    const order = oRows[0];
    if(!order){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' });
    }
    if(order.user_id !== req.user.id && req.user.role !== 'admin'){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(403).json({ success:false, message:'دسترسی ندارید.' });
    }
    const isAdmin = req.user.role === 'admin';
    if(['shipped','delivered','cancelled','refunded'].includes(order.status)){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این سفارش قابل لغو نیست.' });
    }
    /* کاربر فقط می‌تونه سفارش pending رو لغو کنه (پرداخت‌نشده) */
    if(!isAdmin && order.status !== 'pending'){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({
        success:false,
        message:'فقط سفارش در انتظار پرداخت قابل لغو است. برای لغو سفارش پرداخت‌شده با پشتیبانی تماس بگیرید.'
      });
    }
    if(order.stock_restored){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'موجودی این سفارش قبلاً برگشت داده شده.' });
    }
    await conn.query("UPDATE orders SET status = 'cancelled', stock_restored = 1 WHERE id = ?", [order.id]);
    const [items] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    for(const it of items){
      await conn.query('UPDATE products SET stock = stock + ?, sales = GREATEST(sales - ?, 0) WHERE id = ?', [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
    }
    await conn.commit();
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    const items2 = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(updated, items2, true) });
  }catch(err){
    try{ if(conn) await conn.rollback(); }catch(e){}
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    next(err);
  }
};

exports.listAll = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const page = Math.max(1, Number(req.query.page) || 1);
    const limit = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, Number(req.query.limit) || 30));
    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
    const where = []; const params = [];
    if(req.query.status){ where.push('o.status = ?'); params.push(req.query.status); }
    if(req.query.q){ where.push('(o.tracking_code LIKE ? OR o.shipment_tracking LIKE ?)'); const like = '%' + req.query.q + '%'; params.push(like, like); }
    if(req.query.customer){ where.push('(o.shipping_name LIKE ? OR o.shipping_phone LIKE ?)'); const like = '%' + req.query.customer + '%'; params.push(like, like); }
    if(req.query.from){ where.push('o.created_at >= ?'); params.push(req.query.from + ' 00:00:00'); }
    if(req.query.to){ where.push('o.created_at <= ?'); params.push(req.query.to + ' 23:59:59'); }
    const whereSql = where.length ? 'WHERE ' + where.join(' AND ') : '';
    const sql = 'SELECT o.*, u.name as user_name, u.email as user_email FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id ' + whereSql + ' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT ' + limit + ' OFFSET ' + offset;
    const rows = await q(sql, params);
    const totalRow = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM orders o ' + whereSql, params);
    const items = await Promise.all(rows.map(async r => {
      const its = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [r.id]);
      const built = buildOrder(r, its, true);
      built.user = { name: r.user_name, email: r.user_email };
      return built;
    }));
    res.json({ success:true, items, pagination: { page, limit, total: totalRow.c, pages: Math.ceil(totalRow.c / limit) } });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.updateStatus = async (req, res, next) => {
  let conn = null;
  let __released = false;
  try{
    conn = await pool.getConnection();
    const { status } = req.body;
    const allowed = ['pending','paid','processing','shipped','delivered','cancelled','refunded'];
    if(!allowed.includes(status)){
      if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'وضعیت نامعتبر است.' });
    }
    /* State machine — گذارهای مجاز */
    const TRANSITIONS = {
      pending:    ['paid','cancelled'],
      paid:       ['processing','shipped','cancelled','refunded'],
      processing: ['shipped','cancelled','refunded'],
      shipped:    ['delivered','refunded'],
      delivered:  ['refunded'],
      cancelled:  [],
      refunded:   [],
    };
    await conn.beginTransaction();
    const [oRows] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE', [req.params.id]);
    const order = oRows[0];
    if(!order){ await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} } return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' }); }

    /* چک گذار مجاز */
    if(status !== order.status){
      const allowedNext = TRANSITIONS[order.status] || [];
      if(allowedNext.indexOf(status) === -1){
        await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
        return res.status(400).json({
          success:false,
          message: 'گذار از «' + order.status + '» به «' + status + '» مجاز نیست.'
        });
      }
    }

    // if transitioning to cancelled and stock not yet restored, restore it
    if(status === 'cancelled' && !order.stock_restored && order.status !== 'cancelled'){
      const [items] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
      for(const it of items){
        await conn.query('UPDATE products SET stock = stock + ?, sales = GREATEST(sales - ?, 0) WHERE id = ?', [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
      }
      await conn.query('UPDATE orders SET stock_restored = 1 WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    }
    const fields = ['status = ?']; const vals = [status];
    if(status === 'delivered') fields.push('delivered_at = NOW()');
    if(status === 'paid' && !order.paid_at) fields.push('paid_at = NOW()');
    vals.push(order.id);
    await conn.query('UPDATE orders SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals);
    await conn.commit();
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    const items2 = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(updated, items2, true) });
  }catch(err){
    try{ if(conn) await conn.rollback(); }catch(e){}
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    next(err);
  }
};

/* ============ Refund — idempotent ============ */
exports.refund = async (req, res, next) => {
  let conn = null;
  let __released = false;
  try{
    conn = await pool.getConnection();
    const { amount, note } = req.body;
    await conn.beginTransaction();
    const [oRows] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE', [req.params.id]);
    const order = oRows[0];
    if(!order){ await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} } return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' }); }
    if(order.status === 'refunded'){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این سفارش قبلاً بازپرداخت شده.' });
    }
    /* فقط سفارش‌هایی که واقعاً پول گرفته‌ان قابل بازپرداخت هستن */
    if(['pending','cancelled'].includes(order.status)){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({
        success:false,
        message:'این سفارش پرداخت نشده — بازپرداخت مجاز نیست.'
      });
    }
    const amt = Math.max(0, Number(amount) || 0);
    if(amt <= 0){ await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} } return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'مبلغ بازپرداخت الزامی است.' }); }
    if(amt > Number(order.total_price)){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'مبلغ بازپرداخت از مبلغ سفارش بیشتر است.' });
    }
    // restore stock only if not already
    if(!order.stock_restored){
      const [items] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
      for(const it of items){
        await conn.query('UPDATE products SET stock = stock + ?, sales = GREATEST(sales - ?, 0) WHERE id = ?', [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
      }
    }
    await conn.query("UPDATE orders SET refunded_amount = ?, refund_note = ?, refunded_at = NOW(), status = 'refunded', stock_restored = 1 WHERE id = ?", [amt, String(note || '').slice(0, 2000), order.id]);
    await conn.commit();
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    const items2 = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(updated, items2, true) });
  }catch(err){
    try{ if(conn) await conn.rollback(); }catch(e){}
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    next(err);
  }
};

    const order = oRows[0];

    if(order.status === 'refunded'){

exports.fullDashboard = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const SUC = "status IN ('paid','processing','shipped','delivered')";
    const today = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE DATE(created_at)=CURDATE() AND " + SUC);
    const week = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND " + SUC);
    const month = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND " + SUC);
    const year = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE YEAR(created_at)=YEAR(NOW()) AND " + SUC);
    const statusRows = await q('SELECT status, COUNT(*) c FROM orders GROUP BY status');
    const statusCounts = { pending:0, paid:0, processing:0, shipped:0, delivered:0, cancelled:0, refunded:0 };
    statusRows.forEach(r => { statusCounts[r.status] = r.c; });
    const usersRow = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM users WHERE role='user'");
    const prodRow = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(CASE WHEN stock=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) oos, SUM(CASE WHEN stock>0 AND stock<=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) low FROM products WHERE is_active=1");
    const revRow = await qOne('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE ' + SUC);
    const pendingRow = await qOne("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE status='pending'");
    const dailyRaw = await q("SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') d, COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND " + SUC + ' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,\'%Y-%m-%d\') ORDER BY d');
    const dailyMap = {};
    dailyRaw.forEach(r => { dailyMap[r.d] = { c: Number(r.c), s: Number(r.s) }; });
    const chartDaily = [];
    for(let i = 6; i >= 0; i--){
      const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      const key = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
      const row = dailyMap[key] || { c:0, s:0 };
      chartDaily.push({ date:key, orders: row.c, revenue: row.s });
    }
    const monthlyRaw = await q("SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') m, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND " + SUC + ' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,\'%Y-%m\') ORDER BY m');
    const monthlyMap = {};
    monthlyRaw.forEach(r => { monthlyMap[r.m] = Number(r.s); });
    const chartMonthly = [];
    for(let i = 5; i >= 0; i--){
      const d = new Date(); d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - i);
      const key = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0');
      chartMonthly.push({ month:key, revenue: monthlyMap[key] || 0 });
    }
    const bestSellers = await q('SELECT id, name, brand, sales, price, off, art, stock FROM products WHERE is_active=1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5');
    const latestOrders = await q('SELECT id, tracking_code, shipping_name, total_price, status, created_at FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 6');
    const alerts = [];
    if(Number(prodRow.oos) > 0) alerts.push({ type:'danger', icon:'box', text: prodRow.oos + ' محصول ناموجود شده است.' });
    if(Number(prodRow.low) > 0) alerts.push({ type:'warn', icon:'trend', text: prodRow.low + ' محصول موجودی کمتر از ۵ عدد دارد.' });
    if(statusCounts.pending > 0) alerts.push({ type:'info', icon:'cart', text: statusCounts.pending + ' سفارش در انتظار پرداخت است.' });
    if(statusCounts.refunded > 0) alerts.push({ type:'warn', icon:'ret', text: statusCounts.refunded + ' سفارش مرجوع شده است.' });
    res.json({
      success:true,
      today: { orders: Number(today.c), revenue: Number(today.s) },
      week: { orders: Number(week.c), revenue: Number(week.s) },
      month: { orders: Number(month.c), revenue: Number(month.s) },
      year: { orders: Number(year.c), revenue: Number(year.s) },
      statusCounts,
      users: Number(usersRow.c),
      products: { total: Number(prodRow.total) || 0, lowStock: Number(prodRow.low) || 0, outOfStock: Number(prodRow.oos) || 0 },
      revenue: Number(revRow.s),
      pendingAmount: Number(pendingRow.s),
      chartDaily, chartMonthly,
      bestSellers: bestSellers.map(p => {
        const fp = Math.round(p.price * (1 - p.off/100) / 1000) * 1000;
        return { id:p.id, name:p.name, brand:p.brand, art:p.art, sales: Number(p.sales) || 0, revenue: fp * (Number(p.sales)||0) };
      }),
      latestOrders: latestOrders.map(o => ({ id:o.id, trackingCode:o.tracking_code, customer:o.shipping_name, total: Number(o.total_price), status:o.status, createdAt:o.created_at })),
      alerts
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};
```

```js
  return String(s).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-').replace(/[^\w\u0600-\u06FF-]/g, '').slice(0, 200);

function parseJSON(v, fallback){
  if(v === null || v === undefined) return fallback;
  if(typeof v === 'object') return v;
  try{ return JSON.parse(v); }catch(e){ return fallback; }

    warranty: product.warranty || '',
    metaTitle: product.meta_title || '',
    metaDescription: product.meta_description || '',
    images: Array.isArray(images) ? images : [],
    features: Array.isArray(features) ? features : [],
    sizes: Array.isArray(sizes) ? sizes : [],
    colors,
    specs: specs.map(s => ({ key: s.spec_key, value: s.value })),
    finalPrice,
    inStock: Number(product.stock) > 0,
    isLowStock: Number(product.stock) > 0 && Number(product.stock) <= Number(product.min_stock || 3),
    category: cat ? { _id: cat.id, id: cat.id, name: cat.name, slug: cat.slug, color: cat.color, icon: cat.icon } : null,
    description: product.description || '',
    art: product.art || 'book'
  };
  if(forAdmin){
    base.purchasePrice = Number(product.purchase_price || 0);
    base.profit = Number(product.price) - Number(product.purchase_price || 0);
  }
  return base;
}

exports.list = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const isAdmin = canSeePurchase(req);
    const page = Math.max(1, Number(req.query.page) || 1);
    const limit = Math.min(1000, Math.max(1, Number(req.query.limit) || 12));
    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

    const where = [];
    const params = [];
    if(!isAdmin){
      where.push('p.is_active = 1');
    } else if(req.query.includeInactive !== 'true'){
      // admin by default sees only active, but can request all
      where.push('p.is_active = 1');
    }
    if(req.query.category){
      const cat = await qOne('SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = ?', [req.query.category]);
      if(cat){ where.push('p.category_id = ?'); params.push(cat.id); }
    }
    if(req.query.brand){ where.push('p.brand = ?'); params.push(req.query.brand); }
    if(req.query.q){
      where.push('(p.name LIKE ? OR p.brand LIKE ?)');
      const like = '%' + req.query.q + '%';
      params.push(like, like);
    }
    const minP = Number(req.query.minPrice);
    const maxP = Number(req.query.maxPrice);
    if(Number.isFinite(minP)){ where.push('p.price >= ?'); params.push(minP); }
    if(Number.isFinite(maxP)){ where.push('p.price <= ?'); params.push(maxP); }
    if(req.query.inStock === 'true') where.push('p.stock > 0');
    if(req.query.hasOff === 'true') where.push('p.off > 0');
    const minR = Number(req.query.minRating);
    if(Number.isFinite(minR)){ where.push('p.rating >= ?'); params.push(minR); }

    const whereSql = where.length ? 'WHERE ' + where.join(' AND ') : '';
    const sortMap = {
      sales: 'p.sales DESC', rate: 'p.rating DESC, p.num_reviews DESC',
      cheap: 'p.price ASC', exp: 'p.price DESC',
      off: 'p.off DESC', newest: 'p.created_at DESC'
    };
    const orderBy = sortMap[req.query.sort] || 'p.sales DESC';

    const sql = 'SELECT p.* FROM products p ' + whereSql + ' ORDER BY ' + orderBy + ' LIMIT ' + limit + ' OFFSET ' + offset;
    const rows = await q(sql, params);
    const totalRow = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products p ' + whereSql, params);
    const total = totalRow ? totalRow.c : 0;

    const items = await Promise.all(rows.map(r => hydrate(r, isAdmin)));
    res.json({
      success:true, items,
      pagination: { page, limit, total, pages: Math.ceil(total / limit) }
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.getOne = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const isAdmin = canSeePurchase(req);
    const key = req.params.id;
    const isId = /^\d+$/.test(key);
    const extra = isAdmin ? '' : ' AND is_active = 1';
    const product = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE ' + (isId ? 'id = ?' : 'slug = ?') + extra + ' LIMIT 1', [key]);
    if(!product){
      return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'محصول پیدا نشد.' });
    }
    const full = await hydrate(product, isAdmin);
    res.json({ success:true, product: full });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

async function resolveCategoryId(catOrSlug){
  if(!catOrSlug) return null;
  if(/^\d+$/.test(String(catOrSlug))) return Number(catOrSlug);
  const row = await qOne('SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = ?', [catOrSlug]);
  return row ? row.id : null;
}

function validateProduct(body){
  const e = {};
  if(body.price !== undefined){
    const p = Number(body.price);
    if(!Number.isFinite(p) || p < 0) e.price = 'قیمت باید عدد غیرمنفی باشد.';
  }
  if(body.purchasePrice !== undefined){
    const p = Number(body.purchasePrice);
    if(!Number.isFinite(p) || p < 0) e.purchasePrice = 'قیمت خرید نامعتبر است.';
  }
  if(body.stock !== undefined){
    const s = Number(body.stock);
    if(!Number.isFinite(s) || s < 0) e.stock = 'موجودی نامعتبر است.';
  }
  if(body.off !== undefined){
    const o = Number(body.off);
    if(!Number.isFinite(o) || o < 0 || o > 90) e.off = 'تخفیف باید بین ۰ تا ۹۰ باشد.';
  }
  return e;
}

async function saveRelated(pid, body){
  if(Array.isArray(body.colors)){
    await q('DELETE FROM product_colors WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
    for(const c of body.colors){
      if(c && c.name && c.hex) await insert('INSERT INTO product_colors (product_id, name, hex) VALUES (?,?,?)', [pid, c.name, c.hex]);
    }
  }
  if(Array.isArray(body.specs)){
    await q('DELETE FROM product_specs WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
    for(const s of body.specs){
      const k = s && (s.key || s.spec_key || (Array.isArray(s) ? s[0] : null));
      const v = s && (s.value || (Array.isArray(s) ? s[1] : null));
      if(k && v) await insert('INSERT INTO product_specs (product_id, spec_key, value) VALUES (?,?,?)', [pid, k, v]);
    }
  }
}

exports.create = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const b = req.body;
    const errors = validateProduct(b);
    if(Object.keys(errors).length) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message: Object.values(errors)[0], errors });
    const categoryId = await resolveCategoryId(b.category);
    /* چک یکتا بودن SKU */
    if(b.sku){
      const skuDup = await qOne('SELECT id FROM products WHERE sku = ? LIMIT 1', [b.sku]);
      if(skuDup) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این SKU قبلاً استفاده شده است.' });
    }
    if(!categoryId) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'دسته‌بندی پیدا نشد.' });
    const slug = slugify(b.name) + '-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);
    const sku = b.sku || ('SKU-' + Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase());
    const id = await insert(
      'INSERT INTO products (name, slug, sku, brand, category_id, price, purchase_price, off, stock, min_stock, weight, dimensions, art, description, short_description, images, video_url, features, sizes, warranty, meta_title, meta_description, is_active, created_by) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
      [b.name, slug, sku, b.brand, categoryId, Number(b.price)||0, Number(b.purchasePrice)||0, Number(b.off)||0, Number(b.stock)||0, Number(b.minStock)||3, Number(b.weight)||0, b.dimensions||'', b.art || 'book', b.description || '', b.shortDescription || '', JSON.stringify(b.images||[]), b.videoUrl||'', JSON.stringify(b.features||[]), JSON.stringify(b.sizes||[]), b.warranty||'', b.metaTitle||'', b.metaDescription||'', b.isActive === false ? 0 : 1, req.user.id]
    );
    await saveRelated(id, b);
    const product = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, product: await hydrate(product, true) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.update = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const b = req.body;
    const errors = validateProduct(b);
    if(Object.keys(errors).length) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message: Object.values(errors)[0], errors });
    const existing = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!existing) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'محصول پیدا نشد.' });
    /* چک یکتا بودن SKU (به‌جز خودش) */
    if(b.sku && b.sku !== existing.sku){
      const skuDupInUpdate = await qOne('SELECT id FROM products WHERE sku = ? AND id <> ? LIMIT 1', [b.sku, req.params.id]);
      if(skuDupInUpdate) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این SKU برای محصول دیگری استفاده شده است.' });
    }
    const fields = []; const vals = [];
    /* اگه name عوض شد، slug رو دوباره بساز */
    if(b.name !== undefined && String(b.name).trim() !== existing.name){
      fields.push('slug = ?');
      vals.push(slugify(b.name) + '-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4));
    }
    const map = { name:'name', sku:'sku', brand:'brand', price:'price', purchasePrice:'purchase_price', off:'off', minStock:'min_stock', weight:'weight', dimensions:'dimensions', art:'art', description:'description', shortDescription:'short_description', videoUrl:'video_url', warranty:'warranty', metaTitle:'meta_title', metaDescription:'meta_description' };
    Object.keys(map).forEach(function(k){ if(b[k] !== undefined && k !== 'name'){ fields.push(map[k] + ' = ?'); vals.push(b[k]); } });
    /* stock: فقط از طریق stockDelta (تا فروش‌های همزمان پاک نشن) */
    if(b.stockDelta !== undefined){
      const delta = Number(b.stockDelta);
      if(Number.isFinite(delta) && delta !== 0){
        fields.push('stock = GREATEST(0, stock + ?)');
        vals.push(delta);
      }
    } else if(b.stock !== undefined && existing.stock === 0){
      /* فقط اگه محصول قبلاً ۰ بود، مقدار مستقیم قبول کن (برای محصول جدید) */
      fields.push('stock = ?');
      vals.push(Number(b.stock) || 0);
    }
    if(b.isActive !== undefined){ fields.push('is_active = ?'); vals.push(b.isActive ? 1 : 0); }
    if(Array.isArray(b.images)){ fields.push('images = ?'); vals.push(JSON.stringify(b.images)); }
    if(Array.isArray(b.features)){ fields.push('features = ?'); vals.push(JSON.stringify(b.features)); }
    if(Array.isArray(b.sizes)){ fields.push('sizes = ?'); vals.push(JSON.stringify(b.sizes)); }
    if(b.category){ const cid = await resolveCategoryId(b.category); if(cid){ fields.push('category_id = ?'); vals.push(cid); } }
    if(fields.length){ vals.push(req.params.id); await q('UPDATE products SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals); }
    await saveRelated(req.params.id, b);
    const product = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, product: await hydrate(product, true) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.remove = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    await q('DELETE FROM products WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, message:'محصول حذف شد.' });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

    res.status(201).json({ success:true, product: await hydrate(product, true) });
```
