```js
/* ==============================================================
   gallery.js — multi-image gallery for product modals
   Works for #pmThumb (site) and .adm-pv-thumb (admin)
   ============================================================== */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.__GALLERY_LOADED__) return;
  window.__GALLERY_LOADED__ = true;

  function resolve(u){
    if(!u) return '';
    u = String(u);
    if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(u) || /^data:/i.test(u)) return u;
    return window.__ASSET__(u);
  }

  function getImages(product){
    if(!product) return [];
    var arr = product.images || product.imgs || [];
    if(!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];
    return arr.filter(function(x){ return x && typeof x === 'string'; });
  }

  /* ---- build gallery HTML ---- */
  function buildGallery(images, opts){
    opts = opts || {};
    if(!images.length) return null;

    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'gal-wrap';

    var stage = document.createElement('div');
    stage.className = 'gal-stage';

    var img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'gal-main';
    img.src = resolve(images[0]);
    img.alt = opts.alt || '';
    img.setAttribute('data-index', '0');
    stage.appendChild(img);

    /* prev / next */
    if(images.length > 1){
      var prev = document.createElement('button');
      prev.type = 'button';
      prev.className = 'gal-nav gal-prev';
      prev.setAttribute('aria-label', 'قبلی');
      prev.innerHTML = '<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15 6l-6 6 6 6"/></svg>';
      stage.appendChild(prev);

      var next = document.createElement('button');
      next.type = 'button';
      next.className = 'gal-nav gal-next';
      next.setAttribute('aria-label', 'بعدی');
      next.innerHTML = '<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>';
      stage.appendChild(next);

      var counter = document.createElement('span');
      counter.className = 'gal-counter';
      counter.textContent = '۱ / ' + images.length.toLocaleString('fa-IR');
      stage.appendChild(counter);

      var ci = 0;
      function go(i){
        ci = (i + images.length) % images.length;
        img.src = resolve(images[ci]);
        counter.textContent = (ci + 1).toLocaleString('fa-IR') + ' / ' + images.length.toLocaleString('fa-IR');
        var thumbs = wrap.querySelectorAll('.gal-thumb');
        for(var k = 0; k < thumbs.length; k++){
          thumbs[k].classList.toggle('is-active', k === ci);
        }
      }

      prev.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go(ci - 1); });
      next.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go(ci + 1); });

      /* keyboard */
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
        if(!document.body.contains(wrap)) return;
        if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  go(ci + 1);
        if(e.key === 'ArrowRight') go(ci - 1);
      });

      /* swipe for mobile */
      var sx = 0, dx = 0;
      stage.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
        sx = e.touches[0].clientX;
      }, { passive: true });
      stage.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
        dx = e.touches[0].clientX - sx;
      }, { passive: true });
      stage.addEventListener('touchend', function(){
        if(Math.abs(dx) > 40){ go(dx > 0 ? ci + 1 : ci - 1); }
        dx = 0;
      });

      /* thumbnails */
      var thumbs = document.createElement('div');
      thumbs.className = 'gal-thumbs';
      images.forEach(function(u, i){
        var t = document.createElement('button');
        t.type = 'button';
        t.className = 'gal-thumb' + (i === 0 ? ' is-active' : '');
        t.setAttribute('aria-label', 'تصویر ' + (i + 1));
        var ti = document.createElement('img');
        ti.src = resolve(u);
        ti.alt = '';
        ti.loading = 'lazy';
        t.appendChild(ti);
        t.addEventListener('click', function(e){
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          go(i);
        });
        thumbs.appendChild(t);
      });

      wrap.appendChild(stage);
      wrap.appendChild(thumbs);
    } else {
      wrap.appendChild(stage);
    }

    return wrap;
  }

  /* ================================================================
     SITE — inject into #pmThumb when modal opens
     ================================================================ */
  function injectSite(){
    var thumb = document.getElementById('pmThumb');
    if(!thumb) return;
    if(thumb.querySelector('.gal-wrap')) return;

    var p = window.__curPmProduct;
    if(!p){
      /* try to read from any [data-id] in the modal */
      var idAttr = thumb.closest('[data-id]');
      if(idAttr && window.byId) p = window.byId[idAttr.getAttribute('data-id')];
    }
    if(!p) return;

    var imgs = getImages(p);
    if(!imgs.length) return;

    /* clear existing image/svg */
    var existing = thumb.querySelector('.thumb-img');
    if(existing) existing.style.display = 'none';
    var svg = thumb.querySelector('svg');
    if(svg) svg.style.display = 'none';

    /* make thumb a plain container */
    thumb.style.padding = '0';
    thumb.style.background = 'transparent';
    thumb.style.aspectRatio = '1';

    var gal = buildGallery(imgs, { alt: p.n || '' });
    if(gal){
      gal.style.borderRadius = 'inherit';
      thumb.appendChild(gal);
    }
  }

  /* ================================================================
     ADMIN — inject into .adm-pv-thumb in product view modal
     ================================================================ */
  function injectAdmin(){
    var thumb = document.querySelector('.adm-pv-thumb');
    if(!thumb) return;
    if(thumb.querySelector('.gal-wrap')) return;

    var p = window.__curPmAdminProduct;
    if(!p) return;

    var imgs = getImages(p);
    if(!imgs.length) return;

    /* hide any existing img/svg */
    var existing = thumb.querySelector('img');
    if(existing) existing.style.display = 'none';
    var svg = thumb.querySelector('svg');
    if(svg) svg.style.display = 'none';

    thumb.style.padding = '0';
    thumb.style.background = 'transparent';

    var gal = buildGallery(imgs, { alt: p.name || '' });
    if(gal){
      gal.style.borderRadius = 'inherit';
      thumb.appendChild(gal);
    }
  }

  /* ================================================================
     Observer — auto-detect modal open
     ================================================================ */
  function runAll(){
    injectSite();
    injectAdmin();
  }

  var observer = new MutationObserver(function(muts){
    var shouldRun = false;
    for(var i = 0; i < muts.length; i++){
      var m = muts[i];
      if(m.type === 'attributes' && m.target && m.target.id === 'pm'){
        shouldRun = true;
      }
      if(m.type === 'childList'){
        shouldRun = true;
      }
    }
    if(shouldRun){
      setTimeout(runAll, 60);
      setTimeout(runAll, 200);
      setTimeout(runAll, 500);
    }
  });

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
      setTimeout(runAll, 500);
    });
  } else {
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    setTimeout(runAll, 500);
  }

  window.__GALLERY_RUN__ = runAll;
  console.log('[gallery] ready');
})();
```

FILE: full-backup-2026-10-13T14-15-39\frontend\lazy.js
================================================================================
```js
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;

  var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(!e.isIntersecting) return;
      var img = e.target;
      if(img.dataset && img.dataset.src){
        img.src = img.dataset.src;
        delete img.dataset.src;
      }
      obs.unobserve(img);
    });
  }, { rootMargin: '200px' });

  function bind(){
    var list = document.querySelectorAll('img[data-src]');
    for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) obs.observe(list[i]);
  }

  window.__lazyBind = bind;

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bind);
  } else {
    bind();
  }

  /* MutationObserver فقط روی #grid و #offers با debounce */
  var debounceTimer = null;
  function scheduleBind(){
    if(debounceTimer) return;
    debounceTimer = setTimeout(function(){
      debounceTimer = null;
      bind();
    }, 300);
  }

  var mo = new MutationObserver(scheduleBind);
  var observed = new WeakSet();

  function observeTargets(){
    ['grid', 'offers', 'pmPanel', 'catTiles'].forEach(function(id){
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if(el && !observed.has(el)){
        observed.add(el);
        mo.observe(el, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      }
    });
  }

  /* تلاش اولیه + یک بار بعد از تأخیر کوتاه (برای زمانی که JS محتوا رو می‌سازه) */
  setTimeout(observeTargets, 500);
  setTimeout(observeTargets, 3000);
})();
```

```js
(function(){
  'use strict';

  var API = window.__API_BASE__ || '/api';

  /* هشدار: اگر hostname فرق داره، کوکی SameSite=Lax ممکنه ارسال نشه */
  try{
    var apiUrl = new URL(API, location.href);
    if(apiUrl.hostname !== location.hostname){
      console.warn("[login] hostname mismatch: page=" + location.hostname + " api=" + apiUrl.hostname + " — کوکی SameSite=Lax ممکنه ارسال نشه. از همون hostname استفاده کن.");
    }
  }catch(e){}

  var $ = function(s,r){ return (r||document).querySelector(s); };
  var $$ = function(s,r){ return Array.prototype.slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(s)); };

  var card = $('.auth-card');
  var form = $('#loginForm');
  var alertBox = $('#authAlert');
  var submitBtn = $('#authSubmit');

  function setAlert(msg, ok){
    if(!msg){ alertBox.hidden = true; return; }
    alertBox.hidden = false;
    alertBox.textContent = msg;
    alertBox.className = 'auth-alert' + (ok ? ' ok' : '');
  }

  function normPhone(v){
    return String(v || '')
      .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, function(d){ return '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d); })
      .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
  }

  function switchMode(mode){
    card.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    form.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    $$('.auth-tab').forEach(function(t){
      t.classList.toggle('is-active', t.dataset.tab === mode);
    });
    var label = $('.auth-submit-label');
    if(label) label.textContent = mode === 'signup' ? 'ساخت حساب' : 'ورود به حساب';
    var pw = $('#auPassword');
    if(pw) pw.setAttribute('autocomplete', mode === 'signup' ? 'new-password' : 'current-password');
    var pwS = $('#pwStrength');
    if(pwS) pwS.hidden = mode !== 'signup';
    setAlert('');
  }

  $$('.auth-tab').forEach(function(t){
    t.addEventListener('click', function(){ switchMode(t.dataset.tab); });
  });
  $$('[data-switch-to]').forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      switchMode(a.dataset.switchTo);
    });
  });

  $$('.auth-eye').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var inp = document.getElementById(b.dataset.eye);
      if(!inp) return;
      var on = inp.type === 'text';
      inp.type = on ? 'password' : 'text';
      b.classList.toggle('is-on', !on);
    });
  });

  var pwInput = $('#auPassword');
  if(pwInput){
    pwInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
      var v = pwInput.value;
      var bar = $('#pwStrength .auth-pw-bar i');
      var lbl = $('#pwStrength .auth-pw-lbl');
      if(!bar) return;
      var s = 0;
      if(v.length >= 8) s++;
      if(v.length >= 12) s++;
      if(/[A-Z]/.test(v) || /[آ-ی]/.test(v)) s++;
      if(/\d/.test(v)) s++;
      if(/[^A-Za-z0-9آ-ی]/.test(v)) s++;
      var pct = Math.min(100, (s/5)*100);
      bar.style.width = pct + '%';
      bar.style.background = s <= 1 ? '#b91c4a' : (s <= 3 ? '#d97706' : '#0e7c5f');
      lbl.textContent = s <= 1 ? 'ضعیف' : (s <= 3 ? 'متوسط' : (s >= 5 ? 'بسیار قوی' : 'قوی'));
    });
  }

  var otpBtn = $('#otpBtn');
  if(otpBtn){
    otpBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      setAlert('ورود با کد یکبار مصرف به زودی فعال می‌شود. لطفاً از رمز عبور استفاده کنید.');
    });
  }

  var forgotLink = $('#forgotLink');
  if(forgotLink){
    forgotLink.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      setAlert('برای بازیابی رمز، با پشتیبانی تماس بگیرید.');
    });
  }

  var phoneInput = $('#auPhone');
  if(phoneInput){
    phoneInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
      var v = normPhone(phoneInput.value);
      if(v.length > 11) v = v.slice(0, 11);
      phoneInput.value = v;
    });
  }

  form.addEventListener('submit', async function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    setAlert('');
    var mode = form.getAttribute('data-mode') || 'login';
    var phone = normPhone($('#auPhone').value);
    var password = $('#auPassword').value;

    if(!/^09\d{9}$/.test(phone)){
      setAlert('شمارهٔ موبایل باید با ۰۹ شروع شود و ۱۱ رقم باشد.');
      $('#auPhone').focus();
      return;
    }

    if(mode === 'signup'){
      var name = $('#auName').value.trim();
      var confirm = $('#auConfirm').value;
      var terms = $('#auTerms').checked;

      if(name.length < 3){ setAlert('نام حداقل ۳ کاراکتر.'); $('#auName').focus(); return; }
      if(password.length < 8){ setAlert('رمز حداقل ۸ کاراکتر.'); $('#auPassword').focus(); return; }
      if(password !== confirm){ setAlert('رمز و تکرار یکسان نیست.'); $('#auConfirm').focus(); return; }
      if(!terms){ setAlert('پذیرش قوانین الزامی است.'); return; }

      submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.classList.add('is-loading');
      try{
        var r1 = await fetch(API + '/auth/register', {
          method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include',
          body: JSON.stringify({ name: name, phone: phone, password: password })
        });
        var d1 = await r1.json();
        if(!r1.ok) throw new Error(d1.message || 'ثبت‌نام ناموفق');
        setAlert('حساب ساخته شد! در حال انتقال...', true);
        setTimeout(function(){ var u=d.user||d.data&&d.data.user; var target=(u&&u.role==="admin")?"admin.html":"index.html"; window.location.href=target; }, 700);
      }catch(err){
        setAlert(err.message || 'خطا در ثبت‌نام');
      }finally{
        submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.classList.remove('is-loading');
      }
      return;
    }

    if(!password){ setAlert('رمز عبور الزامی است.'); $('#auPassword').focus(); return; }

    submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.classList.add('is-loading');
    try{
      var r = await fetch(API + '/auth/login', {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include',
        body: JSON.stringify({ phone: phone, password: password })
      });
      var d = await r.json();
      if(!r.ok) throw new Error(d.message || 'ورود ناموفق');
      setAlert('خوش آمدید! در حال انتقال...', true);
      setTimeout(function(){ var u=d.user||d.data&&d.data.user; var target=(u&&u.role==="admin")?"admin.html":"index.html"; window.location.href=target; }, 700);
    }catch(err){
      setAlert(err.message || 'شماره یا رمز اشتباه است.');
    }finally{
      submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.classList.remove('is-loading');
    }
  });

  var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  if(params.get('signup') === '1') switchMode('signup');
})();
```

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
/* ================================================================
   setup-seller-system.js
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   ۱) بکاپ کامل از کل سایت
   ۲) DB: اضافه کردن نقش seller

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const http = require('http');
const { spawn, spawnSync } = require('child_process');

const ROOT = process.cwd();
const BACKEND = path.join(ROOT, 'backend');
const PUBLIC = path.join(BACKEND, 'public');
const FRONTEND = path.join(ROOT, 'frontend');
const TIMESTAMP = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-').slice(0, 19);
const BACKUP_DIR = path.join(ROOT, 'full-backup-' + TIMESTAMP);
const TEST_PORT = 5099;

const C = { reset:'\x1b[0m', green:'\x1b[32m', red:'\x1b[31m', yellow:'\x1b[33m', cyan:'\x1b[36m', dim:'\x1b[2m', bold:'\x1b[1m', mag:'\x1b[35m' };
const ok = (s) => C.green + s + C.reset;
const err = (s) => C.red + s + C.reset;
const warn = (s) => C.yellow + s + C.reset;
const info = (s) => C.cyan + s + C.reset;
const dim = (s) => C.dim + s + C.reset;
const bold = (s) => C.bold + s + C.reset;
const mag = (s) => C.mag + s + C.reset;

/* ================================================================
   بکاپ
   ================================================================ */
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(['node_modules', '.git', '.vscode', '.idea', 'uploads', 'dist', 'build']);
function isBackupDir(name) {
  return name.startsWith('.') && (name.indexOf('backup') !== -1 || name.indexOf('-fix-') !== -1 || name.indexOf('patch') !== -1 || name.indexOf('recover') !== -1 || name.indexOf('upgrade') !== -1 || name.indexOf('setup') !== -1);
}
const EXTS = new Set(['.js','.json','.html','.css','.md','.txt','.sql','.env','.example','.yml','.yaml','.config','.xml']);
const SPECIAL = new Set(['.env','.env.example','.gitignore','package.json','package-lock.json','README.md']);
function shouldCopy(src) {
  if (fs.statSync(src).isDirectory()) return false;
  const ext = path.extname(src).toLowerCase();
  const name = path.basename(src);
  if (SPECIAL.has(name)) return true;
  return EXTS.has(ext);
}
function copyRecursive(src, dest, stats) {
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(src, { withFileTypes: true });
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const srcPath = path.join(src, entry.name);
    const destPath = path.join(dest, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      if (SKIP_DIRS.has(entry.name) || isBackupDir(entry.name)) continue;
      fs.mkdirSync(destPath, { recursive: true });
      copyRecursive(srcPath, destPath, stats);
    } else if (entry.isFile()) {
      if (!shouldCopy(srcPath)) continue;
      fs.copyFileSync(srcPath, destPath);
      stats.files++;
      stats.bytes += fs.statSync(srcPath).size;
    }
  }
}
function takeBackup() {
  console.log(bold('── ۱) بکاپ کامل ──'));
  fs.mkdirSync(BACKUP_DIR, { recursive: true });
  const stats = { files: 0, bytes: 0 };
  ['backend', 'frontend'].forEach(function(dir){
    const src = path.join(ROOT, dir);
    if (!fs.existsSync(src)) return;
    const dest = path.join(BACKUP_DIR, dir);
    fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true });
    copyRecursive(src, dest, stats);
  });
  fs.readdirSync(ROOT).filter(function(f){
    return fs.statSync(path.join(ROOT, f)).isFile() && shouldCopy(path.join(ROOT, f));
  }).forEach(function(f){
    fs.copyFileSync(path.join(ROOT, f), path.join(BACKUP_DIR, f));
    stats.files++;
    stats.bytes += fs.statSync(path.join(ROOT, f)).size;
  });
  console.log(ok('  ✅ ' + stats.files + ' فایل، ' + (stats.bytes/1024/1024).toFixed(2) + ' MB'));
  console.log(dim('     ' + path.relative(ROOT, BACKUP_DIR)));
  console.log('');
}

/* ================================================================
   DB: افزودن نقش seller
   ================================================================ */
function migrateDb() {
  console.log(bold('── ۲) DB Migration ──'));
  const script = [
    "require('dotenv').config();",
    "const { pool } = require('./db/init');",
    "(async () => {",
    "  try {",
    "    await pool.query(\"ALTER TABLE users MODIFY COLUMN role ENUM('user','seller','admin') DEFAULT 'user'\");",
    "    console.log('OK: role enum updated');",
    "    const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT role, COUNT(*) c FROM users GROUP BY role');",
    "    console.log('STATS=' + JSON.stringify(rows));",
    "  } catch(e) { console.log('ERR: ' + e.message); }",
    "  await pool.end();",
    "})();"
  ].join('\n');
  const tmp = path.join(BACKEND, '.tmp-migrate-role.js');
  fs.writeFileSync(tmp, script, 'utf8');
  try {
    const r = spawnSync('node', [tmp], { cwd: BACKEND, encoding: 'utf8' });
    const out = (r.stdout || '') + (r.stderr || '');
    if (out.indexOf('OK:') !== -1) {
      console.log(ok('  ✅ نقش seller به ENUM اضافه شد'));
    } else if (out.indexOf('ERR:') !== -1) {
      const m = out.match(/ERR: (.+)/);
      console.log(err('  ❌ ' + m[1]));
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  } finally {
    try { fs.unlinkSync(tmp); } catch(e){}
  }
}

/* ================================================================
   Middleware: sellerOnly
   ================================================================ */
function patchAuthMiddleware(fp) {
  const rel = path.relative(ROOT, fp);
  if (!fs.existsSync(fp)) { console.log(dim('  [skip] ' + rel)); return; }
  let c = fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf8');
  if (c.indexOf('sellerOnly') !== -1) { console.log(dim('  [skip] ' + rel + ' — قبلاً پچ شده')); return; }

  const marker = 'module.exports = { protect, adminOnly, optionalAuth };';
  if (c.indexOf(marker) !== -1) {
    const sellerFn = [
      'function sellerOrAdmin(req, res, next){',
      '  if(!req.user){',
      '    return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:\'وارد شوید.\' });',
      '  }',
      '  if(req.user.role !== \'seller\' && req.user.role !== \'admin\'){',
      '    return res.status(403).json({ success:false, message:\'فقط فروشندگان.\' });',
      '  }',
      '  next();',
      '}',
      '',
    ].join('\n');
    c = c.replace(marker, sellerFn + 'module.exports = { protect, adminOnly, optionalAuth, sellerOrAdmin };');
    fs.writeFileSync(fp, c, 'utf8');

    // ensure backup
    fs.mkdirSync(BACKUP_DIR, { recursive: true });
    const dest = path.join(BACKUP_DIR, rel);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), { recursive: true });
    // backup already taken
    console.log(ok('  ✅ ' + rel + ' → sellerOrAdmin اضافه شد'));
  }
}

const SELLER_CTRL = `'use strict';
const { q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');

/* داشبورد فروشنده */
exports.dashboard = async function(req, res, next){
  try{
    const uid = req.user.id;
    const prodCount = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE owner_id = ?', [uid]);
    const activeCount = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE owner_id = ? AND is_active = 1', [uid]);
    const lowStock = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE owner_id = ? AND stock > 0 AND stock <= 5', [uid]);
    const outStock = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE owner_id = ? AND stock = 0', [uid]);

    /* سفارش‌های مرتبط با محصولات این فروشنده */
    const ordCount = await qOne(
      'SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) c FROM orders o ' +
      'JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id ' +
      'JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id ' +
      'WHERE p.owner_id = ?', [uid]
    );

    /* درآمد کل از فروش محصولات فروشنده */
    const revRow = await qOne(
      'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.line_total),0) s FROM order_items oi ' +
      'JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id ' +
      'JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id ' +
      "WHERE p.owner_id = ? AND o.status IN ('paid','processing','shipped','delivered')",
      [uid]
    );

    /* آخرین سفارش‌ها */
    const latest = await q(
      'SELECT DISTINCT o.id, o.tracking_code, o.status, o.total_price, o.created_at, o.shipping_name ' +
      'FROM orders o ' +
      'JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id ' +
      'JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id ' +
      'WHERE p.owner_id = ? ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 5',
      [uid]
    );

    res.json({
      success: true,
      stats: {
        products: prodCount.c,
        activeProducts: activeCount.c,
        lowStock: lowStock.c,
        outOfStock: outStock.c,
        orders: ordCount.c,
        revenue: Number(revRow.s)
      },
      latestOrders: latest.map(function(o){
        return {
          id: o.id, trackingCode: o.tracking_code, status: o.status,
          total: Number(o.total_price), customer: o.shipping_name,
          createdAt: o.created_at
        };
      })
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* محصولات فروشنده */
exports.myProducts = async function(req, res, next){
  try{
    const uid = req.user.id;
    const page = Math.max(1, Number(req.query.page) || 1);
    const limit = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, Number(req.query.limit) || 50));
    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

    const where = ['p.owner_id = ?'];
    const params = [uid];
    if(req.query.q){
      where.push('(p.name LIKE ? OR p.brand LIKE ? OR p.sku LIKE ?)');
      const like = '%' + req.query.q + '%';
      params.push(like, like, like);
    }
    if(req.query.active === 'true') where.push('p.is_active = 1');
    if(req.query.active === 'false') where.push('p.is_active = 0');

    const whereSql = 'WHERE ' + where.join(' AND ');
    const rows = await q(
      'SELECT p.*, c.name as cat_name, c.color as cat_color FROM products p ' +
      'LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id ' +
      whereSql + ' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT ' + limit + ' OFFSET ' + offset,
      params
    );
    const total = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products p ' + whereSql, params);

    res.json({
      success: true,
      items: rows.map(function(p){
        const finalPrice = Math.round(p.price * (1 - (p.off || 0) / 100) / 1000) * 1000;
        return {
          id: p.id, name: p.name, brand: p.brand, sku: p.sku,
          price: Number(p.price), finalPrice: finalPrice,
          off: Number(p.off || 0), stock: Number(p.stock),
          sales: Number(p.sales), isActive: !!p.is_active,
          art: p.art || 'book',
          images: (function(v){ try{ return JSON.parse(v || '[]'); }catch(e){ return []; } })(p.images),
          category: p.cat_name ? { name: p.cat_name, color: p.cat_color } : null,
          createdAt: p.created_at
        };
      }),
      pagination: { page: page, limit: limit, total: total.c, pages: Math.ceil(total.c / limit) }
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* سفارش‌های فروشنده */
exports.myOrders = async function(req, res, next){
  try{
    const uid = req.user.id;
    const page = Math.max(1, Number(req.query.page) || 1);
    const limit = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, Number(req.query.limit) || 30));
    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

    const rows = await q(
      'SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM orders o ' +
      'JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id ' +
      'JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id ' +
      'WHERE p.owner_id = ? ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT ' + limit + ' OFFSET ' + offset,
      [uid]
    );
    const totalRow = await qOne(
      'SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) c FROM orders o ' +
      'JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id ' +
      'JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id ' +
      'WHERE p.owner_id = ?', [uid]
    );

    /* برای هر سفارش، فقط آیتم‌های فروشنده رو بگیر */
    const items = [];
    for(const o of rows){
      const its = await q(
        'SELECT oi.* FROM order_items oi ' +
        'JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id ' +
        'WHERE oi.order_id = ? AND p.owner_id = ?', [o.id, uid]
      );
      const sellerTotal = its.reduce(function(s, i){ return s + Number(i.line_total); }, 0);
      items.push({
        id: o.id, trackingCode: o.tracking_code, status: o.status,
        customer: o.shipping_name, customerPhone: o.shipping_phone,
        totalPrice: Number(o.total_price),
        sellerTotal: sellerTotal,
        itemsCount: its.length,
        createdAt: o.created_at,
        items: its.map(function(i){
          return {
            id: i.id, product: i.product_id, name: i.name, art: i.art,
            price: Number(i.price), qty: Number(i.qty), lineTotal: Number(i.line_total),
            color: i.color_name ? { name: i.color_name, hex: i.color_hex } : null
          };
        })
      });
    }

    res.json({
      success: true,
      orders: items,
      pagination: { page: page, limit: limit, total: totalRow.c, pages: Math.ceil(totalRow.c / limit) }
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* جزئیات یک سفارش (فقط آیتم‌های خود فروشنده) */
exports.orderDetail = async function(req, res, next){
  try{
    const uid = req.user.id;
    const o = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!o) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' });

    const its = await q(
      'SELECT oi.* FROM order_items oi ' +
      'JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id ' +
      'WHERE oi.order_id = ? AND p.owner_id = ?', [o.id, uid]
    );
    if(!its.length){
      return res.status(403).json({ success:false, message:'این سفارش شامل محصولات شما نیست.' });
    }

    const sellerTotal = its.reduce(function(s, i){ return s + Number(i.line_total); }, 0);
    res.json({
      success: true,
      order: {
        id: o.id, trackingCode: o.tracking_code, status: o.status,
        customer: o.shipping_name, customerPhone: o.shipping_phone,
        shippingAddress: {
          province: o.shipping_province, city: o.shipping_city,
          street: o.shipping_street, postalCode: o.shipping_postal
        },
        sellerTotal: sellerTotal,
        createdAt: o.created_at,
        items: its.map(function(i){
          return {
            id: i.id, product: i.product_id, name: i.name, art: i.art,
            price: Number(i.price), qty: Number(i.qty), lineTotal: Number(i.line_total),
            color: i.color_name ? { name: i.color_name, hex: i.color_hex } : null
          };
        })
      }
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};
`;

/* ================================================================
   server.js — mount /api/seller
   ================================================================ */
function patchServer(fp) {
  const rel = path.relative(ROOT, fp);
  if (!fs.existsSync(fp)) return;
  let c = fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf8');
  if (c.indexOf("'/api/seller'") !== -1) { console.log(dim('  [skip] ' + rel)); return; }

  const marker = "app.use('/api/cms',        cacheMiddleware(60000), require('./routes/cms'));";
  if (c.indexOf(marker) !== -1) {
    c = c.replace(marker, marker + "\napp.use('/api/seller',      require('./routes/seller'));");
    fs.writeFileSync(fp, c, 'utf8');
    console.log(ok('  ✅ server.js → /api/seller mount شد'));
  } else {
    console.log(warn('  ⚠️  ' + rel + ' — marker پیدا نشد'));
  }
}

const SELLER_JS_LINES = [
"(function(){",
"'use strict';",
"if(window.__SELLER_LOADED__) return;",
"window.__SELLER_LOADED__ = true;",
"",
"var API = (window.__API_BASE__ || '/api');",
"",
"/* ============== helpers ============== */",

"var fa = function(n){ try{ return Number(n||0).toLocaleString('fa-IR'); }catch(e){ return String(n||0); } };",
"var esc = function(s){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>\"']/g,function(c){ return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','\"':'&quot;',\"'\":'&#39;'}[c]; }); };",
"var store = {",
"  get: function(k,d){ try{ var v=localStorage.getItem(k); return v?JSON.parse(v):d; }catch(e){ return d; } },",
"  set: function(k,v){ try{ localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v)); }catch(e){} },",
"  del: function(k){ try{ localStorage.removeItem(k); }catch(e){} }",
"};",
"",
"/* ============== api ============== */",
"async function api(path, opts){",
"  opts = opts || {};",
"  var res = await fetch(API + path, Object.assign({",
"    credentials: 'include',",
"    headers: Object.assign({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, opts.headers || {})",
"  }, opts));",
"  var data = null;",
"  try{ data = await res.json(); }catch(e){ data = { success:false, message:'پاسخ نامعتبر' }; }",
"  if(res.status === 401){",
"    showBoot('نشست منقضی شد، در حال انتقال...');",
"    setTimeout(function(){ location.href = 'login.html'; }, 1200);",
"    throw new Error('unauth');",
"  }",
"  if(res.status === 403){",
"    toast('دسترسی ندارید.', 'err');",
"    throw new Error(data.message || 'forbidden');",
"  }",
"  if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || ('HTTP ' + res.status));",
"  return data;",
"}",
"var apiGet = function(p){ return api(p); };",
"",

/* ================================================================
   admin.js — پشتیبانی از نقش seller
   ================================================================ */
function patchAdminJs(fp) {
  const rel = path.relative(ROOT, fp);
  if (!fs.existsSync(fp)) return;
  let c = fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf8');
  const orig = c;

  /* در تغییر نقش، seller هم اضافه بشه */
  if (c.indexOf("role==='seller'") === -1 && c.indexOf("'seller'") === -1) {
    /* role change dialog */
    const roleMarker = 'const next = cur===\'admin\' ? \'user\' : \'admin\';';
    /* این رو دست نمیزنیم */
  }

  /* در نمایش لیست کاربران، نقش seller هم دیده بشه */
  if (c.indexOf('seller-role-badge') === -1 && c.indexOf('>فروشنده<') === -1) {
    /* چک میکنیم آیا بخش نمایش نقش هست */
    const roleMarker = "u.role==='admin'?'<span class=\"adm-bdg brand\">ادمین</span>':'<span class=\"adm-bdg\">کاربر</span>'";
    if (c.indexOf(roleMarker) !== -1) {
      c = c.replace(roleMarker,
        "u.role==='admin'?'<span class=\"adm-bdg brand\">ادمین</span>':(u.role==='seller'?'<span class=\"adm-bdg warn\">فروشنده</span>':'<span class=\"adm-bdg\">کاربر</span>')");
      console.log(ok('  ✅ ' + rel + ' → نمایش نقش فروشنده'));
    }
  }

  if (c !== orig) {
    const backupDir = path.join(BACKUP_DIR, rel);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(backupDir), { recursive: true });
    fs.copyFileSync(fp, backupDir);
    fs.writeFileSync(fp, c, 'utf8');
  } else {
    console.log(dim('  [skip] ' + rel));
  }
}

/* ================================================================
   app.js — لینک پنل فروشنده
   ================================================================ */
function patchAppJs(fp) {
  const rel = path.relative(ROOT, fp);
  if (!fs.existsSync(fp)) return;
  let c = fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf8');

  if (c.indexOf('seller-panel-item') !== -1) { console.log(dim('  [skip] ' + rel)); return; }

  /* اضافه کردن دکمه پنل فروشنده به user menu */
  const adminMarker = 'data-um="admin-panel"';
  if (c.indexOf(adminMarker) !== -1) {
    /* بعد از admin-panel، seller-panel اضافه کن */
    const sellerBtn = `\${state.user && state.user.role === "seller" ? '<button type="button" class="user-menu-item admin-panel-item" data-um="seller-panel" role="menuitem">' +
        '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">' +
          '<path d="M3 9l9-7 9 7v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z"/>' +
          '<path d="M9 22V12h6v10"/>' +
        '</svg>' +
        '<span>پنل فروشنده</span>' +
        '</button>' : ""}`;
    /* پیدا کردن اولین } بعد از admin-panel */
    const idx = c.indexOf(adminMarker);
    const closeIdx = c.indexOf('</button>', idx);
    const after = closeIdx + '</button>'.length;
    /* پیدا کردن `' : ""}` بعدی */
    const endIdx = c.indexOf("' : \"\"}", after);
    if (endIdx !== -1) {
      c = c.slice(0, endIdx + 8) + ' + ' + sellerBtn + c.slice(endIdx + 8);
    }

    /* مدیریت کلیک */
    const clickMarker = "if(um === 'admin-panel'){ window.location.href = 'admin.html'; return; }";
    if (c.indexOf(clickMarker) !== -1) {
      c = c.replace(clickMarker, clickMarker + "\n    if(um === 'seller-panel'){ window.location.href = 'seller.html'; return; }");
    }

    const backupDir = path.join(BACKUP_DIR, rel);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(backupDir), { recursive: true });
    fs.copyFileSync(fp, backupDir);
    fs.writeFileSync(fp, c, 'utf8');
    console.log(ok('  ✅ ' + rel + ' → لینک پنل فروشنده'));
  } else {
    console.log(dim('  [skip] ' + rel));
  }
}

/* ================================================================
   تست
   ================================================================ */
function startServer() {
  return new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
    var env = Object.assign({}, process.env, { PORT: String(TEST_PORT), NODE_ENV: 'development' });
    var proc = spawn('node', ['server.js'], { cwd: BACKEND, env: env, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
    var out = ''; var ready = false;
    var t = setTimeout(function(){
      if (!ready) { try { proc.kill('SIGKILL'); } catch (e) {} reject(new Error('timeout')); }
    }, 15000);
    proc.stdout.on('data', function(d){
      out += d.toString();
      if (!ready && /Running on port/i.test(out)) { ready = true; clearTimeout(t); setTimeout(function(){ resolve(proc); }, 500); }
    });
    proc.on('exit', function(){ if (!ready) { clearTimeout(t); reject(new Error('بست')); } });
  });
}
function stopServer(proc) {
  return new Promise(function(r){
    if (!proc) return r();
    proc.on('exit', r);
    try { proc.kill('SIGTERM'); } catch (e) { return r(); }
    setTimeout(function(){ try { proc.kill('SIGKILL'); } catch (e) {} r(); }, 2000);
  });
}
function fetchRaw(port, p) {
  return new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
    var r = http.request({ method:'GET', hostname:'127.0.0.1', port:port, path:p }, function(res){
      var body = '';
      res.on('data', function(c){ body += c; });
      res.on('end', function(){ resolve({ status: res.statusCode, body: body }); });
    });
    r.on('error', reject);
    r.setTimeout(6000, function(){ r.destroy(new Error('timeout')); });
    r.end();
  });
}
async function dynamicTests() {
  console.log('');
  console.log(bold('── تست ──'));
  var proc = null;
  try { proc = await startServer(); } catch (e) { console.log(err('  ❌ ' + e.message)); return; }
  try {
    var files = ['/seller.html', '/seller.js', '/admin.js', '/app.js'];
    for (var i=0; i<files.length; i++){
      var r = await fetchRaw(TEST_PORT, files[i]);
      console.log('  ' + (r.status === 200 ? '✅' : '❌') + ' ' + files[i] + '  [' + r.status + ']');
    }
    var sl = await fetchRaw(TEST_PORT, '/seller.html');
    console.log('  ' + (sl.body.indexOf('پنل فروشنده') !== -1 ? '✅' : '❌') + ' seller.html صحیح');

    var api = await fetchRaw(TEST_PORT, '/api/seller/dashboard');
    console.log('  ' + (api.status === 401 ? '✅' : '❌') + ' /api/seller/dashboard محافظت‌شده [' + api.status + ']');
  } finally {
    await stopServer(proc);
  }
}
```

```js
require('dotenv').config();
const express = require('express');
const cors = require('cors');
const helmet = require('helmet');
const compression = require('compression');
const morgan = require('morgan');
const cookieParser = require('cookie-parser');
const rateLimit = require('express-rate-limit');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');

const { initSchema } = require('./db/init');
const errorHandler = require('./middleware/error');
const { cacheMiddleware } = require('./utils/cache');

const app = express();
app.set('trust proxy', 1);

app.use(helmet({ crossOriginResourcePolicy:false }));
/* CORS — فقط originهای مجاز */
const ALLOWED_ORIGINS = (() => {
  const raw = process.env.CLIENT_URL || '';
  const list = raw.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (!list.length) {
    return [
      'http://localhost:5000',
      'http://127.0.0.1:5000',
      'http://localhost:8080',
      'http://127.0.0.1:8080',
      'http://localhost:3000',
      'http://127.0.0.1:3000',
      'http://localhost:5500',
      'http://127.0.0.1:5500',
    ];
  }
  return list;
})();

console.log('[CORS] allowed origins:', ALLOWED_ORIGINS.join(', '));

app.use(cors({
  origin: function(origin, callback){
    /* درخواست بدون Origin (curl، same-origin) → مجاز */
    if (!origin) return callback(null, true);
    /* origin در لیست مجاز؟ */
    if (ALLOWED_ORIGINS.indexOf(origin) !== -1) return callback(null, true);
    /* در حالت dev، هر localhost/127.0.0.1 */
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
      try {
        const u = new URL(origin);
        if (u.hostname === 'localhost' || u.hostname === '127.0.0.1') {
          return callback(null, true);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    /* غیرمجاز → بدون هدر CORS (مرورگر بلاک می‌کنه) */
    console.warn('[CORS] blocked origin:', origin);
    return callback(null, false);
  },
  credentials: true,
  methods: ['GET','POST','PUT','PATCH','DELETE','OPTIONS'],
  allowedHeaders: ['Content-Type','Authorization','X-Requested-With'],
  exposedHeaders: ['X-Cache'],
  maxAge: 86400
}));
app.use(express.json({ limit:'10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended:true }));
app.use(cookieParser());

if(process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') app.use(morgan('dev'));
/* Serve uploaded files */
app.use('/uploads', express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'uploads'), {
  maxAge: '7d',
  setHeaders: (res) => { res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*'); }
}));

const limiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs:15*60*1000, max:300,
  message:{ success:false, message:'تعداد درخواست‌ها زیاد است.' }
});
app.use('/api', limiter);

const authLimiter = rateLimit({

app.get('/', (req,res)=>res.json({ success:true, message:'Bazaarche API', version:'3.0.0' }));
app.get('/api/health', (req,res)=>res.json({ success:true, uptime:process.uptime() }));

if(fs.existsSync(pub)){

  app.get(/^\/(?!api).*/, (req,res)=>res.sendFile(path.join(pub, 'index.html')));
}

app.use((req,res)=>res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'مسیر پیدا نشد.' }));
app.use(errorHandler);


/* ================================================================
   Process-level safety nets
   ================================================================ */
process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason, promise) => {
  console.error('[FATAL] Unhandled Rejection at:', promise);
  console.error('[FATAL] Reason:', reason && reason.stack ? reason.stack : reason);
  /* در production بعد از log کردن، پروسه رو با کد خطا ببند تا مدیر پروسه (pm2/systemd) دوباره بالا بیاره */
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    setTimeout(() => process.exit(1), 100);
  }
});

process.on('uncaughtException', (err) => {
  console.error('[FATAL] Uncaught Exception:', err && err.stack ? err.stack : err);
  /* در production باید پروسه بسته بشه — نمی‌تونیم مطمئن باشیم state سالم می‌مونه */
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    setTimeout(() => process.exit(1), 100);
  }
});
```

```js
/* ================================================================
   check-db.js — چک وضعیت دیتابیس

async function run() {
  console.log('==============================================');

  console.log('==============================================');

  console.log('');

  let ok = true;

  /* اتصال */
  try {
    const [c] = await pool.query('SELECT 1');
    console.log('✅ اتصال به MySQL');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('❌ اتصال:', e.message);
    console.log('\n  ➜ چک کن .env درست باشه و MySQL روشن باشه');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  /* جدول‌ها */
  const tables = ['users', 'categories', 'products', 'product_colors', 'product_specs', 'orders', 'order_items', 'reviews', 'cms_pages', 'cms_banners', 'cms_sliders', 'site_features', 'site_festivals'];
  console.log('\n--- جدول‌ها ---');
  for (const t of tables) {
    try {
      const [r] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM ' + t);
      console.log('  ✅ ' + t.padEnd(20) + ' → ' + r[0].c + ' ردیف');
    } catch (e) {
      console.log('  ❌ ' + t.padEnd(20) + ' → ' + e.message);
      ok = false;
    }
  }

  /* محصولات فعال */
  console.log('\n--- محصولات ---');
  try {
    const [all] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products');
    const [active] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE is_active = 1');
    const [inactive] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE is_active = 0');
    console.log('  کل محصولات:     ' + all[0].c);
    console.log('  فعال:           ' + active[0].c);
    console.log('  غیرفعال:        ' + inactive[0].c);

    if (all[0].c === 0) {
      console.log('\n  ⚠️  هیچ محصولی توی DB نیست.');
      console.log('  ➜ اجرا کن: node utils/seed.js');
    } else if (active[0].c === 0) {
      console.log('\n  ⚠️  همه محصولات غیرفعالن.');
      console.log('  ➜ فعالشون کن: UPDATE products SET is_active = 1;');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('  ❌', e.message);
  }

  /* دسته‌ها */
  console.log('\n--- دسته‌بندی‌ها ---');
  try {
    const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT id, name, is_active FROM categories ORDER BY id LIMIT 10');
    if (!rows.length) {
      console.log('  ⚠️  هیچ دسته‌ای نیست → node utils/seed.js');
    } else {
      rows.forEach(r => console.log('  #' + r.id + ' ' + r.name + ' | active=' + r.is_active));
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('  ❌', e.message);
  }

  /* ادمین‌ها */
  console.log('\n--- ادمین‌ها ---');
  try {
    const [rows] = await pool.query("SELECT id, name, phone, email, is_active FROM users WHERE role='admin'");
    if (!rows.length) {
      console.log('  ⚠️  هیچ ادمینی نیست');
      console.log('  ➜ اجرا کن: node utils/make-admin.js "نام" 09123456789 "پسورد-قوی"');
    } else {
      rows.forEach(r => console.log('  #' + r.id + ' ' + r.name + ' | ' + r.phone + ' | ' + r.email + ' | active=' + r.is_active));
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('  ❌', e.message);

  console.log(ok ? '  ✅ همه جدول‌ها موجودن' : '  ⚠️  بعضی جدول‌ها مشکل دارن');
  console.log('==============================================\n');

  await pool.end();
}

run().catch(e => { console.error('FATAL:', e); process.exit(1); });
```

```js
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');
const { signAccess, signRefresh, setCookies, clearCookies, verifyRefresh } = require('../utils/token');

function payload(u){
  return {
    _id: u.id, id: u.id,
    name: u.name, phone: u.phone,
    role: u.role, avatar: u.avatar
  };
}

function normalizePhone(p){
  if(!p) return '';
  return String(p)
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, function(d){ return '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d); })
    .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
}

function bumpTokenVersion(userId){
  return q('UPDATE users SET token_version = COALESCE(token_version,0) + 1 WHERE id = ?', [userId]);
}

/* ============ ثبت‌نام — فقط شماره ============ */
exports.register = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { name, phone, password } = req.body;
    const cleanPhone = normalizePhone(phone);

    if(!name || String(name).trim().length < 3){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نام باید حداقل ۳ کاراکتر باشد.' });
    }
    if(!/^09\d{9}$/.test(cleanPhone)){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'شمارهٔ موبایل باید با ۰۹ شروع شود و ۱۱ رقم باشد.' });
    }
    if(!password || String(password).length < 8){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'رمز عبور حداقل ۸ کاراکتر باشد.' });
    }

    const dup = await qOne('SELECT id FROM users WHERE phone = ? LIMIT 1', [cleanPhone]);
    if(dup){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این شمارهٔ موبایل قبلاً ثبت شده است.' });
    }

    /* ایمیل پلیس‌هولدر یکتا */
    const placeholderEmail = 'u' + cleanPhone + '.' + Date.now().toString(36) + '@phone.local';
    const hash = await bcrypt.hash(password, 10);
    const id = await insert(
      'INSERT INTO users (name, email, phone, password) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [String(name).trim(), placeholderEmail, cleanPhone, hash]
    );
    const user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    const tv = 0;
    setCookies(res, signAccess(user.id, tv), signRefresh(user.id, tv));
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, user: payload(user) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* ============ ورود — فقط شماره ============ */
exports.login = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { phone, password } = req.body;
    const cleanPhone = normalizePhone(phone);

    if(!cleanPhone || !password){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'شماره و رمز عبور الزامی است.' });
    }

    const user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE phone = ? LIMIT 1', [cleanPhone]);
    if(!user){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'شماره یا رمز عبور اشتباه است.' });
    }
    const okPw = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.password);
    if(!okPw){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'شماره یا رمز عبور اشتباه است.' });
    }
    if(!user.is_active){
      return res.status(403).json({ success:false, message:'حساب شما غیرفعال شده است.' });
    }

    await q('UPDATE users SET last_login = NOW() WHERE id = ?', [user.id]);
    const tv = user.token_version || 0;
    setCookies(res, signAccess(user.id, tv), signRefresh(user.id, tv));
    res.json({ success:true, user: payload(user) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* ============ OTP — آماده برای آینده ============ */
exports.sendOtp = async (req, res) => {
  return res.status(503).json({ success:false, message:'ورود با کد یکبار مصرف به زودی فعال می‌شود.' });
};
exports.verifyOtp = async (req, res) => {
  return res.status(503).json({ success:false, message:'ورود با کد یکبار مصرف به زودی فعال می‌شود.' });
};

/* ============ بقیه ============ */
exports.logout = function(req, res){
  clearCookies(res);
  res.json({ success:true, message:'از حساب خارج شدید.' });
};

exports.refresh = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const token = req.cookies && req.cookies.refreshToken;
    if(!token) return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'توکن موجود نیست.' });
    const decoded = verifyRefresh(token);
    const user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ? AND is_active = 1', [decoded.id]);
    if(!user) return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'کاربر معتبر نیست.' });
    if(typeof decoded.tv === 'number' && decoded.tv !== (user.token_version || 0)){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'نشست باطل شده.' });
    }
    const access = signAccess(user.id, user.token_version || 0);
    res.cookie('accessToken', access, {
      httpOnly:true, sameSite:'lax',
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
      maxAge: 7*24*60*60*1000
    });
    res.json({ success:true });
  }catch(err){
    res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'توکن نامعتبر.' });
  }
};

exports.me = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const addresses = await q('SELECT * FROM addresses WHERE user_id = ?', [req.user.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, user: { ...req.user, addresses } });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.updateMe = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const fields = [];
    const vals = [];
    if(req.body.name !== undefined){
      const n = String(req.body.name).trim();
      if(n.length < 3 || n.length > 60) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نام باید بین ۳ تا ۶۰ کاراکتر.' });
      fields.push('name = ?'); vals.push(n);
    }
    if(req.body.avatar !== undefined){
      fields.push('avatar = ?'); vals.push(String(req.body.avatar || '').trim().slice(0, 500));
    }
    if(fields.length){
      vals.push(req.user.id);
      await q('UPDATE users SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals);
    }
    const user = await qOne('SELECT id, name, phone, role, avatar, is_active FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.user.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, user });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.changePassword = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { currentPassword, newPassword } = req.body;
    if(!currentPassword || !newPassword || newPassword.length < 8){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'رمز فعلی و جدید (حداقل ۸ کاراکتر) الزامی است.' });
    }
    if(currentPassword === newPassword){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'رمز جدید باید متفاوت باشد.' });
    }
    const user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.user.id]);
    const okPw = await bcrypt.compare(currentPassword, user.password);
    if(!okPw) return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'رمز فعلی اشتباه است.' });
    const hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 10);
    await q('UPDATE users SET password = ? WHERE id = ?', [hash, user.id]);
    await bumpTokenVersion(user.id);
    clearCookies(res);
    res.json({ success:true, message:'رمز تغییر کرد. دوباره وارد شوید.' });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.forgotPassword = async (req, res) => {
  return res.status(503).json({ success:false, message:'بازیابی رمز به زودی از طریق پیامک فعال می‌شود.' });
};
exports.resetPassword = async (req, res) => {
  return res.status(503).json({ success:false, message:'بازیابی رمز به زودی فعال می‌شود.' });
};
```

```js
const { q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');

function slugify(s){
  return String(s).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-').replace(/[^\w\u0600-\u06FF-]/g, '');
}

exports.list = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const where = req.query.all === 'true' ? '' : 'WHERE is_active = 1';
    const rows = await q('SELECT * FROM categories ' + where + ' ORDER BY order_num ASC, name ASC');
    const withCount = await Promise.all(rows.map(async c => {
      const cnt = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE category_id = ? AND is_active = 1', [c.id]);
      return {
        id: c.id, _id: c.id,
        name: c.name, slug: c.slug,
        icon: c.icon, color: c.color,
        image_url: c.image_url || null,
        order: c.order_num,
        isActive: !!c.is_active,
        productCount: cnt.c
      };
    }));
    res.json({ success:true, categories: withCount });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.create = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { name, icon, color, order, image_url } = req.body;
    if(!name) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نام الزامی است.' });
    const slug = slugify(name);
    const id = await insert(
      'INSERT INTO categories (name, slug, icon, color, order_num, image_url) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)',
      [name, slug, icon || 'book', color || '#3b82f6', Number(order) || 0, String(image_url || '').slice(0, 500)]
    );
    const cat = await qOne('SELECT * FROM categories WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, category: cat });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.update = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const b = req.body;
    const fields = [];
    const vals = [];
    if(b.name !== undefined){ fields.push('name = ?', 'slug = ?'); vals.push(b.name, slugify(b.name)); }
    if(b.icon !== undefined){ fields.push('icon = ?'); vals.push(b.icon); }
    if(b.color !== undefined){ fields.push('color = ?'); vals.push(b.color); }
    if(b.order !== undefined){ fields.push('order_num = ?'); vals.push(Number(b.order) || 0); }
    if(b.isActive !== undefined){ fields.push('is_active = ?'); vals.push(b.isActive ? 1 : 0); }
    if(b.image_url !== undefined){ fields.push('image_url = ?'); vals.push(String(b.image_url || '').slice(0, 500)); }
    if(fields.length){
      vals.push(req.params.id);
      await q('UPDATE categories SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals);
    }
    const cat = await qOne('SELECT * FROM categories WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!cat) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'دسته پیدا نشد.' });
    res.json({ success:true, category: cat });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.remove = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const cnt = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE category_id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(cnt.c > 0) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'ابتدا ' + cnt.c + ' محصول این دسته را منتقل یا حذف کنید.' });
    await q('DELETE FROM categories WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, message:'دسته حذف شد.' });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};
```

```js
function slugify(s){

    .slice(0, 110);

exports.pagesList = async (req, res, next) => {

    const isAdmin = !!(req.user && req.user.role === 'admin');
    const all = isAdmin && req.query.all === 'true';
    const where = all ? '' : ' WHERE is_published = 1';
    const rows = await q('SELECT * FROM cms_pages' + where + ' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC');
    res.json({ success:true, pages: rows });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }

exports.pagesGet = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const isAdmin = !!(req.user && req.user.role === 'admin');
    const extra = isAdmin ? '' : ' AND is_published = 1';
    const page = await qOne('SELECT * FROM cms_pages WHERE (slug = ? OR id = ?)' + extra + ' LIMIT 1', [req.params.slug, req.params.slug]);

    const id = await insert(
      'INSERT INTO cms_pages (slug,title,content,meta_title,meta_description,is_published,show_in_menu,sort_order) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
      [slug, b.title, b.content || '', b.meta_title || '', b.meta_description || '',
       b.is_published === false ? 0 : 1, b.show_in_menu ? 1 : 0, Number(b.sort_order) || 0]
    );
    const page = await qOne('SELECT * FROM cms_pages WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, page });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.pagesUpdate = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const b = req.body;
    const fields = [];
    const vals = [];
    ['title','content','meta_title','meta_description'].forEach(k => {
      if(b[k] !== undefined){ fields.push(k + ' = ?'); vals.push(b[k]); }
    });
    if(b.slug !== undefined){ fields.push('slug = ?'); vals.push(slugify(b.slug)); }
    if(b.is_published !== undefined){ fields.push('is_published = ?'); vals.push(b.is_published ? 1 : 0); }
    if(b.show_in_menu !== undefined){ fields.push('show_in_menu = ?'); vals.push(b.show_in_menu ? 1 : 0); }
    if(b.sort_order !== undefined){ fields.push('sort_order = ?'); vals.push(Number(b.sort_order) || 0); }
    if(fields.length){ vals.push(req.params.id); await q('UPDATE cms_pages SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals); }
```

```js
const { pool, q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');

const { FREE_THRESHOLD: FREE_SHIPPING, SHIPPING_COST } = require('../utils/shippingConstants');

function finalPrice(p){
  return Math.round(p.price * (1 - p.off/100) / 1000) * 1000;
}

async function getOrderItems(conn, orderId){
  const [rows] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [orderId]);
  return rows;
}

function buildOrder(order, items, forAdmin){
  const out = {
    id: order.id, _id: order.id,
    items: items.map(i => ({
      _id: i.id, product: i.product_id, name: i.name, art: i.art,
      color: i.color_name ? { name: i.color_name, hex: i.color_hex } : null,
      price: i.price, qty: i.qty, lineTotal: i.line_total
    })),
    shippingAddress: {
      name: order.shipping_name, phone: order.shipping_phone,
      province: order.shipping_province, city: order.shipping_city,
      street: order.shipping_street, postalCode: order.shipping_postal
    },
    itemsPrice: order.items_price,
    shippingPrice: order.shipping_price,
    totalPrice: order.total_price,
    paymentMethod: order.payment_method,
    trackingCode: order.tracking_code,
    status: order.status,
    paymentSimulated: !!order.payment_simulated,
    customerNote: order.note || '',
    createdAt: order.created_at
  };
  if(forAdmin){
    out.discountAmount = Number(order.discount || 0);
    out.tax = Number(order.tax || 0);
    out.internalNote = order.internal_note || '';
    out.shipmentTracking = order.shipment_tracking || null;
    out.shipmentCarrier = order.shipment_carrier || null;
    out.refundedAmount = Number(order.refunded_amount || 0);
    out.returnedAt = order.returned_at;
    out.returnReason = order.return_reason;
    out.refundedAt = order.refunded_at;
    out.refundNote = order.refund_note;
    out.stockRestored = !!order.stock_restored;
  }
  return out;
}

async function hydrateOrder(row, forAdmin){
  const items = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [row.id]);
  return buildOrder(row, items, forAdmin);
}

function isAdmin(req){ return req && req.user && req.user.role === 'admin'; }

/* ============ Create — with transaction ============ */
exports.create = async (req, res, next) => {
  let conn = null;
  let __released = false;
  try{
    conn = await pool.getConnection();
    const { items, shippingAddress, paymentMethod, note } = req.body;
    if(!Array.isArray(items) || !items.length){
      if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'سبد خرید خالی است.' });
    }
    if(!shippingAddress || !shippingAddress.name || !shippingAddress.city || !shippingAddress.street){
      if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'اطلاعات نشانی ناقص است.' });
    }
    const pm = paymentMethod === 'cod' ? 'cod' : 'online';

    // merge duplicate products
    const merged = {};
    for(const raw of items){
      const pid = Number(raw.product);
      const qty = Number(raw.qty);
      if(!Number.isInteger(pid) || pid <= 0) continue;
      if(!Number.isInteger(qty) || qty <= 0 || qty > 10){
        if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'تعداد کالا نامعتبر است.' });
      }
      /* کلید = product + color تا دو رنگ مختلف با هم ادغام نشن */
      const cname = (raw.color && raw.color.name) ? String(raw.color.name).trim() : '';
      const chex  = (raw.color && raw.color.hex)  ? String(raw.color.hex).trim()  : '';
      const key = pid + '::' + cname;
      if(!merged[key]){
        merged[key] = { product: pid, qty: 0, color: cname ? { name: cname, hex: chex } : null };
      }
      merged[key].qty += qty;
    }
    const list = Object.values(merged);
    if(!list.length){
      if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'سبد خرید خالی است.' });
    }

    await conn.beginTransaction();

    let itemsPrice = 0;
    const prepared = [];

    for(const it of list){
      const [rows] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ? AND is_active = 1 FOR UPDATE', [it.product]);
      const p = rows[0];
      if(!p){
        await conn.rollback();
        if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'کالای انتخاب‌شده در دسترس نیست.' });
      }
      if(p.stock < it.qty){
        await conn.rollback();
        if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'موجودی «' + p.name + '» کافی نیست.' });
      }
      const fp = finalPrice(p);
      const lineTotal = fp * it.qty;
      itemsPrice += lineTotal;
      let color = it.color;
      if(!color || !color.name){
        const [cs] = await conn.query('SELECT name, hex FROM product_colors WHERE product_id = ? LIMIT 1', [p.id]);
        if(cs[0]) color = { name: cs[0].name, hex: cs[0].hex };
      }
      prepared.push({
        product_id: p.id, name: p.name, art: p.art,
        color_name: color ? color.name : null,
        color_hex: color ? color.hex : null,
        price: fp, qty: it.qty, line_total: lineTotal
      });
    }

    const shippingPrice = itemsPrice >= FREE_SHIPPING ? 0 : SHIPPING_COST;
    const totalPrice = itemsPrice + shippingPrice;
    const trackCode = 'BZ-' + Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase() + '-' + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000);

    // online: pending until confirmed. cod: pending too.
    const status = 'pending';
    const paymentSimulated = pm === 'online' ? 1 : 0;

    const [orderRes] = await conn.query(
      'INSERT INTO orders (user_id, payment_method, items_price, shipping_price, total_price, status, tracking_code, note, shipping_name, shipping_phone, shipping_province, shipping_city, shipping_street, shipping_postal, payment_simulated) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
      [req.user.id, pm, itemsPrice, shippingPrice, totalPrice, status, trackCode, note || '', shippingAddress.name, shippingAddress.phone, shippingAddress.province || null, shippingAddress.city, shippingAddress.street, shippingAddress.postalCode || null, paymentSimulated]
    );
    const orderId = orderRes.insertId;

    for(const it of prepared){
      await conn.query(
        'INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, name, art, color_name, color_hex, price, qty, line_total) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
        [orderId, it.product_id, it.name, it.art, it.color_name, it.color_hex, it.price, it.qty, it.line_total]
      );
      await conn.query('UPDATE products SET stock = stock - ?, sales = sales + ? WHERE id = ?', [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
    }

    await conn.commit();
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }

    const order = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [orderId]);
    const items2 = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [orderId]);
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(order, items2, true) });
  }catch(err){
    try{ if(conn) await conn.rollback(); }catch(e){}
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    next(err);
  }
};

exports.confirmPayment = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const order = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?', [req.params.id, req.user.id]);
    if(!order) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' });
    if(order.status !== 'pending'){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این سفارش در وضعیت قابل پرداخت نیست.' });
    }
    if(order.payment_method !== 'online'){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این سفارش پرداخت آنلاین نیست.' });
    }
    await q("UPDATE orders SET status = 'paid', paid_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?", [order.id]);
    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    const items = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(updated, items, true) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }

/* ============ Cancel — with transaction ============ */
exports.cancel = async (req, res, next) => {
  let conn = null;
  let __released = false;
  try{
    conn = await pool.getConnection();
    await conn.beginTransaction();
    const [oRows] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE', [req.params.id]);
    const order = oRows[0];
    if(!order){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' });
    }
    if(order.user_id !== req.user.id && req.user.role !== 'admin'){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(403).json({ success:false, message:'دسترسی ندارید.' });
    }
    const isAdmin = req.user.role === 'admin';
    if(['shipped','delivered','cancelled','refunded'].includes(order.status)){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این سفارش قابل لغو نیست.' });
    }
    /* کاربر فقط می‌تونه سفارش pending رو لغو کنه (پرداخت‌نشده) */
    if(!isAdmin && order.status !== 'pending'){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({
        success:false,
        message:'فقط سفارش در انتظار پرداخت قابل لغو است. برای لغو سفارش پرداخت‌شده با پشتیبانی تماس بگیرید.'
      });
    }
    if(order.stock_restored){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'موجودی این سفارش قبلاً برگشت داده شده.' });
    }
    await conn.query("UPDATE orders SET status = 'cancelled', stock_restored = 1 WHERE id = ?", [order.id]);
    const [items] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    for(const it of items){
      await conn.query('UPDATE products SET stock = stock + ?, sales = GREATEST(sales - ?, 0) WHERE id = ?', [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
    }
    await conn.commit();
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    const items2 = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(updated, items2, true) });
  }catch(err){
    try{ if(conn) await conn.rollback(); }catch(e){}
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    next(err);
  }
};

exports.listAll = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const page = Math.max(1, Number(req.query.page) || 1);
    const limit = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, Number(req.query.limit) || 30));
    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
    const where = []; const params = [];
    if(req.query.status){ where.push('o.status = ?'); params.push(req.query.status); }
    if(req.query.q){ where.push('(o.tracking_code LIKE ? OR o.shipment_tracking LIKE ?)'); const like = '%' + req.query.q + '%'; params.push(like, like); }
    if(req.query.customer){ where.push('(o.shipping_name LIKE ? OR o.shipping_phone LIKE ?)'); const like = '%' + req.query.customer + '%'; params.push(like, like); }
    if(req.query.from){ where.push('o.created_at >= ?'); params.push(req.query.from + ' 00:00:00'); }
    if(req.query.to){ where.push('o.created_at <= ?'); params.push(req.query.to + ' 23:59:59'); }
    const whereSql = where.length ? 'WHERE ' + where.join(' AND ') : '';
    const sql = 'SELECT o.*, u.name as user_name, u.email as user_email FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id ' + whereSql + ' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT ' + limit + ' OFFSET ' + offset;
    const rows = await q(sql, params);
    const totalRow = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM orders o ' + whereSql, params);
    const items = await Promise.all(rows.map(async r => {
      const its = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [r.id]);
      const built = buildOrder(r, its, true);
      built.user = { name: r.user_name, email: r.user_email };
      return built;
    }));
    res.json({ success:true, items, pagination: { page, limit, total: totalRow.c, pages: Math.ceil(totalRow.c / limit) } });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.updateStatus = async (req, res, next) => {
  let conn = null;
  let __released = false;
  try{
    conn = await pool.getConnection();
    const { status } = req.body;
    const allowed = ['pending','paid','processing','shipped','delivered','cancelled','refunded'];
    if(!allowed.includes(status)){
      if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'وضعیت نامعتبر است.' });
    }
    /* State machine — گذارهای مجاز */
    const TRANSITIONS = {
      pending:    ['paid','cancelled'],
      paid:       ['processing','shipped','cancelled','refunded'],
      processing: ['shipped','cancelled','refunded'],
      shipped:    ['delivered','refunded'],
      delivered:  ['refunded'],
      cancelled:  [],
      refunded:   [],
    };
    await conn.beginTransaction();
    const [oRows] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE', [req.params.id]);
    const order = oRows[0];
    if(!order){ await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} } return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' }); }

    /* چک گذار مجاز */
    if(status !== order.status){
      const allowedNext = TRANSITIONS[order.status] || [];
      if(allowedNext.indexOf(status) === -1){
        await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
        return res.status(400).json({
          success:false,
          message: 'گذار از «' + order.status + '» به «' + status + '» مجاز نیست.'
        });
      }
    }

    // if transitioning to cancelled and stock not yet restored, restore it
    if(status === 'cancelled' && !order.stock_restored && order.status !== 'cancelled'){
      const [items] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
      for(const it of items){
        await conn.query('UPDATE products SET stock = stock + ?, sales = GREATEST(sales - ?, 0) WHERE id = ?', [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
      }
      await conn.query('UPDATE orders SET stock_restored = 1 WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    }
    const fields = ['status = ?']; const vals = [status];
    if(status === 'delivered') fields.push('delivered_at = NOW()');
    if(status === 'paid' && !order.paid_at) fields.push('paid_at = NOW()');
    vals.push(order.id);
    await conn.query('UPDATE orders SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals);
    await conn.commit();
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    const items2 = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(updated, items2, true) });
  }catch(err){
    try{ if(conn) await conn.rollback(); }catch(e){}
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    next(err);
  }
};

/* ============ Admin: shipment ============ */
exports.updateShipment = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { shipmentTracking, shipmentCarrier } = req.body;
    const fields = []; const vals = [];
    if(shipmentTracking !== undefined){ fields.push('shipment_tracking = ?'); vals.push(shipmentTracking || null); }
    if(shipmentCarrier !== undefined){ fields.push('shipment_carrier = ?'); vals.push(shipmentCarrier || null); }
    if(shipmentTracking){
      const cur = await qOne('SELECT status FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
      if(cur && ['paid','processing'].includes(cur.status)){
        fields.push("status = 'shipped'");
      }
    }
    if(fields.length){ vals.push(req.params.id); await q('UPDATE orders SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals); }
    const order = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!order) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' });
    const items = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(order, items, true) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* ============ Refund — idempotent ============ */
exports.refund = async (req, res, next) => {
  let conn = null;
  let __released = false;
  try{
    conn = await pool.getConnection();
    const { amount, note } = req.body;
    await conn.beginTransaction();
    const [oRows] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE', [req.params.id]);
    const order = oRows[0];
    if(!order){ await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} } return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' }); }
    if(order.status === 'refunded'){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این سفارش قبلاً بازپرداخت شده.' });
    }
    /* فقط سفارش‌هایی که واقعاً پول گرفته‌ان قابل بازپرداخت هستن */
    if(['pending','cancelled'].includes(order.status)){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({
        success:false,
        message:'این سفارش پرداخت نشده — بازپرداخت مجاز نیست.'
      });
    }
    const amt = Math.max(0, Number(amount) || 0);
    if(amt <= 0){ await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} } return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'مبلغ بازپرداخت الزامی است.' }); }
    if(amt > Number(order.total_price)){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'مبلغ بازپرداخت از مبلغ سفارش بیشتر است.' });
    }
    // restore stock only if not already
    if(!order.stock_restored){
      const [items] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
      for(const it of items){
        await conn.query('UPDATE products SET stock = stock + ?, sales = GREATEST(sales - ?, 0) WHERE id = ?', [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
      }
    }
    await conn.query("UPDATE orders SET refunded_amount = ?, refund_note = ?, refunded_at = NOW(), status = 'refunded', stock_restored = 1 WHERE id = ?", [amt, String(note || '').slice(0, 2000), order.id]);
    await conn.commit();
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    const items2 = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(updated, items2, true) });
  }catch(err){
    try{ if(conn) await conn.rollback(); }catch(e){}
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    next(err);
  }
};

exports.markReturned = async (req, res, next) => {
  let conn = null;
  let __released = false;
  try{
    conn = await pool.getConnection();
    const { reason } = req.body;
    if(!reason || String(reason).trim().length < 3){
      if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'دلیل مرجوعی الزامی است.' });
    }
    await conn.beginTransaction();
    const [oRows] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE', [req.params.id]);
    const order = oRows[0];
    if(!order){ await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} } return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' }); }
    if(order.status === 'refunded'){
      await conn.rollback(); if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این سفارش قبلاً مرجوع/بازپرداخت شده.' });
    }
    if(!order.stock_restored){
      const [items] = await conn.query('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
      for(const it of items){
        await conn.query('UPDATE products SET stock = stock + ?, sales = GREATEST(sales - ?, 0) WHERE id = ?', [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
      }
    }
    await conn.query("UPDATE orders SET returned_at = NOW(), return_reason = ?, status = 'refunded', stock_restored = 1 WHERE id = ?", [String(reason).trim().slice(0, 2000), order.id]);
    await conn.commit();
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    const items2 = await q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: buildOrder(updated, items2, true) });
  }catch(err){
    try{ if(conn) await conn.rollback(); }catch(e){}
    if(!__released){ __released = true; try{ conn.release(); }catch(e){} }
    next(err);
  }
};
```
