exports.fullDashboard = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const SUC = "status IN ('paid','processing','shipped','delivered')";
    const today = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE DATE(created_at)=CURDATE() AND " + SUC);
    const week = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND " + SUC);
    const month = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND " + SUC);
    const year = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE YEAR(created_at)=YEAR(NOW()) AND " + SUC);
    const statusRows = await q('SELECT status, COUNT(*) c FROM orders GROUP BY status');
    const statusCounts = { pending:0, paid:0, processing:0, shipped:0, delivered:0, cancelled:0, refunded:0 };
    statusRows.forEach(r => { statusCounts[r.status] = r.c; });
    const usersRow = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM users WHERE role='user'");
    const prodRow = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(CASE WHEN stock=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) oos, SUM(CASE WHEN stock>0 AND stock<=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) low FROM products WHERE is_active=1");
    const revRow = await qOne('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE ' + SUC);
    const pendingRow = await qOne("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE status='pending'");
    const dailyRaw = await q("SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') d, COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND " + SUC + ' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,\'%Y-%m-%d\') ORDER BY d');
    const dailyMap = {};
    dailyRaw.forEach(r => { dailyMap[r.d] = { c: Number(r.c), s: Number(r.s) }; });
    const chartDaily = [];
    for(let i = 6; i >= 0; i--){
      const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      const key = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
      const row = dailyMap[key] || { c:0, s:0 };
      chartDaily.push({ date:key, orders: row.c, revenue: row.s });
    }
    const monthlyRaw = await q("SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') m, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND " + SUC + ' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,\'%Y-%m\') ORDER BY m');
    const monthlyMap = {};
    monthlyRaw.forEach(r => { monthlyMap[r.m] = Number(r.s); });
    const chartMonthly = [];
    for(let i = 5; i >= 0; i--){
      const d = new Date(); d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - i);
      const key = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0');
      chartMonthly.push({ month:key, revenue: monthlyMap[key] || 0 });
    }
    const bestSellers = await q('SELECT id, name, brand, sales, price, off, art, stock FROM products WHERE is_active=1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5');
    const latestOrders = await q('SELECT id, tracking_code, shipping_name, total_price, status, created_at FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 6');
    const alerts = [];
    if(Number(prodRow.oos) > 0) alerts.push({ type:'danger', icon:'box', text: prodRow.oos + ' محصول ناموجود شده است.' });
    if(Number(prodRow.low) > 0) alerts.push({ type:'warn', icon:'trend', text: prodRow.low + ' محصول موجودی کمتر از ۵ عدد دارد.' });
    if(statusCounts.pending > 0) alerts.push({ type:'info', icon:'cart', text: statusCounts.pending + ' سفارش در انتظار پرداخت است.' });
    if(statusCounts.refunded > 0) alerts.push({ type:'warn', icon:'ret', text: statusCounts.refunded + ' سفارش مرجوع شده است.' });
    res.json({
      success:true,
      today: { orders: Number(today.c), revenue: Number(today.s) },
      week: { orders: Number(week.c), revenue: Number(week.s) },
      month: { orders: Number(month.c), revenue: Number(month.s) },
      year: { orders: Number(year.c), revenue: Number(year.s) },
      statusCounts,
      users: Number(usersRow.c),
      products: { total: Number(prodRow.total) || 0, lowStock: Number(prodRow.low) || 0, outOfStock: Number(prodRow.oos) || 0 },
      revenue: Number(revRow.s),
      pendingAmount: Number(pendingRow.s),
      chartDaily, chartMonthly,
      bestSellers: bestSellers.map(p => {
        const fp = Math.round(p.price * (1 - p.off/100) / 1000) * 1000;
        return { id:p.id, name:p.name, brand:p.brand, art:p.art, sales: Number(p.sales) || 0, revenue: fp * (Number(p.sales)||0) };
      }),
      latestOrders: latestOrders.map(o => ({ id:o.id, trackingCode:o.tracking_code, customer:o.shipping_name, total: Number(o.total_price), status:o.status, createdAt:o.created_at })),
      alerts
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

const { q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');

function slugify(s){
  return String(s).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-').replace(/[^\w\u0600-\u06FF-]/g, '').slice(0, 200);
}

function parseJSON(v, fallback){
  if(v === null || v === undefined) return fallback;
  if(typeof v === 'object') return v;
  try{ return JSON.parse(v); }catch(e){ return fallback; }
}

function canSeePurchase(req){
  return req && req.user && req.user.role === 'admin';
}

async function hydrate(product, forAdmin){
  if(!product) return null;
  const colors = await q('SELECT name, hex FROM product_colors WHERE product_id = ?', [product.id]);
  const specs = await q('SELECT spec_key, value FROM product_specs WHERE product_id = ?', [product.id]);
  const finalPrice = Math.round(product.price * (1 - product.off/100) / 1000) * 1000;
  const cat = await qOne('SELECT id, name, slug, color, icon FROM categories WHERE id = ?', [product.category_id]);
  var owner = null;
  if (product.owner_id) {
    owner = await qOne('SELECT id, name, phone, email, avatar FROM users WHERE id = ?', [product.owner_id]);
  }
  const images = parseJSON(product.images, []);
  const features = parseJSON(product.features, []);
  const sizes = parseJSON(product.sizes, []);
  const base = {
    id: product.id, _id: product.id,
    name: product.name,
    slug: product.slug,
    brand: product.brand,
    price: Number(product.price),
    off: Number(product.off),
    rating: Number(product.rating),
    numReviews: Number(product.num_reviews),
    stock: Number(product.stock),
    minStock: Number(product.min_stock || 3),
    sales: Number(product.sales),
    weight: Number(product.weight || 0),
    isActive: !!product.is_active,
    sku: product.sku || '',
    shortDescription: product.short_description || '',
    videoUrl: product.video_url || '',
    dimensions: product.dimensions || '',
    warranty: product.warranty || '',
    metaTitle: product.meta_title || '',
    metaDescription: product.meta_description || '',
    images: Array.isArray(images) ? images : [],
    features: Array.isArray(features) ? features : [],
    sizes: Array.isArray(sizes) ? sizes : [],
    colors,
    specs: specs.map(s => ({ key: s.spec_key, value: s.value })),
    finalPrice,
    inStock: Number(product.stock) > 0,
    isLowStock: Number(product.stock) > 0 && Number(product.stock) <= Number(product.min_stock || 3),
    category: cat ? { _id: cat.id, id: cat.id, name: cat.name, slug: cat.slug, color: cat.color, icon: cat.icon } : null,
    owner: owner ? { id: owner.id, name: owner.name, phone: owner.phone, email: owner.email, avatar: owner.avatar } : null,
    ownerId: product.owner_id || null,
    description: product.description || '',
    art: product.art || 'book'
  };
  if(forAdmin){
    base.purchasePrice = Number(product.purchase_price || 0);
    base.profit = Number(product.price) - Number(product.purchase_price || 0);
  }
  return base;
}

exports.list = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const isAdmin = canSeePurchase(req);
    const page = Math.max(1, Number(req.query.page) || 1);
    const limit = Math.min(1000, Math.max(1, Number(req.query.limit) || 12));
    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

    const where = [];
    const params = [];
    if(!isAdmin){
      where.push('p.is_active = 1');
    } else if(req.query.includeInactive !== 'true'){
      // admin by default sees only active, but can request all
      where.push('p.is_active = 1');
    }
    if(req.query.category){
      const cat = await qOne('SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = ?', [req.query.category]);
      if(cat){ where.push('p.category_id = ?'); params.push(cat.id); }
    }
    if(req.query.brand){ where.push('p.brand = ?'); params.push(req.query.brand); }
    if(req.query.q){
      where.push('(p.name LIKE ? OR p.brand LIKE ?)');
      const like = '%' + req.query.q + '%';
      params.push(like, like);
    }
    const minP = Number(req.query.minPrice);
    const maxP = Number(req.query.maxPrice);
    if(Number.isFinite(minP)){ where.push('p.price >= ?'); params.push(minP); }
    if(Number.isFinite(maxP)){ where.push('p.price <= ?'); params.push(maxP); }
    if(req.query.inStock === 'true') where.push('p.stock > 0');
    if(req.query.hasOff === 'true') where.push('p.off > 0');
    const minR = Number(req.query.minRating);
    if(Number.isFinite(minR)){ where.push('p.rating >= ?'); params.push(minR); }

    const whereSql = where.length ? 'WHERE ' + where.join(' AND ') : '';
    const sortMap = {
      sales: 'p.sales DESC', rate: 'p.rating DESC, p.num_reviews DESC',
      cheap: 'p.price ASC', exp: 'p.price DESC',
      off: 'p.off DESC', newest: 'p.created_at DESC'
    };
    const orderBy = sortMap[req.query.sort] || 'p.sales DESC';

    const sql = 'SELECT p.* FROM products p ' + whereSql + ' ORDER BY ' + orderBy + ' LIMIT ' + limit + ' OFFSET ' + offset;
    const rows = await q(sql, params);
    const totalRow = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products p ' + whereSql, params);
    const total = totalRow ? totalRow.c : 0;

    const items = await Promise.all(rows.map(r => hydrate(r, isAdmin)));
    res.json({
      success:true, items,
      pagination: { page, limit, total, pages: Math.ceil(total / limit) }
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.getOne = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const isAdmin = canSeePurchase(req);
    const key = req.params.id;
    const isId = /^\d+$/.test(key);
    const extra = isAdmin ? '' : ' AND is_active = 1';
    const product = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE ' + (isId ? 'id = ?' : 'slug = ?') + extra + ' LIMIT 1', [key]);
    if(!product){
      return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'محصول پیدا نشد.' });
    }
    const full = await hydrate(product, isAdmin);
    res.json({ success:true, product: full });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

async function resolveCategoryId(catOrSlug){
  if(!catOrSlug) return null;
  if(/^\d+$/.test(String(catOrSlug))) return Number(catOrSlug);
  const row = await qOne('SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = ?', [catOrSlug]);
  return row ? row.id : null;
}

function validateProduct(body){
  const e = {};
  if(body.price !== undefined){
    const p = Number(body.price);
    if(!Number.isFinite(p) || p < 0) e.price = 'قیمت باید عدد غیرمنفی باشد.';
  }
  if(body.purchasePrice !== undefined){
    const p = Number(body.purchasePrice);
    if(!Number.isFinite(p) || p < 0) e.purchasePrice = 'قیمت خرید نامعتبر است.';
  }
  if(body.stock !== undefined){
    const s = Number(body.stock);
    if(!Number.isFinite(s) || s < 0) e.stock = 'موجودی نامعتبر است.';
  }
  if(body.off !== undefined){
    const o = Number(body.off);
    if(!Number.isFinite(o) || o < 0 || o > 90) e.off = 'تخفیف باید بین ۰ تا ۹۰ باشد.';
  }
  return e;
}

async function saveRelated(pid, body){
  if(Array.isArray(body.colors)){
    await q('DELETE FROM product_colors WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
    for(const c of body.colors){
      if(c && c.name && c.hex) await insert('INSERT INTO product_colors (product_id, name, hex) VALUES (?,?,?)', [pid, c.name, c.hex]);
    }
  }
  if(Array.isArray(body.specs)){
    await q('DELETE FROM product_specs WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
    for(const s of body.specs){
      const k = s && (s.key || s.spec_key || (Array.isArray(s) ? s[0] : null));
      const v = s && (s.value || (Array.isArray(s) ? s[1] : null));
      if(k && v) await insert('INSERT INTO product_specs (product_id, spec_key, value) VALUES (?,?,?)', [pid, k, v]);
    }
  }
}

exports.create = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const b = req.body;
    const errors = validateProduct(b);
    if(Object.keys(errors).length) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message: Object.values(errors)[0], errors });
    const categoryId = await resolveCategoryId(b.category);
    /* چک یکتا بودن SKU */
    if(b.sku){
      const skuDup = await qOne('SELECT id FROM products WHERE sku = ? LIMIT 1', [b.sku]);
      if(skuDup) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این SKU قبلاً استفاده شده است.' });
    }
    if(!categoryId) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'دسته‌بندی پیدا نشد.' });
    const slug = slugify(b.name) + '-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);
    const sku = b.sku || ('SKU-' + Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase());
    const id = await insert(
      'INSERT INTO products (name, slug, sku, brand, category_id, price, purchase_price, off, stock, min_stock, weight, dimensions, art, description, short_description, images, video_url, features, sizes, warranty, meta_title, meta_description, is_active, created_by, owner_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?, ?)',
      [b.name, slug, sku, b.brand, categoryId, Number(b.price)||0, Number(b.purchasePrice)||0, Number(b.off)||0, Number(b.stock)||0, Number(b.minStock)||3, Number(b.weight)||0, b.dimensions||'', b.art || 'book', b.description || '', b.shortDescription || '', JSON.stringify(b.images||[]), b.videoUrl||'', JSON.stringify(b.features||[]), JSON.stringify(b.sizes||[]), b.warranty||'', b.metaTitle||'', b.metaDescription||'', b.isActive === false ? 0 : 1, req.user.id, b.ownerId ? Number(b.ownerId) : null]
    );
    await saveRelated(id, b);
    const product = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, product: await hydrate(product, true) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.update = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const b = req.body;
    const errors = validateProduct(b);
    if(Object.keys(errors).length) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message: Object.values(errors)[0], errors });
    const existing = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!existing) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'محصول پیدا نشد.' });
    /* چک یکتا بودن SKU (به‌جز خودش) */
    if(b.sku && b.sku !== existing.sku){
      const skuDupInUpdate = await qOne('SELECT id FROM products WHERE sku = ? AND id <> ? LIMIT 1', [b.sku, req.params.id]);
      if(skuDupInUpdate) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این SKU برای محصول دیگری استفاده شده است.' });
    }
    const fields = []; const vals = [];
    /* اگه name عوض شد، slug رو دوباره بساز */
    if(b.name !== undefined && String(b.name).trim() !== existing.name){
      fields.push('slug = ?');
      vals.push(slugify(b.name) + '-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4));
    }
    const map = { name:'name', sku:'sku', brand:'brand', price:'price', purchasePrice:'purchase_price', off:'off', minStock:'min_stock', weight:'weight', dimensions:'dimensions', art:'art', description:'description', shortDescription:'short_description', videoUrl:'video_url', warranty:'warranty', metaTitle:'meta_title', metaDescription:'meta_description' };
    if(b.ownerId !== undefined){ fields.push('owner_id = ?'); vals.push(b.ownerId ? Number(b.ownerId) : null); }
    Object.keys(map).forEach(function(k){ if(b[k] !== undefined && k !== 'name'){ fields.push(map[k] + ' = ?'); vals.push(b[k]); } });
    /* stock: فقط از طریق stockDelta (تا فروش‌های همزمان پاک نشن) */
    if(b.stockDelta !== undefined){
      const delta = Number(b.stockDelta);
      if(Number.isFinite(delta) && delta !== 0){
        fields.push('stock = GREATEST(0, stock + ?)');
        vals.push(delta);
      }
    } else if(b.stock !== undefined && existing.stock === 0){
      /* فقط اگه محصول قبلاً ۰ بود، مقدار مستقیم قبول کن (برای محصول جدید) */
      fields.push('stock = ?');
      vals.push(Number(b.stock) || 0);
    }
    if(b.isActive !== undefined){ fields.push('is_active = ?'); vals.push(b.isActive ? 1 : 0); }
    if(Array.isArray(b.images)){ fields.push('images = ?'); vals.push(JSON.stringify(b.images)); }
    if(Array.isArray(b.features)){ fields.push('features = ?'); vals.push(JSON.stringify(b.features)); }
    if(Array.isArray(b.sizes)){ fields.push('sizes = ?'); vals.push(JSON.stringify(b.sizes)); }
    if(b.category){ const cid = await resolveCategoryId(b.category); if(cid){ fields.push('category_id = ?'); vals.push(cid); } }
    if(fields.length){ vals.push(req.params.id); await q('UPDATE products SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals); }
    await saveRelated(req.params.id, b);
    const product = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, product: await hydrate(product, true) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.remove = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    await q('DELETE FROM products WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, message:'محصول حذف شد.' });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

    );

    const specs = await q('SELECT spec_key, value FROM product_specs WHERE product_id = ?', [src.id]);
    for(const s of specs){ await insert('INSERT INTO product_specs (product_id, spec_key, value) VALUES (?,?,?)', [id, s.spec_key, s.value]); }
    const product = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, product: await hydrate(product, true) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

const { q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');

async function calcAverage(productId){
  const row = await qOne(
    'SELECT AVG(rating) avg, COUNT(*) cnt FROM reviews WHERE product_id = ? AND is_approved = 1',
    [productId]
  );
  const avg = row.avg ? Math.round(Number(row.avg) * 10) / 10 : 0;
  const cnt = row.cnt || 0;
  await q('UPDATE products SET rating = ?, num_reviews = ? WHERE id = ?', [avg, cnt, productId]);
}

exports.byProduct = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const rows = await q(
      'SELECT r.*, u.name as user_name, u.avatar as user_avatar FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.product_id = ? AND r.is_approved = 1 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC',
      [req.params.productId]
    );
    const reviews = rows.map(r => ({
      _id:r.id, id:r.id,
      rating:r.rating, comment:r.comment,
      user: { name:r.user_name, avatar:r.user_avatar },
      createdAt:r.created_at
    }));
    res.json({ success:true, reviews });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.create = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { rating, comment } = req.body;
    const productId = req.params.productId;

    const product = await qOne('SELECT id FROM products WHERE id = ?', [productId]);
    if(!product){
      return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'محصول پیدا نشد.' });
    }

    /* چک: کاربر باید این محصول رو خریده باشه */
    const purchased = await qOne(
      "SELECT oi.order_id FROM order_items oi " +
      "JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id " +
      "WHERE o.user_id = ? AND oi.product_id = ? AND o.status IN ('paid','processing','shipped','delivered') " +
      "LIMIT 1",
      [req.user.id, productId]
    );
    if(!purchased){
      return res.status(403).json({
        success:false,
        message:'فقط خریداران این محصول می‌توانند نظر ثبت کنند.'
      });
    }

    const existing = await qOne(
      'SELECT id FROM reviews WHERE user_id = ? AND product_id = ?',
      [req.user.id, productId]
    );
    if(existing){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'قبلاً برای این محصول نظر داده‌اید.' });
    }

    /* نظرات نیاز به تأیید ادمین دارن */
    const id = await insert(
      'INSERT INTO reviews (user_id, product_id, rating, comment, is_approved) VALUES (?,?,?,?,0)',
      [req.user.id, productId, Number(rating), comment]
    );
    /* rating محصول رو آپدیت نکن تا تأیید بشه */
    const review = await qOne('SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    res.status(201).json({
      success:true,
      review,
      message:'نظر شما ثبت شد و پس از تأیید مدیر نمایش داده می‌شود.'
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};;

exports.remove = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const review = await qOne('SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!review) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'نظر پیدا نشد.' });
    if(review.user_id !== req.user.id && req.user.role !== 'admin'){
      return res.status(403).json({ success:false, message:'دسترسی ندارید.' });
    }
    await q('DELETE FROM reviews WHERE id = ?', [review.id]);
    await calcAverage(review.product_id);
    res.json({ success:true, message:'نظر حذف شد.' });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.listAll = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    let where = ['1=1'];
    const params = [];
    if(req.query.approved === 'false') where.push('r.is_approved = 0');
    if(req.query.approved === 'true')  where.push('r.is_approved = 1');
    const rows = await q(
      'SELECT r.*, u.name user_name, u.email user_email, p.name product_name, p.slug product_slug FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE ' +
      where.join(' AND ') + ' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 200',
      params
    );
    const reviews = rows.map(r => ({
      _id:r.id, rating:r.rating, comment:r.comment,
      isApproved:!!r.is_approved, createdAt:r.created_at,
      user:{ name:r.user_name, email:r.user_email },
      product:{ name:r.product_name, slug:r.product_slug }
    }));
    res.json({ success:true, reviews });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.toggleApprove = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const r = await qOne('SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!r) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'نظر پیدا نشد.' });
    await q('UPDATE reviews SET is_approved = 1 - is_approved WHERE id = ?', [r.id]);
    await calcAverage(r.product_id);
    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE id = ?', [r.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, review: updated });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.settingsUpdate = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const body = req.body || {};
    const allowed = ['cat_section_title','cat_section_desc','shop_section_title','shop_section_desc','trust_section_visible'];
    const updates = [];
    for(const k of allowed){
      if(body[k] !== undefined){
        updates.push([k, String(body[k] || '').slice(0, 500)]);
      }
    }
    if(!updates.length){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'هیچ مقداری برای ذخیره نیست.' });
    }
    for(const [k, v] of updates){
      await q('INSERT INTO site_settings (\`key\`, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = VALUES(value)', [k, v]);
    }
    const rows = await q('SELECT \`key\`, value FROM site_settings');
    const settings = {};
    rows.forEach(r => { settings[r.key] = r.value; });
    res.json({ success:true, settings });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

const { q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');

function safeUser(u){
  if(!u) return null;
  return {
    id: u.id, _id: u.id,
    name: u.name,
    email: u.email,
    phone: u.phone,
    role: u.role,
    avatar: u.avatar || null,
    isActive: !!u.is_active,
    lastLogin: u.last_login,
    createdAt: u.created_at
  };
}

exports.list = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const page = Math.max(1, Number(req.query.page) || 1);
    const limit = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, Number(req.query.limit) || 20));
    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

    let where = ['1=1'];
    const params = [];
    if(req.query.q){
      where.push('(name LIKE ? OR email LIKE ? OR phone LIKE ?)');
      const like = '%' + req.query.q + '%';
      params.push(like, like, like);
    }
    if(req.query.role){ where.push('role = ?'); params.push(req.query.role); }
    if(req.query.active === 'true'){ where.push('is_active = 1'); }
    if(req.query.active === 'false'){ where.push('is_active = 0'); }

    const whereSql = 'WHERE ' + where.join(' AND ');
    const rows = await q(
      'SELECT id, name, email, phone, role, avatar, is_active, last_login, created_at FROM users ' + whereSql + ' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ' + limit + ' OFFSET ' + offset,
      params
    );
    const totalRow = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM users ' + whereSql, params);
    const total = totalRow ? totalRow.c : 0;

    const items = rows.map(safeUser);
    res.json({ success:true, items, pagination: { page, limit, total, pages: Math.ceil(total / limit) } });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* ============ جزئیات کامل کاربر ============ */
exports.getDetail = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const user = await qOne(
      'SELECT id, name, email, phone, role, avatar, is_active, last_login, created_at FROM users WHERE id = ?',
      [req.params.id]
    );
    if(!user){
      return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'کاربر پیدا نشد.' });
    }

    /* آمار سفارش‌ها */
    const stats = await qOne(
      "SELECT COUNT(*) total, " +
      "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('paid','processing','shipped','delivered') THEN total_price ELSE 0 END),0) spent, " +
      "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) cancelled, " +
      "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) pending " +
      'FROM orders WHERE user_id = ?',
      [user.id]
    );

    /* آدرس‌ها */
    const addresses = await q('SELECT * FROM addresses WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY is_default DESC, id DESC', [user.id]);

    /* ۱۰ سفارش آخر */
    const orders = await q(
      'SELECT id, tracking_code, total_price, status, created_at FROM orders WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10',
      [user.id]
    );

    /* تعداد نظرات */
    const reviewsCount = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM reviews WHERE user_id = ?', [user.id]);

    res.json({
      success: true,
      user: safeUser(user),
      stats: {
        ordersTotal: Number(stats.total) || 0,
        ordersPending: Number(stats.pending) || 0,
        ordersCancelled: Number(stats.cancelled) || 0,
        totalSpent: Number(stats.spent) || 0,
        reviews: Number(reviewsCount.c) || 0,
        addresses: addresses.length
      },
      addresses: addresses.map(a => ({
        id: a.id, title: a.title, province: a.province, city: a.city,
        street: a.street, postalCode: a.postal_code, phone: a.phone,
        isDefault: !!a.is_default
      })),
      orders: orders.map(o => ({
        id: o.id, trackingCode: o.tracking_code,
        total: Number(o.total_price), status: o.status, createdAt: o.created_at
      }))
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.update = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const b = req.body;
    const fields = [];
    const vals = [];
    ['name','avatar'].forEach(k => {
      if(b[k] !== undefined){ fields.push(k + ' = ?'); vals.push(String(b[k]).trim()); }
    });
    if(b.phone !== undefined){
      const p = String(b.phone).replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
      if(!/^09\d{9}$/.test(p)) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'شمارهٔ موبایل نامعتبر است.' });
      fields.push('phone = ?'); vals.push(p);
    }
    if(b.isActive !== undefined){ fields.push('is_active = ?'); vals.push(b.isActive ? 1 : 0); }
    if(fields.length){
      vals.push(req.params.id);
      await q('UPDATE users SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals);
    }
    const user = await qOne('SELECT id, name, email, phone, role, avatar, is_active FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!user) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'کاربر پیدا نشد.' });
    res.json({ success:true, user: safeUser(user) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.remove = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    if(String(req.params.id) === String(req.user.id)){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نمی‌توانید حساب خود را حذف کنید.' });
    }
    /* چک اگه آخرین ادمین هست */
    const target = await qOne('SELECT role FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(target && target.role === 'admin'){
      const adminsCount = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM users WHERE role='admin' AND is_active=1");
      if(adminsCount.c <= 1){
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نمی‌توانید آخرین ادمین را حذف کنید.' });
      }
    }
    /* چک اگه سفارش داره → نمی‌تونیم حذف کنیم، فقط غیرفعال */
    const ordersCount = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM orders WHERE user_id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(ordersCount.c > 0){
      await q('UPDATE users SET is_active = 0, token_version = COALESCE(token_version,0) + 1 WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
      return res.json({ success:true, message:'کاربر به دلیل داشتن سفارش غیرفعال شد (حذف نمی‌شود).' });
    }
    await q('DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, message:'کاربر حذف شد.' });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.toggleActive = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    if(String(req.params.id) === String(req.user.id)){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نمی‌توانید حساب خود را غیرفعال کنید.' });
    }
    const target = await qOne('SELECT role, is_active FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!target) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'کاربر پیدا نشد.' });
    if(target.role === 'admin' && target.is_active){
      const adminsCount = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM users WHERE role='admin' AND is_active=1");
      if(adminsCount.c <= 1){
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نمی‌توانید آخرین ادمین فعال را غیرفعال کنید.' });
      }
    }
    /* با غیرفعال کردن، توکن‌ها باطل می‌شن */
    await q('UPDATE users SET is_active = 1 - is_active, token_version = COALESCE(token_version,0) + 1 WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    const user = await qOne('SELECT id, is_active FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, user: { ...user, isActive: !!user.is_active } });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.changeRole = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { role } = req.body;
    if(!['user','admin'].includes(role)){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نقش نامعتبر است.' });
    }
    /* چک: نمی‌تونه نقش خودش رو عوض کنه */
    if(String(req.params.id) === String(req.user.id)){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نمی‌توانید نقش خودتان را تغییر دهید.' });
    }
    const target = await qOne('SELECT role FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!target) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'کاربر پیدا نشد.' });
    /* اگه داره ادمین رو کاربر می‌کنه */
    if(target.role === 'admin' && role === 'user'){
      const adminsCount = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM users WHERE role='admin' AND is_active=1");
      if(adminsCount.c <= 1){
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'نمی‌توانید آخرین ادمین را به کاربر تبدیل کنید.' });
      }
    }
    await q('UPDATE users SET role = ?, token_version = COALESCE(token_version,0) + 1 WHERE id = ?', [role, req.params.id]);
    const user = await qOne('SELECT id, role FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, user });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* ============ Addresses ============ */
exports.addAddress = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const b = req.body;
    if(b.isDefault) await q('UPDATE addresses SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = ?', [req.user.id]);
    await insert(
      'INSERT INTO addresses (user_id, title, province, city, street, postal_code, phone, is_default) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
      [req.user.id, b.title, b.province || null, b.city, b.street, b.postalCode || null, b.phone || null, b.isDefault ? 1 : 0]
    );
    const addresses = await q('SELECT * FROM addresses WHERE user_id = ?', [req.user.id]);
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, addresses });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.updateAddress = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const b = req.body;
    const existing = await qOne('SELECT id FROM addresses WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?', [req.params.addrId, req.user.id]);
    if(!existing) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'نشانی پیدا نشد.' });
    if(b.isDefault) await q('UPDATE addresses SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = ?', [req.user.id]);
    const fields = []; const vals = [];
    const map = { title:'title', province:'province', city:'city', street:'street', postalCode:'postal_code', phone:'phone' };
    Object.keys(map).forEach(k => { if(b[k] !== undefined){ fields.push(map[k] + ' = ?'); vals.push(b[k]); } });
    if(b.isDefault !== undefined){ fields.push('is_default = ?'); vals.push(b.isDefault ? 1 : 0); }
    if(fields.length){
      vals.push(req.params.addrId);
      await q('UPDATE addresses SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals);
    }
    const addresses = await q('SELECT * FROM addresses WHERE user_id = ?', [req.user.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, addresses });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.removeAddress = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    await q('DELETE FROM addresses WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?', [req.params.addrId, req.user.id]);
    const addresses = await q('SELECT * FROM addresses WHERE user_id = ?', [req.user.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, addresses });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* سازگاری با کد قدیمی */
exports.getOne = async (req, res, next) => {
  return exports.getDetail(req, res, next);
};

const mysql = require('mysql2/promise');

const pool = mysql.createPool({
  host:     process.env.DB_HOST || 'localhost',
  port:     Number(process.env.DB_PORT || 3306),
  user:     process.env.DB_USER,
  password: process.env.DB_PASS,
  database: process.env.DB_NAME,
  waitForConnections: true,
  connectionLimit: 10,
  queueLimit: 0,
  charset: 'utf8mb4_unicode_ci',
  timezone: 'Z',
  dateStrings: false
});

async function q(sql, params = []){
  const [rows] = await pool.execute(sql, params);
  return rows;
}
async function qOne(sql, params = []){
  const rows = await q(sql, params);
  return rows[0] || null;
}
async function insert(sql, params = []){
  const [result] = await pool.execute(sql, params);
  return result.insertId;
}

async function initSchema(){
  await pool.query(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
      id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
      name VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
      email VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
      phone VARCHAR(11) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
      password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
      role ENUM('user','admin') DEFAULT 'user',
      avatar VARCHAR(500),
      is_active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
      reset_token VARCHAR(255),
      reset_expire BIGINT,
      last_login TIMESTAMP NULL,
      created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
  `);

  await pool.query(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS addresses (
      id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
      user_id INT NOT NULL,
      title VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
      province VARCHAR(80),
      city VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
      street VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
      postal_code VARCHAR(20),
      phone VARCHAR(20),
      is_default TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
      INDEX idx_addr_user (user_id),
      FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
  `);

  await pool.query(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS categories (
      id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
      name VARCHAR(80) UNIQUE NOT NULL,

      color VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '#3b82f6',
      order_num INT DEFAULT 0,
      is_active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
      created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
  `);

  await pool.query(`

      INDEX idx_prod_brand (brand),
      FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id)
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
  `);

  await pool.query(`

  `);

  await pool.query(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_specs (
      id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
      product_id INT NOT NULL,
      spec_key VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
      value VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
      INDEX idx_spec_prod (product_id),
      FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
  `);

  await pool.query(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (

      INDEX idx_order_user (user_id),

      FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)

  `);

  await pool.query(`

  await pool.query(`

      created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      UNIQUE KEY uk_user_product (user_id, product_id),
      INDEX idx_rev_prod (product_id),
      FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
  `);

  await pool.query(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_settings (
      \`key\` VARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY,
      value TEXT,
      updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
  `);

  /* درج مقادیر پیش‌فرض */
  const defaults = [
    ['cat_section_title', 'خرید بر اساس دسته‌بندی'],

    ['shop_section_title', 'همه کالاها'],
    ['shop_section_desc', ''],

  ];
  for (const [k, v] of defaults) {
    await pool.query('INSERT IGNORE INTO site_settings (\`key\`, value) VALUES (?, ?)', [k, v]);
  }

  console.log('[DB] Schema ready');
}

```js
const { qOne } = require('../db/init');
const { verifyAccess } = require('../utils/token');

function extractToken(req){
  if(req.cookies && req.cookies.accessToken) return req.cookies.accessToken;
  const h = req.headers.authorization;
  if(h && h.startsWith('Bearer ')) return h.slice(7);
  return null;
}

async function protect(req, res, next){
  try{
    const token = extractToken(req);
    if(!token) return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'برای دسترسی باید وارد شوید.' });
    const decoded = verifyAccess(token);
    const user = await qOne('SELECT id, name, email, phone, role, avatar, is_active, token_version FROM users WHERE id = ?', [decoded.id]);
    if(!user || !user.is_active){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'حساب یافت نشد یا غیرفعال است.' });
    }
    // token_version check
    if(typeof decoded.tv === 'number' && decoded.tv !== (user.token_version || 0)){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'نشست شما باطل شده است. دوباره وارد شوید.' });
    }
    req.user = user;
    next();
  }catch(err){
    return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'توکن نامعتبر است.' });
  }
}

function adminOnly(req, res, next){
  if(!req.user || req.user.role !== 'admin'){
    return res.status(403).json({ success:false, message:'دسترسی فقط برای مدیران.' });
  }
  next();
}

async function optionalAuth(req, res, next){
  try{
    const token = extractToken(req);
    if(token){
      const decoded = verifyAccess(token);
      const user = await qOne('SELECT id, name, email, role, token_version FROM users WHERE id = ?', [decoded.id]);
      if(user && (typeof decoded.tv !== 'number' || decoded.tv === (user.token_version || 0))){
        req.user = user;
      }
    }
  }catch(e){ /* ignore */ }
  next();
}

module.exports = { protect, adminOnly, optionalAuth };
```

```js
function errorHandler(err, req, res, next){
  console.error('[Error]', err.message);
  const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
  if(err.code === 'ER_DUP_ENTRY'){
    return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این مقدار قبلاً استفاده شده است.' });
  }
  if(err.name === 'JsonWebTokenError'){
    return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'توکن نامعتبر است.' });
  }
  if(err.name === 'TokenExpiredError'){
    return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'توکن منقضی شده است.' });
  }
  if(err.code === 'ER_NO_REFERENCED_ROW_2'){
    return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'ارجاع نامعتبر — ابتدا وابستگی‌ها را حذف کنید.' });
  }
  if(err.code === 'ER_ROW_IS_REFERENCED_2'){
    return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این آیتم در جای دیگر استفاده می‌شود.' });
  }
  const status = err.statusCode || 500;
  const message = isProd && status === 500 ? 'خطای داخلی سرور' : (err.message || 'خطای داخلی سرور');
  res.status(status).json({
    success:false,
    message,
    ...(!isProd && { stack: err.stack })
  });
}
module.exports = errorHandler;
```

const { validationResult } = require('express-validator');

function validate(req, res, next){
  const errors = validationResult(req);
  if(!errors.isEmpty()){
    return res.status(400).json({
      success:false,
      message: errors.array()[0].msg,
      errors: errors.array()
    });
  }
  next();
}
module.exports = validate;

/* ================================================================
   admin-crop.js — v4 (بدون اجرای دوگانه، پیش‌نمایش قطعی)
   ================================================================ */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.__CROP_V4__) return;
  window.__CROP_V4__ = true;

  /* ============================================================
     بارگذاری Cropper
     ============================================================ */
  function loadCropper(cb){
    if(window.Cropper){ cb(null); return; }

    if(!document.querySelector('link[data-cropper-css]')){
      var css = document.createElement('link');
      css.rel = 'stylesheet';
      css.href = 'cropper.min.css';
      css.setAttribute('data-cropper-css', '1');
      document.head.appendChild(css);
    }

    var existing = document.querySelector('script[data-cropper-lib]');
    if(existing){
      var tries = 0;
      var iv = setInterval(function(){
        if(window.Cropper){ clearInterval(iv); cb(null); }
        else if(++tries > 60){ clearInterval(iv); cb(new Error('timeout')); }
      }, 100);
      return;
    }

    var s = document.createElement('script');
    s.src = 'cropper.min.js?v=' + Date.now();
    s.setAttribute('data-cropper-lib', '1');
    s.async = false;
    s.onload = function(){
      if(window.Cropper){ cb(null); return; }
      setTimeout(function(){
        cb(window.Cropper ? null : new Error('Cropper تعریف نشد'));
      }, 200);
    };
    s.onerror = function(){ cb(new Error('load error')); };
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     upload
     ============================================================ */
  function uploadFile(file, onProgress){
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
      var API = window.__API_BASE__ || window.__API_BASE || '/api';
      var fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('image', file);
      var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
      xhr.open('POST', API + '/upload/product-single', true);
      xhr.withCredentials = true;
      if(onProgress){
        xhr.upload.onprogress = function(e){
          if(e.lengthComputable) onProgress(Math.round(e.loaded / e.total * 100));
        };
      }
      xhr.onload = function(){
        var r;
        try{ r = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText || '{}'); }
        catch(e){ return reject(new Error('پاسخ نامعتبر')); }
        if(xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300 && r.success) resolve(r.url);
        else reject(new Error(r.message || ('HTTP ' + xhr.status)));
      };
      xhr.onerror = function(){ reject(new Error('خطای شبکه')); };
      xhr.send(fd);
    });
  }

  function msg(text, type){
    if(typeof window.toast === 'function'){
      try{ window.toast(text, type); return; }catch(e){}
    }
    var box = document.getElementById('toasts');
    if(!box) return;
    var el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'adm-toast ' + (type === 'err' ? 'err' : (type === 'warn' ? 'warn' : 'ok'));
    var m = document.createElement('div');
    m.className = 'adm-toast-msg';
    m.textContent = String(text);
    el.appendChild(m);
    box.appendChild(el);
    setTimeout(function(){ if(el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el); }, 3200);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     ساخت مودال
     ============================================================ */
  function buildModal(){
    var m = document.getElementById('__cropV4');
    if(m) return m;

    m = document.createElement('div');
    m.className = 'crv4-modal';
    m.id = '__cropV4';
    m.hidden = true;
    m.innerHTML = ''
      + '<div class="crv4-scrim"></div>'
      + '<div class="crv4-box">'
      +   '<div class="crv4-head">'
      +     '<h3 class="crv4-title">برش تصویر</h3>'
      +     '<span class="crv4-counter"></span>'
      +     '<button type="button" class="crv4-x">×</button>'
      +   '</div>'
      +   '<div class="crv4-body">'
      +     '<div class="crv4-hint"></div>'
      +     '<div class="crv4-stage"><img class="crv4-img" alt=""></div>'
      +     '<div class="crv4-tools">'
      +       '<button type="button" data-v4="rot-90">چرخش ۹۰°</button>'
      +       '<button type="button" data-v4="rot-180">چرخش ۱۸۰°</button>'
      +       '<button type="button" data-v4="flip-h">قرینه افقی</button>'
      +       '<button type="button" data-v4="flip-v">قرینه عمودی</button>'
      +       '<button type="button" data-v4="reset">بازنشانی</button>'
      +     '</div>'
      +   '</div>'
      +   '<div class="crv4-foot">'
      +     '<button type="button" class="crv4-btn crv4-btn-outline" data-v4-cancel>انصراف</button>'
      +     '<button type="button" class="crv4-btn crv4-btn-primary" data-v4-confirm>تأیید و افزودن</button>'
      +   '</div>'
      + '</div>';

    document.body.appendChild(m);
    return m;
  }

  /* ============================================================
     نمایش مودال کراپ
     ============================================================ */
  function showCrop(files, opts, onUploaded, onDone){
    opts = opts || {};
    var isCircle = opts.mode === 'circle';

    var modal = buildModal();
    var scrim = modal.querySelector('.crv4-scrim');
    var title = modal.querySelector('.crv4-title');
    var counter = modal.querySelector('.crv4-counter');
    var xBtn = modal.querySelector('.crv4-x');
    var hint = modal.querySelector('.crv4-hint');
    var stage = modal.querySelector('.crv4-stage');
    var img = modal.querySelector('.crv4-img');
    var confirmBtn = modal.querySelector('[data-v4-confirm]');
    var cancelBtn = modal.querySelector('[data-v4-cancel]');

    var idx = 0;
    var cropper = null;
    var originalUrl = null;

    /* ظاهر */
    if(isCircle){
      title.textContent = 'برش تصویر دایره‌ای';
      hint.textContent = 'کادر دایره‌ای را بکشید · با چرخ ماوس زوم کنید';
    } else {
      title.textContent = 'برش تصویر (۱:۱)';
      hint.textContent = 'کادر را بکشید · با چرخ ماوس زوم کنید';
    }
    stage.classList.toggle('is-circle', isCircle);

    function showCurrent(){
      if(idx >= files.length){ close(); return; }
      var f = files[idx];
      if(f.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024){
        msg('«' + f.name + '» بیش از ۱۰ مگابایت', 'warn');
        idx++;
        return showCurrent();
      }
      if(originalUrl){ URL.revokeObjectURL(originalUrl); originalUrl = null; }
      originalUrl = URL.createObjectURL(f);
      img.src = originalUrl;
      if(counter) counter.textContent = files.length > 1 ? (idx+1)+' / '+files.length : '';

      img.onload = function(){
        if(cropper){ try{ cropper.destroy(); }catch(e){} cropper = null; }
        cropper = new window.Cropper(img, {
          viewMode: 1,
          dragMode: 'move',
          autoCropArea: 0.9,
          aspectRatio: 1,
          background: false,
          responsive: true,
          guides: !isCircle,
          center: true,
          highlight: false,
          movable: true,
          zoomable: true,
          rotatable: true,
          scalable: true,
          cropBoxMovable: true,
          cropBoxResizable: true,
          toggleDragModeOnDblclick: false
        });
      };
      img.onerror = function(){ msg('خطای تصویر', 'err'); idx++; showCurrent(); };
    }

    function close(){
      modal.hidden = true;
      if(cropper){ try{ cropper.destroy(); }catch(e){} cropper = null; }
      if(originalUrl){ URL.revokeObjectURL(originalUrl); originalUrl = null; }
      idx = 0;
      files = [];
      document.documentElement.style.overflow = '';
    }

    function confirm(){
      if(!cropper) return;
      confirmBtn.disabled = true;
      confirmBtn.textContent = 'در حال پردازش...';

      var size = 800;
      var canvas;
      try{
        canvas = cropper.getCroppedCanvas({
          width: size, height: size,
          imageSmoothingEnabled: true,
          imageSmoothingQuality: 'high'
        });
      }catch(e){ canvas = null; }

      if(!canvas){
        confirmBtn.disabled = false;
        confirmBtn.textContent = 'تأیید و افزودن';
        msg('خطا در پردازش', 'err');
        return;
      }

      var out = canvas;
      if(isCircle){
        var c2 = document.createElement('canvas');
        c2.width = size; c2.height = size;
        var ctx = c2.getContext('2d');
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(size/2, size/2, size/2 - 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.clip();
        ctx.drawImage(canvas, 0, 0, size, size);
        ctx.restore();
        var grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(size/2, size/2, size/2 - 4, size/2, size/2, size/2);
        grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
        grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)');
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(size/2, size/2, size/2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        out = c2;
      }

      out.toBlob(function(blob){
        if(!blob){
          confirmBtn.disabled = false;
          confirmBtn.textContent = 'تأیید و افزودن';
          return;
        }
        var fname = (isCircle ? 'circle-' : 'crop-') + Date.now() + (isCircle ? '.png' : '.jpg');
        var ftype = isCircle ? 'image/png' : 'image/jpeg';
        var file = new File([blob], fname, { type: ftype });

        uploadFile(file).then(function(url){
          /* callback اصلی */
          if(onUploaded) onUploaded(url);
          msg(isCircle ? 'تصویر دایره‌ای اضافه شد.' : 'تصویر اضافه شد.', 'ok');
        }).catch(function(e){
          console.error('[crop-v4] upload error:', e);
          msg('خطا: ' + (e.message || 'نامشخص'), 'err');
        }).then(function(){
          idx++;
          confirmBtn.disabled = false;
          confirmBtn.textContent = 'تأیید و افزودن';
          if(idx < files.length) showCurrent();
          else { close(); if(onDone) onDone(); }
        });
      }, isCircle ? 'image/png' : 'image/jpeg', 0.92);
    }

    confirmBtn.onclick = confirm;
    cancelBtn.onclick = close;
    xBtn.onclick = close;
    scrim.onclick = close;

    modal.querySelectorAll('[data-v4]').forEach(function(b){
      b.onclick = function(){
        if(!cropper) return;
        var a = b.getAttribute('data-v4');
        if(a === 'rot-90') cropper.rotate(90);
        else if(a === 'rot-180') cropper.rotate(180);
        else if(a === 'flip-h'){ var d = cropper.getData(); cropper.scaleX(d.scaleX === -1 ? 1 : -1); }
        else if(a === 'flip-v'){ var d2 = cropper.getData(); cropper.scaleY(d2.scaleY === -1 ? 1 : -1); }
        else if(a === 'reset') cropper.reset();
      };
    });

    confirmBtn.disabled = false;
    confirmBtn.textContent = 'تأیید و افزودن';
    idx = 0;
    modal.hidden = false;
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    showCurrent();
  }

  /* ============================================================
     تابع عمومی
     ============================================================ */
  function startCrop(input, opts, onUploaded, onDone){
    /* جلوگیری از اجرای دوگانه */
    if(window.__CROP_V4_BUSY__) return;
    window.__CROP_V4_BUSY__ = true;
    setTimeout(function(){ window.__CROP_V4_BUSY__ = false; }, 800);

    var files = Array.prototype.slice.call(input.files || []);
    input.value = '';
    if(!files.length) return;

    console.log('[crop-v4] start, files=' + files.length + ', mode=' + (opts.mode || 'square'));

    loadCropper(function(loadErr){
      if(loadErr){
        console.error('[crop-v4] lib fail:', loadErr.message);
        msg('کتابخانه برش لود نشد — بدون برش آپلود میشه', 'warn');
        var i = 0;
        function next(){
          if(i >= files.length){ if(onDone) onDone(); return; }
          var f = files[i++];
          uploadFile(f).then(function(u){ if(onUploaded) onUploaded(u); }).catch(function(){}).then(next);
        }
        next();
        return;
      }
      showCrop(files, opts, onUploaded, onDone);
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     override دو تابع
     ============================================================ */

  /* برای picker دسته‌بندی (catImgPicker) */
  window.__pickAdmImg = function(input, imgFieldId, pickerId){
    var isCircle = (pickerId || '').indexOf('cat') !== -1 || imgFieldId === 'catImg';
    startCrop(input, { mode: isCircle ? 'circle' : 'square' },
      function(url){
        /* ذخیره در hidden input */
        var field = document.getElementById(imgFieldId);
        if(field) field.value = url;

        /* اعمال پیش‌نمایش روی picker */
        var picker = document.getElementById(pickerId);
        if(picker){
          var full = (window.__ASSET__ ? window.__ASSET__(url) : url);
          picker.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + full + '")';
          picker.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
          picker.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
          picker.style.backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat';
          picker.classList.add('has-image', 'cat-circle-picker');
          /* محتوای داخلی (empty state) رو پاک کن */
          var empty = picker.querySelector('.adm-img-picker-empty');
          if(empty) empty.remove();
          /* اگه innerHTML هنوز چیز دیگه داره، پاک کن */
          if(picker.innerHTML.indexOf('adm-img-picker-empty') === -1){
            picker.innerHTML = '';
          }
          console.log('[crop-v4] preview set on picker:', pickerId);
        } else {
          console.warn('[crop-v4] picker not found:', pickerId);
        }
      }
    );
  };

  /* برای فرم محصول */
  window.__handleProdImagePick = function(input, opts){
    opts = opts || { mode: 'square' };
    startCrop(input, opts,
      function(url){
        if(window.__activeProductF){
          if(!Array.isArray(window.__activeProductF.images)) window.__activeProductF.images = [];
          window.__activeProductF.images.push(url);
        }
        if(typeof window.__repaintProdImages === 'function') window.__repaintProdImages();
      }
    );
  };

  /* ============================================================
     فقط یک بار — picker click
     ============================================================ */
  /* picker interception removed — handled in renderCategories */

  console.log('[crop-v4] ready');
})();

/* ==============================================================

(function(){
  'use strict';

  if(window.__uploadModLoaded) return;
  window.__uploadModLoaded = true;

  /* ---- absolute URL helper ---- */
  function toAbs(u){ return window.__ASSET__ ? window.__ASSET__(u) : u; }

  /* ---- upload one file ---- */
  function uploadFile(file, onProgress){
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
      var API = window.__API_BASE__ || window.__API_BASE || '/api';
      var fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('image', file);
      var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
      xhr.open('POST', API + '/upload/product-single', true);
      xhr.withCredentials = true;
      if(onProgress){
        xhr.upload.onprogress = function(e){
          if(e.lengthComputable) onProgress(Math.round(e.loaded / e.total * 100));
        };
      }
      xhr.onload = function(){
        var r;
        try{ r = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText || '{}'); }
        catch(e){ return reject(new Error('پاسخ سرور نامعتبر است.')); }
        if(xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300 && r.success) resolve(r.url);
        else reject(new Error(r.message || ('HTTP ' + xhr.status)));
      };
      xhr.onerror = function(){ reject(new Error('خطای شبکه')); };
      xhr.send(fd);
    });
  }

  /* ---- repaint the image list ---- */
  function repaint(){
    var F = window.__activeProductF;
    var list = document.getElementById('imgList');
    if(!F || !list) return;
    list.textContent = '';
    var arr = Array.isArray(F.images) ? F.images : [];

    arr.forEach(function(url, idx){
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'adm-img-item';

      var thumb = document.createElement('div');
      thumb.className = 'adm-img-thumb';
      thumb.style.backgroundImage = 'url(' + JSON.stringify(window.__ASSET__(url)) + ')';

      var txt = document.createElement('div');
      txt.className = 'adm-img-url';
      txt.setAttribute('dir', 'ltr');
      txt.textContent = url;

      var del = document.createElement('button');
      del.type = 'button';
      del.className = 'adm-iconbtn-sm danger';
      del.setAttribute('aria-label', 'حذف تصویر');
      del.innerHTML = '<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg>';
      del.addEventListener('click', function(){
        F.images.splice(idx, 1);
        repaint();
      });

      row.appendChild(thumb);
      row.appendChild(txt);
      row.appendChild(del);
      list.appendChild(row);
    });
  }

  window.__repaintProdImages = repaint;

  /* ---- file picker handler ---- */
  window.__handleProdImagePick = async function(inputEl){
    var files = Array.prototype.slice.call(inputEl.files || []);
    inputEl.value = '';
    if(!files.length) return;

    var F = window.__activeProductF;
    if(!F){
      try{ window.toast ? toast('ابتدا فرم محصول را باز کنید.', 'warn') : alert('ابتدا فرم محصول را باز کنید.'); }
      catch(e){}
      return;
    }
    if(!Array.isArray(F.images)) F.images = [];

    var progressEl = document.getElementById('uploadProgress');
    var bar = progressEl ? progressEl.querySelector('.adm-upload-bar i') : null;
    var lbl = progressEl ? progressEl.querySelector('.adm-upload-lbl') : null;
    if(progressEl) progressEl.hidden = false;

    var done = 0, failed = 0;
    var total = files.length;

    for(var i = 0; i < files.length; i++){
      var f = files[i];
      if(f.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024){
        try{ toast('«' + f.name + '» بیش از ۵ مگابایت است.', 'warn'); }catch(e){}
        failed++;
        continue;
      }
      try{
        if(lbl) lbl.textContent = 'در حال آپلود ' + (done + 1) + ' از ' + total + '...';
        var url = await uploadFile(f, function(p){
          if(bar) bar.style.width = p + '%';
        });
        F.images.push(url);
        repaint();
        done++;
      }catch(err){
        console.error('[upload] error:', err);
        try{ toast('خطا در «' + f.name + '»: ' + (err.message || 'نامشخص'), 'err', 5000); }catch(e){}
        failed++;
      }
    }

    if(progressEl) progressEl.hidden = true;
    if(bar) bar.style.width = '0%';
    if(done > 0){
      try{ toast(done + ' تصویر آپلود شد. یادت نره ذخیره کنی.', 'ok', 4500); }catch(e){}
    }
  };

})();
```

(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.__CAT_V6__) return;
  window.__CAT_V6__ = true;

  console.log('[cat-v6] starting...');

  var categoriesCache = null;
  var lastFetch = 0;

  function fetchCategories(cb){
    var now = Date.now();
    if(categoriesCache && now - lastFetch < 3000){ return cb(categoriesCache); }
    var API = window.__API_BASE__ || window.__API_BASE || '/api';
    fetch(API + '/categories', { credentials: 'include' })
      .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
      .then(function(d){
        categoriesCache = (d && d.categories) || [];
        lastFetch = now;
        cb(categoriesCache);
      })
      .catch(function(e){
        console.warn('[cat-v6] fetch failed:', e.message);
        cb([]);
      });
  }

  function applyImages(){
    var thumbs = document.querySelectorAll('#catGrid .cat-card-thumb');
    if(!thumbs.length) return;

    fetchCategories(function(cats){
      if(!cats.length) return;

      /* نقشه‌ای از id → image_url */
      var map = {};
      cats.forEach(function(c){ map[c.id] = c.image_url || ''; });

      var applied = 0;
      for(var i = 0; i < thumbs.length; i++){
        var el = thumbs[i];
        var card = el.closest('.cat-card-admin');
        if(!card) continue;
        var id = Number(card.getAttribute('data-id'));
        if(!id) continue;
        var raw = map[id];
        if(!raw || !String(raw).trim()) continue;

function np(p){
  const price = Number(p.price)||0;
  const off   = Number(p.off)||0;
  const fin   = Number(p.finalPrice)||Math.round(price*(1-off/100)/1000)*1000;
  return {
    id: p.id,
    n:  p.name,
    b:  p.brand || '',
    c:  (p.category && (p.category.slug || String(p.category.id))) || '',
    t:  p.art || 'book',
    pr: price,
    off,
    fin,
    r:  Number(p.rating)||0,
    v:  Number(p.numReviews)||0,
    st: Number(p.stock)||0,
    s:  Number(p.sales)||0,
    col:(p.colors&&p.colors.length? p.colors : [{name:'پیش‌فرض',hex:'#94a3b8'}]).map(c=>[c.name,c.hex]),
    sp: (p.specs||[]).map(s=>[s.key||s.spec_key||'',s.value||'']),
    imgs: Array.isArray(p.images) ? p.images.slice() : (Array.isArray(p.imgs) ? p.imgs.slice() : []),
    images: Array.isArray(p.images) ? p.images.slice() : [],
    d:  p.description || ''
  };
}

/* __resolveCartProducts__ */
async function resolveCartProducts(){
  var missing = [];
  for (var k in state.cart) {
    var id = state.cart[k].id;
    if (!byId[id] && missing.indexOf(id) === -1) missing.push(id);
  }
  if (state.wish && typeof state.wish.forEach === 'function') {
    state.wish.forEach(function(w){
      if (!byId[w] && missing.indexOf(w) === -1) missing.push(w);
    });
  }
  if (!missing.length) return 0;
  console.log('[cart] resolving', missing.length, 'missing product(s)');
  var resolved = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < missing.length; i++) {
    var pid = missing[i];
    try {
      var r = await apiGet('/products/' + pid);
      if (r && r.product) {
        var p = np(r.product);
        if (!byId[p.id]) {
          ALL_PRODUCTS.push(p);
          byId[p.id] = p;
        }
        resolved++;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      /* محصول حذف شده → از سبد و علاقه‌مندی پاک کن */
      for (var kk in state.cart) {
        if (state.cart[kk].id === pid) delete state.cart[kk];
      }
      if (state.wish && typeof state.wish.delete === 'function') state.wish.delete(pid);
    }
  }
  persist();
  updateCartUI();
  return resolved;
}

function buildProductQuery(page){
  var p = new URLSearchParams();
  p.set('page', String(page || 1));
  p.set('limit', String(state.perPage || 24));
  if(state.qRaw) p.set('q', state.qRaw);
  if(state.cat && state.cat !== 'all'){
    var cat = state.categories.find(function(c){ return c.id === state.cat; });
    if(cat && cat.slug) p.set('category', cat.slug);
  }
  if(state.sort) p.set('sort', state.sort);
  if(state.max && state.max < MAXP) p.set('maxPrice', String(state.max));
  if(state.minRate > 0) p.set('minRating', String(state.minRate));
  if(state.disc) p.set('hasOff', 'true');
  if(state.stock) p.set('inStock', 'true');
  return p;
}

async function loadProducts(opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  var page = opts.append ? (state.page + 1) : 1;
  var params = buildProductQuery(page);
  var res;
  try{
    res = await apiGet('/products?' + params.toString());
  }catch(e){
    console.error('[loadProducts]', e);
    throw e;
  }
  var items = (res.items || []).map(np);

  if(opts.append){
    ALL_PRODUCTS = [REDACTED]
    state.page = page;
  }else{
    ALL_PRODUCTS = items;
    byId = {};
    state.page = 1;
  }
  items.forEach(function(x){ byId[x.id] = x; });

  state.totalProducts = (res.pagination && res.pagination.total) || ALL_PRODUCTS.length;
  state.totalPages    = (res.pagination && res.pagination.pages) || 1;

  /* اگه اولین باره، سقف قیمت رو از نتایج بگیر */
  if(!opts.append && ALL_PRODUCTS.length){
    var maxP = 0;
    for(var i=0;i<ALL_PRODUCTS.length;i++){
      if(ALL_PRODUCTS[i].fin > maxP) maxP = ALL_PRODUCTS[i].fin;
    }
    if(maxP > 0){
      MAXP = [REDACTED]
      if(state.max > MAXP) state.max = MAXP;
    }
  }

  return res;
}

async function loadMore(){
  if(state.page >= state.totalPages) return;
  if(state.loadingMore) return;
  state.loadingMore = true;
  try{
    await loadProducts({ append:true });

    toast('خطا در بارگذاری بیشتر: '+e.message);
  }
  state.loadingMore = false;
}

async function loadAll(){

  return true;
}

function filtered(){
  /* با صفحه‌بندی سمت سرور، ALL_PRODUCTS همان نتایج فیلترشده است.
     فقط فیلتر wishOnly که کلاینتیه باقی مونده. */
  if(state.wishOnly){
    return ALL_PRODUCTS.filter(function(p){ return state.wish.has(p.id); });
  }
  return ALL_PRODUCTS.slice();
}

  return `<article class="card${sold?' sold':''}">
    <button class="wish" data-action="wish" data-id="${p.id}" aria-pressed="${wished}" aria-label="${wished?'حذف از':'افزودن به'} علاقه‌مندی‌ها">${ic('heart',18)}</button>
    ${tag}
    <a class="clink" href="#p${p.id}" data-action="open" data-id="${p.id}" aria-label="${esc(p.n)}">
      <div class="thumb" style="--tint:${p.col[0][1]};position:relative">
        ${(p.imgs && p.imgs.length) || (p.images && p.images.length) ? '<img src="'+window.__resolveCardImg(p)+'" alt="${esc(p.n)}" loading="lazy" style="position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:inherit;z-index:1" onerror="this.style.display=\'none\'">' : ''}
        ${art(p.t,p.col[0][1])}${p.off&&!sold?``:''}
        ${p.off && !sold ? '<span class="off-badge">'+fa(p.off)+'٪</span>' : ''}
      </div>
      <div class="title">${esc(p.n)}</div>
      <div class="cmeta"><span class="rate"><span class="star">★</span> ${fa(p.r)} <span class="muted">(${fa(p.v)})</span></span>

      ${lowStock?`<div class="low">تنها ${fa(p.st)} عدد در انبار</div><div class="stock-bar"><i style="width:${p.st/5*100}%"></i></div>`:sold?'<div class="low">ناموجود</div>':'<div class="low"></div>'}

}

function tick(){
  var isFest = window.__festivalActive === true;
  var endMs = window.__festivalEnds || 0;
  var now = Date.now();

  /* جشنواره تموم شد → حذف تایمر و پیام «جشنواره فعالی وجود ندارد» */
  if(isFest && endMs && endMs <= now){
    console.log('[festival] ⏰ جشنواره به پایان رسید — حذف تایمر');
    window.__festivalActive = false;
    window.__festivalEnds = 0;
    if(typeof showNoFestival === 'function') showNoFestival();
    return;
  }

  /* بدون جشنواره → عدد تایمر آپدیت نمی‌شه چون وجود نداره */
  if(!isFest || !endMs) return;

  var s = Math.max(0, Math.floor((endMs - now) / 1000));
  var h = Math.floor(s / 3600);
  var m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
  s = s % 60;
  var fp = function(n){ return String(n).padStart(2, '0').replace(/\d/g, function(x){ return '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[x]; }); };
  var A = $('#cdH'), B = $('#cdM'), C = $('#cdS');
  if(A){ A.textContent = fp(h); B.textContent = fp(m); C.textContent = fp(s); }
}

  $('#hero').innerHTML=SLIDES.map((s,i)=>`<div class="slide${i===0?' on':''}" style="background:${s.bg};color:#fff" role="group" aria-label="${fa(i+1)} از ${fa(SLIDES.length)}" aria-hidden="${i!==0}">

function heroGo(i){
  heroI=(i+SLIDES.length)%SLIDES.length;
  $$('.slide').forEach((s,k)=>{const on=k===heroI;s.classList.toggle('on',on);s.setAttribute('aria-hidden',!on);const b=$('.btn',s);if(b)b.tabIndex=on?0:-1});
  $$('.dots button').forEach((d,k)=>d.setAttribute('aria-current',k===heroI));
}
function heroAuto(){
  clearInterval(heroTimer);
  if(reduceMotion)return;
  heroTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(!document.hidden)heroGo(heroI+1)},6000);
}

    loadProducts({ append:false }).then/* __sanitize__ — با DOMPurify و fallback whitelist */
window.__sanitize = window.__sanitize || function(html){
  if(html === null || html === undefined) return '';
  html = String(html);

  /* اگه DOMPurify لود شده، ازش استفاده کن */
  if(typeof window.DOMPurify !== 'undefined' && window.DOMPurify.sanitize){
    return window.DOMPurify.sanitize(html, {
      ALLOWED_TAGS: ['p','br','hr','strong','b','em','i','u','s','del','ins','mark','sub','sup',
                     'h1','h2','h3','h4','h5','h6',
                     'ul','ol','li','blockquote','pre','code',
                     'a','img',
                     'table','thead','tbody','tfoot','tr','th','td',
                     'div','span','section','article','aside','header','footer','nav'],
      ALLOWED_ATTR: ['href','title','target','rel','src','alt','width','height','class','id','style',
                     'colspan','rowspan','align','dir'],
      ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP: /^(?:(?:https?|mailto|tel|ftp):|[^a-z]|[a-z+.\-]+(?:[^a-z+.\-:]|$))/i,
      FORBID_TAGS: ['script','style','iframe','frame','frameset','object','embed','applet','form',
                    'input','button','select','option','textarea','base','link','meta','svg','math'],
      FORBID_ATTR: ['onerror','onload','onclick','onmouseover','onmouseout','onfocus','onblur',
                    'onchange','onsubmit','onkeydown','onkeyup','onkeypress','oninput',
                    'formaction','action','srcdoc','xlink:href'],
      ADD_ATTR: ['target'],
      KEEP_CONTENT: true,
    });
  }

  /* fallback: whitelist regex (اگه DOMPurify لود نشد) */
  return html
    .replace(/<script[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<script[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<style[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<style[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<iframe[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/iframe\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<iframe[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<object[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/object\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<object[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<embed[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<form[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/form\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<form[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<input[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<button[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/button\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<button[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<svg[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/svg\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<svg[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<meta[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<link[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<base[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<math[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/math\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+on[a-z]+\s*=\s*"[^"]*"/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+on[a-z]+\s*=\s*'[^']*'/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+on[a-z]+\s*=\s*[^\s>]+/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+(?:href|src|action|formaction|xlink:href)\s*=\s*"\s*javascript:[^"]*"/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+(?:href|src|action|formaction|xlink:href)\s*=\s*'\s*javascript:[^']*'/gi, '')
    .replace(/javascript\s*:/gi, '');
};

/* __safeLink__ — فقط http(s) و مسیرهای نسبی مجاز */
window.__safeLink = function(url){
  if(!url) return '';
  url = String(url).trim();
  if(!url) return '';
  /* مسیر نسبی */
  if(url.charAt(0) === '/' || url.charAt(0) === '#' || url.charAt(0) === '?') return url;
  /* http(s) */
  if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) return url;
  /* mailto, tel */
  if(/^(mailto|tel):/i.test(url)) return url;
  /* هر چیز دیگه (javascript:, data:, vbscript:, ...) → خالی */
  return '';
};

/* ================================================================
   CART
   ================================================================ */
const cartLines=()=>Object.entries(state.cart).map(([k,i])=>({k,...i,p:byId[i.id]})).filter(x=>x.p);
const FREE = (window.__SHIPPING__ && window.__SHIPPING__.FREE_THRESHOLD) || 1000000;
const SHIP = (window.__SHIPPING__ && window.__SHIPPING__.COST) || 60000;
function totals(){
  let old=0,now=0,n=0;
  for(const i of cartLines()){old+=i.p.pr*i.qty;now+=i.p.fin*i.qty;n+=i.qty}
  const ship=(now===0||now>=FREE)?0:SHIP;
  return {old,now,n,disc:old-now,ship,pay:now+ship};
}
function addToCart(id,ci=0,qty=1,sourceEl=null){
  const p=byId[id];if(!p||!p.st)return false;
  const k=id+':'+ci,cur=state.cart[k]?.qty||0,max=Math.min(p.st,10);
  if(cur>=max){toast(`حداکثر تعداد قابل سفارش این کالا ${fa(max)} عدد است`);return false}
  state.cart[k]={id,ci,qty:Math.min(max,cur+qty)};
  persist();updateCartUI();
  if(sourceEl)flyToCart(sourceEl,p.col[ci]?.[1]||'#d92a3f');
  bumpBadge();
  return true;
}
function updateCartUI(){
  const t=totals();
  for(const id of ['cartBadge','cartBadge2']){const b=$('#'+id);if(b){b.hidden=!t.n;b.textContent=fa(t.n)}}
  const wd=$('#wishDot');if(wd)wd.hidden=!state.wish.size;
  if($('#cart').classList.contains('open'))renderCart();
}
function renderCart(){
  const L=cartLines(),t=totals(),body=$('#cartBody'),foot=$('#cartFoot');
  if(!L.length){
    body.innerHTML=`<div class="cart-empty"><div class="big">${ic('cart',40)}</div><h3>سبد خرید شما خالی است</h3><p>کالاهای مورد علاقه‌تان را به سبد اضافه کنید.</p><button class="btn primary" data-action="close-shop">دیدن کالاها</button></div>`;
    foot.hidden=true;return;
  }
  const left=Math.max(0,FREE-t.now),pct=Math.min(100,t.now/FREE*100);
  body.innerHTML=`<div class="free">${left?`با <b>${fa(left)} تومان</b> خرید بیشتر، ارسال رایگان می‌شود.`:'<b style="color:var(--ok)">ارسال این سفارش رایگان است.</b>'}<div class="bar"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div></div>`
    +L.map(i=>{const p=i.p,c=p.col[i.ci]||p.col[0],max=Math.min(p.st,10);return `<div class="ci">
      <a class="thumb" href="#p${p.id}" data-action="open" data-id="${p.id}" style="--tint:${c[1]}">${art(p.t,c[1])}</a>
      <div><h3>${esc(p.n)}</h3><div class="cl"><i style="--c:${c[1]}"></i>${c[0]}</div>
        <div class="ci-row"><div class="qty"><button data-action="c-dec" data-k="${i.k}" aria-label="کم کردن">${ic('minus',16)}</button><output>${fa(i.qty)}</output><button data-action="c-inc" data-k="${i.k}" aria-label="زیاد کردن" ${i.qty>=max?'disabled':''}>${ic('plus',16)}</button></div>
        <div class="now" style="font-size:15px">${fa(p.fin*i.qty)} <small>تومان</small></div></div>
        <button class="rm" style="margin-top:4px;width:auto;padding:0 8px;height:30px;font-size:12.5px;gap:4px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center" data-action="c-rm" data-k="${i.k}">${ic('trash',15)} حذف</button>
      </div></div>`}).join('');
  foot.hidden=false;
  foot.innerHTML=`<div class="sum-row"><span>قیمت کالاها (${fa(t.n)})</span><span>${fa(t.old)} تومان</span></div>
    ${t.disc?`<div class="sum-row disc"><span>سود شما از خرید</span><span>${fa(t.disc)} تومان</span></div>`:''}
    <div class="sum-row"><span>هزینهٔ ارسال</span><span>${t.ship?fa(t.ship)+' تومان':'رایگان'}</span></div>
    <div class="sum-row pay"><span>مبلغ قابل پرداخت</span><span>${fa(t.pay)} تومان</span></div>
    <button class="btn primary block" style="margin-top:12px;height:46px" data-action="checkout">ادامه و تکمیل سفارش</button>`;
}

/* ================================================================
   TOAST
   ================================================================ */
let toastTimer,toastEl;
function toast(msg,label,fn){
  const box=$('#toasts');
  if(toastEl)toastEl.remove();
  const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='toast';
  const s=document.createElement('span');s.textContent=msg;el.append(s);
  if(label){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=label;b.onclick=()=>{fn();box.innerHTML='';toastEl=null};el.append(b)}
  const prog=document.createElement('div');prog.className='t-progress';prog.innerHTML='<i></i>';el.append(prog);
  box.append(el);toastEl=el;
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
    el.classList.add('out');
    setTimeout(()=>{el.remove();if(toastEl===el)toastEl=null},300);
  },3200);
}

/* ================================================================
   RIPPLE / FLY / BADGE
   ================================================================ */
function ripple(e){
  const b=e.currentTarget;
  const r=document.createElement('span');
  r.className='ripple';
  const rect=b.getBoundingClientRect();
  const size=Math.max(rect.width,rect.height);
  r.style.width=r.style.height=size+'px';
  r.style.left=(e.clientX-rect.left-size/2)+'px';
  r.style.top=(e.clientY-rect.top-size/2)+'px';
  b.appendChild(r);
  setTimeout(()=>r.remove(),600);
}
function flyToCart(sourceEl,tint='#d92a3f'){
  if(reduceMotion)return;
  const cart=$('[data-action="cart"]');if(!cart)return;
  const src=sourceEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const dst=cart.getBoundingClientRect();
  const fly=document.createElement('div');
  fly.className='fly-item';
  fly.style.left=src.left+'px';fly.style.top=src.top+'px';
  fly.innerHTML=`<svg viewBox="0 0 32 32"><rect width="32" height="32" rx="9" fill="${tint}"/><path d="M9.5 12.5h13l-1.2 11H10.7z" fill="#fff"/><path d="M12.8 12.5c0-4.4 6.4-4.4 6.4 0" stroke="#fff" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`;
  document.body.appendChild(fly);
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
    fly.style.left=(dst.left+dst.width/2-30)+'px';
    fly.style.top=(dst.top+dst.height/2-30)+'px';
    fly.style.transform='scale(.3) rotate(360deg)';
    fly.style.opacity='0.2';
  });
  setTimeout(()=>fly.remove(),900);
}
function bumpBadge(){
  for(const id of ['cartBadge','cartBadge2']){
    const b=$('#'+id);if(!b)continue;
    b.classList.remove('bump');void b.offsetWidth;b.classList.add('bump');
  }
}

/* ================================================================
   LAYERS
   ================================================================ */
let current=null,lastFocus=null;
function openLayer(el,scrim){
  if(current&&current!==el)closeLayer(true);
  lastFocus=document.activeElement;current=el;
  el.classList.add('open');document.documentElement.classList.add('lock');
  if(scrim)$('#scrim').classList.add('on');
  setTimeout(()=>{const f=$('[data-autofocus]',el)||$('button,input,select,a[href]',el);f&&f.focus({preventScroll:true})},30);
}
function closeLayer(keepFocus){
  if(!current)return;
  current.classList.remove('open');$('#scrim').classList.remove('on');
  document.documentElement.classList.remove('lock');
  const f=lastFocus;current=null;
  if(!keepFocus&&f&&f.focus&&document.contains(f))f.focus({preventScroll:true});
}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key==='Escape'){
    if($('#sugg') && !$('#sugg').hidden){closeSugg();return}
    if(current){closeLayer();e.preventDefault()}
  }
  if(e.key==='Tab'&&current){
    const f=$$('button:not([disabled]),input:not([disabled]),select,textarea,a[href],[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',current).filter(x=>x.offsetParent!==null);
    if(!f.length)return;
    const a=f[0],z=f[f.length-1];
    if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===a){z.focus();e.preventDefault()}
    else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===z){a.focus();e.preventDefault()}
  }
});
['pm','co','lg'].forEach(id=>{const el=$('#'+id);if(el)el.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{if(e.target.id===id)closeLayer()})});
