```js
const pm={id:0,ci:0,qty:1,tab:'desc',reviews:[]};
function openProduct(id,ci=0){
  const p=byId[id];
  try{ window.__curPmProduct = p; }catch(e){}if(!p)return;
  Object.assign(pm,{id,ci,qty:1,tab:'desc',reviews:[]});
  renderPM();
  if(current!==$('#pm'))openLayer($('#pm'));
  $('#pmSheet').scrollTop=0;
  apiGet('/reviews/product/'+id).then(r=>{
    pm.reviews=(r.reviews||[]).map(x=>({
      name:(x.user&&x.user.name)||'کاربر',
      rating:x.rating, comment:x.comment
    }));
    if(pm.tab==='rev')$('#pmPanel').innerHTML=panelHTML(byId[pm.id]);
  }).catch(()=>{});
}
function panelHTML(p){
  if(pm.tab==='spec'){
    if(!p.sp.length)return '<p class="muted">مشخصات فنی ثبت نشده است.</p>';
    return '<table class="spec"><tbody>'+p.sp.map(function(x){return '<tr><th scope="row">'+esc(x[0])+'</th><td>'+esc(x[1])+'</td></tr>';}).join('')+'<tr><th scope="row">برند</th><td>'+esc(p.b)+'</td></tr></tbody></table>';
  }
  if(pm.tab==='rev'){
    if(!pm.reviews.length){
      return '<div class="reviews-empty">' +
        '<div class="reviews-empty-ic">' +
          '<svg width="42" height="42" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">' +
            '<path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/>' +
            '<path d="M8 9h8M8 13h5"/>' +
          '</svg>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<h4>هنوز نظری ثبت نشده</h4>' +
        '<p>اولین نفری باش که نظر خود را درباره این کالا ثبت می‌کند.</p>' +
      '</div>';
    }
    return pm.reviews.map(function(r){
      return '<div class="rev">' +
        '<b>' + esc(r.name) + '</b> ' + stars(r.rating) +
        '<p>' + esc(r.comment) + '</p>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }
  return '<p>'+esc(p.d||'توضیحی ثبت نشده است.')+'</p>';
}

  $('#pmSheet').innerHTML=`<button class="x icon-btn" data-action="close" aria-label="بستن">${ic('x',22)}</button>
  <div class="pm-grid">
    <div><div class="thumb big" id="pmThumb" style="--tint:${c[1]};position:relative;overflow:hidden">
        ${(p.imgs && p.imgs.length) || (p.images && p.images.length) ? '<img class="thumb-img big" src="'+window.__resolveCardImg(p)+'" alt="" style="position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:inherit;z-index:1" onerror="this.style.display=\'none\'">' : ''}
        <span class="thumb-art big">${art(p.t,c[1])}</span>${p.off&&!sold?`<span class="off-badge">${fa(p.off)}٪ تخفیف</span>`:''}</div>
      <ul class="perks"><li>${ic('shield',18)} اصالت و سلامت فیزیکی کالا</li><li>${ic('truck',18)} ${p.fin>=FREE?'ارسال رایگان':'ارسال رایگان برای خرید بالای ۱ میلیون تومان'}</li><li>${ic('ret',18)} هفت روز مهلت بازگشت</li></ul></div>
    <div class="pm-info">

      <div class="buy">
        <div class="prices">${sold?'<span class="muted">این کالا در حال حاضر ناموجود است</span>':`${p.off?`<div class="was-row"><span class="pct">${fa(p.off)}٪</span><span class="was">${fa(p.pr)}</span></div>`:''}<div class="now">${fa(p.fin)} <small>تومان</small></div>`}</div>
        ${sold?`<button class="btn outline block" disabled>ناموجود</button>`:`<div class="row"><div class="qty"><button data-action="pm-dec" aria-label="کم کردن" ${pm.qty<=1?'disabled':''}>${ic('minus',16)}</button><output id="pmQty">${fa(pm.qty)}</output><button data-action="pm-inc" aria-label="زیاد کردن" ${pm.qty>=max?'disabled':''}>${ic('plus',16)}</button></div><button class="btn primary" data-action="pm-add" data-autofocus>${ic('cart',18)} افزودن به سبد</button></div>${p.st<=5?`<div class="note">تنها ${fa(p.st)} عدد در انبار باقی مانده است.</div>`:''}`}

    <div class="sum-row" style="margin-top:8px"><span>هزینهٔ ارسال</span><span>${t.ship?fa(t.ship)+' تومان':'رایگان'}</span></div>

async function submitOrder(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  const f=e.target,v=n=>f.elements[n].value.trim(),errs={};
  if(v('name').length<3)errs.fn='نام و نام خانوادگی را وارد کنید.';
  if(!/^09\d{9}$/.test(norm(v('phone'))))errs.ph='شمارهٔ موبایل باید با ۰۹ شروع شود و ۱۱ رقم باشد.';
  if(!v('city'))errs.ct='شهر را انتخاب کنید.';
  if(v('addr').length<10)errs.ad='نشانی را کامل‌تر وارد کنید.';
  $$('.err',f).forEach(x=>{const k=x.dataset.for,inp=$('#'+k);x.textContent=errs[k]||'';inp.setAttribute('aria-invalid',!!errs[k])});
  const first=Object.keys(errs)[0];
  if(first){$('#'+first).focus();return}

  if(!state.user){
    toast('برای ثبت سفارش ابتدا وارد شوید.','ورود',()=>{closeLayer();openLogin()});
    return;
  }

  const btn=f.querySelector('button[type=submit]');
  btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='در حال ثبت...';

  const items=cartLines().map(i=>({
    product:i.p.id, qty:i.qty, color:{name:i.p.col[i.ci][0],hex:i.p.col[i.ci][1]}
  }));
  const shippingAddress={
    name:v('name'), phone:norm(v('phone')),
    province:v('province') || null,
    city:v('city'), street:v('addr'),
    postalCode:v('postalCode') ? norm(v('postalCode')) : null
  };
  const payload={
    items, shippingAddress,
    paymentMethod:f.elements.pay.value,
    note:''
  };

  try{
    const res=await apiPost('/orders',payload);
    const code=res.order.trackingCode;
    const cod=f.elements.pay.value==='cod';
    const total=res.order.totalPrice;

    state.cart={};persist();updateCartUI();
    $('#coSheet').innerHTML=`<button class="x icon-btn" data-action="close" aria-label="بستن">${ic('x',22)}</button>
    <div class="sheet-in"><div class="done"><div class="okc">${ic('check',36)}</div><h2 id="coTitle">سفارش شما ثبت شد</h2>
    <p class="muted" style="margin:6px 0 0">${cod?`مبلغ ${fa(total)} تومان را هنگام تحویل پرداخت کنید.`:`مبلغ ${fa(total)} تومان با موفقیت پرداخت شد.`}</p>
    <div class="code">کد پیگیری: ${esc(code)}</div><br><button class="btn primary" data-action="close" data-autofocus>ادامه خرید</button></div></div>`;
    $('#coSheet [data-autofocus]').focus();
  }catch(err){
    toast('خطا: '+err.message);
    btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='ثبت نهایی سفارش';
  }
}

function openLogin(mode){
  /* مودال قدیمی حذف شد — همه‌جا به login.html هدایت می‌شه */
  var target = 'login.html';
  if(mode === 'register' || mode === 'signup') target += '?signup=1';
  window.location.href = target;
}
function renderLogin(err){
  /* فقط حالت کاربر لاگین‌شده */
  if(state.user){
    var sh = $('#lgSheet');
    var x = '<button class="x icon-btn" data-action="close" aria-label="بستن">' + ic('x',22) + '</button>';
    sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2 id="lgTitle">حساب من</h2>' +
      '<p class="muted">' + esc(state.user.name || 'کاربر') + ' عزیز، خوش آمدید.</p>' +
      '<p class="muted" style="font-size:13.5px">شماره: <b dir="ltr">' + esc(state.user.phone || '—') + '</b></p>' +
      '<button class="btn primary block" data-action="my-orders" style="margin-top:12px">سفارش‌های من</button>' +
      '<button class="btn outline block" data-action="logout" style="margin-top:8px" data-autofocus>' + ic('logout',16) + ' خروج از حساب</button>' +
    '</div>';
    return;
  }
  /* کاربر لاگین نیست → به login.html */
  window.location.href = 'login.html';
}

/* ================================================================
   SEARCH SUGGESTIONS
   ================================================================ */
function closeSugg(){const b=$('#sugg');if(b)b.hidden=true;$('#q').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')}
function renderSugg(){
  const q=norm($('#q').value),box=$('#sugg');if(!box)return;
  const raw=$('#q').value.trim();
  if(!q){
    const h=hist.get();
    const trends=ALL_PRODUCTS.filter(p=>p.s>=6000).slice(0,5);
    box.innerHTML=`
      ${h.length?`<div class="s-head"><span>جستجوهای اخیر</span><button class="clear" data-action="clear-hist">پاک کردن</button></div>
        <div style="padding:4px 8px 8px">${h.map(x=>`<button class="history-chip" data-action="hist-item" data-q="${esc(x)}">${esc(x)} <span class="x" data-action="hist-rm" data-q="${esc(x)}">×</span></button>`).join('')}</div>`:''}
      <div class="s-head"><span>پیشنهادهای پرطرفدار</span></div>
      ${trends.map(p=>`<button data-action="open" data-id="${p.id}"><span class="st" style="--tint:${p.col[0][1]}">${art(p.t,p.col[0][1])}</span><span class="sn">${esc(p.n)}</span><span class="sp">${fa(p.fin)}</span></button>`).join('')}
    `;
    box.hidden=false;$('#q').setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    return;
  }
  const R=ALL_PRODUCTS.filter(p=>{const h=norm(`${p.n} ${p.b}`);return q.split(' ').every(w=>h.includes(w))});
  const hl=txt=>{
    if(!raw)return esc(txt);
    let out=esc(txt);
    raw.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).forEach(w=>{
      const re=new RegExp('('+w.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&')+')','gi');
      out=out.replace(re,'<span class="highlight">$1</span>');
    });
    return out;
  };
  box.innerHTML=R.length?R.slice(0,6).map(p=>`<button data-action="open" data-id="${p.id}"><span class="st" style="--tint:${p.col[0][1]}">${art(p.t,p.col[0][1])}</span><span class="sn">${hl(p.n)}</span><span class="sp">${fa(p.fin)}</span></button>`).join('')
    +(R.length>6?`<button class="all" data-action="see-all">نمایش همهٔ ${fa(R.length)} نتیجه</button>`:''):`<div class="none">نتیجه‌ای پیدا نشد.</div>`;
  box.hidden=false;$('#q').setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
}
let qTimer;
const qInput=$('#q');
if(qInput){
  qInput.addEventListener('input',e=>{
    state.qRaw=e.target.value.trim();state.q=norm(e.target.value);state.shown=12;
    renderSugg();clearTimeout(qTimer);qTimer=setTimeout(applyFilters,300);
  });
  qInput.addEventListener('change',e=>{const v=e.target.value.trim();if(v.length>=2)hist.add(v)});
  qInput.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){closeSugg();renderList();scrollToShop()}});
  qInput.addEventListener('focus',()=>renderSugg());
  document.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{if(!e.target.closest('.search'))closeSugg()});
}

async function openMyOrders(){
  const sh=$('#lgSheet');
  const x=`<button class="x icon-btn" data-action="close" aria-label="بستن">${ic('x',22)}</button>`;
  sh.innerHTML=`${x}<div class="sheet-in"><h2 id="lgTitle">سفارش‌های من</h2><p class="muted">در حال بارگذاری...</p></div>`;
  try{
    const res=await apiGet('/orders/my');
    const orders=res.orders||[];
    if(!orders.length){
      sh.innerHTML=`${x}<div class="sheet-in"><h2 id="lgTitle">سفارش‌های من</h2><p class="muted">هنوز سفارشی ثبت نکرده‌اید.</p><button class="btn primary block" data-action="close" style="margin-top:12px" data-autofocus>بستن</button></div>`;
    }else{
      const statusMap={pending:'در انتظار پرداخت',paid:'پرداخت‌شده',processing:'در حال پردازش',shipped:'ارسال شده',delivered:'تحویل داده شده',cancelled:'لغو شده',refunded:'بازگشت داده شده'};
      sh.innerHTML=`${x}<div class="sheet-in"><h2 id="lgTitle">سفارش‌های من</h2>
        ${orders.map(o=>`<div style="border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-top:10px">
          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px"><b>کد: ${esc(o.trackingCode)}</b><span class="muted">${statusMap[o.status]||o.status}</span></div>
          <div class="muted" style="font-size:12.5px;margin-top:4px">${(o.items||[]).length} کالا · مبلغ: ${fa(o.totalPrice)} تومان</div>
        </div>`).join('')}
        <button class="btn primary block" data-action="close" style="margin-top:16px" data-autofocus>بستن</button></div>`;
    }
  }catch(err){
    sh.innerHTML=`${x}<div class="sheet-in"><h2 id="lgTitle">سفارش‌های من</h2><p class="err">${esc(err.message)}</p><button class="btn outline block" data-action="close" style="margin-top:12px">بستن</button></div>`;
  }
}

/* ================================================================
   CLICK HANDLER
   ================================================================ */
document.addEventListener('click',async e=>{
  const el=e.target.closest('[data-action]');if(!el)return;
  const a=el.dataset.action,id=Number(el.dataset.id);

  if(a==='open'){e.preventDefault();closeSugg();openProduct(id);return}

  switch(a){
    case 'add':{
      const p=byId[id];
      const thumb=el.closest('.card')?.querySelector('.thumb');
      if(addToCart(id,0,1,thumb))toast(`«${p.n.split(' ').slice(0,4).join(' ')}…» اضافه شد`,'مشاهده سبد',openCart);
      break}
    case 'wish':{
      if(state.wish.has(id)){state.wish.delete(id);toast('از علاقه‌مندی‌ها حذف شد')}else{state.wish.add(id);toast('به علاقه‌مندی‌ها اضافه شد')}
      persist();updateCartUI();
      if(state.wishOnly)renderList();else $$(`[data-action=wish][data-id="${id}"]`).forEach(b=>{const on=state.wish.has(id);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on)});
      break}
    case 'wishlist':
      if(!state.wish.size&&!state.wishOnly){toast('هنوز کالایی به علاقه‌مندی‌ها اضافه نکرده‌اید.');break}
      closeLayer(true);state.wishOnly=!state.wishOnly;state.shown=12;renderList();if(state.wishOnly)scrollToShop();break;
    case 'cat':closeLayer(true);state.cat=el.dataset.cat;state.disc=false;applyFilters().then(scrollToShop);break;
    case 'deals':closeLayer(true);state.disc=true;state.cat='all';state.sort='off';applyFilters().then(scrollToShop);break;
    case 'sort':state.sort=el.dataset.k;applyFilters();break;
    case 'rate':state.minRate=Number(el.dataset.v);applyFilters();break;
    case 'more':loadMore();break;
    case 'reset':resetFilters();break;
    case 'see-all':closeSugg();renderList();scrollToShop();break;
    case 'chip':{const k=el.dataset.k;
      if(k==='cat')state.cat='all';
      if(k==='q'){state.q='';state.qRaw='';if(qInput)qInput.value=''}
      if(k==='max')state.max=MAXP;
      if(k==='rate')state.minRate=0;
      if(k==='disc')state.disc=false;
      if(k==='stock')state.stock=false;
      if(k==='wish')state.wishOnly=false;
      applyFilters();break}
    case 'filters':openLayer($('#filters'),true);break;
    case 'filters-close':closeLayer();break;
    case 'close':closeLayer();break;
    case 'close-shop':closeLayer(true);scrollToShop();break;
    case 'home':closeLayer(true);scrollTo({top:0,behavior:reduceMotion?'auto':'smooth'});break;
    case 'newsletter':{e.preventDefault();var em=el.querySelector('input[type=email]');if(!em||!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(em.value)){em&&em.focus();toast('ایمیل معتبر وارد کنید.');break}em.value='';toast('به‌زودی خبرنامه فعال می‌شود.');break}
    case 'cart':openCart();break;
    case 'c-inc':{const i=state.cart[el.dataset.k];if(i)addToCart(i.id,i.ci,1);break}
    case 'c-dec':{const k=el.dataset.k,i=state.cart[k];if(i){i.qty--;if(i.qty<=0)delete state.cart[k];persist();updateCartUI()}break}
    case 'c-rm':{const k=el.dataset.k,i=state.cart[k],p=i&&byId[i.id];delete state.cart[k];persist();updateCartUI();if(p)toast('از سبد خرید حذف شد','بازگردانی',()=>{state.cart[k]=i;persist();updateCartUI()});break}
    case 'checkout':closeLayer(true);openCheckout();break;
    case 'pm-color':{pm.ci=Number(el.dataset.i);const p=byId[pm.id],c=p.col[pm.ci];
      const thumb=$('#pmThumb');thumb.querySelector('svg').outerHTML=art(p.t,c[1]);
      thumb.style.setProperty('--tint',c[1]);$('#pmColor').textContent=c[0];
      $$('.swatches button').forEach((b,i)=>b.setAttribute('aria-checked',i===pm.ci));break}
    case 'pm-inc':case 'pm-dec':{const max=Math.min(byId[pm.id].st,10);pm.qty=Math.min(max,Math.max(1,pm.qty+(a==='pm-inc'?1:-1)));
      $('#pmQty').textContent=fa(pm.qty);const dec=$('[data-action=pm-dec]'),inc=$('[data-action=pm-inc]');
      if(dec)dec.disabled=pm.qty<=1;if(inc)inc.disabled=pm.qty>=max;break}
    case 'pm-add':{
      const p=byId[pm.id];
      if(addToCart(pm.id,pm.ci,pm.qty,$('#pmThumb')))toast(`${fa(pm.qty)} عدد به سبد اضافه شد`,'مشاهده سبد',()=>{closeLayer(true);openCart()});
      break}
    case 'pm-tab':{pm.tab=el.dataset.tab;$$('.tabs button').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-selected',b.dataset.tab===pm.tab));$('#pmPanel').innerHTML=panelHTML(byId[pm.id]);break}
    case 'login':handleLoginClick(el);break;
    case 'logout':
      try{await apiPost('/auth/logout')}catch(_){}
      state.user=null;store.set('bz.user',null);paintUser();updateCartUI();closeLayer();toast('از حساب خود خارج شدید.');break;
    case 'my-orders':openMyOrders();break;
    case 'hero-prev':heroGo(heroI-1);heroAuto();break;
    case 'hero-next':heroGo(heroI+1);heroAuto();break;
    case 'hero-go':heroGo(Number(el.dataset.i));heroAuto();break;
    case 'hero-cta':{const s=SLIDES[Number(el.dataset.i)];
      if(s.act==='disc'){resetFilters();state.disc=true;state.sort='off';renderList()}
      else if(s.act.startsWith('cat:')){resetFilters();state.cat=s.act.slice(4);renderList()}
      else resetFilters();
      scrollToShop();break}
    case 'view':{viewMode.set(el.dataset.v);$$('[data-action="view"]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',b.dataset.v===viewMode.get()));renderList();break}
    case 'clear-hist':hist.clear();renderSugg();break;
    case 'hist-item':{const q=el.dataset.q;$('#q').value=q;state.qRaw=q;state.q=norm(q);state.shown=12;closeSugg();renderList();scrollToShop();hist.add(q);break}
    case 'hist-rm':{e.stopPropagation();hist.remove(el.dataset.q);renderSugg();break}
  }
});
function openCart(){renderCart();openLayer($('#cart'),true)}

  if(t.name==='fcat')state.cat=t.value;

  else if(t.id==='fDisc')state.disc=t.checked;

});

   INIT

async function loadSiteSettings(){
  try{
    var r = await apiGet('/site/settings');
    var s = (r && r.settings) || {};

    var el1 = document.getElementById('catSecTitle');
    if(el1 && s.cat_section_title) el1.textContent = s.cat_section_title;

    var el2 = document.getElementById('catSecDesc');
    if(el2){
      if(s.cat_section_desc){ el2.textContent = s.cat_section_desc; el2.style.display = ''; }
      else { el2.style.display = 'none'; }
    }

    /* مخفی کردن کل بخش trust اگه لازم بود */
    var trustEl = document.getElementById('trust');
    if(trustEl && s.trust_section_visible === '0'){
      trustEl.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }catch(e){
    console.warn('[settings] load failed:', e.message);
  }
}

async function init(){
  hydrateIcons();
  renderHero();
  await loadCmsContent();renderTrust();
  loadSiteSettings();
  const ok=await loadAll();
  await resolveCartProducts();
  if(!ok){toast('اتصال به سرور برقرار نشد. مطمئن شو بک‌اند روی ۵۰۰۰ اجراست.');}
  renderCatbar();renderCatTiles();renderOffers();
  buildFilters();renderList();updateCartUI();paintUser();
  /* سال کپی‌رایت */
  try{
    var el = document.getElementById("copyrightYear");
    if(el){
      var jy;
      try{ jy = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("fa-IR-u-ca-persian",{year:"numeric"}).format(new Date()).replace(/\D/g,""); }catch(e){}
      if(jy) el.textContent = jy;
    }
  }catch(e){}
  tick();setInterval(tick,1000);heroAuto();
 try{
    const r = await apiGet('/auth/me');
    if(r.user){
      state.user = r.user;
      store.set('bz.user', r.user);
      paintUser();
    }
  }catch(e){
    /* کوکی منقضی شده - کاربر رو لاگ‌اوت کن */
    if(state.user){
      state.user = null;
      store.set('bz.user', null);
      paintUser();
    }
  }

  /* scrolled header */
  const header=$('header.site');
  addEventListener('scroll',()=>{header.classList.toggle('scrolled',scrollY>10)},{passive:true});

  /* theme toggle */
  const sunIc='<svg class="ic sun" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.5"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.2 4.2l1.4 1.4M18.4 18.4l1.4 1.4M2 12h2M20 12h2M4.2 19.8l1.4-1.4M18.4 5.6l1.4-1.4"/></svg>';
  const moonIc='<svg class="ic moon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 12.8A9 9 0 1 1 11.2 3a7 7 0 0 0 9.8 9.8z"/></svg>';
  const actions=document.querySelector('.actions');
  if(actions && !$('.theme-toggle')){
    const tb=document.createElement('button');
    tb.className='icon-btn theme-toggle';
    tb.setAttribute('aria-label','تغییر تم');
    tb.innerHTML=sunIc+moonIc;
    actions.insertBefore(tb,actions.querySelector('#loginBtn'));
    tb.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const cur=document.documentElement.dataset.theme;
      const isDark=cur?cur==='dark':matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
      theme.set(isDark?'light':'dark');
    });
  }

  /* view toggle */
  if(!$('.view-toggle')){
    const sorts=$('#sorts');
    if(sorts){
      const vt=document.createElement('div');
      vt.className='view-toggle';
      vt.innerHTML=`<button data-action="view" data-v="grid" aria-pressed="${viewMode.get()==='grid'}" aria-label="نمای شبکه‌ای">${ic('grid',16)}</button>
        <button data-action="view" data-v="list" aria-pressed="${viewMode.get()==='list'}" aria-label="نمای لیستی">${ic('list',16)}</button>`;
      sorts.parentElement.insertBefore(vt,sorts.nextSibling);
    }
  }

  /* ripple */
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    const b=e.target.closest('.btn.primary,.btn.outline');
    if(b)ripple(e);
  });

  /* infinite scroll */
  const moreBtn=$('#more');
  if(moreBtn){
    const io=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
      entries.forEach(en=>{
        if(en.isIntersecting && !moreBtn.hidden){loadMore()}
      });
    },{rootMargin:'300px'});
    io.observe(moreBtn);
  }
}


/* ================================================================
   CMS — Banners, Sliders, Pages
   ================================================================ */
async function loadCmsContent(){
  try{
    const results = await Promise.all([
      apiGet('/cms/banners').catch(function(){ return { banners: [] }; }),
      apiGet('/cms/sliders').catch(function(){ return { sliders: [] }; }),
      apiGet('/cms/pages').catch(function(){ return { pages: [] }; })
    ]);
    var banners = (results[0] && results[0].banners) || [];
    var sliders = (results[1] && results[1].sliders) || [];
    var pages   = (results[2] && results[2].pages) || [];
    if(banners.length) renderCmsBanners(banners);
    if(sliders.length) renderCmsSliders(sliders);
    if(pages.length)   renderCmsFooterPages(pages);
  }catch(e){
    console.warn('[cms] load failed:', e.message);
  }
}

function renderCmsBanners(banners){
  var top = banners.filter(function(b){ return b.position === 'top'; });
  var mid = banners.filter(function(b){ return b.position === 'middle' || b.position === 'sidebar'; });
  paintBannersInto('#cmsTopBanners', top);
  paintBannersInto('#cmsMidBanners', mid);
}

function paintBannersInto(sel, list){
  var el = document.querySelector(sel);
  if(!el) return;
  if(!list.length){ el.hidden = true; return; }
  el.hidden = false;
  el.innerHTML = list.map(function(b){
    var url = window.__ASSET__ ? window.__ASSET__(b.image_url) : b.image_url;
    var inner = '<img src="' + esc(url) + '" alt="' + esc(b.title || '') + '" loading="lazy">';
    var safeLink = window.__safeLink ? window.__safeLink(b.link) : '';
    if(safeLink){
      var tgt = safeLink.indexOf('http') === 0 ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"' : '';
      return '<a class="cms-banner" href="' + esc(safeLink) + '"' + tgt + '>' + inner + '</a>';
    }
    return '<div class="cms-banner">' + inner + '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function renderCmsSliders(sliders){
  var hero = document.querySelector('#hero');
  if(!hero || !sliders.length) return;

  var html = '';
  for(var i = 0; i < sliders.length; i++){
    var s = sliders[i];
    var imgUrl = window.__ASSET__ ? window.__ASSET__(s.image_url) : s.image_url;
    var bg = s.bg_color || '#0f172a';
    var btn = s.button_text || 'مشاهده';
    var link = s.link || '#';
    var onCls = i === 0 ? ' on' : '';
    var hidden = i === 0 ? 'false' : 'true';
    var tabIdx = i === 0 ? '' : ' tabindex="-1"';
    link = window.__safeLink ? window.__safeLink(link) : '';
    var tgt = link.indexOf('http') === 0 ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"' : '';
    html += '<div class="slide' + onCls + '" style="background:' + esc(bg) + ';color:#fff" aria-label="' + fa(i+1) + ' از ' + fa(sliders.length) + '" aria-hidden="' + hidden + '">';
    html += '<div><h2>' + esc(s.title || '') + '</h2>';
    if(s.subtitle) html += '<p>' + esc(s.subtitle) + '</p>';
    html += '<a class="btn light" href="' + esc(link) + '"' + tgt + tabIdx + '>' + esc(btn) + '</a></div>';
    html += '<div class="art"><img src="' + esc(imgUrl) + '" alt="" style="position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:inherit"></div>';
    html += '</div>';
  }
  html += '<button class="hnav prev" data-action="hero-prev" aria-label="قبلی"><svg class="ic" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>';
  html += '<button class="hnav next" data-action="hero-next" aria-label="بعدی"><svg class="ic" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15 6l-6 6 6 6"/></svg></button>';
  html += '<div class="dots">';
  for(var j = 0; j < sliders.length; j++){
    html += '<button data-action="hero-go" data-i="' + j + '" aria-label="اسلاید ' + fa(j+1) + '" aria-current="' + (j === 0) + '"></button>';
  }
  html += '</div>';

  hero.innerHTML = html;
  try{ if(typeof heroGo === 'function') heroGo(0); }catch(e){}
  try{ if(typeof heroAuto === 'function') heroAuto(); }catch(e){}
}

function renderCmsFooterPages(pages){
  var el = document.querySelector('#cmsFooterLinks');
  if(!el) return;
  var menu = pages.filter(function(p){ return p.show_in_menu; });
  if(!menu.length){ el.hidden = true; return; }
  el.hidden = false;
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="cms-page-links-inner">' +
    menu.map(function(p){
      return '<a href="#/page/' + esc(p.slug) + '" data-page-slug="' + esc(p.slug) + '">' + esc(p.title) + '</a>';
    }).join('') +
    '</div>';

  var links = el.querySelectorAll('[data-page-slug]');
  for(var i = 0; i < links.length; i++){
    (function(a){
      a.onclick = function(e){
        e.preventDefault();
        openCmsPage(a.getAttribute('data-page-slug'));
      };
    })(links[i]);
  }
}

async function openCmsPage(slug){
  try{
    var r = await apiGet('/cms/pages/' + encodeURIComponent(slug));
    var p = r.page;
    if(!p){ toast('صفحه پیدا نشد.'); return; }
    var sheet = document.querySelector('#pmSheet');
    if(!sheet){ toast('خطا در باز کردن صفحه'); return; }
    var xBtn = '<button class="x icon-btn" data-action="close" aria-label="بستن"><svg class="ic" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button>';
    sheet.innerHTML = xBtn + '<div class="cms-page-view">' +
      '<h2 class="cms-page-title">' + esc(p.title) + '</h2>' +
      '<div class="cms-page-content">' + (window.__sanitize ? window.__sanitize(p.content || '') : '') + '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    openLayer(document.querySelector('#pm'));
    document.querySelector('#pmSheet').scrollTop = 0;
  }catch(e){ toast('خطا: ' + e.message); }
}

/* ================================================================
   User Dropdown Menu
   ================================================================ */
let userMenuEl = null;
let userMenuOutsideBound = false;

function handleLoginClick(btn){
  if(state.user){
    toggleUserMenu(btn);
  }else{
    openLogin('login');
  }
}

function toggleUserMenu(btn){
  if(userMenuEl){ closeUserMenu(); return; }
  openUserMenu(btn);
}

function closeUserMenu(){
  if(!userMenuEl) return;
  const el = userMenuEl;
  el.classList.remove('on');
  userMenuEl = null;
  setTimeout(function(){ el.remove(); }, 220);
  if(userMenuOutsideBound){
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', userMenuOutsideHandler);
    userMenuOutsideBound = false;
  }
  window.removeEventListener('resize', closeUserMenu);
  window.removeEventListener('scroll', closeUserMenu, true);
}

function userMenuOutsideHandler(e){
  if(userMenuEl && !userMenuEl.contains(e.target)){
    closeUserMenu();
  }
}

      <button type="button" class="user-menu-item danger" data-um="logout" role="menuitem">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M9 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4M16 17l5-5-5-5M21 12H9"/>
        </svg>
        <span>خروج از حساب کاربری</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  `;

  document.body.appendChild(el);
  userMenuEl = el;

  /* Position under the button */
  const r = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mw = el.offsetWidth;
  const mh = el.offsetHeight;

  let left = r.left + (r.width / 2) - (mw / 2);
  left = Math.max(12, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - mw - 12));

  let top = r.bottom + 10;
  if(top + mh > window.innerHeight - 12){
    top = Math.max(12, r.top - mh - 10);
  }

  el.style.top = top + 'px';
  el.style.left = left + 'px';

  requestAnimationFrame(function(){ if(userMenuEl) userMenuEl.classList.add('on'); });

  /* Handle item clicks */
  el.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-um]');
    if(!b) return;
    const um = b.dataset.um;
    closeUserMenu();
    if(um === 'admin-panel'){ window.location.href = 'admin.html'; return; }
    if(um === 'orders'){
      if(typeof openMyOrders === 'function') openMyOrders();
    }else if(um === 'wishlist'){
      gotoWishlist();
    }else if(um === 'reviews'){
      openMyReviews();
    }else if(um === 'logout'){
      doUserLogout();
    }
  });

  /* Close on outside click */
  setTimeout(function(){
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', userMenuOutsideHandler);
    userMenuOutsideBound = true;
  }, 0);

  window.addEventListener('resize', closeUserMenu);
  window.addEventListener('scroll', closeUserMenu, true);
}

function gotoWishlist(){
  if(!state.wish.size){
    toast('هنوز کالایی به علاقه‌مندی‌ها اضافه نکرده‌اید.');
    return;
  }
  closeLayer(true);
  state.wishOnly = true;
  state.shown = 12;
  renderList();
  scrollToShop();
}

async function openMyReviews(){
  const sh = $('#lgSheet');
  const x = '<button class="x icon-btn" data-action="close" aria-label="بستن">' + ic('x',22) + '</button>';
  sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2>دیدگاه و پرسش و پاسخ</h2>'
    + '<p class="muted">در حال بارگذاری...</p></div>';
  openLayer($('#lg'));

  try{
    const res = await apiGet('/orders/my');
    const orders = res.orders || [];
    const items = [];
    orders.forEach(function(o){
      (o.items || []).forEach(function(it){
        if(!items.find(function(x){ return x.product === it.product; })){
          items.push({ product: it.product, name: it.name, art: it.art });
        }
      });
    });

    if(!items.length){
      sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2>دیدگاه و پرسش و پاسخ</h2>'
        + '<p class="muted">هنوز خریدی ثبت نکرده‌اید. بعد از خرید، می‌توانید نظر و پرسش خود را ثبت کنید.</p>'
        + '<button class="btn primary block" data-action="close" style="margin-top:16px" data-autofocus>بستن</button>'
        + '</div>';
      return;
    }

    sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2>دیدگاه و پرسش و پاسخ</h2>'
      + '<p class="muted" style="margin:0 0 12px;font-size:13.5px">کالاهایی که خریده‌اید، می‌توانید برایشان نظر ثبت کنید.</p>'
      + '<div class="my-rev-list">'
      + items.slice(0,20).map(function(it){
          return '<button type="button" class="my-rev-item" data-action="open" data-id="' + it.product + '">'
            + '<span class="my-rev-thumb">' + art(it.art || 'book', '#94a3b8') + '</span>'
            + '<span class="my-rev-name">' + esc(it.name) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="my-rev-arrow">›</span>'
            + '</button>';
        }).join('')
      + '</div>'
      + '<button class="btn outline block" data-action="close" style="margin-top:14px">بستن</button>'
      + '</div>';

    sh.querySelectorAll('[data-action="open"]').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click', function(){
        closeLayer(true);
        openProduct(Number(b.dataset.id));
      });
    });
  }catch(e){
    sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2>دیدگاه و پرسش و پاسخ</h2>'
      + '<p class="err">' + esc(e.message) + '</p>'
      + '<button class="btn outline block" data-action="close" style="margin-top:12px">بستن</button>'
      + '</div>';
  }
}

async function doUserLogout(){
  try{ await apiPost('/auth/logout'); }catch(_){}
  state.user = null;
  store.set('bz.user', null);
  paintUser();
  updateCartUI();
  closeLayer();
  toast('از حساب خود خارج شدید.');
}

function attachUserMenuHover(){
  /* Auto-close on page navigation */
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', closeUserMenu);
}
attachUserMenuHover();

})();
```

```js
/* ================================================================
   config.js — تنظیمات مرکزی پروژه
   ================================================================
   این فایل باید *قبل از* همه اسکریپت‌های دیگر بارگذاری شود.

(function(){
  'use strict';

  var DEV_BACKEND_PORT = 5000;
  var DEV_PORTS = [3000, 4200, 5173, 5500, 5501, 8000, 8080];

  var loc = window.location;
  var isFile = loc.protocol === 'file:';
  var isLocalhost = loc.hostname === 'localhost'
                 || loc.hostname === '127.0.0.1'
                 || loc.hostname === '0.0.0.0'
                 || loc.hostname === '::1';
  var port = parseInt(loc.port, 10) || 0;
  var isDevPort = DEV_PORTS.indexOf(port) !== -1;

  var BACKEND_ORIGIN, MODE;

  if (isFile) {
    BACKEND_ORIGIN = 'http://127.0.0.1:' + DEV_BACKEND_PORT;
    MODE = 'file';
  } else if (isLocalhost && isDevPort) {
    BACKEND_ORIGIN = loc.protocol + '//' + loc.hostname + ':' + DEV_BACKEND_PORT;
    MODE = [REDACTED]
  } else {
    BACKEND_ORIGIN = [REDACTED]
    MODE = [REDACTED]
  }

  var API_BASE = BACKEND_ORIGIN + '/api';

  window.__API_BASE__       = API_BASE;
  window.__API_BASE         = API_BASE;
  window.__BACKEND_ORIGIN__ = BACKEND_ORIGIN;
  window.__BACKEND__        = BACKEND_ORIGIN;
  window.__API_ORIGIN__     = BACKEND_ORIGIN;
  window.__CONFIG_MODE__    = MODE;

  /* ثابت‌های ارسال — از سرور هم بیاد بهتر، ولی اینجا هاردکد برای هماهنگی */
  window.__SHIPPING__ = {
    FREE_THRESHOLD: 1000000,
    COST: 60000
  };

  window.__ASSET__ = function(u){
    if (!u) return '';
    u = String(u);
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(u)) return u;
    if (/^data:/i.test(u))         return u;
    if (/^blob:/i.test(u))         return u;
    if (u.charAt(0) === '/')       return BACKEND_ORIGIN + u;
    return BACKEND_ORIGIN + '/' + u;
  };

  window.__resolveCardImg = function(p){
    if (!p) return null;
    var imgs = p.imgs || p.images || p.image || null;
    var u = null;
    if (Array.isArray(imgs) && imgs.length) u = imgs[0];
    else if (typeof imgs === 'string') u = imgs;
    if (!u) return null;
    return window.__ASSET__(u);
  };

  console.log('[config] mode=' + MODE + '  API=' + API_BASE);
})();
```

```js
/* ==============================================================
   gallery.js — multi-image gallery for product modals
   Works for #pmThumb (site) and .adm-pv-thumb (admin)
   ============================================================== */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.__GALLERY_LOADED__) return;
  window.__GALLERY_LOADED__ = true;

  function resolve(u){
    if(!u) return '';
    u = String(u);
    if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(u) || /^data:/i.test(u)) return u;
    return window.__ASSET__(u);
  }

  function getImages(product){
    if(!product) return [];
    var arr = product.images || product.imgs || [];
    if(!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];
    return arr.filter(function(x){ return x && typeof x === 'string'; });
  }

  /* ---- build gallery HTML ---- */
  function buildGallery(images, opts){
    opts = opts || {};
    if(!images.length) return null;

    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'gal-wrap';

    var stage = document.createElement('div');
    stage.className = 'gal-stage';

    var img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'gal-main';
    img.src = resolve(images[0]);
    img.alt = opts.alt || '';
    img.setAttribute('data-index', '0');
    stage.appendChild(img);

    /* prev / next */
    if(images.length > 1){
      var prev = document.createElement('button');
      prev.type = 'button';
      prev.className = 'gal-nav gal-prev';
      prev.setAttribute('aria-label', 'قبلی');
      prev.innerHTML = '<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15 6l-6 6 6 6"/></svg>';
      stage.appendChild(prev);

      var next = document.createElement('button');
      next.type = 'button';
      next.className = 'gal-nav gal-next';
      next.setAttribute('aria-label', 'بعدی');
      next.innerHTML = '<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>';
      stage.appendChild(next);

      var counter = document.createElement('span');
      counter.className = 'gal-counter';
      counter.textContent = '۱ / ' + images.length.toLocaleString('fa-IR');
      stage.appendChild(counter);

      var ci = 0;
      function go(i){
        ci = (i + images.length) % images.length;
        img.src = resolve(images[ci]);
        counter.textContent = (ci + 1).toLocaleString('fa-IR') + ' / ' + images.length.toLocaleString('fa-IR');
        var thumbs = wrap.querySelectorAll('.gal-thumb');
        for(var k = 0; k < thumbs.length; k++){
          thumbs[k].classList.toggle('is-active', k === ci);
        }
      }

      prev.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go(ci - 1); });
      next.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go(ci + 1); });

      /* keyboard */
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
        if(!document.body.contains(wrap)) return;
        if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  go(ci + 1);
        if(e.key === 'ArrowRight') go(ci - 1);
      });

      /* swipe for mobile */
      var sx = 0, dx = 0;
      stage.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
        sx = e.touches[0].clientX;
      }, { passive: true });
      stage.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
        dx = e.touches[0].clientX - sx;
      }, { passive: true });
      stage.addEventListener('touchend', function(){
        if(Math.abs(dx) > 40){ go(dx > 0 ? ci + 1 : ci - 1); }
        dx = 0;
      });

      /* thumbnails */
      var thumbs = document.createElement('div');
      thumbs.className = 'gal-thumbs';
      images.forEach(function(u, i){
        var t = document.createElement('button');
        t.type = 'button';
        t.className = 'gal-thumb' + (i === 0 ? ' is-active' : '');
        t.setAttribute('aria-label', 'تصویر ' + (i + 1));
        var ti = document.createElement('img');
        ti.src = resolve(u);
        ti.alt = '';
        ti.loading = 'lazy';
        t.appendChild(ti);
        t.addEventListener('click', function(e){
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          go(i);
        });
        thumbs.appendChild(t);
      });

      wrap.appendChild(stage);
      wrap.appendChild(thumbs);
    } else {
      wrap.appendChild(stage);
    }

    return wrap;
  }

  /* ================================================================
     SITE — inject into #pmThumb when modal opens
     ================================================================ */
  function injectSite(){
    var thumb = document.getElementById('pmThumb');
    if(!thumb) return;
    if(thumb.querySelector('.gal-wrap')) return;

    var p = window.__curPmProduct;
    if(!p){
      /* try to read from any [data-id] in the modal */
      var idAttr = thumb.closest('[data-id]');
      if(idAttr && window.byId) p = window.byId[idAttr.getAttribute('data-id')];
    }
    if(!p) return;

    var imgs = getImages(p);
    if(!imgs.length) return;

    /* clear existing image/svg */
    var existing = thumb.querySelector('.thumb-img');
    if(existing) existing.style.display = 'none';
    var svg = thumb.querySelector('svg');
    if(svg) svg.style.display = 'none';

    /* make thumb a plain container */
    thumb.style.padding = '0';
    thumb.style.background = 'transparent';
    thumb.style.aspectRatio = '1';

    var gal = buildGallery(imgs, { alt: p.n || '' });
    if(gal){
      gal.style.borderRadius = 'inherit';
      thumb.appendChild(gal);
    }
  }

  /* ================================================================
     ADMIN — inject into .adm-pv-thumb in product view modal
     ================================================================ */
  function injectAdmin(){
    var thumb = document.querySelector('.adm-pv-thumb');
    if(!thumb) return;
    if(thumb.querySelector('.gal-wrap')) return;

    var p = window.__curPmAdminProduct;
    if(!p) return;

    var imgs = getImages(p);
    if(!imgs.length) return;

    /* hide any existing img/svg */
    var existing = thumb.querySelector('img');
    if(existing) existing.style.display = 'none';
    var svg = thumb.querySelector('svg');
    if(svg) svg.style.display = 'none';

    thumb.style.padding = '0';
    thumb.style.background = 'transparent';

    var gal = buildGallery(imgs, { alt: p.name || '' });
    if(gal){
      gal.style.borderRadius = 'inherit';
      thumb.appendChild(gal);
    }
  }

  /* ================================================================
     Observer — auto-detect modal open
     ================================================================ */
  function runAll(){
    injectSite();
    injectAdmin();
  }

  var observer = new MutationObserver(function(muts){
    var shouldRun = false;
    for(var i = 0; i < muts.length; i++){
      var m = muts[i];
      if(m.type === 'attributes' && m.target && m.target.id === 'pm'){
        shouldRun = true;
      }
      if(m.type === 'childList'){
        shouldRun = true;
      }
    }
    if(shouldRun){
      setTimeout(runAll, 60);
      setTimeout(runAll, 200);
      setTimeout(runAll, 500);
    }
  });

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
      setTimeout(runAll, 500);
    });
  } else {
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    setTimeout(runAll, 500);
  }

  window.__GALLERY_RUN__ = runAll;
  console.log('[gallery] ready');
})();
```

```js
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;

  var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(!e.isIntersecting) return;
      var img = e.target;
      if(img.dataset && img.dataset.src){
        img.src = img.dataset.src;
        delete img.dataset.src;
      }
      obs.unobserve(img);
    });
  }, { rootMargin: '200px' });

  function bind(){
    var list = document.querySelectorAll('img[data-src]');
    for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) obs.observe(list[i]);
  }

  window.__lazyBind = bind;

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bind);
  } else {
    bind();
  }

  /* MutationObserver فقط روی #grid و #offers با debounce */
  var debounceTimer = null;
  function scheduleBind(){
    if(debounceTimer) return;
    debounceTimer = setTimeout(function(){
      debounceTimer = null;
      bind();
    }, 300);
  }

  var mo = new MutationObserver(scheduleBind);
  var observed = new WeakSet();

  function observeTargets(){
    ['grid', 'offers', 'pmPanel', 'catTiles'].forEach(function(id){
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if(el && !observed.has(el)){
        observed.add(el);
        mo.observe(el, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      }
    });
  }

  /* تلاش اولیه + یک بار بعد از تأخیر کوتاه (برای زمانی که JS محتوا رو می‌سازه) */
  setTimeout(observeTargets, 500);
  setTimeout(observeTargets, 3000);
})();
```

```js
(function(){
  'use strict';

  var API = window.__API_BASE__ || '/api';

  /* هشدار: اگر hostname فرق داره، کوکی SameSite=Lax ممکنه ارسال نشه */
  try{
    var apiUrl = new URL(API, location.href);
    if(apiUrl.hostname !== location.hostname){
      console.warn("[login] hostname mismatch: page=" + location.hostname + " api=" + apiUrl.hostname + " — کوکی SameSite=Lax ممکنه ارسال نشه. از همون hostname استفاده کن.");
    }
  }catch(e){}

  var $ = function(s,r){ return (r||document).querySelector(s); };
  var $$ = function(s,r){ return Array.prototype.slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(s)); };

  var card = $('.auth-card');
  var form = $('#loginForm');
  var alertBox = $('#authAlert');
  var submitBtn = $('#authSubmit');

  function setAlert(msg, ok){
    if(!msg){ alertBox.hidden = true; return; }
    alertBox.hidden = false;
    alertBox.textContent = msg;
    alertBox.className = 'auth-alert' + (ok ? ' ok' : '');
  }

  function normPhone(v){
    return String(v || '')
      .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, function(d){ return '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d); })
      .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
  }

  function switchMode(mode){
    card.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    form.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    $$('.auth-tab').forEach(function(t){
      t.classList.toggle('is-active', t.dataset.tab === mode);
    });
    var label = $('.auth-submit-label');
    if(label) label.textContent = mode === 'signup' ? 'ساخت حساب' : 'ورود به حساب';
    var pw = $('#auPassword');
    if(pw) pw.setAttribute('autocomplete', mode === 'signup' ? 'new-password' : 'current-password');
    var pwS = $('#pwStrength');
    if(pwS) pwS.hidden = mode !== 'signup';
    setAlert('');
  }

  $$('.auth-tab').forEach(function(t){
    t.addEventListener('click', function(){ switchMode(t.dataset.tab); });
  });
  $$('[data-switch-to]').forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      switchMode(a.dataset.switchTo);
    });
  });

  $$('.auth-eye').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var inp = document.getElementById(b.dataset.eye);
      if(!inp) return;
      var on = inp.type === 'text';
      inp.type = on ? 'password' : 'text';
      b.classList.toggle('is-on', !on);
    });
  });

  var pwInput = $('#auPassword');
  if(pwInput){
    pwInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
      var v = pwInput.value;
      var bar = $('#pwStrength .auth-pw-bar i');
      var lbl = $('#pwStrength .auth-pw-lbl');
      if(!bar) return;
      var s = 0;
      if(v.length >= 8) s++;
      if(v.length >= 12) s++;
      if(/[A-Z]/.test(v) || /[آ-ی]/.test(v)) s++;
      if(/\d/.test(v)) s++;
      if(/[^A-Za-z0-9آ-ی]/.test(v)) s++;
      var pct = Math.min(100, (s/5)*100);
      bar.style.width = pct + '%';
      bar.style.background = s <= 1 ? '#b91c4a' : (s <= 3 ? '#d97706' : '#0e7c5f');
      lbl.textContent = s <= 1 ? 'ضعیف' : (s <= 3 ? 'متوسط' : (s >= 5 ? 'بسیار قوی' : 'قوی'));
    });
  }

  var otpBtn = $('#otpBtn');
  if(otpBtn){
    otpBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      setAlert('ورود با کد یکبار مصرف به زودی فعال می‌شود. لطفاً از رمز عبور استفاده کنید.');
    });
  }

  var forgotLink = $('#forgotLink');
  if(forgotLink){
    forgotLink.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      setAlert('برای بازیابی رمز، با پشتیبانی تماس بگیرید.');
    });
  }

  var phoneInput = $('#auPhone');
  if(phoneInput){
    phoneInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
      var v = normPhone(phoneInput.value);
      if(v.length > 11) v = v.slice(0, 11);
      phoneInput.value = v;
    });
  }

  form.addEventListener('submit', async function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    setAlert('');
    var mode = form.getAttribute('data-mode') || 'login';
    var phone = normPhone($('#auPhone').value);
    var password = $('#auPassword').value;

    if(!/^09\d{9}$/.test(phone)){
      setAlert('شمارهٔ موبایل باید با ۰۹ شروع شود و ۱۱ رقم باشد.');
      $('#auPhone').focus();
      return;
    }

    if(mode === 'signup'){
      var name = $('#auName').value.trim();
      var confirm = $('#auConfirm').value;
      var terms = $('#auTerms').checked;

      if(name.length < 3){ setAlert('نام حداقل ۳ کاراکتر.'); $('#auName').focus(); return; }
      if(password.length < 8){ setAlert('رمز حداقل ۸ کاراکتر.'); $('#auPassword').focus(); return; }
      if(password !== confirm){ setAlert('رمز و تکرار یکسان نیست.'); $('#auConfirm').focus(); return; }
      if(!terms){ setAlert('پذیرش قوانین الزامی است.'); return; }

      submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.classList.add('is-loading');
      try{
        var r1 = await fetch(API + '/auth/register', {
          method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include',
          body: JSON.stringify({ name: name, phone: phone, password: password })
        });
        var d1 = await r1.json();
        if(!r1.ok) throw new Error(d1.message || 'ثبت‌نام ناموفق');
        setAlert('حساب ساخته شد! در حال انتقال...', true);
        setTimeout(function(){ var u=d.user||d.data&&d.data.user; var target=(u&&u.role==="admin")?"admin.html":"index.html"; window.location.href=target; }, 700);
      }catch(err){
        setAlert(err.message || 'خطا در ثبت‌نام');
      }finally{
        submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.classList.remove('is-loading');
      }
      return;
    }

    if(!password){ setAlert('رمز عبور الزامی است.'); $('#auPassword').focus(); return; }

    submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.classList.add('is-loading');
    try{
      var r = await fetch(API + '/auth/login', {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include',
        body: JSON.stringify({ phone: phone, password: password })
      });
      var d = await r.json();
      if(!r.ok) throw new Error(d.message || 'ورود ناموفق');
      setAlert('خوش آمدید! در حال انتقال...', true);
      setTimeout(function(){ var u=d.user||d.data&&d.data.user; var target=(u&&u.role==="admin")?"admin.html":"index.html"; window.location.href=target; }, 700);
    }catch(err){
      setAlert(err.message || 'شماره یا رمز اشتباه است.');
    }finally{
      submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.classList.remove('is-loading');
    }
  });

  var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  if(params.get('signup') === '1') switchMode('signup');
})();
```

```js
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const { body } = require('express-validator');
const validate = require('../middleware/validate');
const { protect } = require('../middleware/auth');
const rateLimit = require('express-rate-limit');
const ctrl = require('../controllers/authController');

/* محدودکننده تلاش ورود */
const loginLimiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  max: 15,
  message: { success:false, message:'تعداد تلاش‌های ورود زیاد است. ۱۵ دقیقه صبر کنید.' }
});

/* ============ ثبت‌نام — فقط شماره ============ */
router.post('/register',
  loginLimiter,
  [
    body('name').trim().isLength({ min:3, max:60 }).withMessage('نام باید بین ۳ تا ۶۰ کاراکتر باشد.'),
    body('phone').trim().matches(/^09\d{9}$/).withMessage('شمارهٔ موبایل باید با ۰۹ شروع شود و ۱۱ رقم باشد.'),
    body('password').isLength({ min:8 }).withMessage('رمز عبور حداقل ۸ کاراکتر باشد.')
  ],
  validate, ctrl.register
);

/* ============ ورود — فقط شماره ============ */
router.post('/login',
  loginLimiter,
  [
    body('phone').trim().matches(/^09\d{9}$/).withMessage('شمارهٔ موبایل باید با ۰۹ شروع شود و ۱۱ رقم باشد.'),
    body('password').notEmpty().withMessage('رمز عبور الزامی است.')
  ],
  validate, ctrl.login
);

/* ============ OTP — به زودی ============ */
router.post('/otp/send', ctrl.sendOtp);
router.post('/otp/verify', ctrl.verifyOtp);

/* ============ بقیه ============ */
router.post('/logout', ctrl.logout);
router.post('/refresh', ctrl.refresh);
router.get('/me', protect, ctrl.me);
router.put('/me', protect, ctrl.updateMe);
router.put('/change-password', protect, ctrl.changePassword);

/* ============ Google (غیرفعال اگه کلید نباشه) ============ */
if(process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID){
  const passport = require('passport');
  require('../config/passport');
  router.get('/google', ctrl.googleStart);
  router.get('/google/callback',
    ctrl.googleVerifyState,
    function(req, res, next){
      const base = (process.env.CLIENT_URL || '').split(',')[0].trim() || 'http://localhost:8080';
      passport.authenticate('google', { session: false, failureRedirect: base + '/login.html?error=oauth' })(req, res, next);
    },
    ctrl.googleCallback
```
```js
  );
```
```js
}
```

```js
module.exports = router;
```

FILE: full-backup-2026-10-14T12-14-45\backend\routes\upload.js
================================================================================
```js
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const multer = require('multer');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { protect, adminOnly } = require('../middleware/auth');

const UPLOAD_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'uploads');
if(!fs.existsSync(UPLOAD_DIR)) fs.mkdirSync(UPLOAD_DIR, { recursive:true });

const ALLOWED = ['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp','image/gif','image/avif'];
const MAX_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024; /* 5MB */

const storage = multer.diskStorage({
  destination: (req, file, cb) => cb(null, UPLOAD_DIR),
  filename: (req, file, cb) => {
    const ext = (path.extname(file.originalname) || '.jpg').toLowerCase().slice(0, 6);
    const id = crypto.randomBytes(12).toString('hex');
    cb(null, 'prod-' + Date.now() + '-' + id + ext);
  }
});

const upload = multer({
  storage,
  limits: { fileSize: MAX_SIZE },
  fileFilter: (req, file, cb) => {
    if(ALLOWED.includes(file.mimetype)) return cb(null, true);
    cb(new Error('فرمت تصویر پشتیبانی نمی‌شود.'));
  }
});

/* POST /api/upload/product  — multiple images */
router.post('/product',
  protect, adminOnly,
  (req, res, next) => {
    upload.array('images', 10)(req, res, (err) => {
      if(err instanceof multer.MulterError){
        const msg = err.code === 'LIMIT_FILE_SIZE'
          ? 'حجم تصویر بیشتر از ۵ مگابایت است.'
          : err.message;
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message: msg });
      }
      if(err) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message: err.message });
      next();
    });
  },
  (req, res) => {
    if(!req.files || !req.files.length){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'هیچ فایلی ارسال نشد.' });
    }
    const urls = req.files.map(f => '/uploads/' + f.filename);
    res.json({ success:true, urls, files: req.files.map(f => ({ name:f.filename, size:f.size })) });
  }
);

/* POST /api/upload/product-single — one image */
router.post('/product-single',
  protect, adminOnly,
  (req, res, next) => {
    upload.single('image')(req, res, (err) => {
      if(err instanceof multer.MulterError){
        const msg = err.code === 'LIMIT_FILE_SIZE'
          ? 'حجم تصویر بیشتر از ۵ مگابایت است.'
          : err.message;
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message: msg });
      }
      if(err) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message: err.message });
      next();
    });
  },
  (req, res) => {
    if(!req.file){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'فایلی ارسال نشد.' });
    }
    res.json({ success:true, url:'/uploads/' + req.file.filename });
  }
);

/* DELETE /api/upload/delete — remove an uploaded file */
router.delete('/delete',
  protect, adminOnly,
  (req, res) => {
    try{
      const { url } = req.body || {};
      if(!url || !url.startsWith('/uploads/')) return res.status(400).json({ success:false });
      const filename = path.basename(url);
      const full = path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, filename);
      if(!full.startsWith(UPLOAD_DIR)) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'مسیر نامعتبر' });
      if(fs.existsSync(full)) fs.unlinkSync(full);
      res.json({ success:true });
    }catch(e){
      res.status(500).json({ success:false, message:e.message });
    }
  }
);

module.exports = router;
```

FILE: full-backup-2026-10-14T12-14-45\backend\utils\add-indexes.js
================================================================================
```js
require('dotenv').config();
const { pool } = require('../db/init');

async function hasIdx(t, n){
  const [r] = await pool.query(
    'SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=? AND TABLE_NAME=? AND INDEX_NAME=?',
    [process.env.DB_NAME, t, n]
  );
  return r[0].c > 0;
}
async function add(t, n, c){
  if(await hasIdx(t, n)){ console.log('[skip] ' + n); return; }
  try{
    await pool.query('CREATE INDEX ' + n + ' ON ' + t + ' (' + c + ')');
    console.log('[add]  ' + n);
  }catch(e){ console.log('[fail] ' + n + ' — ' + e.message); }
}
(async ()=>{
  try{
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_created', 'created_at');
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_price', 'price');
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_off', 'off');
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_stock', 'stock');
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_rating', 'rating');
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_sales', 'sales');
    await add('products', 'idx_prod_cat_active', 'category_id, is_active');
    await add('orders', 'idx_ord_created', 'created_at');
    await add('orders', 'idx_ord_status', 'status');
    await add('orders', 'idx_ord_user', 'user_id');
    await add('order_items', 'idx_oi_prod', 'product_id');
    await add('users', 'idx_usr_role', 'role');
    await add('users', 'idx_usr_created', 'created_at');
    await add('reviews', 'idx_rev_created', 'created_at');
    await add('cms_pages', 'idx_cms_menu', 'show_in_menu');
    console.log('Indexes done.');
    await pool.end();
    process.exit(0);
  }catch(e){ console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); }
})();
```

```js
const store = new Map();
const MAX_ENTRIES = 500;

function get(k){
  const it = store.get(k);
  if(!it) return null;
  if(Date.now() > it.expires){ store.delete(k); return null; }
  return it.value;
}
function set(k, v, ttl){
  if(store.size >= MAX_ENTRIES){
    const first = store.keys().next().value;
    if(first) store.delete(first);
  }
  store.set(k, { value: v, expires: Date.now() + (ttl || 60000) });
}
function del(prefix){
  if(!prefix){ store.clear(); return; }
  for(const k of store.keys()){
    if(k.indexOf(prefix) === 0) store.delete(k);
  }
}
function cacheMiddleware(ttl){
  return function(req, res, next){
    if(req.method !== 'GET') return next();

    /* اگه کوکی یا هدر Authorization هست، کش نکن (ادمین/کاربر لاگین‌شده) */
    if(req.headers && (req.headers.authorization || req.headers.cookie)){
      res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'SKIP-AUTH');
      return next();
    }

    /* کلید کش: مسیر کامل شامل path و query */
    var key = 'http:' + req.originalUrl;

    var hit = get(key);
    if(hit){
      res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'HIT');
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=' + Math.floor(ttl/1000));
      return res.json(hit);
    }

    var orig = res.json.bind(res);
    res.json = function(body){
      if(res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300){
        set(key, body, ttl);
      }
      res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'MISS');
      return orig(body);
    };
    next();
  };
}
setInterval(function(){
  const now = Date.now();
  for(const [k,v] of store.entries()){
    if(now > v.expires) store.delete(k);
  }
}, 300000);
module.exports = { get, set, del, cacheMiddleware };
```

```js
const nodemailer = require('nodemailer');

let transporter = null;
if(process.env.SMTP_HOST && process.env.SMTP_USER){
  transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
    host: process.env.SMTP_HOST,
    port: Number(process.env.SMTP_PORT || 587),
    secure: Number(process.env.SMTP_PORT) === 465,
    auth: { user: process.env.SMTP_USER, pass: process.env.SMTP_PASS }
  });
}

async function sendMail({ to, subject, text, html }){
  if(!transporter){
    console.log('\n========== [MAIL - DEV MODE] ==========');
    console.log('To:', to);
    console.log('Subject:', subject);
    console.log('Body:', text || html);
    console.log('=======================================\n');
    return { dev:true };
  }
  return transporter.sendMail({
    from: process.env.SMTP_FROM || 'Bazaarche <noreply@bazaarche.local>',
    to, subject, text, html
  });
}
module.exports = { sendMail };
```

```js
}

})();
```

FILE: full-backup-2026-10-14T12-14-45\backend\utils\make-admin.js
================================================================================
```js
require('dotenv').config();
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const { pool, q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');

(async ()=>{
  try{
    const NAME  = process.argv[2];
    const PHONE = process.argv[3];
    const PASS  = process.argv[4];

    if(!NAME || !PHONE || !PASS){
      console.error('missing args');
      process.exit(1);
    }

    /* چک اگه از قبل هست */
    let user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE phone = ? LIMIT 1', [PHONE]);
    const hash = await bcrypt.hash(PASS, 12);

    if(user){
      /* آپدیت به ادمین + رمز جدید */
      await q('UPDATE users SET name = ?, password = ?, role = ?, is_active = 1, token_version = COALESCE(token_version,0) + 1 WHERE id = ?', [NAME, hash, 'admin', user.id]);
      console.log('UPDATED');
    } else {
      /* ایجاد */
      const email = 'admin' + PHONE + '.' + Date.now().toString(36) + '@admin.local';
      const id = await insert(
        'INSERT INTO users (name, email, phone, password, role, is_active) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)',
        [NAME, email, PHONE, hash, 'admin', 1]
      );
      console.log('CREATED id=' + id);
    }

    /* لیست ادمین‌ها */
    const [admins] = await pool.query("SELECT id, name, phone, is_active FROM users WHERE role = 'admin' ORDER BY id");
    console.log('ADMINS_TOTAL=' + admins.length);
    for(const a of admins){
      console.log('  #' + a.id + '  ' + a.name + '  |  ' + a.phone + '  |  ' + (a.is_active ? 'فعال' : 'غیرفعال'));
    }

    await pool.end();
    process.exit(0);
  }catch(e){
    console.error('ERR: ' + e.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();
```

```js
const COLUMNS = [
  ['tax',               'INT DEFAULT 0'],
  ['shipment_tracking', 'VARCHAR(80)'],
  ['shipment_carrier',  'VARCHAR(60)'],
  ['internal_note',     'TEXT'],
  ['refunded_amount',   'INT DEFAULT 0'],
  ['returned_at',       'TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL'],
  ['return_reason',     'TEXT'],
  ['refunded_at',       'TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL'],
  ['refund_note',       'TEXT']
];

async function columnExists(table, col){
  const [rows] = await pool.query(
    'SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=? AND TABLE_NAME=? AND COLUMN_NAME=?',
    [process.env.DB_NAME, table, col]
  );
  return rows[0].c > 0;
}

(async ()=>{
  for(const [name, def] of COLUMNS){
    if(await columnExists('orders', name)){
      console.log('[SKIP] orders.' + name);
      continue;
    }
    await pool.query('ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN ' + name + ' ' + def);
    console.log('[ADD]  orders.' + name);
  }
  console.log('Done.');
  await pool.end();
  process.exit(0);
})().catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });
```

```js
    if(fCnt[0].c === 0){
      await pool.query('INSERT INTO site_festivals (title,subtitle,link,ends_at,bg_color,sort_order) VALUES (?,?,?,DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY),?,?)',
        ['شگفت‌انگیزها','تخفیف‌های ویژهٔ امروز','#offers','#7b1e3a',1]);
      console.log('[SEED] 1 festival');
    }

    /* seed categories اگه خالی بود */
    const [cCnt] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM categories');
    if(cCnt[0].c === 0){
      const C = [
        ['موبایل','phone','#3b82f6',1],
        ['لپ‌تاپ','laptop','#64748b',2],
        ['صوتی و تصویری','headphones','#8b5cf6',3],
        ['ساعت هوشمند','watch','#14b8a6',4],
        ['مد و پوشاک','sneaker','#f97316',5],
        ['خانه و آشپزخانه','kettle','#0ea5e9',6],
        ['کتاب','book','#eab308',7]
      ];
      for(const x of C){
        var slug = x[0].trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-').replace(/[^\w\u0600-\u06FF-]/g, '');
        await pool.query('INSERT INTO categories (name,slug,icon,color,order_num) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)', [x[0], slug, x[1], x[2], x[3]]);
      }
      console.log('[SEED] 7 categories');
    }

    console.log('done');
    await pool.end();
    process.exit(0);
  }catch(e){ console.error('ERR: ' + e.message); process.exit(1); }
})();
```

```js
function slugify(s){
  return String(s).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-').replace(/[^\w\u0600-\u06FF-]/g,'');
}

(async function run(){
  try{
    await initSchema();
    console.log('\n--- SEED START ---');

    const adminEmail = (process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL || 'admin@bazaarche.local').toLowerCase();
    const crypto = require('crypto');
const adminPass = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || ('Adm-' + crypto.randomBytes(6).toString('base64').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g,'').slice(0,10) + '!');
    const adminName  = process.env.ADMIN_NAME || 'مدیر کل';

    let admin = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?', [adminEmail]);
    if(!admin){
      const hash = await bcrypt.hash(adminPass, 10);
      const id = await insert(
        'INSERT INTO users (name, email, phone, password, role) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',
        [adminName, adminEmail, '09000000000', hash, 'admin']
      );
      admin = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [id]);
      console.log('[User] Admin created:', adminEmail, '/', adminPass);
    }else{
      await q('UPDATE users SET role = ? WHERE id = ?', ['admin', admin.id]);
      console.log('[User] Admin exists:', adminEmail);
    }

    const catMap = {};
    for(const c of CATS){
      let cat = await qOne('SELECT * FROM categories WHERE name = ?', [c.name]);
      if(!cat){
        const id = await insert(
          'INSERT INTO categories (name, slug, icon, color, order_num) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',
          [c.name, slugify(c.name), c.icon, c.color, c.order]
        );
        cat = await qOne('SELECT * FROM categories WHERE id = ?', [id]);
      }
      catMap[c.name] = cat.id;
    }
    console.log('[Category] ' + Object.keys(catMap).length + ' categories ready');

    let created = 0, skipped = 0;
    for(const p of PRODUCTS){
      const exists = await qOne('SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = ?', [p.name]);
      if(exists){ skipped++; continue; }

      const catId = catMap[p.cat];
      if(!catId) continue;

      const slug = slugify(p.name) + '-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);
      const prodId = await insert(
        'INSERT INTO products (name, slug, brand, category_id, price, off, rating, num_reviews, stock, sales, art, description, created_by) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
        [p.name, slug, p.brand, catId, p.price, p.off, p.rating, p.numReviews,
         p.stock, p.sales, p.art, p.description, admin.id]
      );

      for(const c of p.colors){
        await insert('INSERT INTO product_colors (product_id, name, hex) VALUES (?,?,?)',
          [prodId, c.name, c.hex]);
      }
      created++;
    }
    console.log('[Product] created: ' + created + ', skipped: ' + skipped);

    console.log('\n--- SEED DONE ---');
    console.log('Admin login:');
    console.log('  email:    ' + adminEmail);
    console.log('  password: ' + adminPass);
    console.log('');
    console.log('  ⚠️  این رمز را الان کپی کنید — دیگر نمایش داده نمی‌شود.');
    console.log('');

    await pool.end();
    process.exit(0);
  }catch(err){
    console.error('[Seed error]', err);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();
```

```js
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');

function signAccess(id, tv){
  return jwt.sign({ id: id, tv: tv || 0 }, process.env.JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: process.env.JWT_EXPIRE || '7d' });
}
function signRefresh(id, tv){
  return jwt.sign({ id: id, tv: tv || 0 }, process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET, { expiresIn: process.env.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRE || '30d' });
}
function verifyAccess(t){ return jwt.verify(t, process.env.JWT_SECRET); }
function verifyRefresh(t){ return jwt.verify(t, process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET); }

function setCookies(res, access, refresh){
  const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
  res.cookie('accessToken', access, {
    httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'lax', secure: isProd,
    maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
  });
  res.cookie('refreshToken', refresh, {
    httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'lax', secure: isProd,
    maxAge: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
  });
}
function clearCookies(res){
  res.clearCookie('accessToken');
  res.clearCookie('refreshToken');
}
module.exports = { signAccess, signRefresh, verifyAccess, verifyRefresh, setCookies, clearCookies };
```
