```js
/* ================================================================
   Site Festivals — بارگذاری از API
   ================================================================ */
async function loadSiteFestivals(){
  var el = document.querySelector('#offers');
  if(!el){ console.warn('[festival] #offers پیدا نشد'); return; }

  /* پاک‌سازی استایل و محتوای قبلی */
  el.removeAttribute('style');
  el.innerHTML = '';

  var r, list;
  try{
    r = await apiGet('/site/festivals');
    list = (r && r.festivals) || [];
    console.log('[festival] API برگرداند:', list.length, 'مورد');
  }catch(e){
    console.error('[festival] خطای API:', e);
    showNoFestival(el);
    return;
  }

  /* دنبال اولین جشنواره‌ی فعال و منقضی‌نشده */
  var now = Date.now();
  var chosen = null;
  for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){
    var f = list[i];
    if(f.is_active === 0 || f.is_active === false) continue;
    if(!f.ends_at){ chosen = f; break; }
    var s = String(f.ends_at).replace(' ', 'T').replace(/Z$/, '').replace(/\.\d+$/, '');
    s = s.replace(/[+-]\d{2}:\d{2}$/, '');
    var d = new Date(s);
    if(isNaN(d.getTime())) continue;
    if(d.getTime() > now){ chosen = f; break; }
  }

  /* هیچ جشنواره فعالی نیست */
  if(!chosen){
    console.log('[festival] هیچ جشنواره فعالی وجود ندارد');
    window.__festivalActive = false;
    window.__festivalEnds = 0;
    showNoFestival(el);
    return;
  }

  /* جشنواره فعال پیدا شد */
  var ff = chosen;
  var endsMs = 0;
  if(ff.ends_at){
    var ss = String(ff.ends_at).replace(' ', 'T').replace(/Z$/, '').replace(/\.\d+$/, '');
    ss = ss.replace(/[+-]\d{2}:\d{2}$/, '');
    var dd = new Date(ss);
    endsMs = isNaN(dd.getTime()) ? 0 : dd.getTime();
  }
  window.__festivalEnds = endsMs;
  window.__festivalActive = true;
  el.classList.remove('is-empty');
  el.classList.add('has-active');
  console.log('[festival] ✅ فعال:', ff.title, '| پایان:', new Date(endsMs).toLocaleString('fa-IR'));

  /* محصولات تخفیف‌دار */
  var L = ALL_PRODUCTS.filter(function(p){ return p.off >= 15 && p.st; })
    .sort(function(a, b){ return b.off - a.off; })
    .slice(0, 8);
  if(!L.length) L = ALL_PRODUCTS.filter(function(p){ return p.st; }).slice(0, 8);

  /* رندر جشنواره */
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="o-head">' +
      '<div><h2>' + esc(ff.title) + '</h2><p>' + esc(ff.subtitle || '') + '</p></div>' +
      '<div class="cd" aria-label="زمان باقی‌مانده" role="timer">' +
        '<span id="cdH">۰۰</span><span id="cdM">۰۰</span><span id="cdS">۰۰</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<button class="btn light" data-action="deals">' + esc(ff.button_text || 'دیدن همه') + '</button>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="rail" tabindex="0">' + L.map(cardHTML).join('') + '</div>';

  if(ff.image_url){
    var imgUrl = window.__ASSET__ ? window.__ASSET__(ff.image_url) : ff.image_url;
    el.style.background = ff.bg_color || '#7b1e3a';
    el.style.backgroundImage = 'linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, ' + (ff.bg_color || '#7b1e3a') + ' 60%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, ' + (ff.bg_color || '#7b1e3a') + ' 80%, transparent)), url(' + JSON.stringify(imgUrl) + ')';
    el.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
    el.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
    el.style.color = '#fff';
  } else if(ff.bg_color){
    el.style.background = ff.bg_color;
    el.style.backgroundImage = 'linear-gradient(135deg, ' + ff.bg_color + ' 0%, color-mix(in srgb, ' + ff.bg_color + ' 70%, #000) 100%)';
  }

  if(typeof tick === 'function') tick();
}

let userMenuEl = null;
let userMenuOutsideBound = false;

function handleLoginClick(btn){
  /* چک مستقیم از localStorage برای اطمینان */
  var savedUser = null;
  try{ savedUser = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bz.user') || 'null'); }catch(e){}
  var isLoggedIn = !!(state.user || savedUser);
  if(isLoggedIn){
    if(typeof toggleUserMenu === 'function') toggleUserMenu(btn);
    else if(typeof openUserMenu === 'function') openUserMenu(btn);
    else { window.location.href = 'index.html'; }
  } else {
    window.location.href = 'login.html';
  }
}

function toggleUserMenu(btn){
  if(userMenuEl){ closeUserMenu(); return; }
  openUserMenu(btn);
}

function closeUserMenu(){
  if(!userMenuEl) return;
  const el = userMenuEl;
  el.classList.remove('on');
  userMenuEl = null;
  setTimeout(function(){ el.remove(); }, 220);
  if(userMenuOutsideBound){
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', userMenuOutsideHandler);
    userMenuOutsideBound = false;
  }
  window.removeEventListener('resize', closeUserMenu);
  window.removeEventListener('scroll', closeUserMenu, true);
}

function userMenuOutsideHandler(e){
  if(userMenuEl && !userMenuEl.contains(e.target)){
    closeUserMenu();
  }
}

function openUserMenu(btn){
  const u = state.user || {};
  const initial = (u.name || 'ک').trim().charAt(0);
  const wishCount = state.wish.size || 0;

  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'user-menu';
  el.setAttribute('role', 'menu');
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="user-menu-head">
      <div class="user-menu-avatar">${esc(initial)}</div>
      <div class="user-menu-info">
        <b>${esc(u.name || 'کاربر')}</b>
        <span dir="ltr">${esc(u.email || '')}</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="user-menu-list">
      <button type="button" class="user-menu-item" data-um="orders" role="menuitem">

          <path d="M21 8v8a2 2 0 0 1-1 1.73l-7 4a2 2 0 0 1-2 0l-7-4A2 2 0 0 1 3 16V8a2 2 0 0 1 1-1.73l7-4a2 2 0 0 1 2 0l7 4A2 2 0 0 1 21 8z"/>
          <path d="M3.27 6.96 12 12.01l8.73-5.05M12 22.08V12"/>

        '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">' +
          '<rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="9" rx="1.5"/>' +
          '<rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="5" rx="1.5"/>' +
          '<rect x="14" y="12" width="7" height="9" rx="1.5"/>' +
          '<rect x="3" y="16" width="7" height="5" rx="1.5"/>' +
        '</svg>' +
        '<span>رفتن به پنل ادمین</span>' +
        '</button>' : ""}

      <button type="button" class="user-menu-item" data-um="reviews" role="menuitem">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/>

        <span>خروج از حساب کاربری</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  `;

  document.body.appendChild(el);
  userMenuEl = el;

  /* Position under the button */
  const r = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mw = el.offsetWidth;
  const mh = el.offsetHeight;

  let left = r.left + (r.width / 2) - (mw / 2);
  left = Math.max(12, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - mw - 12));

  let top = r.bottom + 10;
  if(top + mh > window.innerHeight - 12){
    top = Math.max(12, r.top - mh - 10);
  }

  el.style.top = top + 'px';
  el.style.left = left + 'px';

  requestAnimationFrame(function(){ if(userMenuEl) userMenuEl.classList.add('on'); });

  /* Handle item clicks */
  el.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-um]');
    if(!b) return;
    const um = b.dataset.um;
    closeUserMenu();
    if(um === 'admin-panel'){ window.location.href = 'admin.html'; return; }
    if(um === 'orders'){
      if(typeof openMyOrders === 'function') openMyOrders();
    }else if(um === 'wishlist'){
      gotoWishlist();
    }else if(um === 'reviews'){
      openMyReviews();
    }else if(um === 'logout'){
      doUserLogout();
    }
  });

  /* Close on outside click */
  setTimeout(function(){
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', userMenuOutsideHandler);
    userMenuOutsideBound = true;
  }, 0);

  window.addEventListener('resize', closeUserMenu);
  window.addEventListener('scroll', closeUserMenu, true);
}

function gotoWishlist(){
  if(!state.wish.size){
    toast('هنوز کالایی به علاقه‌مندی‌ها اضافه نکرده‌اید.');
    return;
  }
  closeLayer(true);
  state.wishOnly = true;
  state.shown = 12;
  renderList();
  scrollToShop();
}

async function openMyReviews(){
  const sh = $('#lgSheet');
  const x = '<button class="x icon-btn" data-action="close" aria-label="بستن">' + ic('x',22) + '</button>';
  sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2>دیدگاه و پرسش و پاسخ</h2>'
    + '<p class="muted">در حال بارگذاری...</p></div>';
  openLayer($('#lg'));

  try{
    const res = await apiGet('/orders/my');
    const orders = res.orders || [];
    const items = [];
    orders.forEach(function(o){
      (o.items || []).forEach(function(it){
        if(!items.find(function(x){ return x.product === it.product; })){
          items.push({ product: it.product, name: it.name, art: it.art });
        }
      });
    });

    if(!items.length){
      sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2>دیدگاه و پرسش و پاسخ</h2>'
        + '<p class="muted">هنوز خریدی ثبت نکرده‌اید. بعد از خرید، می‌توانید نظر و پرسش خود را ثبت کنید.</p>'
        + '<button class="btn primary block" data-action="close" style="margin-top:16px" data-autofocus>بستن</button>'
        + '</div>';
      return;
    }

    sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2>دیدگاه و پرسش و پاسخ</h2>'
      + '<p class="muted" style="margin:0 0 12px;font-size:13.5px">کالاهایی که خریده‌اید، می‌توانید برایشان نظر ثبت کنید.</p>'
      + '<div class="my-rev-list">'
      + items.slice(0,20).map(function(it){
          return '<button type="button" class="my-rev-item" data-action="open" data-id="' + it.product + '">'
            + '<span class="my-rev-thumb">' + art(it.art || 'book', '#94a3b8') + '</span>'
            + '<span class="my-rev-name">' + esc(it.name) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="my-rev-arrow">›</span>'
            + '</button>';
        }).join('')
      + '</div>'
      + '<button class="btn outline block" data-action="close" style="margin-top:14px">بستن</button>'
      + '</div>';

    sh.querySelectorAll('[data-action="open"]').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click', function(){
        closeLayer(true);
        openProduct(Number(b.dataset.id));
      });
    });
  }catch(e){
    sh.innerHTML = x + '<div class="sheet-in"><h2>دیدگاه و پرسش و پاسخ</h2>'
      + '<p class="err">' + esc(e.message) + '</p>'
      + '<button class="btn outline block" data-action="close" style="margin-top:12px">بستن</button>'
      + '</div>';
  }
}

async function doUserLogout(){
  try{ await apiPost('/auth/logout'); }catch(_){}
  state.user = null;
  try{ localStorage.removeItem('bz.user'); }catch(e){}
  try{ store.set('bz.user', null); }catch(e){}
  closeLayer();
  closeUserMenu();
  /* رفرش صفحه برای پاک کردن همه چیز */
  window.location.href = 'index.html';
}

  /* Auto-close on page navigation */
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', closeUserMenu);
}
```

```js
/* ================================================================
   config.js — تنظیمات مرکزی پروژه

   این فایل باید *قبل از* همه اسکریپت‌های دیگر بارگذاری شود.

(function(){
  'use strict';

  var DEV_BACKEND_PORT = 5000;
  var DEV_PORTS = [3000, 4200, 5173, 5500, 5501, 8000, 8080];

  var loc = window.location;
  var isFile = loc.protocol === 'file:';
  var isLocalhost = loc.hostname === 'localhost'
                 || loc.hostname === '127.0.0.1'
                 || loc.hostname === '0.0.0.0'

  var port = parseInt(loc.port, 10) || 0;
  var isDevPort = DEV_PORTS.indexOf(port) !== -1;

  var BACKEND_ORIGIN, MODE;

  if (isFile) {
    BACKEND_ORIGIN = 'http://127.0.0.1:' + DEV_BACKEND_PORT;
    MODE = 'file';
  } else if (isLocalhost && isDevPort) {

    MODE = [REDACTED]
  } else {
    BACKEND_ORIGIN = [REDACTED]
    MODE = [REDACTED]
  }

  var API_BASE = BACKEND_ORIGIN + '/api';

  window.__API_BASE__       = API_BASE;
  window.__API_BASE         = API_BASE;
  window.__BACKEND_ORIGIN__ = BACKEND_ORIGIN;
  window.__BACKEND__        = BACKEND_ORIGIN;
  window.__API_ORIGIN__     = BACKEND_ORIGIN;
  window.__CONFIG_MODE__    = MODE;

  window.__SHIPPING__ = {
    FREE_THRESHOLD: 1000000,
    COST: 60000
  };

  window.__ASSET__ = function(u){
    if (!u) return '';
    u = String(u);
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(u)) return u;
    if (/^data:/i.test(u))         return u;
    if (/^blob:/i.test(u))         return u;
    if (u.charAt(0) === '/')       return BACKEND_ORIGIN + u;
    return BACKEND_ORIGIN + '/' + u;
  };

  };
```

```js
/* ==============================================================
   gallery.js — multi-image gallery for product modals
   Works for #pmThumb (site) and .adm-pv-thumb (admin)
   ============================================================== */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.__GALLERY_LOADED__) return;
  window.__GALLERY_LOADED__ = true;

  function resolve(u){
    if(!u) return '';
    u = String(u);
    if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(u) || /^data:/i.test(u)) return u;
    return window.__ASSET__(u);
  }

  function getImages(product){
    if(!product) return [];
    var arr = product.images || product.imgs || [];
    if(!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];
    return arr.filter(function(x){ return x && typeof x === 'string'; });
  }

  /* ---- build gallery HTML ---- */
  function buildGallery(images, opts){
    opts = opts || {};
    if(!images.length) return null;

    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'gal-wrap';

    var stage = document.createElement('div');
    stage.className = 'gal-stage';

    var img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'gal-main';
    img.src = resolve(images[0]);
    img.alt = opts.alt || '';
    img.setAttribute('data-index', '0');
    stage.appendChild(img);

    /* prev / next */
    if(images.length > 1){
      var prev = document.createElement('button');
      prev.type = 'button';
      prev.className = 'gal-nav gal-prev';
      prev.setAttribute('aria-label', 'قبلی');
      prev.innerHTML = '<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15 6l-6 6 6 6"/></svg>';
      stage.appendChild(prev);

      var next = document.createElement('button');
      next.type = 'button';
      next.className = 'gal-nav gal-next';
      next.setAttribute('aria-label', 'بعدی');
      next.innerHTML = '<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>';
      stage.appendChild(next);

      var counter = document.createElement('span');
      counter.className = 'gal-counter';
      counter.textContent = '۱ / ' + images.length.toLocaleString('fa-IR');
      stage.appendChild(counter);

      var ci = 0;
      function go(i){
        ci = (i + images.length) % images.length;
        img.src = resolve(images[ci]);
        counter.textContent = (ci + 1).toLocaleString('fa-IR') + ' / ' + images.length.toLocaleString('fa-IR');
        var thumbs = wrap.querySelectorAll('.gal-thumb');
        for(var k = 0; k < thumbs.length; k++){
          thumbs[k].classList.toggle('is-active', k === ci);
        }
      }

      prev.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go(ci - 1); });
      next.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go(ci + 1); });

      /* keyboard */
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
        if(!document.body.contains(wrap)) return;
        if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  go(ci + 1);
        if(e.key === 'ArrowRight') go(ci - 1);
      });

      /* swipe for mobile */
      var sx = 0, dx = 0;
      stage.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
        sx = e.touches[0].clientX;
      }, { passive: true });
      stage.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
        dx = e.touches[0].clientX - sx;
      }, { passive: true });
      stage.addEventListener('touchend', function(){
        if(Math.abs(dx) > 40){ go(dx > 0 ? ci + 1 : ci - 1); }
        dx = 0;
      });

      /* thumbnails */
      var thumbs = document.createElement('div');
      thumbs.className = 'gal-thumbs';
      images.forEach(function(u, i){
        var t = document.createElement('button');
        t.type = 'button';
        t.className = 'gal-thumb' + (i === 0 ? ' is-active' : '');
        t.setAttribute('aria-label', 'تصویر ' + (i + 1));
        var ti = document.createElement('img');
        ti.src = resolve(u);
        ti.alt = '';
        ti.loading = 'lazy';
        t.appendChild(ti);
        t.addEventListener('click', function(e){
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          go(i);
        });
        thumbs.appendChild(t);
      });

      wrap.appendChild(stage);
      wrap.appendChild(thumbs);
    } else {
      wrap.appendChild(stage);
    }

    return wrap;
  }

  /* ================================================================
     SITE — inject into #pmThumb when modal opens
     ================================================================ */
  function injectSite(){
    var thumb = document.getElementById('pmThumb');
    if(!thumb) return;
    if(thumb.querySelector('.gal-wrap')) return;

    var p = window.__curPmProduct;
    if(!p){
      /* try to read from any [data-id] in the modal */
      var idAttr = thumb.closest('[data-id]');
      if(idAttr && window.byId) p = window.byId[idAttr.getAttribute('data-id')];
    }
    if(!p) return;

    var imgs = getImages(p);
    if(!imgs.length) return;

    /* clear existing image/svg */
    var existing = thumb.querySelector('.thumb-img');
    if(existing) existing.style.display = 'none';
    var svg = thumb.querySelector('svg');
    if(svg) svg.style.display = 'none';

    /* make thumb a plain container */
    thumb.style.padding = '0';
    thumb.style.background = 'transparent';
    thumb.style.aspectRatio = '1';

    var gal = buildGallery(imgs, { alt: p.n || '' });
    if(gal){
      gal.style.borderRadius = 'inherit';
      thumb.appendChild(gal);
    }
  }

  /* ================================================================
     ADMIN — inject into .adm-pv-thumb in product view modal
     ================================================================ */
  function injectAdmin(){
    var thumb = document.querySelector('.adm-pv-thumb');
    if(!thumb) return;
    if(thumb.querySelector('.gal-wrap')) return;

    var p = window.__curPmAdminProduct;
    if(!p) return;

    var imgs = getImages(p);
    if(!imgs.length) return;

    /* hide any existing img/svg */
    var existing = thumb.querySelector('img');
    if(existing) existing.style.display = 'none';
    var svg = thumb.querySelector('svg');
    if(svg) svg.style.display = 'none';

    thumb.style.padding = '0';
    thumb.style.background = 'transparent';

    var gal = buildGallery(imgs, { alt: p.name || '' });
    if(gal){
      gal.style.borderRadius = 'inherit';
      thumb.appendChild(gal);
    }
  }

  /* ================================================================
     Observer — auto-detect modal open
     ================================================================ */
  function runAll(){
    injectSite();
    injectAdmin();
  }

  var observer = new MutationObserver(function(muts){
    var shouldRun = false;
    for(var i = 0; i < muts.length; i++){
      var m = muts[i];
      if(m.type === 'attributes' && m.target && m.target.id === 'pm'){
        shouldRun = true;
      }
      if(m.type === 'childList'){
        shouldRun = true;
      }
    }
    if(shouldRun){
      setTimeout(runAll, 60);
      setTimeout(runAll, 200);
      setTimeout(runAll, 500);
    }
  });

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
      setTimeout(runAll, 500);
    });
  } else {
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    setTimeout(runAll, 500);
  }

  window.__GALLERY_RUN__ = runAll;
  console.log('[gallery] ready');
})();
```

FILE: full-backup-2026-10-14T12-14-45\frontend\lazy.js
================================================================================
```js
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;

  var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(!e.isIntersecting) return;
      var img = e.target;
      if(img.dataset && img.dataset.src){
        img.src = img.dataset.src;
        delete img.dataset.src;
      }
      obs.unobserve(img);
    });
  }, { rootMargin: '200px' });

  function bind(){
    var list = document.querySelectorAll('img[data-src]');
    for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) obs.observe(list[i]);
  }

  window.__lazyBind = bind;

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bind);
  } else {
    bind();
  }

  /* MutationObserver فقط روی #grid و #offers با debounce */
  var debounceTimer = null;
  function scheduleBind(){
    if(debounceTimer) return;
    debounceTimer = setTimeout(function(){
      debounceTimer = null;
      bind();
    }, 300);
  }

  var mo = new MutationObserver(scheduleBind);
  var observed = new WeakSet();

  function observeTargets(){
    ['grid', 'offers', 'pmPanel', 'catTiles'].forEach(function(id){
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if(el && !observed.has(el)){
        observed.add(el);
        mo.observe(el, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      }
    });
  }

  /* تلاش اولیه + یک بار بعد از تأخیر کوتاه (برای زمانی که JS محتوا رو می‌سازه) */
  setTimeout(observeTargets, 500);
  setTimeout(observeTargets, 3000);
})();
```

```js
(function(){
  'use strict';

  var API = window.__API_BASE__ || '/api';

  /* هشدار: اگر hostname فرق داره، کوکی SameSite=Lax ممکنه ارسال نشه */
  try{
    var apiUrl = new URL(API, location.href);
    if(apiUrl.hostname !== location.hostname){
      console.warn("[login] hostname mismatch: page=" + location.hostname + " api=" + apiUrl.hostname + " — کوکی SameSite=Lax ممکنه ارسال نشه. از همون hostname استفاده کن.");
    }
  }catch(e){}

  var $ = function(s,r){ return (r||document).querySelector(s); };
  var $$ = function(s,r){ return Array.prototype.slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(s)); };

  var card = $('.auth-card');
  var form = $('#loginForm');
  var alertBox = $('#authAlert');
  var submitBtn = $('#authSubmit');

  function setAlert(msg, ok){
    if(!msg){ alertBox.hidden = true; return; }
    alertBox.hidden = false;
    alertBox.textContent = msg;
    alertBox.className = 'auth-alert' + (ok ? ' ok' : '');
  }

  function normPhone(v){
    return String(v || '')
      .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, function(d){ return '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d); })
      .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
  }

  function switchMode(mode){
    card.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    form.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    $$('.auth-tab').forEach(function(t){
      t.classList.toggle('is-active', t.dataset.tab === mode);
    });
    var label = $('.auth-submit-label');
    if(label) label.textContent = mode === 'signup' ? 'ساخت حساب' : 'ورود به حساب';
    var pw = $('#auPassword');
    if(pw) pw.setAttribute('autocomplete', mode === 'signup' ? 'new-password' : 'current-password');
    var pwS = $('#pwStrength');
    if(pwS) pwS.hidden = mode !== 'signup';
    setAlert('');
  }

  $$('.auth-tab').forEach(function(t){
    t.addEventListener('click', function(){ switchMode(t.dataset.tab); });
  });
  $$('[data-switch-to]').forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      switchMode(a.dataset.switchTo);
    });
  });

  $$('.auth-eye').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var inp = document.getElementById(b.dataset.eye);
      if(!inp) return;
      var on = inp.type === 'text';
      inp.type = on ? 'password' : 'text';
      b.classList.toggle('is-on', !on);
    });
  });

  var pwInput = $('#auPassword');
  if(pwInput){
    pwInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
      var v = pwInput.value;
      var bar = $('#pwStrength .auth-pw-bar i');
      var lbl = $('#pwStrength .auth-pw-lbl');
      if(!bar) return;
      var s = 0;
      if(v.length >= 8) s++;
      if(v.length >= 12) s++;
      if(/[A-Z]/.test(v) || /[آ-ی]/.test(v)) s++;
      if(/\d/.test(v)) s++;
      if(/[^A-Za-z0-9آ-ی]/.test(v)) s++;
      var pct = Math.min(100, (s/5)*100);
      bar.style.width = pct + '%';
      bar.style.background = s <= 1 ? '#b91c4a' : (s <= 3 ? '#d97706' : '#0e7c5f');
      lbl.textContent = s <= 1 ? 'ضعیف' : (s <= 3 ? 'متوسط' : (s >= 5 ? 'بسیار قوی' : 'قوی'));
    });
  }

  var otpBtn = $('#otpBtn');
  if(otpBtn){
    otpBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      setAlert('ورود با کد یکبار مصرف به زودی فعال می‌شود. لطفاً از رمز عبور استفاده کنید.');
    });
  }

  var forgotLink = $('#forgotLink');
  if(forgotLink){
    forgotLink.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      setAlert('برای بازیابی رمز، با پشتیبانی تماس بگیرید.');
    });
  }

  var phoneInput = $('#auPhone');
  if(phoneInput){
    phoneInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
      var v = normPhone(phoneInput.value);
      if(v.length > 11) v = v.slice(0, 11);
      phoneInput.value = v;
    });
  }

  form.addEventListener('submit', async function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    setAlert('');
    var mode = form.getAttribute('data-mode') || 'login';
    var phone = normPhone($('#auPhone').value);
    var password = $('#auPassword').value;

    if(!/^09\d{9}$/.test(phone)){
      setAlert('شمارهٔ موبایل باید با ۰۹ شروع شود و ۱۱ رقم باشد.');
      $('#auPhone').focus();
      return;
    }

    if(mode === 'signup'){
      var name = $('#auName').value.trim();
      var confirm = $('#auConfirm').value;
      var terms = $('#auTerms').checked;

      if(name.length < 3){ setAlert('نام حداقل ۳ کاراکتر.'); $('#auName').focus(); return; }
      if(password.length < 8){ setAlert('رمز حداقل ۸ کاراکتر.'); $('#auPassword').focus(); return; }
      if(password !== confirm){ setAlert('رمز و تکرار یکسان نیست.'); $('#auConfirm').focus(); return; }
      if(!terms){ setAlert('پذیرش قوانین الزامی است.'); return; }

      submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.classList.add('is-loading');
      try{
        var r1 = await fetch(API + '/auth/register', {
          method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include',
          body: JSON.stringify({ name: name, phone: phone, password: password })
        });
        var d1 = await r1.json();
        if(!r1.ok) throw new Error(d1.message || 'ثبت‌نام ناموفق');
        setAlert('حساب ساخته شد! در حال انتقال...', true);
        setTimeout(function(){ var u=d.user||d.data&&d.data.user; var target=(u&&u.role==="admin")?"admin.html":"index.html"; window.location.href=target; }, 700);
      }catch(err){
        setAlert(err.message || 'خطا در ثبت‌نام');
      }finally{
        submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.classList.remove('is-loading');
      }
      return;
    }

    if(!password){ setAlert('رمز عبور الزامی است.'); $('#auPassword').focus(); return; }

    submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.classList.add('is-loading');
    try{
      var r = await fetch(API + '/auth/login', {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include',
        body: JSON.stringify({ phone: phone, password: password })
      });
      var d = await r.json();
      if(!r.ok) throw new Error(d.message || 'ورود ناموفق');
      setAlert('خوش آمدید! در حال انتقال...', true);
      setTimeout(function(){ var u=d.user||d.data&&d.data.user; var target=(u&&u.role==="admin")?"admin.html":"index.html"; window.location.href=target; }, 700);
    }catch(err){
      setAlert(err.message || 'شماره یا رمز اشتباه است.');
    }finally{
      submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.classList.remove('is-loading');
    }
  });

  var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  if(params.get('signup') === '1') switchMode('signup');
})();
```

```js
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');
const { signAccess, signRefresh, setCookies, clearCookies, verifyRefresh } = require('../utils/token');
const { sendMail } = require('../utils/email');

function payload(u){
  return {
    _id: u.id, id: u.id,
    name: u.name, email: u.email, phone: u.phone,
    role: u.role, avatar: u.avatar
  };
}

exports.register = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { name, email, phone, password } = req.body;
    const lowEmail = String(email || '').toLowerCase();

    const dup = await qOne(
      'SELECT id, email, phone FROM users WHERE email = ? OR phone = ? LIMIT 1',
      [lowEmail, phone]
    );
    if(dup){
      return res.status(400).json({
        success:false,
        message: dup.email === lowEmail
          ? 'این ایمیل قبلاً ثبت شده است.'
          : 'این شمارهٔ موبایل قبلاً ثبت شده است.'
      });
    }

    const hash = await bcrypt.hash(password, 10);
    const id = await insert(
      'INSERT INTO users (name, email, phone, password) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [name.trim(), lowEmail, phone.trim(), hash]
    );

    const user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    const access = signAccess(user.id);
    const refresh = signRefresh(user.id);
    setCookies(res, access, refresh);

    res.status(201).json({ success:true, user: payload(user) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.login = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { email, password } = req.body;
    if(!email || !password){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'ایمیل و رمز عبور الزامی است.' });
    }
    const user = await qOne(
      'SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ? LIMIT 1',
      [String(email).toLowerCase()]
    );
    if(!user){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'ایمیل یا رمز عبور اشتباه است.' });
    }
    const ok = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.password);
    if(!ok){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'ایمیل یا رمز عبور اشتباه است.' });
    }
    if(!user.is_active){
      return res.status(403).json({ success:false, message:'حساب شما غیرفعال شده است.' });
    }

    await q('UPDATE users SET last_login = NOW() WHERE id = ?', [user.id]);

    const access = signAccess(user.id);
    const refresh = signRefresh(user.id);
    setCookies(res, access, refresh);

    res.json({ success:true, user: payload(user) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.logout = (req, res) => {
  clearCookies(res);
  res.json({ success:true, message:'از حساب خارج شدید.' });
};

exports.refresh = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const token = req.cookies && req.cookies.refreshToken;
    if(!token){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'توکن تازه‌سازی موجود نیست.' });
    }
    const decoded = verifyRefresh(token);
    const user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ? AND is_active = 1', [decoded.id]);
    if(!user){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'کاربر معتبر نیست.' });
    }
    const access = signAccess(user.id);
    res.cookie('accessToken', access, {
      httpOnly:true, sameSite:'lax',
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
      maxAge: 7*24*60*60*1000
    });
    res.json({ success:true });
  }catch(err){
    res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'توکن نامعتبر یا منقضی شده.' });
  }
};

  }catch(err){ next(err); }

    });
    if(fields.length){
      vals.push(req.user.id);
      await q('UPDATE users SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals);
    }
    const user = await qOne(
      'SELECT id, name, email, phone, role, avatar, is_active FROM users WHERE id = ?',
      [req.user.id]
    );
    res.json({ success:true, user });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.changePassword = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { currentPassword, newPassword } = req.body;
    if(!currentPassword || !newPassword || newPassword.length < 6){
      return res.status(400).json({
        success:false,
        message:'رمز فعلی و رمز جدید (حداقل ۶ کاراکتر) الزامی است.'
      });
    }
    const user = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.user.id]);
    const ok = await bcrypt.compare(currentPassword, user.password);
    if(!ok){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'رمز فعلی اشتباه است.' });
    }
    const hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 10);
    await q('UPDATE users SET password = ? WHERE id = ?', [hash, user.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, message:'رمز عبور تغییر کرد.' });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.forgotPassword = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { email } = req.body;
    if(!email){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'ایمیل الزامی است.' });
    }
    const user = await qOne(
      'SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ? LIMIT 1',
      [String(email).toLowerCase()]
    );
    const safe = { success:true, message:'اگر این ایمیل در سیستم باشد، لینک بازیابی ارسال می‌شود.' };
    if(!user) return res.json(safe);

    const raw = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    const hashed = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex');
    const expire = Date.now() + 10*60*1000;
    await q(
      'UPDATE users SET reset_token = ?, reset_expire = ? WHERE id = ?',
      [hashed, expire, user.id]
    );

    const base = (process.env.CLIENT_URL || 'http://localhost:3000').split(',')[0].trim();
    const url = base + '/reset-password?token=' + raw;

    await sendMail({
      to: user.email,
      subject: 'بازیابی رمز عبور - بازارچه',
      text: 'برای تغییر رمز عبور روی لینک زیر کلیک کنید:\n\n' + url + '\n\nاین لینک ۱۰ دقیقه اعتبار دارد.'
    });

    const body = { ...safe };
    if(process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') body.devToken = raw;
    res.json(body);
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.resetPassword = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { token, newPassword } = req.body;
    if(!token || !newPassword || newPassword.length < 6){
      return res.status(400).json({
        success:false,
        message:'توکن و رمز جدید معتبر (حداقل ۶ کاراکتر) لازم است.'
      });
    }
    const hashed = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
    const user = await qOne(
      'SELECT * FROM users WHERE reset_token = ? AND reset_expire > ? LIMIT 1',
      [hashed, Date.now()]
    );
    if(!user){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'توکن نامعتبر یا منقضی شده است.' });
    }
    const hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 10);
    await q(
      'UPDATE users SET password = ?, reset_token = NULL, reset_expire = NULL WHERE id = ?',
      [hash, user.id]
    );
    res.json({ success:true, message:'رمز عبور با موفقیت تغییر کرد.' });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};
```

```js
function slugify(s){
  return String(s || '').trim().toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
    .replace(/[^\w\u0600-\u06FF-]/g, '')
    .slice(0, 110);
}
```

```js
const { q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');

const FREE_SHIPPING = 1000000;
const SHIPPING_COST = 60000;

function finalPrice(p){
  return Math.round(p.price * (1 - p.off/100) / 1000) * 1000;
}

async function getOrderItems(orderId){
  return q('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', [orderId]);
}

async function buildOrder(order){
  const items = await getOrderItems(order.id);
  return {
    ...order,
    _id: order.id,
    items: items.map(i => ({
      _id: i.id,
      product: i.product_id,
      name: i.name,
      art: i.art,
      color: i.color_name ? { name:i.color_name, hex:i.color_hex } : null,
      price: i.price,
      qty: i.qty,
      lineTotal: i.line_total
    })),
    shippingAddress: {
      name: order.shipping_name,
      phone: order.shipping_phone,
      province: order.shipping_province,
      city: order.shipping_city,
      street: order.shipping_street,
      postalCode: order.shipping_postal
    },
    itemsPrice: order.items_price,
    discountAmount: Number(order.discount||0),
    tax: Number(order.tax||0),
    shippingPrice: order.shipping_price,
    totalPrice: order.total_price,
    paymentMethod: order.payment_method,
    trackingCode: order.tracking_code,
    shipmentTracking: order.shipment_tracking || null,
    shipmentCarrier: order.shipment_carrier || null,
    customerNote: order.note || '',
    internalNote: order.internal_note || '',
    refundedAmount: Number(order.refunded_amount||0),
    returnedAt: order.returned_at,
    returnReason: order.return_reason,
    refundedAt: order.refunded_at,
    refundNote: order.refund_note,
    createdAt: order.created_at
  };
}

exports.create = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { items, shippingAddress, paymentMethod, note } = req.body;
    if(!Array.isArray(items) || !items.length){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'سبد خرید خالی است.' });
    }
    if(!shippingAddress || !shippingAddress.name || !shippingAddress.city || !shippingAddress.street){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'اطلاعات نشانی ناقص است.' });
    }

    let itemsPrice = 0;
    const prepared = [];

    for(const raw of items){
      const p = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ? AND is_active = 1', [raw.product]);
      if(!p){
        return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'کالای انتخاب‌شده در دسترس نیست.' });
      }
      const qty = Math.max(1, Number(raw.qty) || 1);
      if(p.stock < qty){
        return res.status(400).json({
          success:false,
          message:'موجودی «' + p.name + '» کافی نیست.'
        });
      }
      const fp = finalPrice(p);
      const lineTotal = fp * qty;
      itemsPrice += lineTotal;

      let color = null;
      if(raw.color && raw.color.name){
        color = raw.color;
      }else{
        const c = await qOne('SELECT name, hex FROM product_colors WHERE product_id = ? LIMIT 1', [p.id]);
        if(c) color = { name:c.name, hex:c.hex };
      }

      prepared.push({
        product_id: p.id, name: p.name, art: p.art,
        color_name: color ? color.name : null,
        color_hex:  color ? color.hex  : null,
        price: fp, qty, line_total: lineTotal
      });
    }

    const shippingPrice = itemsPrice >= FREE_SHIPPING ? 0 : SHIPPING_COST;
    const totalPrice = itemsPrice + shippingPrice;
    const trackCode = 'BZ-' + Math.floor(100000 + Math.random()*900000);

    const orderId = await insert(
      'INSERT INTO orders (user_id, payment_method, items_price, shipping_price, total_price, status, tracking_code, note, shipping_name, shipping_phone, shipping_province, shipping_city, shipping_street, shipping_postal) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
      [
        req.user.id,
        paymentMethod || 'online',
        itemsPrice, shippingPrice, totalPrice,
        paymentMethod === 'online' ? 'paid' : 'pending',
        trackCode, note || '',
        shippingAddress.name, shippingAddress.phone,
        shippingAddress.province || null,
        shippingAddress.city, shippingAddress.street,
        shippingAddress.postalCode || null
      ]
    );

    for(const it of prepared){
      await insert(
        'INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, name, art, color_name, color_hex, price, qty, line_total) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
        [orderId, it.product_id, it.name, it.art, it.color_name, it.color_hex, it.price, it.qty, it.line_total]
      );
      await q('UPDATE products SET stock = stock - ?, sales = sales + ? WHERE id = ?',
        [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
    }

    if(paymentMethod === 'online'){
      await q('UPDATE orders SET paid_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?', [orderId]);
    }

    const order = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [orderId]);
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, order: await buildOrder(order) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.cancel = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const order = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!order){
      return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' });
    }
    if(order.user_id !== req.user.id && req.user.role !== 'admin'){
      return res.status(403).json({ success:false, message:'دسترسی ندارید.' });
    }
    if(['shipped','delivered','cancelled'].includes(order.status)){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این سفارش دیگر قابل لغو نیست.' });
    }
    await q('UPDATE orders SET status = ? WHERE id = ?', ['cancelled', order.id]);

    const its = await getOrderItems(order.id);
    for(const it of its){
      await q('UPDATE products SET stock = stock + ?, sales = sales - ? WHERE id = ?',
        [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
    }

    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: await buildOrder(updated) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }

exports.listAll = async (req, res, next) => {

    const limit = Math.min(200, Number(req.query.limit) || 30);
    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

    const where = ['1=1'];
    const params = [];

    if(req.query.status){ where.push('o.status = ?'); params.push(req.query.status); }
    if(req.query.q){
      where.push('(o.tracking_code LIKE ? OR o.shipment_tracking LIKE ?)');
      const like = '%' + req.query.q + '%';
      params.push(like, like);
    }
    if(req.query.customer){
      where.push('(o.shipping_name LIKE ? OR o.shipping_phone LIKE ?)');
      const like = '%' + req.query.customer + '%';
      params.push(like, like);
    }
    if(req.query.from){ where.push('o.created_at >= ?'); params.push(req.query.from + ' 00:00:00'); }
    if(req.query.to){ where.push('o.created_at <= ?'); params.push(req.query.to + ' 23:59:59'); }

    const rows = await q(
      'SELECT o.*, u.name as user_name, u.email as user_email ' +
      'FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id ' +
      'WHERE ' + where.join(' AND ') + ' ' +
      'ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',
      [...params, limit, offset]
    );
    const totalRow = await qOne(
      'SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM orders o WHERE ' + where.join(' AND '),
      params
    );

    const items = await Promise.all(rows.map(async r => {
      const built = await buildOrder(r);
      built.user = { name: r.user_name, email: r.user_email };
      return built;
    }));

    res.json({
      success:true,
      items,
      pagination: { page, limit, total: totalRow.c, pages: Math.ceil(totalRow.c / limit) }
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Full dashboard for admin panel
------------------------------------------------------------------ */
exports.fullDashboard = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    /* ---- فروش امروز / هفته / ماه / سال ---- */
    const todayRow = await qOne(
      "SELECT COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()"
    );
    const weekRow = await qOne(
      "SELECT COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)"
    );
    const monthRow = await qOne(
      "SELECT COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)"
    );
    const yearRow = await qOne(
      "SELECT COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(NOW())"
    );

    /* ---- سفارش‌ها بر اساس وضعیت ---- */
    const statusRows = await q("SELECT status, COUNT(*) c FROM orders GROUP BY status");
    const statusCounts = { pending:0, paid:0, processing:0, shipped:0, delivered:0, cancelled:0, refunded:0 };
    statusRows.forEach(r=>{ statusCounts[r.status] = r.c; });

    /* ---- کاربران ---- */
    const usersRow = await qOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM users WHERE role = 'user'");

    /* ---- محصولات ---- */
    const prodRow = await qOne(
      "SELECT COUNT(*) total, " +
      "SUM(CASE WHEN stock = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) oos, " +
      "SUM(CASE WHEN stock > 0 AND stock <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) low " +
      "FROM products WHERE is_active = 1"
    );

    /* ---- درآمد و مبالغ ---- */
    const revRow = await qOne(
      "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid','processing','shipped','delivered')"
    );
    const pendingRow = await qOne(
      "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending'"
    );

    /* ---- نمودار ۷ روز اخیر ---- */
    const dailyRaw = await q(
      "SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') d, COUNT(*) c, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s " +
      "FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) " +
      "GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY d"
    );
    const dailyMap = {};
    dailyRaw.forEach(r=>{ dailyMap[r.d] = { c:Number(r.c), s:Number(r.s) }; });
    const chartDaily = [];
    for(let i=6;i>=0;i--){
      const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      const key = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
      const row = dailyMap[key] || { c:0, s:0 };
      chartDaily.push({ date:key, orders:row.c, revenue:row.s });
    }

    /* ---- نمودار ۶ ماه اخیر ---- */
    const monthlyRaw = await q(
      "SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') m, COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) s " +
      "FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) " +
      "GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY m"
    );
    const monthlyMap = {};
    monthlyRaw.forEach(r=>{ monthlyMap[r.m] = Number(r.s); });
    const chartMonthly = [];
    for(let i=5;i>=0;i--){
      const d = new Date(); d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - i);
      const key = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0');
      chartMonthly.push({ month:key, revenue: monthlyMap[key] || 0 });
    }

    /* ---- پرفروش‌ترین محصولات ---- */
    const bestSellers = await q(
      "SELECT id, name, brand, sales, price, off, art, stock " +
      "FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5"
    );

    /* ---- آخرین سفارش‌ها ---- */
    const latestOrders = await q(
      "SELECT id, tracking_code, shipping_name, total_price, status, created_at " +
      "FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 6"
    );

    /* ---- هشدارها ---- */
    const alerts = [];
    if(Number(prodRow.oos) > 0)
      alerts.push({ type:'danger', icon:'box', text: prodRow.oos + ' محصول ناموجود شده است.' });
    if(Number(prodRow.low) > 0)
      alerts.push({ type:'warn', icon:'trend', text: prodRow.low + ' محصول موجودی کمتر از ۵ عدد دارد.' });
    if(statusCounts.pending > 0)
      alerts.push({ type:'info', icon:'cart', text: statusCounts.pending + ' سفارش در انتظار پرداخت است.' });
    if(statusCounts.refunded > 0)
      alerts.push({ type:'warn', icon:'ret', text: statusCounts.refunded + ' سفارش مرجوع شده است.' });

    res.json({
      success:true,
      today:  { orders: Number(todayRow.c),  revenue: Number(todayRow.s) },
      week:   { orders: Number(weekRow.c),   revenue: Number(weekRow.s) },
      month:  { orders: Number(monthRow.c),  revenue: Number(monthRow.s) },
      year:   { orders: Number(yearRow.c),   revenue: Number(yearRow.s) },
      statusCounts,
      users: Number(usersRow.c),
      products: {
        total: Number(prodRow.total) || 0,
        lowStock: Number(prodRow.low) || 0,
        outOfStock: Number(prodRow.oos) || 0
      },
      revenue: Number(revRow.s),
      pendingAmount: Number(pendingRow.s),
      chartDaily,
      chartMonthly,
      bestSellers: bestSellers.map(p=>{
        const fp = Math.round(p.price * (1 - p.off/100) / 1000) * 1000;
        return {
          id:p.id, name:p.name, brand:p.brand, art:p.art,
          sales:Number(p.sales)||0,
          revenue: fp * (Number(p.sales)||0)
        };
      }),
      latestOrders: latestOrders.map(o=>({
        id:o.id,
        trackingCode:o.tracking_code,
        customer:o.shipping_name,
        total:Number(o.total_price),
        status:o.status,
        createdAt:o.created_at
      })),
      alerts
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.updateShipment = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { shipmentTracking, shipmentCarrier } = req.body;
    const fields = [];
    const vals = [];
    if(shipmentTracking !== undefined){ fields.push('shipment_tracking = ?'); vals.push(shipmentTracking || null); }
    if(shipmentCarrier !== undefined){ fields.push('shipment_carrier = ?'); vals.push(shipmentCarrier || null); }

    /* If shipment tracking is set and status is paid/processing, move to shipped */
    if(shipmentTracking){
      const cur = await qOne('SELECT status FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
      if(cur && ['paid','processing'].includes(cur.status)){
        fields.push("status = 'shipped'");
      }
    }

    if(fields.length){
      vals.push(req.params.id);
      await q('UPDATE orders SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals);
    }
    const order = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!order) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' });
    res.json({ success:true, order: await buildOrder(order) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.updateFinancial = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const order = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!order) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' });

    const tax       = req.body.tax !== undefined       ? Math.max(0, Number(req.body.tax)||0) : Number(order.tax||0);
    const discount  = req.body.discount !== undefined  ? Math.max(0, Number(req.body.discount)||0) : Number(order.discount||0);
    const shipping  = req.body.shippingCost !== undefined ? Math.max(0, Number(req.body.shippingCost)||0) : Number(order.shipping_price||0);

    const total = Number(order.items_price||0) + tax + shipping - discount;

    await q(
      'UPDATE orders SET tax = ?, discount = ?, shipping_price = ?, total_price = ? WHERE id = ?',
      [tax, discount, shipping, Math.max(0, total), order.id]
    );

    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: await buildOrder(updated) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.refund = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { amount, note } = req.body;
    const order = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!order) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' });

    const amt = Math.max(0, Number(amount)||0);
    if(amt <= 0) return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'مبلغ بازپرداخت الزامی است.' });

    await q(
      'UPDATE orders SET refunded_amount = ?, refund_note = ?, refunded_at = NOW(), status = ? WHERE id = ?',
      [amt, note||'', 'refunded', order.id]
    );

    /* Restore stock */
    const its = await getOrderItems(order.id);
    for(const it of its){
      await q('UPDATE products SET stock = stock + ?, sales = GREATEST(sales - ?, 0) WHERE id = ?',
        [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
    }

    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: await buildOrder(updated) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.markReturned = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const { reason } = req.body;
    if(!reason || reason.trim().length < 3){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'دلیل مرجوعی الزامی است.' });
    }
    const order = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!order) return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'سفارش پیدا نشد.' });

    await q(
      'UPDATE orders SET returned_at = NOW(), return_reason = ?, status = ? WHERE id = ?',
      [reason.trim(), 'refunded', order.id]
    );

    const its = await getOrderItems(order.id);
    for(const it of its){
      await q('UPDATE products SET stock = stock + ?, sales = GREATEST(sales - ?, 0) WHERE id = ?',
        [it.qty, it.qty, it.product_id]);
    }

    const updated = await qOne('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [order.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, order: await buildOrder(updated) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};
```

```js
const { q, qOne, insert } = require('../db/init');

function slugify(s){
  return String(s).trim().toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
    .replace(/[^\w\u0600-\u06FF-]/g, '')
    .slice(0, 200);
}

function parseJSON(v, fallback){
  if(v === null || v === undefined) return fallback;
  if(typeof v === 'object') return v;
  try{ return JSON.parse(v); }catch(e){ return fallback; }
}

async function hydrate(product){
  if(!product) return null;
  const colors = await q('SELECT name, hex FROM product_colors WHERE product_id = ?', [product.id]);
  const specs  = await q('SELECT spec_key, value FROM product_specs WHERE product_id = ?', [product.id]);
  const finalPrice = Math.round(product.price * (1 - product.off/100) / 1000) * 1000;
  const cat = await qOne('SELECT id, name, slug, color, icon FROM categories WHERE id = ?', [product.category_id]);

  const images = parseJSON(product.images, []);
  const features = parseJSON(product.features, []);
  const sizes = parseJSON(product.sizes, []);

  return {
    ...product,
    _id: product.id,
    id: product.id,
    price: Number(product.price),
    purchasePrice: Number(product.purchase_price || 0),
    off: Number(product.off),
    rating: Number(product.rating),
    numReviews: Number(product.num_reviews),
    stock: Number(product.stock),
    minStock: Number(product.min_stock || 3),
    sales: Number(product.sales),
    weight: Number(product.weight || 0),
    isActive: !!product.is_active,
    sku: product.sku || '',
    shortDescription: product.short_description || '',
    videoUrl: product.video_url || '',
    dimensions: product.dimensions || '',
    warranty: product.warranty || '',
    metaTitle: product.meta_title || '',
    metaDescription: product.meta_description || '',
    images: Array.isArray(images) ? images : [],
    features: Array.isArray(features) ? features : [],
    sizes: Array.isArray(sizes) ? sizes : [],
    colors,
    specs: specs.map(s => ({ key: s.spec_key, value: s.value })),
    finalPrice,
    profit: Number(product.price) - Number(product.purchase_price || 0),
    inStock: Number(product.stock) > 0,
    isLowStock: Number(product.stock) > 0 && Number(product.stock) <= Number(product.min_stock || 3),
    category: cat ? { _id: cat.id, ...cat } : null,
    category_id: undefined,
    num_reviews: undefined,
    is_active: undefined,
    purchase_price: undefined,
    short_description: undefined,
    video_url: undefined,
    min_stock: undefined,
    meta_title: undefined,
    meta_description: undefined,
    published_at: undefined
  };
}

exports.list = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const page = Math.max(1, Number(req.query.page) || 1);
    const limit = Math.min(60, Number(req.query.limit) || 12);
    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

    let where = ['p.is_active = 1'];
    const params = [];

    if(req.query.category){
      const cat = await qOne('SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = ?', [req.query.category]);
      if(cat){ where.push('p.category_id = ?'); params.push(cat.id); }
    }
    if(req.query.brand){
      where.push('p.brand = ?'); params.push(req.query.brand);
    }
    if(req.query.q){
      where.push('(p.name LIKE ? OR p.brand LIKE ? OR p.description LIKE ?)');
      const like = '%' + req.query.q + '%';
      params.push(like, like, like);
    }
    if(req.query.minPrice){ where.push('p.price >= ?'); params.push(Number(req.query.minPrice)); }
    if(req.query.maxPrice){ where.push('p.price <= ?'); params.push(Number(req.query.maxPrice)); }
    if(req.query.inStock === 'true') where.push('p.stock > 0');
    if(req.query.hasOff === 'true')  where.push('p.off > 0');
    if(req.query.minRating){ where.push('p.rating >= ?'); params.push(Number(req.query.minRating)); }

    const sortMap = {
      sales:  'p.sales DESC',
      rate:   'p.rating DESC, p.num_reviews DESC',
      cheap:  'p.price ASC',
      exp:    'p.price DESC',
      off:    'p.off DESC',
      newest: 'p.created_at DESC'
    };
    const orderBy = sortMap[req.query.sort] || 'p.sales DESC';

    const sql = 'SELECT p.* FROM products p WHERE ' + where.join(' AND ') +
                ' ORDER BY ' + orderBy + ' LIMIT ? OFFSET ?';
    const rows = await q(sql, [...params, limit, offset]);

    const totalRow = await qOne(
      'SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM products p WHERE ' + where.join(' AND '),
      params
    );
    const total = totalRow ? totalRow.c : 0;

    const items = await Promise.all(rows.map(hydrate));

    res.json({
      success:true,
      items,
      pagination: { page, limit, total, pages: Math.ceil(total / limit) }
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.getOne = async (req, res, next) => {

      [key]
    );

      return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'محصول پیدا نشد.' });

async function resolveCategoryId(catOrSlug){
  if(!catOrSlug) return null;
  if(/^\d+$/.test(String(catOrSlug))) return Number(catOrSlug);
  const row = await qOne('SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = ?', [catOrSlug]);
  return row ? row.id : null;
}

async function saveRelated(pid, body){
  if(Array.isArray(body.colors)){
    await q('DELETE FROM product_colors WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
    for(const c of body.colors){
      if(c && c.name && c.hex) await insert(
        'INSERT INTO product_colors (product_id, name, hex) VALUES (?,?,?)',
        [pid, c.name, c.hex]
      );
    }
  }
  if(Array.isArray(body.specs)){
    await q('DELETE FROM product_specs WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
    for(const s of body.specs){
      const k = s && (s.key || s.spec_key || (Array.isArray(s) ? s[0] : null));
      const v = s && (s.value || (Array.isArray(s) ? s[1] : null));
      if(k && v) await insert(
        'INSERT INTO product_specs (product_id, spec_key, value) VALUES (?,?,?)',
        [pid, k, v]
      );
    }
  }
}

exports.create = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const b = req.body;
    const categoryId = await resolveCategoryId(b.category);
    if(!categoryId){
      return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'دسته‌بندی پیدا نشد.' });
    }
    const slug = slugify(b.name) + '-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);
    const sku = b.sku || ('SKU-' + Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase());

    const id = await insert(
      'INSERT INTO products (name, slug, sku, brand, category_id, price, purchase_price, off, stock, min_stock, weight, dimensions, art, description, short_description, images, video_url, features, sizes, warranty, meta_title, meta_description, is_active, created_by) ' +
      'VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
      [
        b.name, slug, sku, b.brand, categoryId,
        Number(b.price)||0, Number(b.purchasePrice)||0, Number(b.off)||0,
        Number(b.stock)||0, Number(b.minStock)||3,
        Number(b.weight)||0, b.dimensions||'',
        b.art || 'book', b.description || '', b.shortDescription || '',
        JSON.stringify(b.images||[]), b.videoUrl||'',
        JSON.stringify(b.features||[]), JSON.stringify(b.sizes||[]),
        b.warranty||'', b.metaTitle||'', b.metaDescription||'',
        b.isActive === false ? 0 : 1, req.user.id
      ]
    );
    await saveRelated(id, b);
    const product = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, product: await hydrate(product) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.update = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const b = req.body;
    const existing = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!existing){
      return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'محصول پیدا نشد.' });
    }

    const fields = [];
    const vals = [];
    const map = {
      name:'name', sku:'sku', brand:'brand',
      price:'price', purchasePrice:'purchase_price', off:'off',
      stock:'stock', minStock:'min_stock', weight:'weight', dimensions:'dimensions',
      art:'art', description:'description', shortDescription:'short_description',
      videoUrl:'video_url', warranty:'warranty',
      metaTitle:'meta_title', metaDescription:'meta_description'
    };
    Object.keys(map).forEach(k => {
      if(b[k] !== undefined){
        fields.push(map[k] + ' = ?');
        vals.push(b[k]);
      }
    });
    if(b.isActive !== undefined){ fields.push('is_active = ?'); vals.push(b.isActive ? 1 : 0); }
    if(Array.isArray(b.images)){ fields.push('images = ?'); vals.push(JSON.stringify(b.images)); }
    if(Array.isArray(b.features)){ fields.push('features = ?'); vals.push(JSON.stringify(b.features)); }
    if(Array.isArray(b.sizes)){ fields.push('sizes = ?'); vals.push(JSON.stringify(b.sizes)); }
    if(b.category){
      const cid = await resolveCategoryId(b.category);
      if(cid){ fields.push('category_id = ?'); vals.push(cid); }
    }

    if(fields.length){
      vals.push(req.params.id);
      await q('UPDATE products SET ' + fields.join(', ') + ' WHERE id = ?', vals);
    }

    await saveRelated(req.params.id, b);

    const product = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, product: await hydrate(product) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.remove = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    await q('DELETE FROM products WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    res.json({ success:true, message:'محصول حذف شد.' });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.toggleActive = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    await q('UPDATE products SET is_active = 1 - is_active WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    const product = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!product){
      return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'محصول پیدا نشد.' });
    }
    res.json({ success:true, product: await hydrate(product) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.stats = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const total = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products');
    const oos = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE stock = 0');
    const low = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE stock > 0 AND stock <= 5');
    const disc = await qOne('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM products WHERE off > 0');
    res.json({
      success:true,
      stats:{
        total: total.c, outOfStock: oos.c,
        lowStock: low.c, discounts: disc.c
      }
    });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

exports.generateSku = async (req, res, next) => {

    const sku = prefix + '-' + Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase();
    res.json({ success:true, sku });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};

------------------------------------------------------------------ */
exports.duplicate = async (req, res, next) => {
  try{
    const src = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if(!src){
      return res.status(404).json({ success:false, message:'محصول پیدا نشد.' });
    }
    const slug = slugify(src.name) + '-copy-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);
    const sku = 'SKU-' + Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase();

    const id = await insert(
      'INSERT INTO products (name, slug, sku, brand, category_id, price, purchase_price, off, stock, min_stock, weight, dimensions, art, description, short_description, images, video_url, features, sizes, warranty, meta_title, meta_description, is_active, created_by) ' +
      'VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
      [
        src.name + ' (کپی)', slug, sku, src.brand, src.category_id,
        src.price, src.purchase_price, src.off, 0, src.min_stock,
        src.weight, src.dimensions, src.art, src.description, src.short_description,
        src.images, src.video_url, src.features, src.sizes,
        src.warranty, src.meta_title, src.meta_description,
        0, req.user.id
      ]
    );

    const colors = await q('SELECT name, hex FROM product_colors WHERE product_id = ?', [src.id]);
    for(const c of colors){
      await insert('INSERT INTO product_colors (product_id, name, hex) VALUES (?,?,?)', [id, c.name, c.hex]);
    }
    const specs = await q('SELECT spec_key, value FROM product_specs WHERE product_id = ?', [src.id]);
    for(const s of specs){
      await insert('INSERT INTO product_specs (product_id, spec_key, value) VALUES (?,?,?)', [id, s.spec_key, s.value]);
    }

    const product = await qOne('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    res.status(201).json({ success:true, product: await hydrate(product) });
  }catch(err){ next(err); }
};
```

```js
const { qOne } = require('../db/init');
const { verifyAccess } = require('../utils/token');

function extractToken(req){
  if(req.cookies && req.cookies.accessToken) return req.cookies.accessToken;
  const h = req.headers.authorization;
  if(h && h.startsWith('Bearer ')) return h.slice(7);
  return null;
}

async function protect(req, res, next){
  try{
    const token = extractToken(req);
    if(!token) return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'برای دسترسی باید وارد شوید.' });
    const decoded = verifyAccess(token);
    const user = await qOne(
      'SELECT id, name, email, phone, role, avatar, is_active FROM users WHERE id = ?',
      [decoded.id]
    );
    if(!user || !user.is_active){
      return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'حساب یافت نشد یا غیرفعال است.' });
    }
    req.user = user;
    next();
  }catch(err){
    return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'توکن نامعتبر است.' });
  }
}

function adminOnly(req, res, next){
  if(!req.user || req.user.role !== 'admin'){
    return res.status(403).json({ success:false, message:'دسترسی فقط برای مدیران.' });
  }
  next();
}

async function optionalAuth(req, res, next){
  try{
    const token = extractToken(req);
    if(token){
      const decoded = verifyAccess(token);
      req.user = await qOne('SELECT id, name, email, role FROM users WHERE id = ?', [decoded.id]);
    }
  }catch(e){ /* ignore */ }
  next();
}

module.exports = { protect, adminOnly, optionalAuth };
```

```js
function errorHandler(err, req, res, next){
  console.error('[Error]', err.message);

  if(err.code === 'ER_DUP_ENTRY'){
    return res.status(400).json({ success:false, message:'این مقدار قبلاً استفاده شده است.' });
  }
  if(err.name === 'JsonWebTokenError'){
    return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'توکن نامعتبر است.' });
  }
  if(err.name === 'TokenExpiredError'){
    return res.status(401).json({ success:false, message:'توکن منقضی شده است.' });
  }
  res.status(err.statusCode || 500).json({
    success:false,
    message: err.message || 'خطای داخلی سرور',
    ...(process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && { stack: err.stack })
  });
}
module.exports = errorHandler;
```

FILE: _backup_1791111596832\backend__utils__cache.js
================================================================================
```js
const store = new Map();

function get(k){
  const it = store.get(k);
  if(!it) return null;
  if(Date.now() > it.expires){ store.delete(k); return null; }
  return it.value;
}
function set(k, v, ttl){
  store.set(k, { value: v, expires: Date.now() + (ttl || 60000) });
}
function del(prefix){
  if(!prefix){ store.clear(); return; }
  for(const k of store.keys()){
    if(k.indexOf(prefix) === 0) store.delete(k);
  }
}
function cacheMiddleware(ttl){
  return function(req, res, next){
    if(req.method !== 'GET') return next();
    const key = 'http:' + req.originalUrl;
    const hit = get(key);
    if(hit){
      res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'HIT');
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=' + Math.floor(ttl/1000));
      return res.json(hit);
    }
    const orig = res.json.bind(res);
    res.json = function(body){
      if(res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) set(key, body, ttl);
      res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'MISS');
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=' + Math.floor(ttl/1000));
      return orig(body);
    };
    next();
  };
}
setInterval(function(){
  const now = Date.now();
  for(const [k,v] of store.entries()){
    if(now > v.expires) store.delete(k);
  }
}, 300000);
module.exports = { get, set, del, cacheMiddleware };
```

```js
function slugify(s){
  return String(s).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-').replace(/[^\w\u0600-\u06FF-]/g,'');
}

(async function run(){
  try{
    await initSchema();
    console.log('\n--- SEED START ---');

    const adminEmail = (process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL || 'admin@bazaarche.local').toLowerCase();
    const adminPass  = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'Admin@1234';
    const adminName  = process.env.ADMIN_NAME || 'مدیر کل';

    let admin = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?', [adminEmail]);
    if(!admin){
      const hash = await bcrypt.hash(adminPass, 10);
      const id = await insert(
        'INSERT INTO users (name, email, phone, password, role) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',
        [adminName, adminEmail, '09000000000', hash, 'admin']
      );
      admin = await qOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [id]);
      console.log('[User] Admin created:', adminEmail, '/', adminPass);
    }else{
      await q('UPDATE users SET role = ? WHERE id = ?', ['admin', admin.id]);
      console.log('[User] Admin exists:', adminEmail);
    }

    const catMap = {};
    for(const c of CATS){
      let cat = await qOne('SELECT * FROM categories WHERE name = ?', [c.name]);
      if(!cat){
        const id = await insert(
          'INSERT INTO categories (name, slug, icon, color, order_num) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',
          [c.name, slugify(c.name), c.icon, c.color, c.order]
        );
        cat = await qOne('SELECT * FROM categories WHERE id = ?', [id]);
      }
      catMap[c.name] = cat.id;
    }
    console.log('[Category] ' + Object.keys(catMap).length + ' categories ready');

    let created = 0, skipped = 0;
    for(const p of PRODUCTS){
      const exists = await qOne('SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = ?', [p.name]);
      if(exists){ skipped++; continue; }

      const catId = catMap[p.cat];
      if(!catId) continue;

      const slug = slugify(p.name) + '-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);
      const prodId = await insert(
        'INSERT INTO products (name, slug, brand, category_id, price, off, rating, num_reviews, stock, sales, art, description, created_by) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
        [p.name, slug, p.brand, catId, p.price, p.off, p.rating, p.numReviews,
         p.stock, p.sales, p.art, p.description, admin.id]
      );

      for(const c of p.colors){
        await insert('INSERT INTO product_colors (product_id, name, hex) VALUES (?,?,?)',
          [prodId, c.name, c.hex]);
      }
      created++;
    }
    console.log('[Product] created: ' + created + ', skipped: ' + skipped);

    console.log('\n--- SEED DONE ---');
    console.log('Admin login:');
    console.log('  email:    ' + adminEmail);
    console.log('  password: ' + adminPass);
    console.log('');

    await pool.end();
    process.exit(0);
  }catch(err){
    console.error('[Seed error]', err);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();
```

```js
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');

const signAccess  = id => jwt.sign({ id }, process.env.JWT_SECRET,         { expiresIn: process.env.JWT_EXPIRE || '7d' });
const signRefresh = id => jwt.sign({ id }, process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET, { expiresIn: process.env.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRE || '30d' });
const verifyAccess  = t => jwt.verify(t, process.env.JWT_SECRET);
const verifyRefresh = t => jwt.verify(t, process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET);

function setCookies(res, access, refresh){
  const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
  res.cookie('accessToken', access, {
    httpOnly:true, sameSite:'lax', secure:isProd,
    maxAge: 7*24*60*60*1000
  });
  res.cookie('refreshToken', refresh, {
    httpOnly:true, sameSite:'lax', secure:isProd,
    maxAge: 30*24*60*60*1000
  });
}
function clearCookies(res){
  res.clearCookie('accessToken');
  res.clearCookie('refreshToken');
}
module.exports = { signAccess, signRefresh, verifyAccess, verifyRefresh, setCookies, clearCookies };
```

```js
async function uploadProductImage(file, onProgress){
  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append('image', file);
  return new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open('POST', API + '/upload/product-single', true);
    xhr.withCredentials = true;
    if(onProgress) xhr.upload.onprogress = function(e){
      if(e.lengthComputable) onProgress(Math.round((e.loaded / e.total) * 100));
    };
    xhr.onload = function(){
      try{
        const r = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText || '{}');
        if(xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300 && r.success) resolve(r.url);
        else reject(new Error(r.message || ('HTTP ' + xhr.status)));
      }catch(e){ reject(e); }
    };
    xhr.onerror = function(){ reject(new Error('خطای شبکه')); };
    xhr.send(fd);
  });
}

(function setupGlobalUpload(){
  'use strict';

  /* single hidden input created once */
  let picker = document.getElementById('__globalImgPicker');
  if(!picker){
    picker = document.createElement('input');
    picker.type = 'file';
    picker.id = '__globalImgPicker';
    picker.accept = 'image/*';
    picker.multiple = true;
    picker.style.position = 'fixed';
    picker.style.left = '-9999px';
    picker.style.top = '-9999px';
    picker.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(picker);
  }

  let currentTarget = null;    /* element that opened the picker */
  let currentFRef = null;      /* the F object of the open form */
  let currentRepaint = null;   /* repaint function to call */
  let currentToastArea = null;

  /* listen for clicks anywhere */
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    const btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('#uploadImgBtn');
    if(!btn) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    currentTarget = btn;

    /* find the F object + repaint function from the modal */
    currentFRef = window.__activeProductF || null;
    currentRepaint = window.__activeProductRepaint || null;

    if(!currentFRef){
      console.warn('[upload] no active product F reference');
    }

    picker.value = '';
    picker.click();
  }, true /* capture */);

  /* file selection */
  picker.addEventListener('change', async function(){
    const files = Array.from(picker.files || []);
    if(!files.length) return;

    if(!currentFRef){
      try{ toast('ابتدا فرم محصول را باز کنید.', 'warn'); }catch(_){}
      picker.value = '';
      return;
    }

    /* progress UI */
    let progressEl = document.getElementById('uploadProgress');
    let bar = progressEl && progressEl.querySelector('.adm-upload-bar i');
    let lbl = progressEl && progressEl.querySelector('.adm-upload-lbl');
    if(progressEl) progressEl.hidden = false;

    let done = 0;
    const total = files.length;

    for(let i = 0; i < files.length; i++){
      const f = files[i];
      if(f.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024){
        try{ toast('«' + f.name + '» بیش از ۵ مگابایت است.', 'warn'); }catch(_){}
        done++;
        continue;
      }
      try{
        if(lbl) lbl.textContent = 'در حال آپلود ' + (done+1) + ' از ' + total + '...';
        const url = await uploadProductImage(f, function(p){
          if(bar) bar.style.width = p + '%';
        });
        if(!Array.isArray(currentFRef.images)) currentFRef.images = [];
        currentFRef.images.push(url);
        if(typeof window.__activeProductRepaint === 'function') window.__activeProductRepaint();
        done++;
      }catch(err){
        console.error('[upload] error:', err);
        try{ toast('خطا در «' + f.name + '»: ' + (err.message || 'نامشخص'), 'err', 5000); }catch(_){}
        done++;
      }
    }

    if(progressEl) progressEl.hidden = true;
    if(bar) bar.style.width = '0%';
    if(done > 0){
      try{ toast(done + ' تصویر آپلود شد. یادت نره ذخیره کنی.', 'ok', 4500); }catch(_){}
    }
    picker.value = '';
    currentFRef = null;
    currentRepaint = null;
  });
})();
```
